title: Research Fellow - Administrative Data Research Centre NI
description:
This 48-month Research Fellow post is funded by the Administrative Data Research Centre Northern Ireland (ADRC NI) funded research programme, led by Dr Aideen Maguire (Director), which is part of Administrative Data Research UK (ADR UK), a partnership transforming the way researchers access the UK's wealth of public sector data, to enable better informed policy decisions that improve people's lives. ADRC NI is currently undertaking a large programme of work and is seeking an experienced post-doctoral research fellow to aid in the delivery of our research packages. The successful candidate will take the lead on projects related to ADRC NI's recently recommissioned programme which is due to run until 31 March 2031, with a specific focus on (a) assist the management of administrative data research in Northern Ireland's main Trusted Research Environments, and (b) explore new data sets and novel linkages to support investigation of patterns and relationships between social, structural and health-related outcomes for vulnerable and underserved groups.



The post will be expected to deliver and/or contribute to research within in the Underserved Groups work package, with particular focus on Understanding Homelessness, and the Enhancing Health Data work package, with particular focus on social determinants and outcomes related to Reproductive and Maternal Health.



*Reasonable requests for part-time working may be considered.

About The Person

The successful candidates must have, and your application should clearly demonstrate that you meet the following essential criteria:
- First or second class primary degree in a subject area relevant to the post and with a significant quantitative component
- Have or be about to obtain* a relevant PhD in cognate subjects.
- Significant administrative data research experience and skills relevant to this project
- Experience in handling, cleaning, and linking administrative data/routinely collected health data to prepare research-ready population-based datasets
- Experience in advanced statistical techniques to analyse large datasets, e.g. multivariate statistical analyses / survival analysis
- Recent, relevant experience of using statistical packages STATA or R to conduct reproducible research
- Research activity related to the use of large, complex, datasets.
- A demonstrable proficiency in academic paper writing
- A demonstrable interest and track record of research in at least one of the following areas: vulnerable and underserved groups or reproductive and maternal health
- Experience of working in a Trusted Research Environment (TRE), ideally in the Northern Ireland context.

This is not an exhaustive list. To be successful at shortlisting stage, please ensure you clearly evidence in your application how you meet the essential and, where applicable, desirable criteria listed in the Candidate Information on our website.

This post is available for 48 months or until 31 March 2031, whichever is soonest Fixed term contract posts are available for the stated period in the first instance but in particular circumstances may be renewed or made permanent subject to availability of funding.

description:
​​​

Big E's is a fast-paced, high-energy workplace, with endless opportunities for skill development and advancement. Come join the best team in the Food and Beverage and the Hospitality Industries!

* Available Shift: 2nd, FULL-TIME position

* Wage: Competitive pay - negotiable based on experience

* Position can be used as a paid internship

Benefits Include:

  • Hotel and restaurant discounts
  • Earned Paid Time Off for ALL Team Members
  • Insurance (health, vision, dental, life) for full time Team Members
  • Flexible schedules
  • Holiday Pay
  • 8 hours of paid volunteer time per year
  • Advancement and professional growth opportunities
  • 100% paid maternity/paternity or adoption leave for those who qualify for FMLA
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) through Pine Rest (3 free counseling visits, online library, and access to legal, financial and elder care consultations)

Position Summary
Responsible for assisting management with the overall Front of the House (FOH) in a manner most pleasing to guests, while following Suburban Inns’ Core Values, Suburban Inns/Big E’s standards, and local health department standards.
Essential Functions

  • Greet all guests in a friendly, positive manner. Ask questions of guests and make personal connections to make them feel they are welcome and valued
  • Meet labor goals as projected by management
  • Take reservations and check table reservation schedules
  • Conduct table touches to 100% of tables serviced
  • Carefully supervise FOH staff to help assure proper service
  • Lead, Manage, and Hold Team Members accountable to the standards of employment and job performance set by the core values of Suburban Inns. Discipline Team Members as needed, according to Suburban Inns’ policies
  • Assure that all side-work is accomplished and that all cleaning of equipment and storage areas is completed according to schedule
  • Assure the correct appearance, cleanliness, and safety of dining room areas, equipment, and fixtures. Check the maintenance of all equipment in the dining room and report deficiencies and maintenance concerns
  • Assist in service of guests as needed
  • Assure that the dining room areas are secure at the end of the business day
  • Attend scheduled staff meetings
  • Follow all Suburban Inns standards
  • Exhibit regular and recurrent attendance records
  • Other duties as requested by management

Position Requirements
Minimum Knowledge: Requires ability to interpret/extract information and/or perform arithmetic functions. May require typing, record keeping, or word processing skills. Good communication skills
Formal Education and Job-Related Experience: This position requires a minimum formal education of a High School Diploma or equivalent related experience plus a one-year job-related experience
License, Registration, and/or Certification Required: ServSafe, CPR, and TIPS Certification (may be completed upon hire)
Work Schedule: Work regularly requires or varies between day, evening, night, holiday, and/or weekend assignments. Schedule varies according to business demands and needs
Required Travel: Position may require travel to other Suburban Inns properties, client locations, or other locations.

Uniform and Appearance Guidelines
Uniform: Professional attire according to Suburban Inns guidelines. Shoes need to be closed-toed and non-slip.
Appearance: Hair must be kept well-groomed. All facial piercings and tattoos that are not covered by a work uniform must be approved by management. Any tattoo that is deemed offensive to co-workers, guests, vendors or others in the workplace based on racial, sexual, religious, ethnic, or other characteristics or attributes of a sensitive or legally protected nature are not permitted and must remain covered or concealed at all times. This policy will be administered by the position’s supervisor, without regard to race, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, height, weight, genetics, familial status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The Vice President of Operations has the authority to veto any decision made by the position’s supervisor
We are a dynamic organization in a rapidly changing industry. Accordingly, the responsibilities associated with this job will change from time to time in accordance with Suburban Inns’ business needs. More specifically, the incumbent may be required to perform additional and/or different responsibilities from those set forth above.

title: Product Development Intern (Fashion)
description:
About us

Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia’s leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Headquartered in Singapore, we’ve grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence.

For the next decade, we are looking to expand through new categories, markets, wholesale partnerships, and brand acquisitions. We are evolving into a next-generation regional consumer group — one that blends heart with performance, and creativity with technology.

At our core, we’re a team of builders, dreamers, and doers who believe culture is more than words on a wall — it’s how we show up every day. We move fast, stay curious, and take bold bets on ideas and people we believe in. Here, you’ll find a community that challenges you to grow, trusts you to lead, and celebrates you for being you. Together, we’re shaping the future of Asian brands — from right here in Southeast Asia, to the world.

Why join us?

At Love, Bonito, you’ll do more than just a job — you’ll help build a movement. We’re creating an organization that’s lean, bold, and full of heart — where every person has the space to make an impact. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Purpose with performance: We’re building a world-class Asian brand that competes globally. We hold ourselves to high standards and operate with purpose, integrity, grit and excellence
  • Growth that’s real: We are known to be incredibly dynamic and fast-paced. You’ll be expected to learn fast, stretch beyond your comfort zone, and work alongside people who challenge and support you in equal measure
  • Culture at our core: If you’re looking for a no-corporate-BS environment, we are the perfect fit for you. We operate with empathy, celebrate individuality, encourage effective collaboration, and believe great work comes from trust, not titles

Join us as we redefine what it means to build an enduring consumer group — from Asia, for the world.

The role

You will be responsible for assisting the Product Development team in every aspect of the process from daily adhoc administrative tasks to the sorting and preparation of our garments for fitting. This is a multi-faceted role that requires a dynamic individual with initiative - one who thrives in a fast paced and exciting environment but can remain calm under pressure.

You should have / be

  • Highly detail-oriented, meticulous, and well-organized
  • Effectively manage multiple tasks in high-pressure, fast-paced environments
  • Demonstrate a strong sense of responsibility by ensuring each task is completed thoroughly from start to finish
  • Proactive and capable of working independently, while also being a reliable and collaborative team player
  • Consistent and committed to completing the internship

Main responsibilities

Sample Management

    • Support product developers during fitting sessions by preparing the garments before and after each fitting session
    • Assist product developers in development of new styles

Administrative Support

    • Purchase fabrics, stationery, or other materials as needed by the team
    • Organise food orders for large meetings
    • Model dresser for buying sessions
    • Support event preparation through ad hoc errands

Data Entry

    • Upload fitting photos to internal systems
    • Transfer information from paper to digital systems (or between platforms)
    • Create powerpoint slides for meetings

Requirements

  • Minimum commitment of 6 months
  • All qualifications are welcome
  • Proficient in basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office. Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator would be an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail with a meticulous approach to tasks
  • Highly organized, efficient, and capable of handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is required, as the role involves entering data in Chinese
  • Open to Singaporeans and PRs only due to quota restrictions

Benefits

  • Market level internship salary and benefits provided
  • #TeamLB perks
    • Generous staff discount off LB products
    • Employee driven peer-to-peer recognition platform to honour and celebrate everyday achievements

title: Building/Infrastructure Executive (West)
description:
Requirements

  • Oversee daily building operations and facilities maintenance activities.
  • Conduct routine inspections of building facilities, equipment, and common areas to ensure operational readiness and compliance with safety requirements.
  • Coordinate and supervise maintenance contractors, service providers, and vendors.
  • Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance schedules for building systems, including electrical, mechanical, air-conditioning, fire protection, plumbing, and security systems.

  • Track asset usage, maintenance history, and replacement requirements.
  • Generate inventory and asset reports for management review.
  • Serve as the point of contact for facilities-related enquiries, requests, and feedback.

  • Deliver professional and responsive customer service to ensure high levels of stakeholder satisfaction.

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in facilities management, building operations, or inventory management.
  • Knowledge of building maintenance practices, contractor management, inventory control processes, and procurement activities.
  • Familiarity with Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) requirements and building safety regulations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and inventory management systems.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: [CLS][L4] Process Innovation Specialist(Quickflex Tactical Planning)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

CLS (Coupang Logistics Services)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다. CLS는 국토교통부로 지정 받은 택배운송사업자로서 전국단위의 배송캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업전담인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다. 로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

팀 소개

Quickflex Tactical Planning팀은 라스트마일 배송에서 가장 큰 비중(약 90%)을 담당하고 있는 Quickflex CAPA의 플래닝과 실적 관리, 프로세스 개선을 담당하고 있는 팀입니다. 예상되는 배송물량에 맞추어 Quickflex 인원의 출석율을 관리하여, 보다 효율적이고 안정적인 배송이 이루어질 수 있도록 관리하고 있습니다

업무 내용

• Daily / Weekly 퀵플렉서 스케줄 취합 및 분석을 통한 CAPA 관리
• 캠프/벤더/타 부서와의 협업을 통한 운영 업무
• CAPA 효율성을 향상시키기 위한 프로젝트성 개선 업무

자격 요건

• 연간/월간/주간 단위 플래닝 업무 경험 2년 이상 있으신 분
• 실적 트래킹을 통해 프로세스를 개선시키고 향상시킨 경험이 있으신 분
• 타 부서와의 원활한 소통을 위한 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분
• 스케줄근무 가능하신 분(주말 포함 주 5일 근무)

우대 사항

• 엑셀, 쿼리 등 플래닝 관련 문서작성 능력이 탁월하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형 절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고 사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangls.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

description:
Jouw baan: Mid-level Backend Engineer Amsterdam

  • Wil jij groeien als Mid-level Backend Engineer Amsterdam op distributed systems waarbij een betaling in één keer goed moet zijn, en nóg goed als een device retryt?
  • Wil je in een nieuw Go-team rond fysieke terminals stappen, waar een groot deel van de backend nog ontworpen moet worden, zodat je kunt pionieren in plaats van een af platform overnemen?
  • En zeg je ja tegen een vast contract vanaf dag één, tot €85.000 plus €20.000 stock, in een Amsterdams team met meer dan 30 nationaliteiten?

Dan is dit een rol die je aandacht waard is.

Jouw werkgever: payment-infrastructuur die ook in de winkel moet kloppen

Elke dag gaat geld door systemen waar de meeste mensen nooit over nadenken. Voor een ondernemer moet het instant voelen. Daaronder zit infrastructuur die beschikbaar, observeerbaar en correct moet zijn, 24/7.

Je toekomstige werkgever is een Amsterdamse fintech scale-up die die laag cloud-native bouwt. Geen checkout-widget. Core processing, al in productie voor serieuze klanten. Miljoenen mensen gebruiken die systemen al. Miljarden euro's gaan er al doorheen.

Nu komt de terminal erbij. Een device moet weten bij welke merchant het hoort, welke currency, welke stromen, hoe het veilig live gaat zonder ooit voor de winkel ernaast te kunnen werken. Dit nieuwe team mag de backend eromheen uitvinden. Er is nog meer te ontwerpen dan te onderhouden.

Dat is de onderliggende behoefte: jij wilt sterker worden in systemen waar idempotency, encryptie en failure handling geen tentamenvragen zijn. Ze zijn waarom een echte winkel een echte betaling aankan. Hier zie je nog het effect van je eigen code, omdat het bedrijf klein genoeg is om mensen bij naam te kennen en serieus genoeg dat verkeerde state echt geld is.

De mensen zijn scherp, laag ego en emotioneel intelligent. Ze houden van CS fundamentals en first-principles reasoning. Sterke meningen zijn welkom als je ze naar het whiteboard kunt lopen.

Jouw baan: Mid-level Backend Engineer Amsterdam

Als Mid-level Backend Engineer Amsterdam krijg je de kans om te groeien in een compact, nieuw gevormd Go-team, naast een CTO en seniors waar je waanzinnig snel kunt leren. Je bouwt mee aan systemen waar miljoenen mensen en miljarden euro's doorheen gaan. Je zit in het design, niet alleen in de implementatie. In dit team kun je je tanden zetten in de lelijke, interessante problemen. Wat gebeurt er als een device twee keer online komt? Als een retry twee keer zou afrekenen? title: Technical Director - Boccia (Full-Time, Contract 2+2 Years)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced and accomplished Technical Director to join the Singapore Disability Sports Council (SDSC) — at a pivotal moment for Singapore para sport. With ambitious Los Angeles 2028 and Brisbane 2032 Paralympic Games targets on the horizon, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the Boccia elite programme from the ground up and deliver results on both a home stage and the world stage.

The Technical Director serves as the senior technical authority and Lead Coach Developer for Boccia. You will lead the design and oversight of a world-class high performance programme, drive the integration of evidence-based coaching and sport science, and build Singapore’s Boccia coaching capability from development level through to elite. You will also contribute to athlete pathway and talent pipeline activities, working closely with the High Performance Manager across the full performance continuum.

Boccia presents unique programme leadership demands: four BC classification categories, sports assistant management, specialist equipment, and athletes with high physical care needs. The Technical Director must have deep sensitivity and professionalism in engaging with athletes, their sports assistants, and caregivers, and a working understanding of occupational therapy as it applies to Boccia performance.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Programme Leadership

• Lead and implement a world-class individualised high performance programme, grounded in innovative, evidence-based coaching, sport science, and sport medicine practices.
• Develop and maintain quadrennial and annual Performance and Pathway Plans, including detailed plans for identified athletes and clear benchmarks aligned to major Games cycles.
• Establish and maintain Daily Training Environment (DTE) standards that support elite athlete development, progression, and performance.
• Drive the integration of sport science, sport medicine, occupational therapy, and physiotherapy into training design and competition preparation.
• Set, monitor, and review KPIs for the national squad and programme, benchmarking progress against multi-year targets and international competitors.
• Develop and implement selection criteria and measurable performance standards, including squad entry, retention, and Games selection benchmarks.

Athlete Development & Support

• Provide technical oversight of individual athlete programmes, ensuring training plans are evidence-based, athlete-centred, and aligned with each athlete’s classification, event, and impairment profile.
• Oversee athlete well-being, actively contributing to a positive, inclusive, and safe sporting environment and culture.
• Support athlete classification processes: advise the High Performance Manager on classification status and liaise with international classifiers to ensure athletes are competition-ready.
• Play an active role in talent identification and transfer for Boccia: apply classification knowledge and sport-specific technical expertise to assess individuals with para sport potential, advise on sport class suitability and impairment-to-sport matching, and work with the High Performance Manager and SDSC’s Talent Identification function to build and sustain a strong athlete pipeline.
• Lead the implementation of the Long-Term Para Athlete Development (LTPAD) model, establishing development benchmarks, defining athlete transition criteria, and ensuring the talent pipeline is well-structured and regularly reviewed.

Coach Development (Lead Coach Developer)

• Design and implement a structured coaching development framework for Boccia, from community level through to elite.
• Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and performance feedback to Head Coaches and programme coaches, elevating coaching standards and building sustainable coaching capability within Singapore.
• Organise and lead workshops, on-deck/trackside/court-side training sessions, seminars, and certification opportunities covering Boccia-specific techniques, classification, sport science application, and evidence-based programme design.
• Lead the sharing of knowledge, experience, and expertise across all coaches and practitioners within the national programme.
• Develop a transparent coaching pathway that supports talent identification, coach retention, and long-term programme sustainability.

Competition and Major Games

• Provide technical leadership and coaching presence at major international competitions and training camps, including ASEAN Para Games, Asian Para Games, Paralympic Games, and relevant World Championships, World Boccia Cups, and World Boccia Challengers.
• Contribute to competition strategy, event selection, and team delegation composition for major championships.
• Advise on sport-specific equipment preparation and requirements for competition (including ramp setup, ball selection, and assistive device calibration).

Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with World Boccia and other relevant bodies, staying current on technical developments, rule changes, classification updates, and best practice.
• Represent SDSC at technical forums, international federation meetings, and coaching conferences.
• Work with the High Performance Manager and Pathway and Performance Director to contribute to programme reports, strategic plans, and budget proposals.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

• An internationally recognised Boccia coaching qualification or demonstrated and successful track record of coaching Boccia athletes across multiple BC classifications to medal success at Paralympic Games and/or World Boccia Championship events.
• Additional qualifications or expertise in sport science, occupational therapy, or performance analysis are highly valued.
• Minimum 8 years of high performance coaching or technical leadership experience in Boccia or a closely related para sport, including significant international competition experience.
• Deep working knowledge of Boccia classification categories (BC1–BC4), sports assistant regulations, equipment standards (ramps, balls, assistive devices), competition formats (Singles, Pairs, Team), and international competition calendars.
• Proven ability to design and deliver integrated, evidence-based Boccia performance programmes incorporating physiotherapy, sport science, and holistic athlete development.
• Demonstrated experience and cultural competence in developing Boccia coaches and building local coaching capacity.
• Sensitivity and professionalism in engaging with athletes who have complex physical support needs, their sports assistants, and caregivers.
• Strong knowledge of para athlete development frameworks and WADA anti-doping regulations.

Skills & Competencies

Required Skills
• Technical Coaching Expertise
• Communication Skills
• Works Independently
• Leadership & Mentoring
• Stakeholder Management
• Programme Planning

Preferred / good-to-have skills
• HP Programme Management
• Para / Disability Sport
• Athlete Development & TID
• DTE Design & Monitoring
• Classification Literacy
• Coach Development
• Sport Science Application
• Performance Analysis
• Anti-Doping Compliance
• Boccia BC1–BC4 Expertise
• OT / Allied Health Knowledge
• Sports Assistant Management
• Ramp / Equipment Analysis
• Competition Strategy (Boccia)

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your CV and a cover letter (including your current and expected salary, and the sport you are applying for or have experience in) to: sdsc.hr@sdsc.org.sg

Subject line: Application – Technical Director Boccia

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. SDSC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Role: Senior Integrated Project Manager (with Advertising agency background)

Location: Remote (México)

Language: Proficiency in English is required as we are a global business

About the role:

The Integrated Project Manager is responsible for running creative and production processes and working alongside our existing talented Project Management team to drive a project from brief to delivery. Leading on projects while working with our dynamic teams across the business, our project managers successfully deliver projects following BRANDTECH+’ ways of working.

What we want is a passionate, talented individual who can showcase their skills of managing multiple mid to high complexity projects. You should have meticulous attention to detail, understand the importance of the profitability of your projects for the agency and you will have proven yourself as a safe pair of hands on the day-to-day running of multiple prestigious projects.

What you will be doing:

GENERAL TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Have integrated experience across various disciplines which can include one or more of the following: Ai/Automation, Digital, Technology, Film, CGI, Motion Design and/or Print projects across different sized accounts and across different time zones; from initial brief to final delivery (based on experience)
  • Manage your team to deliver a wide range of deliverables from email marketing to website content
  • Strive to follow and implement the defined project management and production processes within BRANDTECH+ and with partners
  • Handle multiple projects simultaneously and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Face adversity, setbacks and negativity with a resilient mindset and attitude
  • Embody the company values, instil these behaviours within all team members
  • Drive continuous improvement through each step of the process and consult on process improvements
  • Close off projects to set standards/requirements

INITIATE & PLAN THE PROJECT:

  • Serve as the point of contact to receive new briefs and manage the process of transforming unclear briefs into well prepared briefs where applicable
  • Manage the scoping, costing and planning of projects across different briefs
  • Work to the BRANDTECH+ Project Management Way of Working while executing projects
  • Identify stakeholders and create a communication plan to ensure each of them has access to the right level of information
  • Set deadlines with partners and challenge unrealistic timelines to ensure workload is managed based on creative processes
  • Create project plan and identify key milestones for each of the projects you are assigned
  • Work closely with the Delivery Lead and Resource/Studio Manager to staff the project correctly based on the required deliverables and deadlines
  • Identify risks and possible issues and create risk registers
  • Work closely with the creative team to define a cost, scope and timeplan for the projects
  • Prepare and run effective and structured client and team kick-off meetings
  • Create and manage the delivery of project documentation

MANAGE PROJECT EXECUTION, MONITORING AND CONTROL:

  • Coordinate development and delivery among various project participants and stakeholders
  • Prioritize and manage workload of the project team
  • Partner liaison when required, presenting project scopes, cost estimates and timing plans
  • Build partner relationship and ensure their needs and requirements are addressed, while following the BRANDTECH+ ways of working
  • Monitor the progress of the project delivery within scope and budget with the planned resources
  • Prepare status reports for the stakeholders and actively manage the control of project progress using weekly action points
  • Follow the project management change control process for any changes needed in the scope, budget, timelines or resource requirement
  • Create and keep up to date all related project documentation and ensure compliance in the project management system
  • Proactively problem-solve, mitigate risks and plan for future issues
  • Be accountable for the financial profitability of the project and actively manage cost overburn and time logged daily
  • Ensure final deliverables are quality driven and comply to the design and production requirements and expectations
  • Monitor utilization and output of team

What you need to be great in this role:

  • Willingness to accept feedback and iterate over processes in a highly-collaborative, low-ego team environment.
  • Process driven and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Curiosity, creativity, and ambition.
  • Attention to detail.
  • The ability to take a project from brief to completion, good communication, organizational, and time management skills are essential.
  • Impeccable problem-solving skills and a love for client satisfaction.
  • 5+ years of experience and proven track record of successfully managed projects from start to end
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Strong organisational skills – able to multi-task and manage multiple projects with different deadlines at one time.
  • Good eye for detail and quality control experience.
  • Software competency – Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Zoom, Teams and OMG (BRANDTECH+ Marketing Gateway internal approval system - training will be provided).

title: Patient Services Assistant - Patient Transport
description:

As part of our supportive and vibrant team, you will play an important role in ensuring patients are transported safely and efficiently throughout the hospital, including to and from wards, theatres and diagnostic departments.

You will provide a high standard of patient care and assistance while working closely with nursing and clinical teams to support the smooth day-to-day operation of the hospital.

About You

We are looking for a caring, reliable and team-focused individual who is committed to providing safe and respectful patient support.

To be successful, you will have:

  • Certificate III in Health Services Assistance or equivalent
  • Recent and relevant experience within an acute hospital setting
  • A strong commitment to patient dignity, safety and quality care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • The ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Sound manual handling skills and the ability to safely use patient transport aids
  • A flexible and reliable approach to work
  • The ability to work a 7-day rotating roster, including evening, night and on-call shifts

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely transport patients between wards, theatres and diagnostic departments via wheelchair, bed or trolley
  • Assist with patient transfers and manual handling using appropriate aids and equipment
  • Prioritise patient dignity, comfort and safety throughout every transfer
  • Work closely with nursing and clinical staff to coordinate and prioritise patient transfers
  • Assist with urgent transfers and responses to emergencies as required
  • Clean, maintain and correctly store patient transport equipment
  • Monitor equipment to ensure it remains clean, safe and functional
  • Assist with minor environmental tasks or courier duties as required
  • Maintain a professional, respectful and caring approach when interacting with patients, visitors and staff
  • Follow hospital policies, procedures, infection prevention and control requirements, and workplace health and safety standards

You Will Also Bring

  • A patient-focused and compassionate approach
  • Confidence assisting patients with mobility and transfers
  • Good understanding of safe manual handling practices
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise tasks
  • Excellent communication skills across a multidisciplinary environment
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Reliability, flexibility and a willingness to support the team where required
  • Commitment to maintaining a safe, clean and efficient patient transport service

What’s in it for You:

At Ramsay, we care for our people by offering benefits that truly support your career, wellbeing and lifestyle, including:

  • Grow your career with recognition programs, employee referral bonuses, scholarships, free access to LinkedIn Learning and the Ramsay Leadership Academy
  • Save more every day with Ramsay Rewards, giving you exclusive deals at 100+ retailers, restaurants, travel providers and more
  • Enjoy peace of mind with lower hospital cover costs and higher extras limits on services like General and Major Dental, plus pharmacy and allied health discounts
  • Find balance through flexible rostering options, flexible leave and access to free, confidential counselling and wellbeing support 24/7
  • Increase your take-home pay through salary packaging and novated leasing, plus discounts on leisure travel, gyms and lifestyle services.

Why Join Ramsay:

At Ramsay Health Care, “people caring for people” is at the heart of everything we do. We are:

  • Australia’s largest private hospital operator, with over 74 sites and 35,000 staff
  • A values-led workplace where you’ll be supported personally and professionally
  • A place with flexible, permanent and career-growth opportunities nationwide.
  • Must provide or complete a National Police Check conducted within the previous 12 months.

You’ll work end-to-end across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and production AI pipelines.
The role combines hands-on product development with technical architecture, reliability, and engineering leadership.
You’ll work directly from real user problems, taking ideas from discovery through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
Your work will help automate complex workflows and make it significantly easier for organizations to navigate and manage grant applications.
As one of the early engineering hires, you’ll have substantial influence over architecture, technical standards, product direction, and engineering practices.

  • Work across the full technology stack to translate real user needs into practical, scalable product solutions.

  • Work with AI agents and tool-calling workflows where appropriate and incorporate AI-native development tools into daily engineering practices.

    • Strong PostgreSQL expertise, including experience with JSONB, query performance optimization, and database migrations.
    • Demonstrated full-stack development experience across technologies such as Next.js 15, React Query, Express, and BullMQ.

    • Experience working with multiple AI providers and understanding how to design flexible, production-ready AI architectures.
    • Strong debugging instincts and the ability to investigate and resolve issues in live production systems.
    • Exceptional autonomy and ownership, with the ability to identify problems, develop solutions, execute independently, and drive work through to completion.

    • Comfortable working in an environment where requirements and processes are not always fully defined, with a proactive approach to shaping solutions.

title: Supplier Carbon Analyst Intern - March 2027
description:

The main activities will be analyzing, updating, and improving procurement/supply chain data related to data gathering, calculation and simulation for carbon footprint calculation. This will concern following categories : packaging, agriculture, logistics, ...

Your key missions:

  • You will support the Climate team in the analysis and improvement of the methodology for calculating the scope 3 carbon footprint (non-FLAG and FLAG).

  • You will contribute to the integration and modeling of CO2 initiatives deployed at the group level.

  • You will support the implementation and monitoring of subsidiary CO2 action plans to achieve the 2030 CO2 ambition.

  • You will support other related projects: guidelines, external collaboration, legislation and standards, benchmarks, ...

  • You will contribute to the annual Extra-Financial reporting exercise on the Climate part.

If you recognize yourself in the description below, don’t wait to apply!

  • You are pursuing a Master’s Degree in Sustainability or Environmental Sciences specialization, or equivalent.

  • You ideally have a first experience, in Sustainability/ Carbon/ Data management.

  • You speak English fluently.

  • You master Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI is a plus.

  • You are curious, rigorous, and autonomous.

  • You are team-spirited and have very good analytical skills.

Please note: to apply, you must be able to complete 6 months of internship and have an agreement issued by your school/university.

And you'll benefit from these advantages:

title: Director, Transition & Integration
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Transition & Integration based in Canada.

This senior leadership role is responsible for the strategic planning and execution of complex, large-scale enterprise transitions and transformation initiatives. You will serve as the central point of accountability for integration success, ensuring continuity of services, effective change sequencing, and strong risk management throughout each phase. Working across operations, technology, people, and vendor teams, you will orchestrate multiple workstreams and proactively address dependencies and emerging pressure points. The role requires close partnership with executive and operational leaders to support timely decisions and maintain clear, consistent communication. You will also ensure that major changes are introduced sustainably without compromising service levels, operational performance, safety, or team morale. This is an opportunity to shape enterprise-wide initiatives with significant visibility and impact across a complex, national environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead and own transition and integration roadmaps for selected large-scale enterprise initiatives across planning, mobilization, execution, and stabilization phases.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability for transition outcomes, ensuring milestones, success measures, readiness requirements, and stabilization criteria are clearly defined and tracked.
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams to maintain alignment, readiness, accountability, and timely decision-making across concurrent initiatives.
  • Act as the enterprise focal point for transition coordination, providing visibility into progress, dependencies, risks, issues, and critical decisions.
  • Proactively identify and manage pressure points across technology, operations, people, vendors, resources, and service delivery, escalating issues early and driving resolution before they affect operations.
  • Maintain an integrated view of risks, issues, and dependencies in line with organizational risk management practices, while planning resource requirements to prevent competing demands and capacity constraints.

Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— Reno, NV Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

  • Bonus opportunities (holidays, short notice, strong feedback)

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

  • Apply to one location only
  • No phone calls (we contact strong matches)

• Experience working within Linux environments.

• Strong debugging and performance optimisation capabilities.

• Exposure to trading systems, market infrastructure, HFT, or exchange environments.

Why This Role

title: Director CRO Alliance - Commercial
description:
About Signant Health
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
About the Role
The Director, CRO Alliance is responsible for managing, implementing and delivering CRO partnership strategy and vision, utilizing their strong relationships within the CRO industry to enable successful collaborations and meet annual partnership objectives. They will closely collaborate with CRO executives and senior leaders to grow and maintain strategic partnerships that drive mutual value and enhance service delivery capabilities.
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Build and maintain strategic relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers within global CRO organizations, focusing on top-tier CROs and regional leaders.
Lead partnership strategy across assigned CRO portfolio to meet or exceed partnership revenue targets, focusing on collaborative growth, service integration, and joint business development opportunities.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of CRO partner pipeline, taking a methodical approach to partnership activities, including long-term strategic planning, revenue sharing models, and implementation of joint solutions.
Effectively develop, communicate and implement partnership solutions aligned with CRO service offerings and strategic objectives, ensuring seamless integration of technologies and services.
Leverage existing relationships and build new connections within CRO organizations to identify and execute collaborative solutions and drive strategic partnership expansion.
Successfully collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with CRO partner initiatives, facilitate joint implementations, and support complex partnership opportunities.
Represents Signant Health at major CRO and industry events, participating in partnership-focused commercial activities to build brand awareness, maintain executive-level relationships, and identify strategic opportunities.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
Essential:

Proven success in CRO partnership management or strategic alliance development, with experience developing and managing relationships with global CRO organizations.
Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, including the ability to present partnership solutions and strategic vision at the board and C-suite level.
Extensive experience within the CRO industry, with emphasis on strategic partnerships and service integration.
Strong business acumen with focus on partnership outcomes, along with advanced analytical skills and a strategic, innovative mindset.
Dynamic and adaptive in approach to managing complex CRO relationships and stakeholder expectations.
Demonstrated ability to drive individual excellence while elevating partnership team performance and collaboration.

Desirable:

Experience with partnership management platforms and strategic alliance planning tools.
Strong partnership team leadership and executive relationship management ability.
Bachelor's degree, MBA preferred.

Why Signant Health?
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Senior Cardiologist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cardiologist based in Canada.

As Senior Cardiologist, you will provide scientific and medical leadership across cardiac safety, cardiac efficacy, and digital physiology solutions supporting clinical research. You will serve as a trusted cardiology expert for pharmaceutical sponsors, internal teams, and external stakeholders. The role combines clinical expertise with consulting, endpoint development, regulatory strategy, and scientific innovation. You will contribute to global clinical programs and help shape approaches to cardiac safety and efficacy throughout drug development. Your work will support high-quality evidence generation and informed regulatory decision-making. This is a highly visible opportunity to collaborate with clinicians, scientists, technologists, and life sciences organizations on programs that can accelerate the delivery of new therapies to patients worldwide

Accountabilities:

  • Provide cardiology expertise to pharmaceutical sponsors across consulting engagements, including protocol design, cardiac safety and efficacy strategies, statistical analysis plans, expert reports, and regulatory representation.
  • Serve as a cardiology liaison across internal functions, supporting cardiologist activities, cardiac solutions, safety consulting, compliance strategies, and related medical initiatives.
  • Provide clinical consulting for digital physiology and other specialized endpoints, supporting cross-functional opportunities and therapeutic-area strategies.
  • Participate in discussions with prospective and existing clients regarding clinical studies requiring cardiac safety or efficacy expertise.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of cardiology policies, procedures, SOPs, review guidelines, and approaches for emerging digital physiology endpoints.
  • Monitor advances in cardiac safety, cardiac efficacy, electrocardiography, and related scientific fields and share relevant developments with internal stakeholders.
  • Support the generation and interpretation of endpoint data from ECGs, Holters, patch devices, stress tests, blood pressure variability assessments, and other cardiac measures, including quality assurance and quality control activities.
  • Contribute to the improvement of ECG core laboratory procedures, with a focus on interpretation quality, consistency, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide scientific and clinical expertise to support commercial and business-development activities when required.
  • Contribute to the development and validation of clinical systems and technology platforms used to support cardiac and digital physiology programs.
  • Participate in scientific meetings, research collaborations, and interactions with regulatory authorities.
  • Provide leadership and subject-matter expertise in statistical innovation and research, contributing to sponsor discussions around statistical design, analysis, and broader clinical development strategies.

    • Requirements

    • MD degree is required.
    • ABIM Board Certification in Cardiovascular Disease is required; Canada-based candidates with active U.S. board certification are encouraged to apply.
    • Clinical Cardiac Electrophysiology training is preferred.
    • At least 3 years of pharmaceutical-industry experience as an employed cardiologist or consultant, particularly within early-phase drug development.
    • 5+ years of clinical cardiology and electrocardiography experience is preferred.
    • Prior experience working directly with or consulting for pharmaceutical sponsors.
    • Strong knowledge of cardiac safety and efficacy principles, with familiarity with ICH E14 guidance preferred.
    • Experience with concentration-effect modeling is preferred.
    • Experience preparing or authoring reports supporting QT waivers is desirable.
    • Working knowledge of clinical pharmacology is an advantage.
    • Strong ability to interpret and assess cardiac endpoint data, including ECG and related physiological measurements.
    • Excellent scientific, medical, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with pharmaceutical sponsors, clinicians, scientists, statisticians, regulatory stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
    • Strong professional judgment, high ethical standards, and a consistent commitment to integrity and professionalism.
    • Ability to work effectively in a global, collaborative environment and contribute strategically across multiple clinical and scientific initiatives.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation aligned with the Canadian market.
      • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
      • Retirement benefits and financial-support programs.
      • Opportunities to contribute to global, high-impact clinical development programs.
      • Collaboration with leading scientists, clinicians, statisticians, and technology specialists.
      • Exposure to innovative cardiac safety, efficacy, and digital physiology technologies.
      • Opportunities for ongoing professional development, scientific collaboration, and research engagement.
      • The opportunity to influence clinical research, regulatory strategy, and evidence generation for therapies intended to improve patient outcomes worldwide.
      • Remote work opportunity within Canada.

title: ServiceNow Solution Architect — HAM/SAM
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a ServiceNow Solution Architect — HAM/SAM based in Canada.

This role leads the architecture and delivery of enterprise ServiceNow solutions focused on Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Software Asset Management (SAM), and broader IT Asset Management (ITAM).
You will translate complex business needs into scalable, sustainable architectures that improve asset visibility, governance, compliance, and technology investment decisions.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with clients and delivery teams throughout discovery, design, implementation, deployment, and optimization.
The role spans ServiceNow capabilities including HAM, SAM, CMDB, CSDM, ITOM, ITSM, Discovery, Service Catalog, and Procurement.
You will shape data strategies and integrations across enterprise platforms, endpoint-management tools, procurement systems, ERP environments, and discovery sources.
Working across architects, developers, project managers, and stakeholders, you will provide technical leadership while ensuring high-quality, measurable delivery outcomes.
This is an opportunity to influence enterprise technology strategies while solving complex asset-management challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead end-to-end solution architecture for ServiceNow HAM and SAM engagements, from discovery and requirements gathering through implementation, deployment, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a senior technical advisor across HAM, SAM, ITAM, CMDB, CSDM, ITOM, and ITSM, providing guidance aligned with platform capabilities and industry best practices.
  • Facilitate customer workshops, architecture reviews, requirements sessions, and technical design discussions, translating business objectives into practical solution architectures.
  • Design HAM solutions covering the complete hardware lifecycle, including procurement, receiving, inventory, stockroom management, assignment, transfers, refresh, returns, retirement, and disposal.
  • Architect SAM solutions covering software discovery, normalization, software models, publisher content, license entitlements, reconciliation, compliance, reclamation, and optimization.
  • Define strategies for maintaining accurate, trusted asset and configuration data across ServiceNow and connected enterprise systems, including ERP, procurement, endpoint-management, discovery, and contract-management platforms.
  • Establish data governance, process controls, and quality standards that improve the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and auditability of asset, entitlement, contract, and CMDB information.
  • Design integrations and technical architectures using appropriate APIs, web services, authentication mechanisms, and enterprise integration technologies.
  • Provide engineers with architectural blueprints, technical specifications, data models, integration requirements, and implementation guidance.
  • Oversee solution quality across configuration, customization, integrations, data migration, testing, security, deployment, and operational readiness.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration gaps, and governance concerns throughout delivery.
  • Collaborate with delivery leaders, architects, developers, project managers, and client stakeholders to achieve agreed outcomes within scope, budget, and timelines.
  • Support a high-performing delivery culture through effective communication, technical mentoring, knowledge sharing, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Research emerging ServiceNow capabilities, industry trends, and innovative approaches to recommend platform enhancements and continuous improvements.
  • Deliver measurable outcomes such as stronger asset visibility, improved lifecycle control, greater software compliance, cost optimization, and increased operational efficiency.

    • Requirements

    • 8–12 years of experience in IT services, enterprise architecture, consulting, solution delivery, or a closely related field, including at least 4 years of hands-on ServiceNow experience.
    • Significant experience architecting or implementing ServiceNow HAM, SAM, ITAM, or related asset-management solutions within enterprise environments.
    • Strong understanding of hardware asset lifecycle management, including procurement, receiving, inventory, stockroom operations, deployment, reclamation, refresh, return, and disposal.
    • Strong knowledge of software asset-management practices, including software discovery, normalization, software models, publisher content, entitlements, license reconciliation, compliance, and optimization.
    • Experience with ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM principles and the governance of asset and configuration data.
    • Experience designing integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms such as ERP and procurement systems, endpoint-management tools, discovery platforms, contract-management systems, and software-license data sources.
    • Familiarity with ServiceNow ITOM capabilities, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, Cloud Management, Orchestration, CMDB, and CSDM.
    • Strong ServiceNow configuration and development knowledge, including JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, UI Pages, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and REST/SOAP APIs.
    • Experience with enterprise integration technologies and protocols such as SSO, SAML, SSL/TLS, web services, LDAP, JDBC, ODBC, SOAP, SCP, and FTPS.
    • Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, technical designs, data flows, functional requirements, and implementation documentation.
    • Strong client-facing communication, workshop facilitation, requirements analysis, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • A consultative and product-minded approach, with the ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and long-term sustainability.
    • Strong engineering judgment and a commitment to applying sound architecture and delivery principles.
    • Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to changing requirements, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.
    • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is preferred.
    • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certification in Hardware Asset Management, Software Asset Management, or related product areas is strongly preferred.
    • Additional ServiceNow certifications covering CMDB, ITSM, ITOM, or other platform areas are considered an advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and expertise.
      • Opportunity to work on complex, enterprise-scale ServiceNow architecture and asset-management initiatives.
      • Exposure to a broad technology landscape spanning HAM, SAM, ITAM, CMDB, CSDM, ITOM, ITSM, integrations, and enterprise systems.
      • Client-facing responsibilities that provide significant ownership and influence over solution strategy and delivery.
      • Collaborative environment bringing together architects, developers, project managers, and business stakeholders.
      • Opportunities for continued professional growth through exposure to evolving ServiceNow capabilities and industry practices.
      • Supportive and inclusive workplace culture where diverse perspectives are valued and employees are encouraged to contribute.
      • Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities while taking meaningful ownership of technical outcomes.
      • Opportunity to make a measurable impact on asset governance, software compliance, operational efficiency, and technology cost optimization.

title: Technical Director - Para Athletics (Full-Time, Contract 2+2 Years)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced and accomplished Technical Director to join the Singapore Disability Sports Council (SDSC) — at a pivotal moment for Singapore para sport. With ambitious Los Angeles 2028 and Brisbane 2032 Paralympic Games targets on the horizon, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the Para Athletics elite programme from the ground up and deliver results on both a home stage and the world stage.

The Technical Director serves as the senior technical authority and Lead Coach Developer for Para Athletics. You will lead the design and oversight of a world-class high performance programme, drive the integration of evidence-based coaching and sport science, and build Singapore’s Para Athletics coaching capability from development level through to elite. You will also contribute to athlete pathway and talent pipeline activities, working closely with the High Performance Manager across the full performance continuum.

This is SDSC’s most technically complex coaching leadership role, spanning multiple track and field disciplines across standing, vision-impaired (VI), and wheelchair classifications. Candidates should have demonstrable experience across at least two of the three classification groups.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Programme Leadership

• Lead and implement a world-class individualised high performance programme, grounded in innovative, evidence-based coaching, sport science, and sport medicine practices.
• Develop and maintain quadrennial and annual Performance and Pathway Plans, including detailed plans for identified athletes and clear benchmarks aligned to major Games cycles.
• Establish and maintain Daily Training Environment (DTE) standards that support elite athlete development, progression, and performance.
• Drive the integration of sport science, sport medicine, strength and conditioning, and sports psychology into training design and competition preparation.
• Set, monitor, and review KPIs for the national squad, benchmarking progress against multi-year targets and international competitors.
• Develop and implement selection criteria and measurable performance standards, including squad entry, retention, and Games selection benchmarks.

Athlete Development & Support

• Provide technical oversight of individual athlete programmes, ensuring training plans are evidence-based, athlete-centred, and aligned with each athlete’s classification, event, and impairment profile.
• Oversee athlete well-being, actively contributing to a positive, inclusive, and safe sporting environment and culture.
• Support athlete classification processes: advise the High Performance Manager on classification status and liaise with international classifiers to ensure athletes are competition-ready.
• Play an active role in talent identification and transfer for Para Athletics: apply classification knowledge and sport-specific technical expertise to assess individuals with para sport potential, advise on sport class suitability and impairment-to-sport matching, and work with the High Performance Manager and SDSC’s Talent Identification function to build and sustain a strong athlete pipeline.
• Lead the implementation of the Long-Term Para Athlete Development (LTPAD) model, establishing development benchmarks, defining athlete transition criteria, and ensuring the talent pipeline is well-structured and regularly reviewed.
• Advise on guide-athlete relationships for vision-impaired athletes, supporting the High Performance Manager in guide accreditation, athlete-guide pairing, and welfare considerations specific to VI Para Athletics.

Coach Development (Lead Coach Developer)

• Design and implement a structured coaching development framework for Para Athletics, from community level through to elite.
• Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and performance feedback to Head Coaches and programme coaches, elevating coaching standards and building sustainable coaching capability within Singapore.
• Organise and lead workshops, on-deck/trackside/court-side training sessions, seminars, and certification opportunities covering Para Athletics-specific techniques, classification, sport science application, and evidence-based programme design.
• Lead the sharing of knowledge, experience, and expertise across all coaches and practitioners within the national programme.
• Develop a transparent coaching pathway that supports talent identification, coach retention, and long-term programme sustainability.

Competition and Major Games

• Provide technical leadership and coaching presence at major international competitions and training camps, including ASEAN Para Games, Asian Para Games, Paralympic Games, and relevant World Championships and Grand Prix events.
• Contribute to competition strategy, event selection, and team delegation composition for major championships.
• Advise on sport-specific equipment preparation and requirements for competition (including prosthetics, racing wheelchairs, throwing frames, and guide tethers).

Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with World Para Athletics and other relevant bodies, staying current on technical developments, rule changes, classification updates, and best practice.
• Represent SDSC at technical forums, international federation meetings, and coaching conferences.
• Work with the High Performance Manager and Pathway and Performance Director to contribute to programme reports, strategic plans, and budget proposals.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

• An internationally recognised coaching qualification or demonstrated and successful track record of coaching para athletes across multiple disciplines and impairment classifications (track and/or field; standing, VI, and/or wheelchair) to medal success at Paralympic Games and/or World Para Athletics Championships.
• Additional qualifications or expertise in biomechanics, sport science, or performance analysis are highly valued.
• Minimum 8 years of high performance coaching or technical leadership experience in athletics, including significant experience at the international para athletics level.
• Deep working knowledge of World Para Athletics classification systems (standing, VI, wheelchair), technical rules, equipment regulations (including prosthetics and racing wheelchairs), and competition calendars including Grand Prix circuits.
• Proven ability to design and deliver integrated, evidence-based performance programmes incorporating biomechanics, sport science, sport medicine, and holistic athlete development across diverse track and field disciplines.
• Demonstrated experience and cultural competence in engaging and developing coaches at the high performance level.
• Understanding of guide-athlete relationships and VI athlete welfare considerations specific to Para Athletics.
• Strong knowledge of para athlete development frameworks and WADA anti-doping regulations.

Skills & Competencies

Required Skills
• Technical Coaching Expertise
• Communication Skills
• Works Independently
• Leadership & Mentoring
• Stakeholder Management
• Programme Planning

Preferred / good-to-have skills
• HP Programme Management
• Para / Disability Sport
• Athlete Development & TID
• DTE Design & Monitoring
• Classification Literacy
• Coach Development
• Sport Science Application
• Performance Analysis
• Anti-Doping Compliance
• Biomechanics Application
• Multi-Discipline Coaching
• Guide / VI Athlete Management
• Adaptive Equipment Expertise

title: Ringahāpai Tumu Herenga Waka Terminal Operator
description:
About Z
Z has a clear purpose: Powering better journeys, today and tomorrow. As one of New Zealand’s largest transport energy companies, we have a commitment to delivering safe, secure, and reliable transport energy – with the opportunity to deliver new journeys, with new energy solutions in a changing world.

We are proud to be the Kiwi contingent of Ampol, an independent Trans-Tasman energy company, with trading offices across the globe, which are united behind our shared purpose. While many of the challenges and opportunities we face go beyond national boundaries, together we have the scale, influence, and capability to deliver for our customers, communities, and our people.

About Supply
Our Supply team are the team that fuels our customers, literally! Supply at Z Energy looks after the whole fuel supply chain and ensures our customers have energy when and where they need it. Our terminals and aviation teams are a critical part of this network that includes high hazard facilities, refuelling operations and industry joint ventures.

About the role
We are looking to welcome a Ringahāpai Tumu Herenga Waka Terminal Operator to the Z whānau based at our Timaru Terminal. This is a 12-month fixed term contract.

So, what is a Terminal? A Terminal is a critical piece of infrastructure that receives petrol and diesel from Ships which is pumped into large storage tanks. Trucks then load at the Terminal and deliver to Service Stations and Truck Stops to meet the energy needs of our customers.

What does working at a Z Fuel Terminal involve? A typical day might see you recording stock movements, carrying out Safety and Wellbeing observations, assisting bulk Ship receipts into storage tanks, taking fuel samples to check the quality, inducting contractors onto site, and more. Our Terminal Operations typically happen during business hours Monday to Friday, however at times there is a need for overtime (afterhours and weekends).

It’s a great opportunity to start a new career, previous experience welcomed but not essential, as on the job training will be provided.

A career as a Ringahāpai Tumu Herenga Waka Terminal Operator is a great option for practically minded people who enjoy process and procedure, knowing how things work and the variety of working inside and outside an office. If you are looking to join a small and cohesive team, we would love to hear from you!

You will have the opportunity to

  • Work in a close-knit team at the Terminal carrying out tasks such as: receiving petroleum products from Ships into our bulk tanks, tank gauging, product sampling & testing, product transfers, compliance checks and forklift operations etc.
  • Learn and comply with Safety and Wellbeing policies, standards and procedures to ensure the Terminal is run in a safe and reliable way
  • Train to become certified in ‘Shore Officer’ and ‘Permit to Work’ responsibilities
  • Help supervise and coordinate maintenance activities and record completed tasks in Z’s maintenance system
  • Provide administrative support with the day-to-day running of the Terminal. This includes stock management, purchasing activities and ad hoc other administrative tasks
  • Participate and learn from regular training

What you’ll bring to Z

  • High level of communication and interpersonal skills
  • Willingness to work inside and outside an office
  • A practical and hands-on nature, basic mechanical understanding would be helpful but not essential
  • Good work ethic and a great team player
  • Computer literate with the ability to learn new systems
  • Capable of passing regular medicals including drug and alcohol testing
  • A full and clean driver’s licence

And of course, you’ll be passionate about what matters to Z, embracing and living our values to help us deliver on our aspirations and broader commitment to Aotearoa New Zealand.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Z we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

What we can offer you

  • A competitive remuneration package including an enhanced employer contribution for KiwiSaver
  • Access to Z’s Benefits & Recognition platform providing you access to retail discounts and cashbacks at over 150+ retailers in Aotearoa New Zealand that assist with everyday living expenses
  • The opportunity to contribute and be part of a supportive team that is here to make a difference
  • A chance to build your own capability through learning from some of the industry’s most knowledgeable people who have a desire to share their insights along with access to upskilling opportunities and career development across the organisation
  • Two days a year to do Good in your Hood, though our volunteering scheme, a chance for you to help others in your community in a meaningful way to you


The base salary range for this role is $67,400 to $75,000 per annum, plus a 5% KiwiSaver employer contribution.

Why Z?

Z has always been a proud Kiwi company. We’re aspirational for our future, confident of our role in Aotearoa New Zealand’s success and deeply loyal to our customers, communities and people.

At Z we focus on achieving extraordinary outcomes by setting the appropriate context, rather than by telling our people what to do. By doing this, high performing and talented people deliver better results and are more personally fulfilled.

We’re distinctive in our approach and if you’re up for a challenge, we’d love you to be part of it. If Z sounds like a place you believe you can add value and grow your own capability, then make sure you read Our Why. This is our founding document and provides further insights in what it means to part of the Z whānau.

If Z feels like a good match for your head and your heart, come join us for one heck of a journey!

Whakauru | Apply

Please include a cover letter in your application, telling us why you’re a great fit for Z.

Applications close: Tuesday 22nd September 2026

Please note that we may begin shortlisting as we receive applications. We encourage early applications as we may withdraw the advertising at any time.

To be considered for this position you must have the legal right to live and work in New Zealand

We care deeply for our people while pushing them to achieve their best as individuals and collectively as an organisation. Our flexible working approach and Rainbow Tick and Gender Tick accreditations - backed by our strong Group values, Whakatika Move as One, Whakaora Make it Happen, Whakamana Make it Count - have created an open and inclusive workplace that promotes personal development and is underpinned by a desire for our people and our communities to succeed.

One of the things we stand for at Z is Diversity & Inclusion. It is our belief that having a diverse workforce make it possible for our people to truly be themselves and deliver on our aspirations for Z.

title: SoC Execution and Customer Engagements Lead - Taiwan
description:
About the role

TylSemi is looking for a SoC Execution and Customer Engagements Lead who can sit at the intersection of silicon, supply chain, and customer success. You will own the operational thread that connects our stretagic initiatives to customers and semiconductor supply chain — making sure every engagement moves with precision from idea to silicon.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at a company in its earliest and most consequential stage. You will work directly with founders, customers, the leading semiconductor ecosystem players. No layers, no ambiguity about impact.

What you'll do

  • Manage all active customer engagements end-to-end: from architectural spec alignment through tape-out, KGD testing, packaging, and volume shipment milestones
  • Ensure alignment with ecosystem partners — including foundries, OSAT/packaging houses, EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence), and IP partners
  • Translate customer requirements (silicon architecture, interface specs, package form factor, delivery schedules) into internal program plans with clear owners and dates
  • Build and maintain program trackers, risk registers, and executive dashboards covering each engagement
  • Drive gate reviews and weekly program syncs across internal RTL/DV, physical design, and validation teams
  • Manage internal and external scoping and delivery timelines in coordination with technical and business teams
  • Identify and escalate risks early; propose and implement mitigations before they become schedule threats

What you bring

  • 15+ years of technical program or project management experience in semiconductor, custom silicon, or chiplet/advanced packaging environments
  • Direct experience interfacing with ecosystem partners — chip development schedules, interdepencies on EDA and IP, tape-out schedules and silicon bringup timelines
  • Familiarity with silicon fabrication, advanced packaging formats: CoWoS, InFO, 2.5D/3D integration, substrate/interposer-based assembly
  • Technical fluency in SoC or chiplet design flows — enough to understand RTL milestones, DV sign-off, PD handoffs, and silicon bring-up phases without needing translation
  • Strong communication skills — comfortable presenting program status and risk posture to internal and external stakeholders
  • Proficiency with program tracking tools (and spreadsheet-based trackers); experience building program infrastructure from scratch is a plus
  • Familiarity with key connectivity IPs UCIe, PCIe Gen 5/6/7+, or high-bandwidth D2D interconnect standards is a strong plus

Nice to Have to Shine

  • Prior experience at a chiplet startup, merchant silicon company, or systems company
  • Background in AI/ML infrastructure silicon — accelerators, network switches, CPO-enabled platforms
  • Familiarity with IVR/PMIC integration challenges in advanced packaging
  • Exposure to EDA infrastructure programs (SNPS/CDNS cloud flows)

title: Data Modeler
