Functie

We zijn op zoek naar een getalenteerde datamodelleerder die ons internationale team komt versterken en een sleutelrol gaat spelen bij het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van een consistent, schaalbaar en hoogwaardig bedrijfsdatamodel binnen een modern Unified Data Platform.
In deze functie werk je nauw samen met zakelijke stakeholders, dataproductteams en architecten om logische en fysieke datamodellen te ontwerpen die de ambitie van de organisatie ondersteunen om een echt datagestuurde onderneming te worden. Je draagt bij aan standaarden, governance en best practices op het gebied van datamodellering, terwijl je ervoor zorgt dat datamodellen nauwkeurig en herbruikbaar blijven en aansluiten bij de bedrijfsbehoeften.
  • Ondersteun de ontwikkeling en het levenscyclusbeheer van het bedrijfsdatamodel.
  • Ontwerp, ontwikkel en onderhoud logische en fysieke datamodellen.
  • Definieer en promoot standaarden, richtlijnen, sjablonen en best practices voor datamodellering.
  • Ondersteun dataproductteams bij het ontwerpen van schaalbare datamodellen van hoge kwaliteit.
  • Zet bedrijfsconcepten en bronsystemen om in gestandaardiseerde gegevensstructuren.
  • Beoordeel en integreer modelwijzigingen en zorg daarbij voor consistentie, kwaliteit en governance.
  • Zorg voor afstemming tussen het bedrijfsgegevensmodel, de bedrijfswoordenlijst en het raamwerk voor gegevensgovernance.
  • Meet en monitor de acceptatie en de zakelijke impact van het bedrijfsgegevensmodel.
  • Werk samen met multifunctionele teams om de werkwijzen op het gebied van gegevensmodellering voortdurend te verbeteren.

Functie-eisen
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in datamodellering of een vergelijkbare functie.
  • Grondige kennis van zowel genormaliseerde als gedenormaliseerde datamodellen.
  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden met praktische ervaring in data-analyse.
  • Ervaring met het Teradata Vantage Data Model of een vergelijkbaar raamwerk voor bedrijfsdatamodellering.

  • Ervaring met werken in Agile-omgevingen.
  • Goed begrip van de principes van datagovernance en datakwaliteit.
  • Sterke vaardigheden op het gebied van samenwerking en stakeholdermanagement.
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om zakelijke en technische stakeholders op één lijn te brengen.
  • Vloeiend in het Engels.

Aanbod

Je wordt verloond naar takenpakket, kennis en competenties. Met zorg werken wij een motiverend salarispakket uit inclusief een interessant extralegaal pakket met een groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een jaarlijks budget voor de aankoop van persoonlijk IT-materiaal, ... Tevens bieden we je graag een bedrijfswagen met laad- of tankkaart aan.

Wat echt telt
Jij en jouw persoonlijke wensen en noden staan voor ons centraal. Aan de hand van persoonlijke opvolging en contacten streven we samen naar jouw gewenste carrière. We bieden je de doorgroeimogelijkheden en uitdagingen die je ambieert, en begeleiden je aan de hand van een professioneel opleidings- en evolutiebeleid. Work-life balance vinden we belangrijk, in dit kader bieden wij ook graag flexibiliteit. Daarnaast organiseren we jaarlijks tal van superfijne evenementen waar we jou steeds voor uitnodigen! Zo zijn we ook elk jaar als sponsor aanwezig op enkele festivals.
Al het bovenstaande, en veel meer, zorgt ervoor dat wij jaar na jaar de award voor Great Place to Work binnenhalen!

Freelance? Aarzel zeker niet om ons te contacteren voor een voorstel op maat. En ja, ook als freelancer kan je genieten van opleidingen en evenementen via IT-Planet!

title: Director, Quality Assurance, Combination Products
description:
Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNATM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit .
At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney.

Position Summary:
The Director, Quality Assurance Combination Products will report to the Vice President of Quality Assurance and oversee the quality oversight of design controls and risk management of the combination product projects from inception through commercialization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in drug delivery systems, medical devices and combination product regulations involving biologics. Exceptional organizational, clear communication, strong interpersonal skills, and strategic agility are essential for effectively conveying quality requirements to stakeholders across various functions and external partners. This role will involve collaboration with cross-functional teams and external partners to ensure that combination products meet regulatory standards, and are safe and effective for patient use.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the quality and compliance of combination products, ensuring they meet regulatory standards and company objectives.
  • Develop and implement quality strategies and processes for combination products, in alignment with company goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as the QA contact for all quality-related inquiries and issues concerning device and combination products.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product development, manufacturing, clinical development, supply chain, commercial, quality, and regulatory affairs, to ensure quality and compliance throughout the combination product lifecycle.
  • Help define and implement as appropriate quality standards/specification, methods, systems, and metrics for clinical and commercial quality operations.
  • Stay up-to-date with changes in medical device and combination product regulations and industry best practices.
  • Participate in the development, review and approval of product documentation, including design control, risk management, and validation.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities within the Design History File and Risk Management and track to closure.
  • Collaborate with external partners and suppliers to ensure quality and compliance with company standards. Perform quality assurance oversight for validation studies conducted by external partners.
  • Communicate effectively with senior management to provide updates on the status of quality and compliance for medical device / combination product.
  • Participate in preparation for and execution of regulatory audits. Ensures audit observations related to functional area are addressed appropriately and completed on schedule.
  • Act as the Quality representative on assigned product teams to advocate compliance and quality assurance.
  • Availability for 5-15% travel, both domestically and internationally.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering, chemical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in quality oversight of drug product device development, with a proven track record of successful product launches.
  • Experience in quality oversight of design controls and combination products is required.
  • In-depth knowledge of global medical device/combination products standards such as 21 CFR Parts 803, 806, and 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 and EU MDR.

title: Software Engineer: Data Pipelines and ML (Mid-career / Senior)
description:
About the role

Theia Insights builds foundational financial intelligence products, including industry classification, knowledge graphs and factor risk models, for institutional investors. We serve some of the largest asset managers, hedge funds, index providers and sell-side banks.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain pipelines that classify global public equities across our five-level taxonomy, sector, industry, sub-industry, major theme and micro theme, by extracting information from filings and web content, and assigning thematic exposures based on this information.
  • Run large-scale NLP and LLM inference (entity extraction, classification, knowledge graph construction) over company documents, with cost- and throughput-aware batch execution.
  • Ingest market data and publish datasets to external distributors.
  • Own schema and contract evolution for datasets with real downstream consumers.
  • Work with economists and engineers to turn modelling decisions into reliable production data.

Essential

  • Strong production Python.
  • Datasets in pandas and Parquet/Arrow, plus an analytical engine, e.g. DuckDB, or a warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Orchestrated batch pipelines you’ve operated, not just written: Dagster or Airflow, S3-based data flows, and a habit of testing outputs for correctness rather than only for exceptions.
  • Applied ML in production: embeddings and semantic similarity, clustering, or operationalising models (not necessarily training from scratch).
  • AWS fluency and CI/CD discipline.

Nice to have

  • Practical LLM engineering: prompting, batch inference, and cost and throughput trade-offs across providers.
  • SageMaker, Bedrock, or comparable managed ML tooling.
  • Financial and equities domain knowledge: classification taxonomies, factor models, index construction. Valuable but learnable.
  • Infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or Terraform) and Docker.

We care more about what you’ve owned than years on a CV. If you’ve built a pipeline that runs on a schedule against real volume, and you were the person who got paged when it broke, you’re in scope. More senior candidates will typically have made the cost and throughput trade-offs, and set the standard for how a team tests data quality.

Experience we’re looking for

  • Competitive salary plus EMI share options
  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays
  • Private health insurance, pension
  • Hybrid working in UK from London or Cambridge

title: Product Manager
description:
Does driving innovation and creating better experiences through technology inspire you?

At Re-Leased, we’re levelling up real estate and helping property professionals thrive in a digital-first world. Our cloud-based property management platform combines smart automation, AI-driven insights, and deep industry expertise to make everyday work simpler and more rewarding. We’re here to help property people run better businesses, build stronger communities, and love what they do.

Your Role

As Product Manager (Reporting & Credia AI), you'll own the "why", the "what", and the "how it looks and feels" for two squads, one extending the reporting and insight capability our customers rely on to run their portfolios, and one extending Credia AI across the Re-Leased product.

This is a deliberately hybrid role. You're the product manager and the designer for your squads, roughly half your time on discovery, prioritisation and delivery, and half on the design craft itself: flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens and prototypes. There is no hand-off culture here, we all ship together. Design experience is a distinct advantage, we're looking for a product manager first, but one who can design what they ship. AI-augmented product work is core to how we operate, not an experiment on the side; you'll use AI tools daily across research, drafting, design and prototyping.

This role could be based remotely in New Zealand or in our Auckland or Napier offices.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for two squads, translating customer needs and business priorities into clear, well-sequenced work
  • Act as both product manager and designer — producing user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens and interactive prototypes using Claude Design
  • Shape reporting and analytics capability that's accurate, trusted and genuinely self-serve, partnering with Engineering and Data on data models and trade-offs
  • Extend Credia AI across the product, designing for probabilistic behaviour, graceful failure, transparency and user trust
  • Conduct customer interviews independently and use product usage data (Pendo) and AI synthesis to inform roadmap direction
  • Use AI tools (e.g. Claude Desktop, Claude Projects) as an everyday teammate for research, analysis, drafting and prototyping
  • Write clear user stories, PRDs and specs, and present and defend design rationale to stakeholders and executives
  • Hold a high bar for functional quality and craft — accessibility, responsiveness and interaction detail included

Your Experience

  • Solid experience as a Product Manager in a SaaS or technology environment, with a track record of owning a product area and delivering with quality
  • Demonstrable product design skill evidenced by a portfolio — work you personally designed and shipped, not just design appreciation
  • Confident producing production-ready UI; fluency with AI-native design tooling matters more than any single package (we use Claude Design and Claude Artifacts)
  • Strong discovery and validation practice, with data literacy as a baseline and comfort with analytics tools
  • Daily fluency with AI assistants for product and design work, with a working understanding of prompt design, evaluation and hallucination management
  • Experience designing complex B2B/SaaS workflows where information density and user expertise are real constraints
  • Experience with Pendo, ProductBoard, Azure DevOps or comparable tools; exposure to reporting or data-heavy product areas is highly regarded

Our culture is very important to us too, and we strongly believe in living out our core values:

  • People First: One team globally; our people and customers always come first.
  • Find a Way: Like a river, we find a way around all obstacles
  • Win or Learn: Our journey for improvement never ends; enjoy the ride!
  • Aim High: We dare to set big goals and love the challenge of achieving them against the odds.

title: Network Operations Tech Lead
description:
About Latitude.sh

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world. We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single-tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Why Latitude.sh?

We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem-solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one. Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.

The Role

The Network Operations Tech Lead is responsible for leading the 3rd shift team at Latitude.sh, ensuring around-the-clock availability, stability, and performance of our global network infrastructure. This role bridges hands-on technical work and team leadership, acting as the primary escalation point during overnight operations.

The Tech Lead coordinates with other shift leads and reports directly to the Network Manager, contributing to a continuous improvement culture across the entire NetOps team. This position demands deep technical expertise, strong decision-making under pressure, and the ability to guide and develop a team of Senior Network Analysts.

What You'll Be Doing

Server Provisioning & Delivery

  • Provision and deliver servers to customers within the delivery timeframes agreed at the point of sale;

  • Execute the full provisioning workflow: hardware configuration and validation, firmware updates, RAID setup, OS installation (Linux and Windows Server), network configuration, and IPMI/BMC access setup;

  • Run pre-delivery checks and validation to ensure every server is handed off to the customer fully functional and to standard;

  • Coordinate with data center teams and remote hands for physical tasks such as racking, cabling, and component swaps;

  • Prioritize daily work according to agreed delivery windows and direction from the DIOPS Tech Lead.

Delivery Timeframe Awareness & Escalation

  • Track the status and deadline of every order assigned to you and organize your work to meet each agreed delivery window;

  • Immediately flag to the DIOPS Regional Manager any order at risk of missing its delivery window (hardware shortages, failed components, tooling issues, or blocked dependencies) so action can be taken before the deadline slips;

  • Escalate complex or non-standard technical issues to the Regional Manager rather than letting a delivery stall.

Process Adherence & Continuous Improvement

  • Follow the standardized delivery workflows, runbooks, and checklists defined for the team, ensuring consistency and quality across deliveries;

  • Suggest improvements to runbooks and workflows based on hands-on experience, contributing to shorter and more predictable delivery times;

  • Participate in retrospectives on delivery misses and delays, providing accurate first-hand information for root-cause analysis.

Documentation & Records

  • Keep delivery records accurate and up to date in real time: order status, timestamps, configurations delivered, and issues encountered;

  • Document non-standard steps, workarounds, and recurring issues so they can be incorporated into runbooks;

  • Maintain accurate asset and configuration information for every server delivered.

What We're Looking For

  • English communication skills (B2 level or higher), both written and spoken;
  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience);
  • Proven experience leading or mentoring technical teams in a network operations environment;
  • Deep understanding of networking fundamentals and protocols, including:
  • Layer 2 & 3 concepts: MAC, VLAN, Trunking, Spanning Tree
  • IP networking: ARP, Subnetting, ACLs, DHCP
  • Routing: BGP, OSPF
  • Transport & management: TCP, UDP, SNMP, NTP, SSH
  • Troubleshooting tools: Ping, Traceroute
  • Strong incident command skills, with demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional response during critical events;
  • Excellent prioritization and decision-making skills, able to act calmly and effectively under pressure;
  • Clear and effective communication with both technical and non-technical audiences;
  • Cisco CCNA certification (required); CCNP or higher strongly preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Juniper, Fortinet, Huawei, or multi-vendor environments;
  • Previous experience in ISP, data center, or large-scale infrastructure environments;
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, LibreNMS, etc.);
  • Experience interacting directly with carriers and transit providers;
  • Prior experience in a shift lead or team lead role within a 24x7 NOC environment.

title: 2027 Early Career - Electronic Systems Engineer - Software
description:
Job Summary:

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities:

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Competencies:
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred
  1. Participate in full‑cycle development of core generator set projects, including electrical concept definition, schematic design, control logic development, simulation modeling, bench testing, system integration and validation to ensure project delivery.
  2. Take part in development and validation of hybrid generator sets and diesel‑BESS hybrid power solutions. Work on system architecture, energy‑management strategy simulation, power‑electronics matching, joint commissioning, DVP validation and issue closure to enable new hybrid product releases.
  3. Drive innovative pre‑research projects, including system modeling, algorithm simulation and prototype verification. Deliver technical documents, simulation reports and test reports for new‑technology assessment.
  4. Create and maintain electrical schematics and wiring drawings using CAD tools. Build system models and run simulation analysis in Matlab/Simulink for electric machines, power electronics and hybrid systems. Develop Python scripts for data processing and automated analysis. Implement, debug and validate PLC control logic.
  5. Provide technical support for internal and external stakeholders. Perform on‑site troubleshooting, fault analysis and commissioning for generator and hybrid systems. Generate root‑cause analysis reports and resolve customer field issues in cross‑functional teams.
  6. Compile development specifications, test procedures and technical documentation. Capture project knowledge and collaborate across multi‑disciplinary teams.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer based in Brazil.

This is a senior analytics engineering opportunity within a fast-growing, AI-native FP&A platform.
You’ll turn complex financial and operational data from multiple systems into reliable, production-ready analytical models.
Your work will help customers transform fragmented data into trusted insights that support better financial decision-making.
The role combines hands-on data engineering with architectural ownership, data quality, scalability, and continuous improvement.
You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Engineering, and other stakeholders to solve challenging data problems and deliver robust solutions.
As the team grows, you’ll help establish engineering standards, improve developer experience, and use AI to accelerate data transformation workflows.
This role is ideal for an autonomous, technically strong engineer who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys having meaningful ownership.

Accountabilities

  • Own the development and evolution of client-facing data transformation pipelines, making them faster, more reliable, scalable, and maintainable as integrations and customers grow.
  • Identify and implement effective ways to leverage AI to accelerate, improve, automate, and document data transformation work.
  • Design and continuously improve data integrity and quality tests in partnership with Engineering and Customer Success, ensuring issues are detected before reaching customers.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to understand data and reporting requirements, troubleshoot issues, and develop robust transformations across diverse data sources.
  • Build and maintain production-ready analytical models that transform raw financial and operational data into FP&A-ready datasets.
  • Refactor and optimize critical models and pipelines to improve performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Define technical patterns, conventions, and best practices that can be adopted across the wider data team.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and data integrity through strong implementation practices and thoughtful code reviews.
  • Improve team processes and developer experience to enable faster, higher-quality delivery.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and proactively identify opportunities to strengthen the platform's technical foundations.
  • Coach team members, support onboarding, and contribute to hiring and the continued development of the data engineering function.

    • Requirements

    • Proven professional experience owning data transformation pipelines end to end, from source integration through production-ready analytical models.
    • Experience working with financial or operational data; experience with financial datasets is a strong advantage.
    • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt or a comparable data transformation framework.
    • Solid understanding of data flows from source systems through transformation layers to end-user consumption, with the ability to make sound technical decisions throughout the pipeline.
    • Professional experience with Python and modern data engineering practices, including version control, testing, and deployment.
    • Familiarity with BigQuery and Git, as well as CI/CD workflows for data transformations.
    • Experience working with diverse business systems such as ERP, HRIS, CRM, and billing platforms.
    • Familiarity with data ingestion and integration tools such as Airbyte, Fivetran, or Merge is an advantage.
    • Experience with data observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog is beneficial.
    • Strong commitment to code quality, data integrity, performance, scalability, and clear documentation.
    • High level of autonomy and ownership, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, make decisions, and drive complex technical initiatives without constant direction.
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong collaboration skills and experience partnering with Customer Success, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
    • A growth-oriented mindset, with enthusiasm for mentoring colleagues, improving team practices, and contributing to hiring and onboarding.
    • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment while aligning with Americas-based working hours.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation for LATAM, with a listed range of $86,000–$116,000 annually, plus equity.
      • Fully remote work from Brazil and other eligible locations across LATAM.
      • Flexible working hours.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Klaar om impact te maken met automatisering en cloudtechnologie?

Als DevOps Engineer bij Team EIFFEL bouw je aan slimme CI/CD pipelines, automatiseer je infrastructuur en adviseer je klanten over moderne DevOps strategieën. Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in verschillende sectoren, waar je continu verbetert en vernieuwt. Of je je wilt verdiepen in cloudtechnologie of juist jouw brede DevOps expertise verder wilt uitbouwen: bij ons bepaal jij je route.

Dit ga je doen

Als DevOps Engineer werk je binnen onze Business Unit Technology aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je maakt deel uit van een team van 30 IT consultants en werkt voor verschillende soorten organisaties. Dat betekent afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en veel ruimte om je technische én adviesvaardigheden in te zetten. Je schakelt intensief met development en operations teams en speelt een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van moderne DevOps werkwijzen. Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van CI/CD pipelines voor diverse projecten.
  • Automatiseren van infrastructuur met tools zoals Terraform, Ansible of Pulumi.
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van cloudomgevingen, zoals Azure en AWS.
  • Adviseren van klanten over DevOps strategieën en best practices.
  • Monitoren en verbeteren van security en compliance binnen DevOps processen.
  • Samenwerken met development en operations teams om een cultuur van Continuous Improvement te stimuleren.

Je bent fit for the job als je...

Je hebt ruime ervaring als DevOps Engineer en voelt je thuis in een dynamische consultancy omgeving. Je kent containertechnologieën en cloudplatformen door en door en schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en advies. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden weet je klanten helder mee te nemen in keuzes, oplossingen en best practices. Je wilt blijven groeien, nieuwe technieken ontdekken en werkt graag in omgevingen waar je impact maakt.

Harde eisen:

  • Hbo opleiding richting business IT & management of een vergelijkbare studie.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als DevOps Engineer binnen consultancy of een vergelijkbare dynamische omgeving.
  • Diepgaande kennis van Docker en Kubernetes, sterke ervaring met Azure en goede scriptingvaardigheden (bijv. Python, Bash).

Zachte eisen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code en configuratiemanagement en zet dit effectief in.
  • Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (minimaal C1 niveau).
  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen klantvragen, technische uitdagingen en adviesrollen.

For international candidates: our consultants must be able to communicate in Dutch at a minimum of C1 level, both spoken and written.

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 6.000 en 7.800 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en relevante certificaten. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot meer dan 950 trainingen en cursussen die je onbeperkt kunt volgen.

Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in een inspirerende consultancy omgeving waar je niet sectorgebonden bent. Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je samen met 75 consultants, waarvan 30 IT consultants in jouw directe team. De sfeer is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is Team EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is. Of je nu werkt voor een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis: jij helpt teams slimmer werken en brengt ideeën van papier naar praktijk. Soms voor grote transformaties, soms voor snelle oplossingen. Van startup tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je met 75 consultants verdeeld over drie specialisaties: Data & Analytics, IT en GEOS. Als DevOps Engineer maak je deel uit van het IT team, samen met zo’n 30 collega consultants. Omdat we niet sectorgebonden werken, krijg je de kans om in verschillende omgevingen ervaring op te doen. IT raakt alle sectoren, daardoor is er altijd een project dat past bij jouw kennis, ambitie en energie.

Elke vrijdag is onze samenwerkdag in het clubhuis in Arnhem. Die staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de onderlinge verbinding. Moet je opdrachtgever je die dag op kantoor hebben? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

Team EIFFEL is onderdeel van een community van ruim 3.000 experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers. Groot in omvang, maar persoonlijk in cultuur. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die wil groeien, ontwikkelen en zichzelf scherp wil houden.

Deze skills komen van pas
  • Software testing en automatisering

Je communiceert sterk en weet klanten op een duidelijke, rustige manier mee te nemen in complexe DevOps vraagstukken. Je werkt graag samen en stimuleert teams om continu te verbeteren. Met jouw analytische blik zie je snel waar knelpunten zitten en vind je oplossingen die werken, altijd met aandacht voor security en compliance. Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in DevOps en cloudtechnologie en past die kennis toe in je werk. Je houdt van hard werken, maar zeker ook van humor op de werkvloer. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gericht op groei en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: Software Developer, Integrations
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Developer, Integrations based in Canada.

As a Software Developer, Integrations, you will help build and scale the systems that power critical data flows across an enterprise platform.
You will design, develop, and maintain integrations connecting HRIS, ATS, payroll, and other third-party systems through reliable APIs and data pipelines.
Your work will directly influence how customers connect their systems, move data, and troubleshoot integration issues.
You will tackle real-world engineering challenges including authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes, retries, and partial failures.
The role spans backend services, workflow orchestration, data transformation, observability, and customer-facing integration experiences.
You will collaborate closely with engineering, implementation, customer success, and other cross-functional teams to turn customer needs into scalable platform capabilities.
This is an ownership-oriented opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex integration problems and building infrastructure that customers can depend on.

Accountabilities:

  • Build, maintain, and optimize reliable integrations between the platform and third-party systems, including HRIS, ATS, payroll, CRM, and ERP platforms.
  • Design and develop API-based integrations using technologies and protocols such as REST, SOAP, webhooks, OAuth, and API-key authentication.
  • Manage real-world integration challenges including pagination, rate limiting, authentication flows, upstream schema changes, retries, and partial failures.
  • Design and improve data ingestion workflows that reliably move and transform customer data across multiple systems.
  • Work with workflow orchestration to manage scheduling, sequencing, retries, monitoring, and other operational requirements across integration pipelines.
  • Improve the performance and scalability of data flows supporting customer datasets that can include hundreds of thousands of employee records across numerous sources.
  • Develop clear error handling and diagnostic capabilities that make synchronization issues understandable and actionable for customers and Customer Success teams.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure and application components using modern engineering practices, including version control, automation, and CI/CD.
  • Contribute to backend services and distributed systems spanning Go-based APIs, workflow orchestration, Python-based data transformation, and customer-facing application components.
  • Collaborate with Implementation and Forward Deployed Engineering teams to understand customer onboarding challenges and turn recurring needs into scalable product capabilities.
  • Establish and document engineering patterns, integration standards, error-handling conventions, and operational practices that enable the platform to scale sustainably.
  • Support secure handling of sensitive employee and compensation data by applying appropriate security, privacy, and compliance practices.
  • Troubleshoot complex cross-system issues by tracing data through APIs, workflows, transformations, and downstream systems.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in the integration platform, balancing immediate customer needs with long-term architectural scalability.

    • Requirements

    • 2+ years of experience building and shipping production software, with strong backend engineering fundamentals.
    • Professional experience with Python and/or Go is preferred.
    • Hands-on experience building or maintaining integrations with third-party APIs, including REST/SOAP, webhooks, OAuth, API keys, pagination, rate limiting, and changing upstream schemas.
    • Experience building or supporting data pipelines and workflow orchestration involving scheduling, retries, sequencing, monitoring, and cross-system processing.
    • Strong SQL skills and the ability to understand, query, transform, and reason about complex data models.
    • Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, CRM, ERP, or comparable enterprise systems and their underlying data structures.
    • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate unfamiliar APIs, trace problematic records through data pipelines, and identify the root cause of integration failures.
    • Strong documentation habits and a commitment to making technical decisions, workflows, and solutions clear and accessible to others.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work directly with Customer Success, Implementation, and engineering teams to translate customer needs into effective technical solutions.
    • Strong awareness of security, privacy, and compliance considerations when working with sensitive employee or compensation data.
    • Comfortable working in a remote environment that requires proactive communication, ownership, and intentional relationship-building.
    • Ability to work effectively in an evolving environment, navigate ambiguity, and take ownership of problems from discovery through resolution.
    • Frontend development experience with TypeScript, React, or an equivalent framework is a plus.
    • Experience with integration platforms or iPaaS tools such as Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Tray.io, or Celigo is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal or Airflow is desirable.
    • Experience with file-based ingestion at scale, including SFTP, CSV, flat-file pipelines, and data validation, is a plus.
    • Experience working with sensitive workforce, employee, or compensation data is highly valued.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive annual salary of approximately $106,000–$125,000 CAD, with final compensation based on experience and expertise.
      • Annual equity opportunity, allowing employees to share in the organization’s success.
      • Additional private medical coverage.
      • Paid time off of 20 days annually, plus paid sick and safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
      • Remote-first working arrangements for candidates located within commuting distance of Calgary.
      • Opportunity to work on a critical data integration platform that serves as a foundation for customer analytics and business processes.

title: Head of Real Estate & Facilities
description:
The Role

As Head of Real Estate & Facilities, you'll own the physical footprint behind Rips. Every pack ripped in the app is backed by real inventory that has to be stored, sorted, and shipped. Today that runs out of a single site, and volume keeps climbing.

Over the next several years we'll stand up many more sites on both coasts, leased and purchased. You'll find the space, close the deal, run the buildout, and hand a working facility to the operations team.

This is a builder role. You'll be walking sites, negotiating with brokers and landlords, working purchase agreements with legal, designing floor layouts and blueprints, and on the floor with general contractors bringing them to life. You'll lead real estate for Triumph with the full support of the operations team, and you'll write the playbook every future site follows. You open a building, and you see it in the shipment numbers that week. This role reports to our Senior Director of Operations.

What You'll Do

• Own site selection on the West Coast and East Coast, from market analysis and broker relationships through touring and recommendation.

• Lead leases and purchases end to end. Run LOIs, negotiate terms, and close with legal and finance.

• Design floor layouts and blueprints for each site: receiving, storage, sorting, packing, and shipping flow.

• Manage buildouts from empty box to operational. Scope, bid, and manage general contractors, run permitting and inspections, and hold schedule and budget.

• Coordinate with operations, security, and IT so every site opens with racking, power, network, and access control ready on day one.

• Stand up short-term and overflow space fast when volume demands it.

• Manage the existing portfolio: landlord relationships, lease obligations, renewals, and exits.

• Build the playbook: site requirements, buildout standards, vendor bench, and budgeting model.

• Travel regularly to sites in progress.

Qualifications

• 7+ years in industrial or corporate real estate or construction project management, with direct experience on warehouse or fulfillment space.

• Track record of taking multiple sites from search through occupancy, including both leases and purchases.

• Hands-on experience managing general contractors and buildouts.

• Comfort working directly with counsel on purchase agreements and leases.

• Financial rigor. You can model lease vs. buy and buildout budgets, and defend the numbers.

• Comfort owning a function end to end and driving work to completion without a playbook handed to you.

Preferred

• Existing broker and landlord network in Bay Area industrial markets or a major East Coast logistics market.

• Experience opening space under real time pressure.

• Fluency with AI tooling as a daily working habit.

Why Triumph?

• High growth. Build the physical backbone of a high-scale consumer platform that touches gaming, finance, and collectibles.

• High agency. Small, high-impact operations team with significant opportunity for leadership and growth.

• High energy. Passionate team who are proud of our work and velocity (16x year over year growth).

• Competitive salary and benefits. $400/mo lunch credit, healthcare, vision, dental, 401k, etc.

This role is based out of Mountain View, with one day a week at Triumph's headquarters at Levi's Plaza in San Francisco.

title: Partnerships Implementation Lead
description:
About the role

This is a newly created role within SEEK Pass and an opportunity to help define how we bring partners live at scale. Sitting between external partners, commercial teams, product and engineering, you will shape the operating model for partner integrations and onboarding, and drive end-to-end delivery of implementation initiatives.

This is not a hands-on engineering role, but it does require strong technical judgement and fluency. You should be comfortable working with engineers and technical stakeholders on APIs, workflows, system dependencies, implementation requirements and delivery trade-offs, while also being confident engaging external partners and internal stakeholders.

This role is distinct from ongoing partner success or account management. The focus here is on scoping, designing and delivering the onboarding and integration motion, building repeatable ways of working, and helping SEEK Pass solve new partner implementation challenges as the function evolves.

This role would suit someone from an implementation, solutions consulting, partner integration, technical business analysis or onboarding delivery background who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and building new processes from the ground up.

What you’ll do

  • Lead partner integration and implementation initiatives from scoping through go-live
  • Work closely with external partners to understand their technical setup, operational requirements and implementation constraints
  • Partner with product, engineering, operations and commercial stakeholders to design practical onboarding and integration solutions
  • Help define the operating model, decision paths and ways of working for a newly created partner integration function
  • Translate business and partner needs into clear requirements, workflows, implementation plans and delivery trade-offs
  • Support integration planning across APIs, system dependencies, data flows, verification steps and operational processes
  • Identify risks, gaps and friction points early, and drive resolution across teams
  • Build repeatable playbooks, documentation and implementation approaches that make partner onboarding more scalable and consistent
  • Act as an internal thought partner on what it will take to onboard new partners successfully as SEEK Pass expands

What success looks like

In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:

  • Build a strong understanding of the current partner onboarding and integration landscape
  • Help define which parts of the onboarding motion should be standardised and which require bespoke design
  • Improve how SEEK Pass scopes, prioritises and delivers partner implementation work
  • Help partners go live with greater speed, clarity and confidence
  • Strengthen collaboration between commercial, product, operations and engineering teams on integration delivery
  • Identify and implement process and systems improvements that make partner onboarding more scalable
  • Become a trusted internal thought partner on what it takes to onboard new partners successfully

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in partner integrations, implementation, solutions delivery, technical business analysis, onboarding delivery or integration/project delivery
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across external partners and internal cross-functional teams
  • Experience owning work end to end in environments where the path is not always clearly defined
  • Ability to turn business needs into structured requirements, workflows, implementation plans and delivery decisions
  • Technical fluency and confidence working with APIs, system workflows, integration requirements and technical stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence, align and simplify complexity for different audiences
  • A builder mindset, with experience creating scalable, repeatable ways of working rather than only operating within established processes
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and new problem sets

Highly regarded

  • Experience in platform, SaaS, marketplace, fintech or other partner ecosystem businesses
  • Experience with API-driven integrations, data mapping, testing, UAT or technical onboarding
  • Experience working with external clients, merchants, vendors or strategic partners
  • Experience improving onboarding, activation or go-live outcomes at scale

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to help shape how SEEK Pass grows its partner ecosystem. You will work on meaningful cross-functional problems, partner closely with commercial and product teams, and help build scalable onboarding and integration foundations for the future.

If you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity, working across business and technology, and helping external partners succeed, we’d love to hear from you.

At SEEK, we are passionate about fostering a culture of inclusion and wellbeing that embraces and values the diversity of our people. We are a purpose driven business that works with heart.

We know teams with diverse ideas, experiences and perspectives are more creative and are critical to ensuring effective delivery and innovating to enable our future success. As such, we welcome applications from people with a diverse group of backgrounds and life experiences, especially as they relate to gender, sexual identity, culture, faith, disability and life stages. If you have the skills, curiosity and an adaptable approach but don't meet every responsibility or qualification listed in this advertisement, please still get in touch with us.

title: Preventive Maintenance Planner
description:
Overview
The Preventive Maintenance (PM) Planner is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and documentation of preventive and condition‑based maintenance activities within the facility. This role focuses on improving equipment reliability, ensuring safe and efficient execution of maintenance work, and maintaining accuracy within the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). The PM Planner works closely with the Reliability Engineer and Maintenance Supervisor to continuously optimize maintenance strategies and deliver effective work management.

Key Responsibilities

Work Package Development & Management

  • Develop detailed, standardized work packages for all preventive and condition‑based maintenance tasks.
  • Write clear and concise work instructions outlining job scope, sequence of tasks, required labor, tools, materials, and specialized equipment.
  • Identify and document all required parts, consumables, and support resources to ensure technicians have complete information prior to job execution.
  • Perform field walkdowns to scope jobs, validate work conditions, and identify potential hazards.
  • Identify required safety permits, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), Job Hazard Analysis (JHA), and other regulatory requirements.
  • Integrate safety protocols and hazard analyses into each work package to ensure compliance with industrial safety standards.
  • Ensure timely and accurate close-out of work packages within the CMMS after job completion.

Maintenance Strategy & Optimization

  • Collaborate with the site Reliability Engineer to analyze equipment history and refine PM strategies for critical assets.
  • Incorporate technician and supervisor feedback to improve accuracy, completeness, and effectiveness of PM job plans.
  • Continuously evaluate maintenance plans to optimize equipment performance, reliability, and safety.

Documentation & Communication

  • Maintain accurate PM documentation within the CMMS, ensuring data integrity and configuration consistency.
  • Communicate effectively with engineers, maintenance supervisors, and technicians to clarify work requirements and resolve planning issues.
  • Provide clear written and verbal communication across multidisciplinary teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High School Diploma required; additional technical training preferred.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in an industrial maintenance environment (technician, lead, or planner).
  • Strong understanding of mechanical and electrical systems, equipment operation, and maintenance best practices.
  • Hands‑on experience with mechanical or electrical systems is highly preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in a CMMS (SAP strongly preferred).
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills, with the ability to manage large backlogs and multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Thorough understanding of industrial safety procedures, particularly Lockout/Tagout (LOTO).

title: Sourcing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sourcing Specialist based in Brazil.

This is a fully remote opportunity to own the top of the recruiting funnel for a wide range of legal and non-legal staffing roles supporting U.S. law firms. You will combine inbound recruitment marketing with proactive outbound sourcing to build strong, qualified candidate pipelines. The role involves writing and optimizing job advertisements, managing recruitment channels, analyzing performance metrics, and running targeted headhunting campaigns. You will use modern sourcing tools and techniques to reach both active applicants and high-quality passive candidates. Working closely with recruiters and hiring stakeholders, you will ensure sourcing strategies remain focused on each role's specific requirements. The position offers significant autonomy, visibility, and direct impact in a fast-moving international environment. It is an excellent opportunity for an experienced sourcing professional who enjoys building talent pipelines and continuously improving recruitment performance.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the top of the recruiting funnel for legal and non-legal staffing roles, covering both inbound and outbound candidate acquisition.
  • Write, refine, and continuously improve job advertisements to strengthen positioning and candidate conversion.
  • Manage job postings across relevant job boards and recruitment channels, ensuring advertisements remain accurate, current, and effective.
  • Track job-site performance metrics, including views, applications, conversion rates, and cost or quality indicators where applicable.
  • Analyze recruitment channel performance and determine where to increase investment or reduce effort based on results.
  • Manage and promote the employee referral program, tracking submissions and maintaining it as an active source of qualified candidates.
  • Proactively source and headhunt candidates for legal staffing positions, building outbound pipelines rather than relying solely on inbound applications.
  • Use JuiceBox, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Boolean searches, X-ray searches, and other sourcing techniques to identify passive candidates.
  • Develop targeted outreach campaigns for urgent, specialized, or difficult-to-fill positions.
  • Qualify and engage candidates at the initial stage by assessing fit, availability, and interest before transitioning candidates to the recruiting team.
  • Continuously refine outreach messaging, sourcing methods, and channels based on conversion and candidate engagement.
  • Partner closely with recruiters and hiring stakeholders to understand role requirements, priorities, and must-have qualifications.
  • Explore referral networks, niche communities, professional groups, job boards, and direct outreach channels to identify strong talent.
  • Maintain momentum across multiple searches and postings while responding quickly to changing hiring priorities.

    • Requirements

    • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in sourcing or headhunting, with demonstrated experience sourcing candidates for fully remote positions.
    • Direct experience writing job advertisements, managing job-board postings, and tracking recruitment marketing or sourcing performance metrics.
    • Proven success running proactive outbound sourcing campaigns and cold outreach to candidates who are not actively applying.
    • Hands-on experience with tools such as JuiceBox, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Boolean search, and X-ray search techniques.
    • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, particularly the ability to write compelling and clear job advertisements and outreach messages.
    • Ability to work full-time on a U.S.-hours schedule while working remotely from Brazil.
    • Strong self-management skills and the ability to handle multiple concurrent searches, campaigns, and job postings without losing momentum.
    • Proactive, resilient, persistent, and results-oriented approach to sourcing and candidate engagement.
    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing sourcing pipelines and recruitment activity.
    • Previous experience in staffing or recruiting is a plus.
    • Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are advantageous.
    • Experience recruiting international or remote talent is desirable.
    • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, job-board platforms, and structured sourcing workflows is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule.
      • Competitive base salary.
      • Annual performance bonus.
      • Anniversary loyalty bonuses.
      • Company-sponsored health insurance.
      • Generous paid time off that increases with tenure, up to 30 days per year.
      • Birthday paid time off.
      • 7 paid U.S. holidays.
      • 5 paid sick days per year.
      • Bereavement leave.
      • Additional unpaid personal leave when needed.
      • Home-office stipend for equipment and workspace improvements.
      • Computer replacement stipend.
      • Monthly internet allowance that increases with tenure.
      • Professional development and training programs.
      • Education support for high-performing employees.
      • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
      • Fast-moving environment with high visibility and direct impact.
      • Clear opportunities for career growth and internal promotion.
      • Recognition and rewards for strong performance.

title: Cygnet SCADA
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cygnet SCADA based in India.

As a Manufacturing Domain Specialist, you will help translate complex manufacturing processes into effective, scalable MES solutions. You’ll work closely with customers to understand operational workflows, identify business-critical KPIs, and define functional and technical requirements. Your expertise in factory automation, PLC systems, and Cygnet SCADA will be central to shaping solutions that improve manufacturing operations and visibility. You’ll collaborate with plant users, subject matter experts, technical teams, and business stakeholders throughout AS-IS and TO-BE assessments. The role also involves supporting integrations across ERP, MES, and control systems and translating requirements into clear specifications. This is an opportunity to contribute to manufacturing transformation projects in a collaborative, multicultural, and technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Understand customer manufacturing processes, operational workflows, and business needs, translating them into clear functional requirements and actionable solution objectives.
  • Identify and prioritize business-critical Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that support operational performance, manufacturing visibility, and continuous improvement.
  • Apply hands-on knowledge of factory automation, including PLC systems and Cygnet SCADA, to understand plant-level requirements and contribute to effective MES solution design.
  • Gather and document functional, technical, and integration requirements for Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE studies of existing MES landscapes in collaboration with Subject Matter Experts, plant users, customer teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Support the design of interfaces and integration flows between ERP, MES, and industrial control systems, helping ensure reliable information exchange across the manufacturing environment.
  • Work closely with customer stakeholders to develop client-specific requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS) and Business Requirement Specifications (BRS).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout solution design, development, configuration, and implementation activities, contributing domain expertise and practical manufacturing insights.
  • Troubleshoot functional and technical challenges, apply analytical problem-solving techniques, and contribute to solutions that improve manufacturing efficiency and operational excellence.

    • Requirements

    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in the Manufacturing domain, with exposure to both functional and technical aspects of manufacturing environments.
    • Strong proficiency in Cygnet SCADA is essential, along with practical knowledge of factory automation and PLC-based systems.
    • Hands-on experience with Python programming is required.
    • Functional understanding of manufacturing processes and areas such as Product Data Management, Shop Floor Control, Traceability, and Product Quality is preferred.
    • Basic database knowledge, particularly MSSQL, with the ability to understand and work with manufacturing-related data.
    • Technical or functional experience with Sepasoft or a similar MES platform is a valuable advantage.
    • Previous experience contributing to Design, Development, Configuration, and Implementation projects across different manufacturing industries is desirable.
    • Experience with MES-ERP integration and understanding of interfaces between enterprise and shop-floor systems is advantageous.
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and creative problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex manufacturing and technology challenges.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, technical teams, plant users, and subject matter experts.
    • Proven ability to collaborate within multicultural, cross-functional, and team-oriented environments.
    • Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent educational background or relevant exposure to the IT and manufacturing technology industry.

      • Benefits

      • Workplace: Fully remote.
      • Location: India.
      • Opportunity to work on manufacturing transformation and MES initiatives involving factory automation, SCADA, PLC, ERP, and industrial technology.
      • Exposure to complex customer environments and cross-functional collaboration with manufacturing, business, and technology stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to contribute to the design and implementation of solutions that improve manufacturing visibility, efficiency, traceability, and operational performance.
      • Collaborative and multicultural working environment.
      • Opportunity to strengthen expertise across MES, manufacturing processes, automation, system integration, and industrial technology.

title: [쿠팡로지스틱스서비스] 로켓설치 서비스 운영 및 전략 기획 담당자
description:
회사 소개

CLS (Coupang Logistics Services)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다. CLS 는 국토교통부로 지정 받은 택배운송사업자로서 전국단위의 배송캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업전담인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다. 로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS 는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

직무 소개

Rocket A/S팀은 쿠팡에서 판매 된 가전,전자 제품의 구매 후 발생 될 수 있는 문제에 대해 신속하고 효과적으로 대응 하여 고객경험의 향상을 목표로 합니다. 전국 서비스 네트워크를 활용한 출장A/S와 전문인력을 통한 택배수리로 TV,냉장고,세탁기를 비롯한 대형가전과 생활가전,주방가전, 랩탑 등 다양한 가전제품을 대상으로 서비스를 확대하고 있습니다.

업무 내용

  • A/S 운영 전략 수립 및 실행방안 도출
  • 데이터 기반 지표 설계,성과 측정 및 서비스개선
  • A/S Process, Infra(Router/CAPA) 개선 및 최적화

자격 요건

  • 경력이 7년 이상 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 기반 인사이트 도출 및 비즈니스 문제 해결 경험 보유하신 분
  • 유관부서와 원활한 협업 및 논리적인 커뮤니케이션 역량 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • A/S관련 업무 경험 및 이해도 보유하신 분
  • 가전 제조/유통Biz관련 경험 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangls.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.
