title: Tech Lead - Associate Director, Engineering
description:
About Us

MoneyHero Limited (NASDAQ: MNY) is a leading tech- and AI-powered personal finance aggregation and comparison platform that provides consumers with actionable insights to discover, compare, and choose the best financial products with confidence — bringing data intelligence and seamless digital access across insurance and banking solutions. The Company operates in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Philippines. Its brand portfolio includes B2C platforms MoneyHero, SingSaver, Money101, Moneymax and Seedly, as well as the B2B platform Creatory. The Company also retains an equity stake in preference shares in Malaysian fintech company, Jirnexu Pte. Ltd., parent company of Jirnexu Sdn. Bhd., the operator of RinggitPlus, Malaysia’s largest operating B2C platform. MoneyHero had over 270 commercial partner relationships as at March 31, 2026, and had approximately 3.9 million Monthly Unique Users across its platform for the three months ended March 31, 2026.


About the Job

You will lead a team of frontend and backend engineers, ensuring high-quality delivery, adherence to best practices, and effective collaboration across disciplines. You will own architecture decisions, conduct code reviews, debug production issues, and maintain reliable deployments, while working closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to translate requirements into scalable, well-engineered solutions.

We rely heavily on AI tools for coding and code review: 80-90% of our code is written with AI, with engineers directing, reviewing, and refining the output. This role leads that adoption across the team, setting the standards for AI-assisted development and keeping quality, architecture, and review practices strong as the volume and pace of code grows.

The team lead will be responsible for:

- AI-Assisted Development: Define how the team uses AI coding and review tools day to day. Set the standards for shipping AI-generated code safely and keep quality standards high for what gets merged.
- Architecture & Patterns: Own the architecture of the team's services. Define and apply proven patterns (microservice boundaries, event-driven design, domain-driven design, clean API contracts) and keep systems modular, coherent, and maintainable as AI increases the volume and pace of code.
- Coding (70%): Write, review, and optimize production-ready code in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, working with AI tools from design through review and testing, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability.
- Code Review & Quality: Enforce best practices and high code quality standards, with review practices adapted to AI-generated code: automated checks handle routine issues, human review focuses on correctness, architecture, and business logic. Guide engineers through constructive feedback.
- Mentorship: Coach and support engineers through regular feedback, pair programming, and technical guidance, including effective use of AI tools.
- Issue Resolution: Debug and resolve production issues, coordinate incident response, and ensure root-cause analysis and prevention.
- Planning & Delivery: Plan and prioritize development work, balance workloads, and manage release deliverables.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to align on requirements, timelines, and technical feasibility.
- CI/CD & DevOps: Maintain reliable build and deployment pipelines, monitor system health, and enforce security and automation standards.
- Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks, propose tooling or workflow improvements, and drive overall engineering efficiency.

Skills (we are looking for someone with):

- Expert in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, with strong experience building full-stack web applications and reusable components.
- Strong grasp of software architecture and design patterns (microservices, event-driven systems, domain-driven design, API design), with experience designing high-load distributed systems that stay scalable and maintainable.
- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in production work (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot): generating, reviewing, and correcting AI-written code, and helping others do the same. Familiarity with RAG, MCP, and evals is a plus.
- Skilled in designing and maintaining microservices and GraphQL APIs for scalable, distributed architectures.
- Proficient with SQL databases and modern NoSQL solutions such as MongoDB and Redis, including schema design, query optimization, and caching strategies.
- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including container orchestration, automated deployments, and system monitoring, plus working knowledge of AWS and cloud-native infrastructure.
- Proficient with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing, building, and deployment.
- Strong understanding of web security standards, authentication flows, data protection, and secure coding practices.
- Familiar with SEO optimization, web performance metrics, and best practices for improving visibility and user experience.
- Committed to clean code, testing, observability, and production-grade reliability.
- Skilled in leading cross-functional teams, conducting code reviews, mentoring engineers, and aligning technical work with business objectives.
- Good to have: familiarity with Java/Kotlin/C#, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and scalable caching or storage solutions.
- 10+ years in software engineering, delivering secure, scalable, and high-performance applications.
- Excellent business mindset and execution skills, with strong presentation and communication skills in English.


#MoneyHeroGroup #LI-SK1 #LI-Hybrid

What can you expect from us?
Impact: We are actively empowering and connecting people to a better financial future. Join us if you want to help us achieve our mission.
Work: We have a team of over 350 talented individuals in 4 markets who are hyper passionate about building innovative financial solutions and making an impact on people’s lives.
Culture: We take our work seriously but don’t hesitate to keep things light. We can only create magic when we have a little bit of fun.
Thrive: We launched in 2014, and now help over 10 million monthly users make the best financial decisions. Accelerate your career and become a pioneer in your field with a leading fintech company that seeks to push the boundaries of your imagination and is committed to growing your career.
Reputation: We are backed by world-class organizations and companies and have raised over US$110 million from investors including Experian, Pacific Century Group, IFC - a member of the World Bank Group
EEO Statement
MoneyHero Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value, support and respect all individuals and is committed to maintaining an inclusive and diverse working environment. Decisions in hiring are based on business needs, requirements of the job and individual qualifications and shall not be influenced by any consideration of race, ethnic or national origin, religion, sex (including gender identity and/or expression), age, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Important Information for Job Applicants
Recruitment fraud and fake job postings have become increasingly common and sophisticated. At MoneyHero Group, we are committed to maintaining a fair, transparent, and secure hiring process, and we take candidate trust and safety seriously.
Most legitimate opportunities at MoneyHero Group are published on our official careers portals, and our Talent Acquisition team will contact candidates only through authorized channels and official MoneyHero Group email addresses. For selected executive-level or confidential searches, we may partner with trusted recruitment firms, and candidates may be contacted by authorized recruitment partners engaged by MoneyHero Group.
MoneyHero Group will never request payment or ask candidates to share sensitive personal or financial information, such as banking details, during the recruitment process.
If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent MoneyHero Group and are unsure whether the communication is genuine, or if you receive a message about a MoneyHero Group opportunity that is not listed on our official careers portals, please contact us directly at recruitment@moneyherogroup.com to verify.

title: CHIROPRACTOR - VISTA
description:
Chiropractor – Full-Time [Sunday-Saturday]

title: BeaconWORKS+ Student Employment Specialist
description:
Join Beacon College and help students with neurodivergent profiles build the skills, confidence,
and experience needed to thrive in the workplace. As the BeaconWORKS+ Student Employment
Specialist, you'll combine your organizational, communication, and training talents to support a
transformative student employment program that makes a lasting impact.

TITLE: BeaconWORKS+ Student Employment Specialist
DEPARTMENT: Center for Career Preparation
WORK TYPE: Full-Time Staff
LOCATION: Beacon College, Leesburg, Florida
FLSA: Exempt Salary
DIVISION: Academic Affairs

JOB SUMMARY:
The BeaconWORKS+ Student Employment Specialist supports the administration of Beacon College's
student employment program by guiding students and supervisors through hiring, onboarding,
training, and evaluation processes. As a fully on-campus position, this role provides direct,
in-person support to students through employment-related programs, workshops, consultations, and
career readiness activities. Reporting to the Executive Director, the Specialist serves as a key
resource for program participants, maintains accurate records and systems, and promotes student
development through meaningful employment experiences.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Program Operations and Hiring Support
• Serve as the primary point of contact for student employment inquiries, providing guidance to
students, supervisors, and campus partners.
• Coordinate and track student employment requests, approvals, job postings, candidate selections,
placements, and onboarding activities.
• Monitor hiring timelines and communicate deadlines, required actions, and status
updates.
• Maintain program records, calendars, procedures, templates, and documentation.
• Collaborate with Human Resources, Payroll, Financial Aid, Academic Affairs, and other
departments to support student employment processes.
• Assist with Federal Work-Study administration in accordance with established
procedures and guidelines.
Paycor, I-9, and New-Hire Onboarding
• Support student employees through onboarding by providing training, instructions, and
individualized assistance.
• Complete or coordinate I-9 verification and new-hire documentation in compliance with College
requirements.
• Maintain accurate student employment records in Paycor and identify discrepancies requiring
follow-up.
• Develop and update onboarding resources, job aids, FAQs, and training materials.
• Ensure the confidentiality and accuracy of employment records and student information.

Student Development and Career Readiness
• Design and deliver student employee orientations, workshops, and professional development
programs.
• Integrate NACE Career Readiness Competencies into training and student employment
experiences.
• Provide coaching and support through individual consultations, group sessions, and digital
resources.
• Help students identify, develop, and articulate transferable skills gained through
employment.

Supervisor Support and Program Improvement
• Create resources and tools that support hiring, onboarding, supervision, and employee
development.
• Assist with supervisor training and communications to promote effective and consistent
management practices.
• Coordinate the student employee evaluation process and provide support to supervisors and
students.
• Identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness and recommend process
enhancements.
• Refer employee relations, accommodation, payroll, conduct, or performance concerns to the
appropriate College representatives.

Data, Outreach, and Administrative Support
• Maintain records and tracking systems related to hiring, onboarding, training, evaluations, and
program outcomes.
• Prepare reports, presentations, and data summaries to support program assessment and grant
requirements.
• Support student employment outreach, hiring events, recognition programs, and Center for Career
Preparation initiatives.
• Perform other duties consistent with the responsibilities and objectives of the
position.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Relevant student employment, internship, practicum, or early-career experience will be considered.
Experience: 2+ years of related experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
• Experience with Paycor or another HR information/payroll system.
• Experience supporting new-hire onboarding, Form I-9 verification, or employment
documentation.
• Experience in higher education, student employment, career services, workforce development, or
training facilitation.
• Familiarity with NACE Career Readiness Competencies or competency-based student
development.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution
skills.
• Demonstrated experience in customer service, student support, administrative operations, human
resources, training, or a related field.
• Ability to explain complex processes, facilitate learning, and provide effective support to
diverse audiences.
• Excellent organizational, time-management, and project coordination skills with strong attention
to detail and follow-through.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and
the ability to learn new technologies and systems.
• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism, discretion, and
sound judgment.
• Commitment to providing accessible, inclusive, and strengths-based support to neurodiverse
students and colleagues.
• Knowledge of process improvement and system optimization, with the ability to identify
opportunities to enhance workflows and services.
• Ability to collaborate effectively across departments while contributing to shared goals and
continuous improvement efforts.
• Availability to participate in evening and weekend on-call responsibilities and respond to
emergencies as needed.

ENVIRONMENT:
This role operates in a professional office environment with regular interaction across campus and
digital platforms. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to
perform essential functions.
Additional Information
This description is intended to outline the general scope of responsibilities and is not an
exhaustive list of duties. Beacon College is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to
fostering a diverse and inclusive community.

    • Candidates must be able to work without H-1B or STEM OPT sponsorship.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible, hourly engagement designed to accommodate different professional schedules.
      • Opportunity to apply your existing expertise to projects focused on improving and training advanced AI systems.
      • Competitive compensation based on services rendered.

🛠️ What You Bring

  • Experience building propensity and behavioral prediction models

  • Hands-on knowledge of Machine Learning frameworks including Scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM

  • Experience designing and measuring experiments through A/B testing and campaign performance analysis

  • Strong expertise with Business Intelligence platforms including MicroStrategy, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent solutions

  • Experience working with analytics and data environments on AWS

  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions while working directly with client stakeholders

  • Direct experience within payment ecosystems, debit/credit card products, or VISA-related initiatives

  • Knowledge of PySpark and distributed data processing frameworks

  • Experience designing or supporting ETL/ELT data pipelines

  • Understanding of marketing attribution models and campaign optimization methodologies

🎯 What Makes You Successful

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through data-driven storytelling

  • Comfortable leading analytical discussions, workshops, and strategic conversations with business leaders

  • Able to translate complex analytical findings into practical recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes

  • Brings a consultative mindset that balances analytical excellence with commercial impact

  • Demonstrates strong prioritization and decision-making skills in high-demand BAU environments

  • Builds credibility through technical leadership, proactive insight generation, and collaborative problem solving

Role Details

📍Location: Bogotá, Colombia.
💼 Contract: Full-time | Indefinite-term
🌐 Work Model: Hybrid (1 - 2 days per week on site)

Rewards - What We Offer at Keyrus

  • 100% remote work

  • International and multicultural projects

  • Opportunities to work with leading technologies in the Digital Commerce ecosystem

  • Access to training programs and continuous professional development

  • Professional growth opportunities and internal mobility

  • A culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning

🌍 What We Stand For

  • Collective Intelligence — Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

  • Reliability — The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

  • Pragmatism — Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit — Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. Designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (AWS & Azure)
location: Metro Manila, National Capital Region, ph
description:
As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer at Bilue, you own the security, compliance and operational integrity of the AWS and Azure platforms we run for our clients, including their AI workloads.

You will run the infrastructure, harden the pipelines, take the alerts our SOC partner escalates through to closure, and keep our ISO 27001 evidence audit ready.This is a hands-on role inside the codebase, working alongside our engineers rather than reviewing their work from a distance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operate and maintain AWS and Azure infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and environment configuration across client platforms

  • Triage security alerts escalated by our third party SOC, drive each one through to remediation and closure, and lead the post incident review

  • Monitor security posture and manage vulnerability remediation across the infrastructure and application layers, including patching and dependency updates

  • Review pull requests alongside the development team and embed security controls into build and deployment processes in line with agreed policies

  • Manage identity, access controls, secrets and API credentials across both clouds, including key rotation and least privilege reviews

  • Maintain observability, alerting, backup and disaster recovery capability, and run regular recovery and restoration testing

  • Maintain infrastructure and security compliance to ISO 27001, covering configuration standards, logging, audit evidence and closure of control gaps

  • Use AI responsibly and in line with Bilue's AI policies, treating it as a tool to work smarter while keeping human judgement at the centre of your decisions

  • Act as the escalation point for critical security alerts outside business hours, with an allowance provided

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Mindset & Experience

  • Real craft in your work, you build the security gate rather than only switching on the scanner, and you care that a fix actually holds

  • A consultative approach, you can explain a risk and its trade offs to a client or an engineer without hiding behind jargon

  • A passion for connection, you share what you find and lift the security knowledge of the whole team rather than keeping it to yourself

  • Ownership and accountability, happy to be the security escalation point and to take an alert through to closure without being chased

  • A drive to shape solutions, curious enough to trace a dependency alert through to real exploitability in the codebase and then work with developers on the fix

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands on experience operating production workloads across both AWS and Azure in a cloud security, DevSecOps or platform engineering role

  • Cloud security services in production. GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM, KMS and CloudTrail on the AWS side, or Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Key Vault and Azure Policy on the Azure side

  • Confident writing and reviewing Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code

  • Able to read application code, raise security issues at the code level, and understand how APIs, services and databases fit together in a running platform

  • Able to diagnose faults across the stack and run root cause analysis, tracing a vulnerability from a dependency alert through to real exploitability, then working with developers on the fix

  • CI/CD pipeline experience, including building the security gates rather than only configuring a scanner

  • Practical security alert triage and incident response alongside an external SOC or MSSP

  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence

  • AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or an equivalent certification

Nice to Have

  • A background in platform or backend delivery, with experience building and shipping systems rather than only securing them

LIFE AT BILUE

Connection that counts
From monthly Anchor Days and team lunches to our annual offsite, we create intentional moments to connect, collaborate, and celebrate. These are not just fun perks. They are part of how we work and grow together.

Flexibility that works
We offer flexible hours, aligned with AEST so you can collaborate with the wider team. It gives you the space to do your best work while staying genuinely connected.

Strong internal communities
We actively foster internal communities across tech, design, delivery, AI and beyond, giving you plenty of chances to connect, share knowledge, and learn from your peers.

Opportunities to grow
We invest in your development with unlimited access to our learning library, partnership networks and certification pathways, plus support from our internal performance coach. Whether you want to deepen your technical skills or grow your leadership potential, we will back you.

Flat structure, real impact
At Bilue, everyone's voice matters. Our leadership team is hands-on and approachable, and we operate without unnecessary layers. We keep things open and transparent, and your ideas will be heard, no matter your title.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Kubernetes & Customised Scheduler)
description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior AI Engineer will be a core builder of the AI & Applications team’s Model-to-Grid product, designing, developing, and operating the Kubernetes-based workload orchestration layer for massive-scale AI factories. The role has a strong software and platform engineering focus: building a proprietary job scheduler that enables efficient, reliable, and policy-driven execution of training, fine-tuning, inference, batch, benchmarking, and agentic workloads across cutting-edge GPU systems, including NVIDIA NVL72 GB300-scale deployments and future-generation platforms such as VR200.

The proprietary scheduler is a central product differentiator. It must be network-topology aware and AI-factory-resource aware: making placement, queueing, prioritization, admission, and execution decisions based not only on nominal GPU availability, but also on GPU and NVLink/NVSwitch topology, node and fault-domain boundaries, RDMA and fabric health, storage locality and throughput, workload characteristics, capacity, power, thermal state, maintenance activity, and other operational constraints.

The resulting capability improves outcomes in two directions. For AI users, it provides better workload placement, lower queue times, higher GPU utilization, stronger job-success rates, improved end-to-end throughput, and faster time-to-results. For AI-factory and grid operators, it serves as a technical shock absorber by making demand more observable, controllable, schedulable, and responsive to infrastructure availability, system health, power, thermal, capacity, and operational conditions.

The role will work closely with other AI engineers, inference and optimization engineers, the Model-to-Grid product and program lead, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and operations teams. It will turn scheduler product requirements into robust production capabilities, integrating Kubernetes, custom controllers, APIs, observability, automation, workload recipes, benchmark signals, and supporting platform services. The work will align with the architectural direction of NVIDIA DSX OS and AI Factory Blueprint concepts - co-designed, resilient, multi-tenant AI-factory operations, while delivering the organization’s proprietary scheduler intelligence and differentiated Model-to-Grid capabilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, operate, and continuously improve the proprietary Kubernetes-native job scheduling platform for AI workloads.
  • Develop scheduler architecture, custom resource definitions, Kubernetes controllers, admission webhooks, scheduling plugins, APIs, CLI tools, and automation required to support workload submission, placement, execution, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Define and implement scheduling policies for training, fine-tuning, inference, benchmarking, batch, data-processing, and agentic workloads.
  • Build topology-aware placement mechanisms that account for GPU locality, NVLink/NVSwitch domains, node topology, NUMA affinity, NIC placement, RDMA paths, network-fabric topology, storage locality, and fault-domain boundaries.
  • Build AI-factory resource-aware scheduling mechanisms that account for cluster capacity, node health, fabric condition, storage performance, GPU availability, maintenance windows, software compatibility, capacity reservations, power limits, thermal conditions, and operational constraints.
  • Implement workload-control capabilities including admission control, queueing, priorities, quotas, fair sharing, reservations, preemption, gang scheduling, co-scheduling, backfilling, workload aging, retry policies, checkpoint-aware scheduling, deferred execution, and failure recovery.
  • Develop workload demand-shaping and grid-aware controls that allow eligible workloads to be delayed, paced, prioritized, rescheduled, right-sized, or placed differently in response to capacity, health, power, thermal, maintenance, or other AI-factory operating signals.
  • Integrate the scheduler with Kubernetes control-plane capabilities, GPU device plugins, node-feature discovery, network and storage services, observability systems, and policy engines.
  • Integrate, where appropriate, with Slurm, Slinky, vCluster, Kueue, KAI, Volcano, YuniKorn, or related systems to deliver a coherent workload-management experience across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Build a stable developer and user experience for workload submission and management, including APIs, SDKs, CLI workflows, templates, workload definitions, job-status visibility, event streams, scheduling explanations, and self-service troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Work with AI and inference engineers to encode validated model and workload recipes into scheduler-aware templates, including requirements for model size, precision, distributed parallelism, GPU count, topology, network, storage, runtime, benchmark target, and expected resource profile.
  • Enable Model-to-Grid benchmarking by exposing scheduler, placement, resource, and workload-lifecycle data for end-to-end analysis across models, runtimes, GPUs, network, storage, power, thermals, and application performance.
  • Build observability into the scheduling platform, including queue depth, scheduling latency, admission outcomes, placement decisions, resource fragmentation, topology quality, GPU utilization, job lifecycle, failure reasons, preemption events, retry behavior, power and thermal signals, and workload performance.
  • Develop actionable scheduler explanations and operator views that show why a workload was queued, admitted, placed, deferred, preempted, or rescheduled and what changes could improve execution outcomes.
  • Establish performance testing, load testing, scale testing, chaos testing, fault recovery testing, and regression testing for scheduler components and Kubernetes platform integrations.
  • Operate production Kubernetes clusters and associated scheduling services with strong reliability, security, change-management, backup, recovery, and incident-response practices.
  • Build CI/CD and GitOps workflows for scheduler code, configuration, CRDs, controllers, policy definitions, workload templates, and cluster-service releases.
  • Implement secure multi-tenancy and resource-governance controls, including namespace and tenant isolation, RBAC, quotas, workload identity, policy enforcement, audit trails, and controlled access to GPU, data, and infrastructure resources.
  • Partner with platform, infrastructure, networking, storage, and operations teams to ensure scheduler decisions reflect actual infrastructure capabilities, constraints, health, performance, maintenance, and capacity conditions.
  • Partner with the Model-to-Grid product and program lead to define scheduler feature scope, milestone plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, benchmark targets, documentation, and adoption measures.
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, design reviews, release readiness, incident postmortems, and continuous improvement of Model-to-Grid and AI-factory operations.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or comparable software and systems-engineering roles.
  • Deep practical expertise in Kubernetes architecture and operations, including control planes, scheduling, controllers, operators, CRDs, admission controllers, APIs, networking, storage, security, and multi-tenancy.
  • Demonstrated experience building, extending, or deeply integrating workload schedulers, resource managers, or orchestration systems, such as Kubernetes Scheduler Framework, Kueue, KAI, Volcano, YuniKorn, Slurm, Slinky, Run:ai, or proprietary implementations.
  • Strong programming skills in Go, with Python proficiency for automation, integration, tooling, and performance analysis.
  • Experience building production Kubernetes controllers, operators, scheduling plugins, admission webhooks, REST or gRPC APIs, CLI tools, and event-driven distributed services.
  • Strong understanding of GPU-accelerated AI/ML workloads, including distributed training, fine-tuning, model serving, inference, benchmarking, and batch processing.
  • Practical experience with GPU scheduling and resource allocation, including GPU partitioning, MIG where applicable, GPU affinity, multi-GPU workloads, gang scheduling, and topology-aware placement.
  • Understanding of GPU system topology and high-performance AI networking, including NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe, NUMA, RDMA, RoCEv2, NIC affinity, collective communication, and network contention.
  • Familiarity with large-scale NVIDIA GPU architectures, including NVL72 GB300-class systems and future-generation high-density GPU platforms, and their implications for cluster scheduling, workload placement, network topology, operations, and fault handling.
  • Experience working with storage and data-path considerations for AI workloads, including high-throughput shared file systems, object storage, caching, data locality, checkpointing, and storage-performance constraints.
  • Understanding of AI-factory or data-center operations, including capacity planning, workload demand forecasting, power-aware scheduling, energy efficiency, thermal constraints, maintenance coordination, system health, resiliency, and infrastructure telemetry.
  • Experience with observability and performance analysis using tools and concepts such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, logs, traces, metrics, DCGM, GPU telemetry, network telemetry, workload profiling, and SLOs.
  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, infrastructure as code, policy as code, and safe production rollout practices using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD, Flux, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, OPA, or Kyverno.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native security practices, including container security, image signing, software supply-chain controls, secrets management, RBAC, workload identity, network policies, runtime security, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Kubernetes, distributed systems, GPU workloads, networking, storage, operating systems, and application-level job execution.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Kubernetes scheduler and controller engineering.
  • Distributed systems architecture, reliability, and performance engineering.

  • Model-to-Grid engineering: connecting AI demand, scheduler decisions, benchmark data, infrastructure telemetry, and AI-factory operating constraints.
  • Multi-objective scheduling design across user throughput, latency, time-to-results, utilization, fairness, cost, power, energy, resilience, and grid or operator constraints.

  • Security-conscious multi-tenant platform engineering.
  • Pragmatic architecture and technical decision-making under evolving hardware, software, and operational constraints.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with AI, applications, platform, infrastructure, networking, storage, security, operations, and product teams.
  • Delivery and adoption of a reliable proprietary Kubernetes-native scheduler that supports the AI & Applications team’s Model-to-Grid product roadmap.
  • Scheduler availability, reliability, recovery performance, and successful completion of scheduled workload operations.
  • Improvement in end-user workload outcomes, including lower queue time, reduced time-to-start, improved placement quality, increased job completion rate, faster time-to-results, higher training scaling efficiency, and improved inference throughput and latency.
  • Improvement in AI-factory resource efficiency, including GPU utilization, reduced resource fragmentation, improved multi-node placement, increased cluster throughput, more effective capacity use, and reduced avoidable network or storage contention.
  • Percentage of eligible workloads scheduled using topology-aware placement policies that account for GPU, NVLink/NVSwitch, network, RDMA, node, storage, and fault-domain characteristics.
  • Percentage of eligible workloads scheduled using AI-factory-resource-aware policies incorporating relevant capacity, health, maintenance, power, thermal, storage, or fabric signals.
  • Measurable accuracy and effectiveness of scheduler placement and admission decisions, based on workload performance relative to expected benchmarks, queue-time outcomes, job-success rate, resource utilization, user overrides, and operator intervention rates.
  • Reduction in manual scheduling, workload-placement, capacity-allocation, and operational-triage effort for users and AI-factory operators.
  • Quality and adoption of scheduler APIs, CLI tools, workload templates, model recipes, self-service workflows, scheduling explanations, and developer documentation.

  • Successful integration of scheduler telemetry and policy outcomes into Model-to-Grid benchmarking, capacity planning, performance optimization, and operator-facing insights.
  • Demonstrated support for grid and operator objectives, including improved workload-demand visibility, more predictable capacity use, controlled workload behavior, support for maintenance coordination, and reduced exposure to avoidable power, thermal, capacity, or infrastructure hotspots.
  • Release quality for scheduler and platform components, measured through automated-test coverage, performance-regression prevention, scale-test results, fault-recovery validation, security posture, deployment reliability, rollback readiness, and incident trends.

Effective collaboration with the Model-to-Grid product and program lead, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and operations teams, demonstrated by predictable delivery against agreed feature milestones, early dependency identification, and timely resolution of critical blockers

title: Team Leader, Contribution Management
description:
About Us
UniSuper is a place where brilliant thinkers and passionate people come together. As one of Australia’s largest super funds, the work you’ll do with us makes a meaningful difference today and tomorrow for our members, the planet and for you.

The Service & Experience (S&E) business unit brings together all member facing teams, with the ambition to deliver a consistently high quality, end to end service experience. Our service proposition is central to the UniSuper purpose - providing great retirement outcomes through easy, seamless, personalised interactions every time.

The Opportunity
This 12 month contract is a genuine opportunity to step into a leadership role where your impact will be seen every day. As Team Leader, Contribution Management Services, you will lead a team at the heart of how UniSuper delivers for its members. Your work will directly influence how contributions are processed, how services are experienced, and how we continue to lift outcomes for the people who rely on us for their retirement.

You’ll join at a time of evolution. As our services become more digital and straight through, this role offers the chance to shape how a modern operations team works.

You’ll bring people together, set clear expectations, and build confidence in a team with varied experience, helping them grow capability, work more collaboratively, and take ownership of increasingly complex work. In addition you will:

  • Lead an established team and continue to create a connected, collaborative environment where people feel supported and clear on expectations
  • Play a key role in lifting service outcomes by strengthening capability, removing inefficiencies, and improving how work flows through the team
  • Drive a more modern, adaptable way of working as services shift toward digital and straight through processing
  • Use performance insights and operational data to guide decisions, improve efficiency, and track meaningful progress
  • Build individual and team capability through coaching, development, and thoughtful leadership, supporting people at different stages of their journey
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that simplify processes and enhance the experience for members and colleagues

About You
You’re a people leader who knows how to balance care, clarity, and performance. You set expectations early, follow through consistently, and create an environment where people understand what good looks like. You’re comfortable leading a team with a mix of tenure and capability, and you know how to bring individuals together to work as one team.

You’re also someone who leans into change rather than away from it. You enjoy improving how things work, using data and insight to guide decisions, and helping others build confidence in new ways of working. You lead with patience and adaptability, and you know how to support individuals with different learning needs while still maintaining strong team outcomes.
In addition, you will hold the following:

  • Demonstrated experience leading operational teams with a focus on performance, engagement, and development
  • Ability to set clear expectations and translate priorities into structured, achievable work plans
  • Strong capability in coaching and developing individuals with varied experience and learning styles
  • Confidence in using data and reporting to monitor performance and identify improvement opportunities
  • Experience leading teams through change, building understanding and momentum as priorities evolve
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to simplify processes and improve efficiency while maintaining quality and compliance

What US offer
UniSuper is proud of our culture and benefits, which empower our people to achieve their full potential, thrive, and grow their career with us. These include:

  • Amazing Lunch & Learn sessions
  • A culture that values diversity and inclusion
  • Community, Culture & Wellbeing leave

UniSuper believes that the best way to achieve great things is when we come together and collaborate. Therefore, we ask you to be able to commit to 60% of your time in office.

It should go without saying, but at UniSuper, we value and celebrate diversity and inclusion. We believe that a variety of perspectives, backgrounds, interests, abilities, and skills is crucial for delivering great retirement outcomes for our members. We invite you to apply for the roles that suit your career aspirations, even if you don't meet all the requirements.

Think Great. Create Great.

title: Dog Sitter
description:
Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— San Diego County Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

This is a flexible, part-time independent contractor position where all jobs are voluntary and you set your availability and service area, and we match you with clients. It’s a great fit if you want meaningful, independent work caring for dogs and cats, helping pet parents travel with peace of mind, and building trust with repeat clients.

What You’ll Do

Pet sitting visits may include:

  • Feeding and refreshing water
  • Cleaning up waste
  • Giving playtime, affection, or companionship based on each pet's personality
  • Sending visit updates and photos through our app
  • Following each client’s detailed care instructions
  • Bringing in mail or packages
  • Adjusting lights, blinds, or trash/recycling when requested
  • Administering medication when within your experience and comfort level
Most visits take place while clients are traveling, so weekend, holiday, morning, afternoon, and evening availability is especially valuable.

Service Types

  • Walks: 30-90 minutes (1-3x daily)
  • Drop-ins: 30 / 45 / 60 minutes (1–3x daily)
  • Extended daytime visits: 2-8 hours
  • Overnights: 10-12 hour stays
  • 24-hour care: live-in with overnight care

What We Look For

  • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented
  • Strong written communication
  • Comfortable working independently in clients’ homes
  • Smartphone with reliable internet & camera
  • Medication experience (oral, injections, fluids)
  • Holiday & weekend availability

Pay + Perks

  • Sitters are paid per visit, with rates typically starting around $25 per 30 minute visit, with higher pay for longer visits, overnight care, house sitting.
  • Weekly direct deposit
  • Bonus opportunities (holidays, short notice, strong feedback)
  • 100% of tips go to you

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

Notes:

  • Apply to one location only
  • No phone calls (we contact strong matches)

Job Description:

Job Description

En Johnson & Johnson creemos que la salud lo es todo. Nuestra fortaleza en innovación en atención médica nos permite construir un mundo donde se previenen, tratan y curan enfermedades complejas, donde los tratamientos son más inteligentes y menos invasivos y las soluciones son personales. A través de nuestra experiencia en Medicina Innovadora y MedTech, estamos en una posición única para innovar en todo el espectro de soluciones de atención médica y ofrecer los avances del mañana para impactar profundamente la salud de la humanidad.

Estamos buscando al mejor talento para la posición de Analista de servicio al cliente, que estará localizada en Bogotá, Colombia.

Propósito del cargo

El Analista de servicio al cliente es un punto clave de contacto entre las funciones internas de J&J y las partes externas para interactuar con la organización de Deliver y Customer Service. El especialista brinda soporte directo a los clientes y facilita las actividades transaccionales. Se espera que las personas en este rol demuestren un sólido entendimiento de los procesos de servicio al cliente de J&J, sus productos y la relación entre ellos. Asimismo, debe gestionar relaciones clave y colaborar con diferentes áreas para resolver problemas de los clientes. El Especialista de Servicio al Cliente reporta directamente a un Supervisor de Servicio al Cliente y escala los asuntos cuando es necesario.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Gestionar actividades de administración de pedidos, incluyendo programación de entregas y citas.

  • Procesar pedidos y realizar seguimiento a órdenes nuevas y existentes.

  • Brindar soporte y atención a consultas de clientes.

  • Administrar actividades de facturación, incluyendo emisión y corrección de facturas.

  • Revisar planes de facturación y coordinar requerimientos especiales de facturación.

  • Trabajar en conjunto con Finanzas y otras áreas para la gestión de créditos y débitos.

  • Resolver situaciones relacionadas con gestión de pedidos, reclamaciones, devoluciones y retiros de producto (recalls).

  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para identificar soluciones efectivas.

  • Mantener comunicación constante con el cliente y proporcionar soluciones oportunas a sus requerimientos.

Requisitos

  • Profesional universitario en administracion de empresas, ingenieria industrial o afines.

  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en áreas relacionadas con servicio al cliente, logística, administración de pedidos o funciones afines.

  • Conocimiento de procesos de servicio al cliente y manejo de relaciones con clientes.

  • Manejo de herramientas Microsoft Office.

  • Conocimiento de SAP (deseable).

  • Conocimiento de Salesforce (deseable).

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal.

  • Capacidad para tomar decisiones de manera ágil y trabajar con múltiples fuentes de información.

  • Español avanzado requerido.

  • Inglés son deseable.

Competencias clave

  • Orientación al cliente y entendimiento de sus necesidades.

  • Capacidad de adaptación a entornos dinámicos y de constante cambio.

  • Enfoque en calidad, cumplimiento y gestión de riesgos.

  • Habilidad para construir relaciones colaborativas y trabajar en equipos de alto desempeño.

  • Sentido de urgencia, flexibilidad y responsabilidad para alcanzar resultados.

Durante más de 130 años, la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión (DEI) han sido parte de nuestro tejido cultural en Johnson & Johnson y están integradas en la forma en que hacemos negocios todos los días. Arraigados en Nuestro Credo, los valores de DEI impulsan nuestra búsqueda de crear un mundo más saludable y equitativo.

Sabemos que el éxito de nuestro negocio depende de qué tan bien comprendamos y satisfagamos las diversas necesidades de las comunidades a las que servimos. Por eso fomentamos una cultura de inclusión y pertenencia donde se valoran todas las perspectivas, habilidades y experiencias, y donde nuestra gente puede alcanzar su máximo potencial.

En Johnson & Johnson, todos pertenecemos.

title: Senior/ Cloud Engineer
company: ST ENGINEERING CLOUD AND DATA CENTRE SOLUTIONS PTE. LTD.
description:
About ST Engineering

ST Engineering is a global technology, defence, and engineering group with offices across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and the U.S., serving customers in more than 100 countries. The Group uses technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives through its diverse portfolio of businesses across the aerospace, smart city, defence, and public security segments. Headquartered in Singapore, ST Engineering ranks among the largest companies listed on the Singapore Exchange.

Our history spans more than 50 years, and our strategy is underpinned by our core values – Integrity, Value Creation, Courage, Commitment and Compassion. These 5 core values guide every aspect of our business and are embedded in our ST Engineering culture – from the people we hire, to working with each other, to our partners and customers.

About our Line of Business – Cloud & Data Centre Solutions

ST Engineering Cloud and Data Centre Solutions Pte Ltd provides all aspects of cloud management, services, and solutions, from initial setup and migration to ongoing operations and optimization. Services include engineering works to design, build and provide facility management service for mission critical environments such data centers, disaster recovery, and business continuity sites.

Together, We Can Make A Significant Impact

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Cloud Engineer with 1–2 years of hands-on experience in AWS Cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and automating scalable and secure cloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads. The ideal candidate is passionate about cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and continuous improvement.

Be Part of Our Success

  • Design, deploy, and manage AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, CloudWatch, etc.) following best practices for security, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform templates/modules to automate cloud resource provisioning and configuration.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud systems to ensure reliability and performance.
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to enable smooth application deployment and compliance alignment.
  • Implement infrastructure monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools like CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK Stack.
  • Maintain proper documentation, version control, and configuration management across environments.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, proof-of-concepts, and ongoing improvements to infrastructure automation.

Qualities We Value

  • 1-2 years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or DevOps.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Cloud Services (compute, storage, networking, IAM, and monitoring).
  • Proven experience in Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts, VPC design, security groups, and IAM policies.
  • Familiarity with Linux administration and scripting (Bash or Python).
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and version control practices.
  • Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

Our Commitment That Goes Beyond the Norm

  • An environment where you will be working on cutting-edge technologies and architectures.
  • Safe space where diverse perspectives are valued, and everyone’s unique contributions are celebrated.
  • Meaningful work and projects that make a difference in people’s lives.
  • A fun, passionate and collaborative workplace.
  • Competitive remuneration and comprehensive benefits.

title: Senior Regulatory and Start Up Specialist (Argentina)
description:
We’re expanding our capabilities across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru, and we’re hiring our first Senior Regulatory and Start Up Specialist (Senior RSS) in Argentina!

As the Senior RSS on our team, you are a seasoned, experienced professional in regulatory and site start-up activities. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the location of the Senior RSS and include but are not limited to initial and subsequent clinical trial submission to Competent Authorities and IRB/Ethics Committees, Informed Consent Form review and adaptation, Essential Document collection and quality review, supporting sites on IRB/EC submissions and providing support to the Site Contract Management group in budget and contract negotiation.

The Senior RSS may act as Subject Matter Expert for questions by other in-country members (CRAs, CSSs or others) supporting site start-up activities, trainer for less-experienced staff on site start-up activities and may be identified as Owner of country specific tools and guidance documents to increase knowledge share of country specific site start-up activities and ensure compliance with local and international clinical trials regulations and guidelines.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Responsible for delivery, in terms of timeliness and quality, of site activation readiness within the assigned country/sites and foreseeing and mitigating any risks
  • Preparation of Clinical Trial Application Forms as well as preparation of submission dossier (initial and amendments/notifications) for submission to Competent Authorities (CA), Ethics Committee (EC) and other applicable local bodies according to local requirements and within required timelines to obtain all necessary authorizations/approvals for the conduct of the Clinical Trial according to international and local/national applicable regulations, company SOPs and principles of ICH-GCP
  • Interaction with CA/EC for study purposes and handling responses to the CA/EC
  • Providing regular updates about CA and EC submissions to the Start Up Lead and/or Regulatory Lead assigned to the study and to Project Manager/Project Team as relevant
  • Maintenance of project plans, project trackers and regulatory intelligence tools as it pertains to assigned responsibilities and to keep Regulatory Leadership updated
  • Preparation/Support the development of study specific start-up plans, IMP release requirements and essential document review criteria
  • Partner with the assigned site CRA to ensure alignment in communication and secure site collaboration
  • Prepare, review and manage collection of essential documents required for site activation/IMP release
  • Customize country/site specific Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Forms.
  • Responsible for/facilitates the translation and co-ordination of translations for documents required for submission
  • Maintain communication with other key functions participating to country start up i.e., Feasibility, Clinical Operations, Project Management, Regulatory, and Site Contracts management group on project specific status and deliverables
  • Act as SME for collection and maintenance of site level critical path to Site Activation data points, including but not limited to Competent Authority, local IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) timelines, site contracts and budget negotiation requirements for and other required reviews to secure on time site activation for the assigned sites in the country
  • When required, participate/support the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee department
  • Keep an updated knowledge of the local clinical trial laws, regulations and help distributing this knowledge within Precision for Medicine to ensure the conduct of Clinical Trials according to international and local/national applicable regulations
  • Maintain audit/inspection readiness at all times and file documents as per TMF plan and/ or study specific plans in the relevant TMF
  • May support the clinical team performing Pre-Study Site Visits
  • May participate/support feasibility group in site outreach to assess potential interest of investigators to a potential study
  • May support development of country specific Country Start-up summary and process flow identifying timelines, risks, and success factors
  • May support development of training sessions to expand Country Start-up knowledge and act as Subject Matter Expert for queries
  • May mentor staff on local study start-up regulations, submissions, and internal procedures
  • May interact with clients to provide activation readiness status updates, request documents or document review, and participate in proposal activities, including slide development and client presentation as required
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management

Qualifications

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelors’ degree in life sciences or related field (ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline), or Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • 3.5 years or more as a Regulatory or SU specialist in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing at the English proficiently (Professional level)

Other Required:

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential
  • Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail required
  • Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based
  • Ability to prioritize workload to meet deadlines

Preferred:

  • Relevant regulatory and site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, CA/EC/IRB submissions) experience for the particular country
  • Experience using milestone tracking tools/systems
  • Can assist junior SU specialists in problem resolution
  • Advanced degree in medical or life sciences (MD, PhD, PharmD)/RAC certification/Masters in Regulatory Science

Competencies:

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Ability to follow task-specific procedures, be attentive to detail and place importance on accuracy of information
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Ability to effectively interact with project team(s) and effectively communicate in English and the local language of the country where located
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency to match the pace
  • Must demonstrate excellent computer skills
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade
  • Flexible attitude with respect to work assignments and new learning

title: ServiceNow Lead Engineer - Sam Pro
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a ServiceNow Lead Engineer - SAM Pro based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to lead the development and enhancement of sophisticated ServiceNow solutions within enterprise technology environments. You will focus on SAM Pro, Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB, and integrated applications that support critical business workflows. The position combines hands-on engineering with solution design, technical problem-solving, and collaboration with stakeholders and technical subject matter experts. You will help configure and optimize complex ServiceNow capabilities while ensuring accurate service visibility, reliable integrations, and high-quality configuration data. Your work will directly contribute to improving operational workflows, application performance, and the accuracy of enterprise service management processes. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong ServiceNow professional who enjoys solving complex platform challenges and delivering scalable solutions.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop and enhance customer applications within ServiceNow, with a primary focus on Work Order Management, scheduling, dispatch, and SAM Pro capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to identify functional requirements and translate them into effective solutions within customized ServiceNow environments.
  • Implement and maintain ServiceNow event rules to support accurate Configuration Management Database (CMDB) binding and reliable service relationships.
  • Work closely with technical SMEs to gather environment information and support the development and maintenance of service maps and event-management capabilities.
  • Design and implement interfaces tailored to different user audiences, including custom application models and Service Portals.
  • Develop integrated business logic and functional components that interact with ServiceNow internal services and APIs through REST-based integrations.
  • Apply enterprise service-oriented and distributed application architecture principles across web services, data access, persistence, and client/server components.
  • Configure and manage Credential-less and Credential-based Discovery capabilities.
  • Install, configure, integrate, maintain, and optimize ServiceNow SAM Pro capabilities across Discovery, Service Mapping, Certification Management, Service Graph Connectors, and Multi-Source CMDB.
  • Configure mechanisms to prevent duplicate Configuration Items (CIs), including the effective use of CI identifiers and identification rules.
  • Extend Horizontal Discovery through custom Infrastructure Patterns and Application Patterns to support complex enterprise environments.
  • Configure, manage, and maintain MID Servers supporting Discovery and Service Mapping activities.
  • Use command-line tools and consoles to troubleshoot, configure, and manage Service Mapping environments.
  • Develop, manage, and migrate Service Mapping patterns between different environments while maintaining configuration consistency and reliability.
  • Configure Identification Rules and other Service Mapping capabilities to ensure accurate discovery and service relationships.
  • Design and configure Discovery for multi-tier services, including advanced Service Mapping patterns and complex application dependencies.
  • Contribute to technical reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvements across the ServiceNow platform.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience working as a ServiceNow Lead Engineer, with hands-on expertise in SAM Pro and related ServiceNow capabilities.
    • Strong understanding of SAM Pro functionality and the ability to communicate, design, configure, and implement solutions using the platform.
    • Proven experience developing interfaces for different user audiences through custom ServiceNow applications and Service Portals.
    • Solid experience developing integrated logic and functional components that interact with ServiceNow internal services and APIs, particularly through REST integrations.
    • Strong understanding of service-oriented and distributed enterprise application architectures, including web services, data access, persistence, and client/server models.
    • Hands-on experience with both Credential-less and Credential-based Discovery.
    • Proven experience installing, configuring, integrating, managing, and maintaining ServiceNow SAM Pro and related capabilities.
    • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, Certification Management, Service Graph Connectors, and Multi-Source CMDB.
    • Experience configuring CI identifiers and Identification Rules to prevent duplicate Configuration Items and maintain CMDB integrity.
    • Hands-on experience extending Horizontal Discovery with custom Infrastructure Patterns and Application Patterns.
    • Strong knowledge of configuring, managing, and maintaining MID Servers.
    • Experience working with command-line consoles for Service Mapping configuration and troubleshooting.
    • Proven ability to create, manage, and migrate Service Mapping patterns between environments.
    • Strong experience configuring Identification Rules and advanced Service Mapping capabilities.
    • Experience discovering and mapping multi-tier services, including advanced pattern configuration and complex service dependencies.
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate complex platform and integration issues.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders, technical SMEs, and distributed teams.
    • Strong ability to understand complex technical environments and translate requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
    • Detail-oriented and proactive approach to platform quality, configuration accuracy, and continuous improvement.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to work remotely from India.
      • Technical ownership of complex ServiceNow implementations and enterprise platform capabilities.
      • Exposure to SAM Pro, Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB, Service Graph Connectors, and advanced ServiceNow integrations.
      • Opportunity to work on sophisticated enterprise workflows involving service visibility, configuration management, and operational processes.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Job Summary

The Finance Business Partner plays a critical role in supporting the Finance & Administration Director in driving the Group's financial planning, business performance management, and strategic decision-making processes.

The incumbent will lead management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and business partnering activities across the Group. This role serves as a key bridge between Finance and business operations, providing management with meaningful financial insights, performance analysis, and recommendations to support growth and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

  • Lead the annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes for the Group.
  • Develop financial models, business cases, scenario analysis, and sensitivity assessments to support strategic initiatives.
  • Analyse business and financial performance against budgets, forecasts, and key performance indicators.
  • Monitor revenue, profitability, cash flow, and cost drivers, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities.

Management Reporting

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management reports for senior management.
  • Develop and maintain management dashboards and KPIs to support business performance monitoring.
  • Provide insightful variance analysis and recommendations to improve financial and operational performance.
  • Translate financial data into meaningful business insights to support decision-making.

Business Partnering

  • Partner closely with operational and functional leaders to support business objectives and drive accountability.
  • Provide financial guidance on commercial decisions, capital investments, project evaluations, and resource allocation.
  • Support business units in achieving budget targets and improving profitability.
  • Challenge assumptions and promote financially sound decision-making across the organisation.

Strategic Finance Support

  • Support the Finance & Administration Director in strategic planning and corporate initiatives.
  • Conduct market, industry, and financial analysis to support business growth opportunities.
  • Participate in mergers, acquisitions, investments, or strategic projects where required.
  • Prepare presentation materials and financial analyses for management and Board discussions.

Systems, Automation & Process Improvement

  • Drive continuous improvement in financial reporting processes, controls, and systems.
  • Champion the effective use of Workday Financial Management and reporting tools.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, data analytics, and dashboard enhancements.
  • Support finance digitalisation and transformation initiatives across the Group.

Governance & Controls

  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support internal and external audit processes as required.
  • Maintain high standards of financial integrity, accuracy, and governance.


Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification is mandatory.
  • Additional professional qualifications such as CA Singapore, ACCA, CPA Australia, ICAEW, or equivalent will be an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant finance experience, with significant exposure to:
    - Management Reporting
    - Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
    - Budgeting and Forecasting
    - Financial Modelling
    - Business Partnering
    - Performance Analytics
  • Experience in a group finance, multinational, listed company, manufacturing, engineering, marine, construction, or project-based environment will be advantageous.
  • Experience leading finance transformation or ERP implementation projects will be highly regarded.

Technical Skills

  • Strong financial analysis, planning, and forecasting capabilities.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modelling skills.
  • Experience with Workday ERP or SAP is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or similar analytics and reporting platforms is advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of accounting standards, financial controls, and corporate finance principles.


TAFEP-Compliant Equal Opportunity Statement

Penguin International Limited is committed to fair and merit-based employment practices. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and assess applicants based on their skills, qualifications, experience, and ability to perform the job.


Why Join Us?

​Drive the Future of Shipbuilding

At Penguin International Limited, we don’t just build ships; we set industry benchmarks.

As a global leader in high-speed aluminum commercial vessels, we are at the forefront of maritime innovation, including the design and deployment of cutting-edge hybrid-electric and pure electric propulsion systems.

​A Legacy of Excellence and Innovation

With over 50 years of heritage and the global recognition of our "Flex" brand of crewboats and security boats, we offer a stable yet dynamic environment. You will play a pivotal role in maintaining the quality of vessels that are trusted by our clients around the world.

​Cross-Border Leadership

This role offers a unique opportunity to manage quality standards across international borders. You will gain diverse operational experience by bridging our Singapore headquarters with our high-volume production hub at PT Kim Seah Shipyard in Batam.

​Professional Growth and Impact

We value technical expertise and leadership. In this role, you are a key stakeholder in our "Quality First" culture, with the autonomy to drive process improvements and mentor the next generation of maritime professionals.

▪ ensure the availability of qualified employees for the quality function in cooperation with plant HR

Monitoring and Reporting

▪ ensure quality performance (KPI) monitoring and reporting (e.g. regarding scrap, waste, etc.) in cooperation with plant controlling and production
▪ initiate and control measures to improve quality performance

Standardization

▪ provide feedback and input for further development of standards regarding quality processes (e.g. test criteria, KPI reporting, etc.), quality equipment (e.g. laboratory equipment, measurement equipment for quality assurance), quality IT (e.g.Control plan tools, etc.) to segment, BU or BA functions

Professional Experience
(Variety of Functions, Variety of Business, General Management Experience)▪ 5 or more years of professional experience in various quality management functions

Project and/or Process Experience

▪ comprehensive experience in rubber and plastic production processes

Leadership Experience

Intercultural / International Experience

▪ experience in working with international teams on quality topics and understanding of foreign cultures

title: Associate, AML Analytics

You will use data to strengthen anti-money laundering detection strategies and help identify unusual transaction patterns and suspicious activity. You will contribute to improving detection models, risk scoring, dashboards, and overall program effectiveness while helping reduce false positives. It is an excellent fit for a curious, data-driven professional who enjoys solving complex problems and applying technology to real-world risk challenges.

Accountabilities:

  • Create, improve, and maintain detection models designed to identify unusual transaction patterns and suspicious activities while minimizing false positives.
  • Extract, transform, and analyze large datasets to uncover patterns, trends, anomalies, and emerging risks associated with financial crime.
  • Conduct quantitative analysis using SQL and translate analytical findings into clear, actionable proposals for improving AML detection strategies.
  • Refine risk-scoring models to assess and quantify the level of AML risk associated with clients and support stronger risk-based decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical reporting that provide meaningful insights into AML program effectiveness and detection performance.
  • Monitor AML trends, performance indicators, and emerging patterns, communicating key findings and recommendations to AML leadership.
  • Partner closely with compliance, product, technology, and other cross-functional teams to ensure AML considerations are incorporated into new products and feature launches.
  • Identify opportunities to improve detection approaches, analytical processes, and program effectiveness through data-driven experimentation and iteration.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and other data workflows while applying sound judgment to validate outputs and maintain analytical quality.
  • Translate complex analytical results into compelling stories and recommendations that can be understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, curiosity, and thoughtful innovation in financial crime prevention.

    • Requirements

    • Strong data and analytical skills, with applied experience in a risk-related function such as AML, fraud, compliance, or a similar field.
    • Practical experience using SQL for quantitative analysis, data investigation, pattern identification, and insight generation.
    • Ability to synthesize complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business and risk stakeholders.
    • Experience using AI tools to improve productivity and analytical workflows, combined with the judgment to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs.
    • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Ability to weigh multiple sources of information, assess trade-offs, and make balanced, well-reasoned decisions.
    • Strong intellectual curiosity and genuine interest in solving complex problems involving data, risk, and financial crime.

    • Strong collaborative skills and the ability to work effectively with product, technology, compliance, and operational teams.
    • A thoughtful, detail-oriented approach with strong ownership and accountability for analytical outcomes.
