Die Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und mittelfristig zusätzliche Verantwortung als Subject Matter Expert oder Senior Scientist zu übernehmen.

Kompetenzen und Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Planung, Koordination und wissenschaftliche Betreuung von Stabilitätsstudien unter Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen sowie interner Qualitätsstandards.
  • Erstellung, Überarbeitung und Pflege von Studienprotokollen, wissenschaftlichen Berichten und weiterer stabilitätsrelevanter Dokumentation in englischer Sprache.
  • Auswertung, Interpretation und Plausibilisierung von Stabilitätsdaten sowie Analyse von Trends zur Sicherstellung der Produktqualität.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Quality Control, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Research & Development sowie weiteren internen und externen Stakeholdern.
  • Unterstützung bei der Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, CAPAs, Changes und Risikobewertungen im Zusammenhang mit Stabilitätsstudien.
  • Mitarbeit bei der Vorbereitung und Unterstützung interner sowie externer Audits und Behördeninspektionen.
  • Mitwirkung bei der kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Prozessen, Systemen und Dokumentationen im Bereich Stability.
  • Unterstützung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie Übernahme eigener wissenschaftlicher Aufgaben und Teilprojekte.

Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Pharmazie, Chemie, Biologie, Biotechnologie oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Erste Berufserfahrung (idealerweise 2–3 Jahre) in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- oder Life-Science-Industrie.
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Stabilitätsstudien ist von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.
  • Interesse an wissenschaftlicher Datenanalyse; Kenntnisse in Statistik oder Data Analytics sind von Vorteil.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen; Erfahrung mit LIMS oder vergleichbaren Systemen ist von Vorteil.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Dokumentationen.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Organisations- und Priorisierungskompetenz.
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen.
  • Hohe Lernbereitschaft und Motivation, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich fachlich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Über diese Position

  • Als Stability Scientist arbeitest du in einer wissenschaftlich anspruchsvollen und gleichzeitig stark vernetzten Funktion innerhalb unserer Qualitätsorganisation. Du koordinierst Stabilitätsstudien, analysierst wissenschaftliche Daten und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Qualität und Zulassung unserer Produkte über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg.
  • Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Bürotätigkeit mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen sowie einer klaren Entwicklungsperspektive zum Senior Scientist oder Subject Matter Expert.

Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnissen und relevanten Ausbildungsnachweisen.

title: CNC Specialist (NX CAM) - Blades & Vanes
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

CNC SPECIALIST (NX CAM) - BLADES & VANES

The CNC Specialist role at SpaceX owns programming and process decisions for IGT blades and vanes—not only writing mill toolpaths. This role works with vendors, machinists, programmers, engineering, and operations with a high level of autonomy, critical thinking, and accountability for equipment, consumables, processes, and output. The CNC Specialist will support the new blades and vanes line in Bastrop, Texas, and must have a strong understanding of programming, equipment, and consumables for: milling, grinding, sinker EDM, wire EDM, trailing-edge machining, laser drilling, and stem drilling on high-temperature superalloys (including nickel-based materials). Mechanical design of functional shop aids (brackets, holders, rigging, fixtures) is expected.

This role sits on a project team selecting, installing, and commissioning the line. We need a high-ownership Specialist who ships results, unblocks other teams, and does not wait to be asked.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use NX CAD/CAM to program all blades/vanes processes: 5-axis milling, grinding, sinker EDM, wire EDM, trailing-edge machining, laser drilling, and stem drilling.
  • Own a comprehensive level of process knowledge: machine capability, workholding, electrodes/wire/wheels/nozzles and other consumables, parameters, and quality outcomes for each process above.
  • Verify NC files (e.g. Vericut) and own revision control on programs, setup sheets, and process documentation.
  • Select tooling and consumables; set parameters for superalloys; be accountable for tool/consumable life, cycle time, and part quality.
  • Drive DFM: recommend and implement drawing/process changes; own the process decision.
  • Design fixtures, brackets, holders, and rigging required to run the line.
  • Support equipment selection, vendor engagement, and commissioning, including FAT and SAT as required, for mill, grind, EDM, laser, and related cells.
  • Troubleshoot common machine, program, consumable, and process issues; train operators and CNC Programmers; act as technical backup on the floor.
  • Own process development through prove-out to stable production; meet performance goals and escalate only when the issue is beyond the cell.
  • Drive process improvements and support other teams.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma/equivalency certificate.
  • 5+ years of CNC programming experience in NX.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years of CNC programming in NX, including experience as a manufacturing engineer or lead programmer on blades/vanes.
  • Demonstrated ownership of turbine blade or equivalent airfoil processes (programming, tooling, probing, and prove-out).
  • Working knowledge of milling plus two or more of the following: grinding, sinker EDM, wire EDM, trailing-edge machining, laser drilling, and stem drilling, including equipment and consumables.
  • 5-axis mill airfoil work: Starrag/Liechti (LX, NB, STC, Turbomill/g-Mill), Hermle C-series, DMG MORI DMU/DMC, Makino D-series/MAG, GROB, Mazak VARIAXIS, Okuma MU-V, or equivalent.
  • IGT (or aero turbine) blades, vanes, or high-precision airfoils on superalloys.
  • Sinker and wire EDM (GF/Agie, Makino, Sodick, Mitsubishi, or equivalent), including electrodes, wire, and dielectric/consumable selection.
  • Cooling holes and stem drilling: fast-hole EDM and/or laser (Winbro, Huffman, Current EDM, Belmont, GF laser, or similar), including diffusers through base metal and TBC; electrodes, nozzles, assist gas, and related consumables.
  • CNC grinding/trailing-edge: IMM, Blohm/Mägerle/United Grinding, or equivalent; wheels, dressing, and finish-to-print.
  • Metrology (CMM, 3D scanning, on-machine probing).

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to lift 25 lbs. unassisted.
  • Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required.
  • Travel to vendors for FAT as required.
  • Must be willing to work overtime and/or weekends if needed.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Police Constable - Degree Holder Entry Programme - (DHEP)
description:
Police Constable - Degree Holder Entry Programme - (DHEP)

Are you looking for a career like no other? Do you want the opportunity to use your degree while gaining hands-on experience from day one? If so, join West Midlands Police through our Degree Holder Entry Programme (DHEP).

As a Police Constable, you’ll play a vital role in keeping our communities safe, protecting the vulnerable, and tackling crime. This is a challenging but hugely rewarding career where no two days are ever the same.

About the DHEP Programme

  • Graduate Route, open to graduates in any subject, this programme allows you to train as a Police Constable while studying for a Graduate Diploma in Professional Policing.
  • Two-Year Programme, a balance of in-house training, university-led learning, and frontline policing.
  • Blended Learning, classroom teaching (delivered at WMP sites and virtually) is combined with on-the-job experience and digital study.
  • Ongoing Support, you’ll receive guidance and mentoring from experienced officers throughout.
  • Future Opportunities – Once you’ve completed your two-year probation, you’ll have access to a wide range of career paths, including specialist units (Firearms, Dogs, Roads Policing, Investigations, Drones) and progression into leadership roles.

Please note: This is not a direct Detective route. However, after initial training, you may apply to join our Detective Academy pathway.

It is important to note that alongside your role as a Police Officer, you will study toward a Graduate Diploma in Professional Policing Practice. If you are not interested in completing a further educational qualification, please explore our PCEP or DCEP routes.”

What’s in it for you?

  • Starting salary: £31,164 rising annually up to £50,256 within seven years.
  • Graduate Diploma in Professional Policing (on successful completion).
  • 25 days’ annual leave, rising to 30 after five years.
  • Extensive benefits, including a pension scheme, employee support, staff networks, and professional development opportunities. See our benefits webpage for more details.
  • A career that matters, make a lasting impact on communities while developing your skills and future.

Who can apply?

You must have:

  • A degree (Level 6 or above) in any subject, at any grade, OR
  • Be in the final academic year of your degree (eligibility dependent on completion).

Only final degree certificates will be accepted, these must be uploaded with your application.

Fitness, Medical & Vetting

  • Must meet the bleep test standard of 5.4.
  • Must pass medical checks, which may include drug and fitness testing.
  • Must pass our required vetting checks. See our Vetting FAQ for more information.

Residency & Nationality

  • Lived in the UK for the past three years.
  • Must be a British, Irish, or EEA national, or have the right to work in the UK without restrictions.

Application Process

  • Our careers website provides a step by step breakdown of the application process.
  • Training & Probation – A two-year blended learning programme combining policing experience with academic study.

title: Vacature in Geldermalsen: BI Datawarehouse Specialist/Data Engineer (interne positie)
description:
De Organisatie:

Een gerenommeerde organisatie in Geldermalsen, die bekend staat als stabiel en een aangename werkgever, heeft momenteel een vacature voor een ervaren Microsoft BI Datawarehouse Developer, ook een Data Engineer met geruime ETL ervaring is welkom. Het bedrijf bevindt zich op een goed bereikbare locatie, zowel per auto met voldoende parkeergelegenheid als met het openbaar vervoer. Naast een aantrekkelijk kantoor biedt de organisatie diverse faciliteiten, zoals een bedrijfsrestaurant met lunch, tafeltennis en voetbal, een game room en een fitnessruimte.

In deze functie kom je terecht in een dynamisch bedrijf met een informele en prettige sfeer, waar korte communicatielijnen zorgen voor een laag hiërarchieniveau. Het team, bestaande uit ongeveer 150 collega's, waarvan 40 op de IT-afdeling werken, richt zich op complexe en technologisch uitdagende applicaties voor een betere wereld. De organisatie staat bekend om haar solide werkgeverschap, waar zowel sterke primaire als secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden gelden. Hier krijg je de ruimte om zowel persoonlijk als technisch te groeien.

De ideale kandidaat voor deze interne positie is een ervaren Business Intelligence Developer met DataWareHouse (DWH) expertise. Je zult betrokken zijn bij het ontsluiten van gegevens uit het DataWareHouse binnen een Enterprise-omgeving via SSIS, het genereren van rapportages met behulp van SSRS, en het bouwen van kubussen met SSAS. Er wordt verwacht dat je sterk bent in ETL-processen, SQL en kennis hebt van DWH-concepten en architectuur.

De Functie:

Dit bedrijf beheert een van de grootste databases in Nederland, waar zowel multinationals als lokale overheden afhankelijk van zijn voor inzichten in consumentengedrag. Ze werken met de nieuwste technologieën, talen en tools, waaronder Microsoft Azure Cloud. Het gaat zowel om het beheer van het bestaande datawarehouse als de ontwikkeling van een nieuw datawarehouse.

Als Back-end BI Specialist werk je binnen een multidisciplinair BI/Data team, waar communicatie op verschillende niveaus van groot belang is. Je levert een significante bijdrage aan procesverbeteringen en bent medeverantwoordelijk voor een nauwkeurige informatievoorziening aan klanten. Flexibiliteit wordt gewaardeerd, met mogelijkheden voor thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden.

Gevraagd Profiel:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Back-end BI of Big Data;
  • Kennis van datawarehousing (DWH);
  • Ervaring met SSIS en SSRS;
  • Kennis en ervaring met SSAS is een pre;
  • Bekendheid met Agile/Scrum methodieken;
  • Bereidheid om je te ontwikkelen op het gebied van Microsoft BI;
  • Ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
  • Analytisch sterk met een praktische instelling en zelfstandigheid;
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

De arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk, met een boven marktconform salaris (4.000 – 5.750 euro bruto per maand), 13e maand, minimaal 29 vrije dagen, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling. Daarnaast krijg je als BI DWH Developer de kans om je te ontwikkelen op het gebied van BI en Data door middel van cursussen en trainingen.

Salaris:

4000 – 6000 euro

Uren per week

Fulltime (32-40 uur)

Specialisatie:

Datawarehouse ETL Specialist

Gerelateerd:

ETL, Datawarehouse, Business Intelligence, SQL Server, Oracle, Extraction, Transformation and Load, Datawarehouse, Cubes, Vacature ETL ontwikkelaar

Plaatsen in de omgeving:

Tiel, Culemborg, Zaltbommel, Buren

title: RECONCILIATION & SETTLEMENT SPECIALIST
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: Reconciliation and Settlement Specialist
Department: CFM
Job Level: P3
Location: Opebi , Lagos
Role Summary
The Reconciliation and Settlement Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely reconciliation of assigned transaction channels, processing and monitoring settlements, managing wallet funding activities, and resolving transaction discrepancies. The role ensures settlement obligations are completed within agreed SLAs, financial records are accurate, and revenue leakage and operational risks are minimized.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform daily reconciliation of assigned transaction channels, including dealer settlements and wallet funding activities.
  • Validate reconciliation results, identify discrepancies, and ensure all exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.
  • Monitor transaction flows and follow up with relevant channels and partners to resolve outstanding reconciliation issues.
  • Process and monitor transaction settlements in line with agreed SLAs.
  • Ensure settlement credits are accurately processed for collections and cash-in transactions.
  • Ensure settlement debits are accurately processed for disbursement and cash-out transactions.
  • Prepare, validate, and upload accurate settlement and wallet funding reports through designated SFTP or online platforms.
  • Investigate transaction discrepancies and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution.
  • Support the resolution of customer transaction-related complaints and enquiries.
  • Provide partners with timely updates on the status and resolution of transaction-related issues.
  • Maintain accurate reconciliation and settlement records for reporting, control, and audit purposes.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, operational procedures, reporting standards, and audit requirements.
  • Identify settlement and reconciliation risks and implement appropriate controls to minimize financial exposure.
  • Monitor transactions and settlement activities to identify potential revenue leakage and support revenue assurance across assigned channels.
  • Escalate unresolved exceptions, settlement failures, and material financial discrepancies to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Contribute to process improvements that enhance reconciliation accuracy, settlement efficiency, and operational controls.
Requirements
Education and Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in reconciliation, settlement, financial operations, payments, or a related function.
  • Experience working with transaction reconciliation, settlement processes, payment channels, or digital financial services is preferred.
Key Skills and Competencies
  • Strong reconciliation and settlement expertise.
  • Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of transaction flows and payment operations.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve financial discrepancies.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls and revenue assurance.
  • Good stakeholder and partner management skills.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work with large volumes of transaction data.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other reconciliation or financial reporting tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict SLAs.
  • Strong communication and escalation skills.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and confidentiality.
Key Performance Indicators
  • Reconciliation accuracy and completion rate.
  • Settlement accuracy and adherence to SLA.
  • Timely resolution of reconciliation exceptions.
  • Reduction in outstanding transaction discrepancies.
  • Revenue leakage identified and prevented.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of settlement and wallet reports.
  • Compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.
  • Resolution turnaround time for transaction-related issues.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Voor een grote, gevestigde organisatie binnen de infrastructuursector zijn wij op zoek naar een Data Engineer. Deze organisatie zet technologie in om de bouw en het beheer van infrastructuur slimmer, duurzamer en toekomstbestendig te maken. Je werkt aan echte dataproducten met directe impact op projecten en besluitvorming binnen de organisatie.

Je komt terecht hecht team dat middenin een interessante transitie zit: van Azure Data Factory en TimeXtender naar Microsoft Fabric. Er is veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan deze overstap en je eigen ambities vorm te geven.

Als Data Engineer ben je samen met een ervaren collega verantwoordelijk voor het ontsluiten en beschikbaar maken van data uit verschillende bronnen. Je werkt aan de doorontwikkeling van het dataplatform en de migratie van bestaande oplossingen naar Fabric, een proces dat de komende 1,5 jaar plaatsvindt. Daarnaast vormt de data lake een belangrijke basis om AI-agents te voeden, met extra aandacht voor de omgang met persoonsgegevens.

  • Data ontsluiten uit diverse bronnen en beschikbaar maken voor analyses;
  • Meewerken aan de migratie van Azure Data Factory en TimeXtender naar Microsoft Fabric;
  • Data pipelines bouwen en doorontwikkelen, met oog voor datakwaliteit en schaalbaarheid;
  • Samenwerken met een data science team en GIS-specialisten, en raakvlakken verkennen met knowledge graph engineering;
  • Meedenken over en experimenteren met nieuwe technieken binnen Fabric;
  • Actief bijdragen aan de groei van een klein team richting een grotere Fabric-organisatie.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent leergierig, communicatief sterk en weet zowel met techniek als met de business het gesprek aan te gaan: je begrijpt het probleem van de ander en durft kritisch en doorvragend te zijn. Je staat open voor feedback op je aanpak, maar werkt ook zelfstandig op je eigen manier. Je haalt energie uit het uitproberen van nieuwe technieken.

Daarnaast neem je mee:

  • Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring, bereidheid om te leren is belangrijker dan een lang trackrecord;
  • Ervaring in de Cloud, kennis van Fabric is een pré;
  • HBO-niveau (MBO met sterke ervaring kan in overweging worden genomen);
  • Branche-ervaring is niet vereist.

Over de organisatie

Onze opdrachtgever is een grote, gevestigde organisatie binnen de infrastructuursector die continu investeert in het vernieuwen van haar applicatielandschap en datamanagement. Er is veel aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling: ieder werkt aan een eigen ambitieplan, met doorgroeimogelijkheden richting senior data engineer of een meer strategische rol, en ruimte om je te verdiepen in onderwerpen als knowledge graph engineering.

Wat bieden zij?

  • Salaris tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring;
  • Fulltime dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • 32-40 uur per week, hybride werken met een thuiswerkvergoeding van €2,45 per dag;
  • Onbeperkt verlof;
  • Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

Ben jij de Data Engineer die mee wil bouwen aan de transitie naar Microsoft Fabric binnen een dynamische, technische organisatie?

title: Senior Workday Administrator (HCM, Compensation and Security)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Workday Administrator (HCM, Compensation and Security) based in India.

This is a senior, hands-on Workday role focused on owning and optimizing critical HCM, Compensation, and Security capabilities within a global organization. You will lead configuration, maintenance, system improvements, upgrades, and feature adoption across a live Workday environment. The role combines deep functional expertise with troubleshooting, reporting, security administration, process improvement, and stakeholder partnership. You will support core HR processes, organizational structures, compensation cycles, business processes, and compensation statements while ensuring data integrity and compliance. You will collaborate closely with People, Finance, IT, Payroll, and integration teams to translate business requirements into effective Workday solutions. The position also provides opportunities to mentor junior administrators and guide users through new features and capabilities. This is an impactful opportunity for an experienced Workday professional to shape enterprise HR technology and improve system efficiency and user experience.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the configuration, maintenance, and ongoing operation of Workday HCM, Advanced Compensation, and Security as primary areas of responsibility.
  • Manage core HR configuration, organizational structures, business processes, bonus cycles, merit and promotion processes, and compensation statements.
  • Lead Workday configuration projects, including new module deployments, system upgrades, enhancements, and adoption of features introduced through biannual Workday releases.
  • Monitor Workday system health, performance, functionality, and security to ensure reliable and compliant operations.
  • Administer Workday security configurations, including security groups, roles, permissions, and access controls while maintaining least-privilege principles, segregation of duties, and audit requirements.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify process improvement and automation opportunities and conduct gap analyses to enhance system efficiency and user experience.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting for configuration issues, data discrepancies, and operational problems, performing root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize Workday reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and other reporting solutions to support business decisions and ensure data accuracy.
  • Ensure Workday configurations and processes comply with applicable regulations, internal policies, security standards, and audit requirements.
  • Mentor junior Workday administrators and provide guidance on configuration standards, best practices, and effective system administration.
  • Develop and deliver training for People Partners, Finance teams, and other end users on Workday features, functionality, and process changes.
  • Act as a key liaison between People, Finance, IT, Payroll, and other business functions to align business processes with Workday capabilities.
  • Partner with integration teams on functional requirements and data feeds involving Workday.
  • Support change management activities associated with system releases, configuration changes, new functionality, and evolving business requirements.

    • Requirements

    • Minimum 5 years of hands-on Workday configuration experience within a live production tenant.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
    • Deep functional expertise in Workday HCM, Advanced Compensation, and Security.
    • Workday certification is highly desirable, particularly in HCM, Security, and Advanced Compensation.
    • Previous experience deploying or implementing Workday modules and supporting configuration projects.
    • Strong configuration experience across additional Workday modules such as Recruiting, Benefits, Time Tracking, Absence, and Performance.
    • Strong understanding of Workday architecture, business processes, security models, reporting capabilities, and configuration principles.
    • Proficiency in creating and maintaining Workday calculated fields, EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder), and advanced reports.
    • Experience supporting Workday system upgrades, change management, and feature adoption associated with biannual releases.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess system requirements and identify effective configuration solutions.
    • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy and system quality.
    • Customer-focused approach with the ability to understand business needs and translate them into practical Workday solutions.
    • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build productive relationships across technical and business teams.
    • Resourceful approach to resolving day-to-day system issues and operational queries.
    • High level of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and professionalism when handling sensitive employee and compensation information.
    • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and work independently with minimal supervision.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to take ownership of critical enterprise Workday HCM, Compensation, and Security capabilities.
      • Remote work opportunity with a global and collaborative environment.
      • Exposure to complex Workday configuration, module deployments, system upgrades, and biannual feature releases.
      • Opportunity to influence HR technology processes and improve employee and stakeholder experiences.
      • Cross-functional collaboration with People, Finance, IT, Payroll, and integration teams.
      • Opportunity to work across multiple Workday modules and expand functional expertise.
      • Leadership and mentoring opportunities through guidance of junior administrators and end users.
      • Opportunity to contribute to process automation, reporting improvements, data integrity, security, and compliance initiatives.
      • Professional development through exposure to evolving Workday capabilities and enterprise HR technology practices.
      • Inclusive environment that values collaboration, creativity, diverse perspectives, and professional growth.
      • Meaningful opportunity to support technology and processes that contribute to better experiences for employees and stakeholders.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
About LendableLendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
  • Profitable since 2017
  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of the company from day 1

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
  • Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We’re looking for a full-stack Python engineer to join our Central Operations team.

Central Ops sits across our core products (Cards, Loans and Motor), focusing on shared operational challenges and opportunities. We build a mix of internally facing web applications and robust automations to help our Operations teams deliver great outcomes for customers, efficiently and at scale.

It’s a broad space: Operations makes up roughly half of our employee headcount and covers everything from day-to-day customer support up to complex areas like Fraud and Fincrime prevention. As our customer base grows rapidly, our role is to help ops keep pace without relying solely on headcount growth. We make intelligent, pragmatic use of AI where it adds real value, working closely with Product, Data Science and Analytics to deploy solutions that genuinely support our ops agents.

You’ll have real ownership from an engineering perspective, shipping features that are used daily by Ops teams. It’s an evolving space at the company, and what you build will help shape both our tools and our technical direction.

Some examples of things we’ve built recently:

  • Rebuilt our Ops QA admin system from the ground up, replacing an off-the-shelf tool with something tailored to our needs
  • Deployed a pipeline to summarise customer calls into concise notes using LLMs, automatically surfaced in ops admin panels - removing the need for manual note-writing
  • More than doubled the number of complaints processed by agents through a combination of targeted AI automation and improved UX

What we’re looking for

We’d consider the following essential to the role:

  • Solid experience with Python in a web application context. You have some experience with web frameworks like FastAPI, Django or Flask. We use FastAPI.
  • Experience with Javascript/Typescript and a modern JS framework such as React, Angular or Vue.js. We generally use React & NextJS
  • Strong engineering principles & practices: design patterns, testing, clean code and a good reviewer
  • Previous experience working in a product-focused team
  • A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team
  • A desire to learn about and experiment with Generative AI and LLMs. Actual experience is a plus

The following are also a plus, but by no means essential.

  • You use AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, Claude or others in your day-to-day coding
  • Exposure to Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS
  • SQL, and finding your way around data schemas
  • Shipping containerised software with Argo, Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform
  • Skill with CSS and exposure to Tailwind

Interview process

  • A 30 minute introductory call
  • Take Home Task
  • Technical Interview
  • Cultural/behavioural interview

Life at the company

Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls
  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover
  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans
  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Race Strategy and Race Engineering Industrial Placements
description:
The Role

Race Strategy and Race Engineering Industrial Placements

Brackley, UK

Build your skills. Make an impact. Race towards excellence.

Every dream needs a team.

Join the Race Team as we take on the challenge of Formula One’s exciting new era of sustainable technical regulations.

By spending your year in industry with us, you will:

  • Apply your learning in one of the most technically demanding global sports.
  • Take on responsibility as you are supported and trained throughout your year.
  • Join us for a year-long placement from the end of June 2027 to the end of July 2028.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment at our state-of-the-art factory in Brackley.
  • Be an integral part of a cohort of students working across all functions of our team.

Key Responsibilities

We have two exciting opportunities for a current university student to join either the Race Strategy or Race Engineering Team on an Industrial Placement. The destination will be an outcome of the assessment and selection process.

The successful candidates will work as part of the race team running support systems and providing analysis of data for both race and test events. Outside of these events the successful candidates will contribute towards development and automation of tools used within the race team.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Provide race and test support, factory based, for all events during the year.
  • Assist with pre- and post-event analysis tasks for each event covering data and competitor information.
  • Run and monitor a range of software systems during race and test events, including input parameterisation.
  • Assist with live analysis and support during free-practice, qualifying and races.
  • Carry out ad-hoc tasks, for example investigating trends in data or opponent behaviour.
  • Develop and automate tools and analyse routines in Python and/or JavaScript.

It does not matter whether you already have an interest in motorsport or not: we are looking for candidates who are passionate about reaching their full potential and are excited about constantly learning. Whatever your background, we believe that you will find your placement with us a memorable and enriching experience.

About You

Essential:

  • Be currently studying a BSc / Beng or a combined undergraduate masters in MSc / Meng in Engineering / Maths / Physics / Computer Science.
  • Have a strong background in an engineering discipline with excellent skills in Mathematics and Physics.
  • Have at least one year remaining on your current course or be enrolled on your next course* from the point at which you start your placement with us (*please note that if you will be enrolled on a Masters or PhD course you will need to be able to evidence enrolment to confirm eligibility).
  • The ability to apply their reflective nature to understanding a problem and adopt a continuous improvement mindset to tasks.
  • Flexibility in hours, enthusiasm to support F1 race weekend work is required.
  • A ‘can do’, ‘team-playing’ attitude and the ability to work to strict deadlines under minimal supervision.
  • Take full ownership of their work, driving projects forward with initiative and independence.
  • Be adaptable, have a proactive mindset, a collaborative approach and thrive in a team environment.
  • Show determination and resilience when facing challenges.
  • Have keen attention to detail.
  • Possess an analytical and inquisitive approach.
  • Relish challenges and enjoy pushing for continuous improvement.

Desirable:

  • Experience writing code.

About Us

At the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, every win starts with the energy to exceed our exceptional standards.

It’s the belief and focus you give that powers our performance.

Whether you’re leading innovation, bringing precision to our manufacturing or supporting trackside operations around the world, every detail matters.

We’re setting new standards in our sport, together. More growth, more pride, more of what makes our team exceptional.


Give all. Gain more.

Benefits

When you put the effort in, we give it back. Start with a competitive salary, a generous joining bonus, add in a world-class wellbeing programme (including a free on-site gym), delicious, subsidised food, and private medical cover - all on our riverside campus powered by 100% renewable energy.

You’ll have everything you need to thrive both inside and outside of work.

Why Us

We believe that building a more inclusive and diverse culture helps us go faster and further.

From recruitment and building our future talent pipeline to internal communications and leadership training, we’re building a team where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

Our aim is to attract, develop and retain exceptional people from all backgrounds, creating a workplace where all team members feel respected, supported and able to fulfil their potential.

Your Application

We will ask you to complete our application form as well as submitting a cover letter and CV. Please note, if you are making multiple applications please ensure to update your cover letter on subsequent applications.

Our IP programme is designed with the intent to progress into available graduate roles in the future. You will be required to meet the eligibility criteria of the IP programme including any right to work requirements for your application to progress.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Staff Machine Learning Engineer — AI-native productivity, stealth

Fully remote, UK-based candidates preferred.


TL;DR

  • Founding-team Staff MLE at a well-funded stealth AI company
  • Product: AI-native productivity — starting with email, expanding into notes, tasks, calendar
  • Own the full model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, deployment
  • US$100M initial funding, internally backed, no VC pressure
  • Cash + meaningful founding-team equity
  • Fully remote


The play

Email, calendar, notes, tasks. The tools 5 billion people run their lives on. None of them are AI-native. Every attempt so far has been a bolt-on — a copilot button, a summary at the top of the thread. This company is building the layer underneath: proactive, context-aware, capable of running long workflows, completing real tasks, and asking before it acts. First product is AI-native email. The goal: cut four hours a day in the inbox down to thirty minutes. Email first. Productivity suite next.


The role, first 12 months

Own the execution layer of the company's intelligence — turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems. Build and evolve fine-tuning pipelines for large models. Design evaluation systems that measure real-world capability, robustness, and safety — not benchmark vanity. Architect high-performance inference infrastructure: latency, GPU utilisation, memory, cost. Build data pipelines for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data. Bridge research and application engineering so model improvements actually reach users.


The bar

Read this before you DM.

  • Production ML systems you've built and shipped — not prototypes, not research demos, real products with real users
  • Deep understanding of large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference
  • Experience running GPU-based ML workloads at meaningful scale
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals — you write production-grade code and you care about correctness
  • Comfortable reasoning about failure modes, model degradation, and what happens when things go wrong in the wild
  • Independent judgment — you can navigate ambiguity and make pragmatic trade-offs without being hand-held


Who this isn't for

ML engineers who've only ever worked in notebooks. Researchers chasing publications. Anyone who needs a stable, well-defined system before they can contribute. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a pre-launch team moving fast.


If the bar above doesn't quite match where you are today — no worries. Save your energy for the role that does.


The rest

Everything else — who they are, who's behind it, comp and equity detail — is a call.

DM me if this is you, or if you know the person it should be.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test - SDET

The position combines advanced software engineering, test automation, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD optimization.   • Develop custom testing tools, automation utilities, and reporting solutions that provide actionable quality insights.
  • Design and implement API testing and orchestration across REST and GraphQL services, including integrations with UI-based workflows.
  • Apply scalable object-oriented test architecture and reusable abstractions rather than relying on linear or repetitive test scripts.
  • Produce and maintain advanced test reporting using solutions such as Allure, Playwright HTML reports, and custom reporting frameworks.
  • Conduct technical code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, best practices, and architectural decisions.
  • Mentor SDET I engineers, helping them strengthen their automation, software design, and testing capabilities.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test infrastructure, developer productivity, automation reliability, and overall engineering quality.

    • Requirements

    • Extensive hands-on experience with Playwright, including deep knowledge of its fixtures architecture and scalable test automation practices.
    • Strong experience designing object-oriented test frameworks using layered patterns such as Page Object Model (POM), Page Component Object Model (PCOM), and other reusable abstractions.

    • Advanced TypeScript expertise, including generics, decorators, advanced typing patterns, type inference, and complex asynchronous programming.

    • Strong Docker experience covering containerization, docker-compose, image management, and container-based testing environments.
    • Proven ability to debug, optimize, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
    • Expert-level knowledge of Git, GitHub, and distributed version control workflows.
    • Advanced experience with test reporting solutions such as Allure, Playwright HTML reports, and custom reporting approaches.
    • Strong understanding of test infrastructure architecture, framework scalability, performance optimization, and the npm ecosystem/package management.
    • Terraform experience is a plus.
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to make sound technical decisions in complex testing environments.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering practices and work effectively across teams.
    • Demonstrated ability to mentor less experienced engineers and provide constructive technical feedback.

      • Remote workspace setup bonus.
      • Remote-first work environment with the flexibility to work from a location of choice.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams.
      • Annual company offsites in international destinations.
      • High-impact role with significant ownership over test infrastructure, automation, and engineering quality.
      • Opportunity to work with modern technologies across test automation, TypeScript, AWS, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure.

title: Senior Specialist, Workforce Planning & Optimization(Hub Operations)
description:

As the Workforce Planning & Optimization Specialist (HUB Operations), you will serve as the strategic labor and capacity planning backbone for Coupang’s HUB sortation facilities co-located within our Fulfillment Centers (FCs). You will own end-to-end capacity planning to ensure seamless downstream last-mile operations.

In this role, you will balance operational excellence with cost efficiency—modeling temp worker incentive structures, managing senior/perm labor ratios, optimizing Cost Per Hour (CPH) through precision rostering, and building analytics dashboards to drive quality and execution. You will act as the key liaison between HUB Operations, FC Manpower teams, in-house hiring, and external staffing agencies.

What you will do?

  • Capacity & Labor Modeling: Build, maintain, and refine comprehensive capacity plans across all Taiwan HUBs. Model demand forecasts against show-up rates, attrition, and optimal senior/tenured temp labor ratios.

  • Cost & Incentive Optimization: Design and implement competitive, cost-effective temp worker incentive structures. Drive intelligent rostering strategies to achieve low, optimized Cost Per Hour (CPH).

  • Talent Pool Development: Strategy-build and maintain a reliable pool of tenured/senior temporary workers to ensure shift stability, high quality, and fast operational ramp-ups.

  • Stakeholder & Agency Management: Serve as the trusted partner to HUB Operations leaders. Collaborate daily with FC Manpower teams (given shared facility roofs), in-house talent acquisition, and external vendors/agencies.

  • Operations Analytics & Dashboarding: Build scalable dashboards, data models, and tracking tables to showcase critical input metrics, labor show-up trends, and quality guardrails for leadership decision-making.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in workforce planning, labor modeling, or capacity planning within high-volume logistics, fulfillment centers or similar HVH operations
  • Analytical & Data Skills: Advanced proficiency in quantitative data analysis and visualization (e.g., SQL, Excel, Tableau, or Power BI) with a track record of building labor tracking models and operational dashboards.
  • Cost & Capacity Optimization: Proven capability in labor cost management, Cost Per Hour (CPH) optimization, shift rostering, and modeling temporary labor incentive/wage structures.
  • Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Experience managing temporary staffing agency relationships, vendor SLAs, and collaborating with cross-functional operational teams and HR/Talent Acquisition.
  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: Strong numerical acuity to model variance in demand forecasts, show-up rates, and attrition in high-tempo operational environments.
  • Language Proficiency: Basic English ( especially speaking)
Preferred Qualifications
  • Industry Background: Direct experience in co-located fulfillment center environments within express delivery, parcel logistics, or e-commerce.

Data Modelling & Persistence

GenAI & Agentic Application Development

  • Integrate LLMs, prompts, retrieval components, APIs, and backend services into reliable GenAI capabilities

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Python and backend application development
  • Hands-on experience building APIs and backend services using FastAPI
  • Strong working knowledge of SQLAlchemy and ORM frameworks
  • Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, indexing, and query optimization
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph for building agents, tools, workflows, and LLM-powered applications
  • Understanding of GenAI concepts, LLM integration patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration

title: Workflow Automation Developer
description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

Allied Command Transformation (ACT) is NATO’s leading agent for change: driving, facilitating, and advocating the continuous improvement of Alliance capabilities to maintain and enhance the military relevance and effectiveness of the Alliance. The main objectives of ACT are: providing appropriate support to NATO missions and operations; leading NATO military transformation; and improving relationships, interaction and practical cooperation with partners, nations and international organisations. ACT therefore leads Alliance concept development, capability development, training and lessons-learned initiatives and provides unfettered military support to policy development within NATO.

The program

Capability Development & Management Support (CDMS)

DCOS Capability Development (CAPDEV) acts as the Supreme Allied Commander Transformation's Director for guidance, direction and coordination of the activities and resources of the Capability Development Directorate.

The Requirements Division will execute all tasks and activities needed to support requirements management for NATO capabilities

The Capability Requirements (CR) Branch will develop the Capability Requirements Brief and recommended courses of action to resolve issues through the life cycle management of requirements using matrixed, cross-functional project-specific Requirements Management teams.

The Requirements Forward Branch (Mons) is responsible for conducting requirements development and management representation and engagement-related functions in Europe.

The Capability Division coordinates the development of capabilities from capability planning through acceptance and then disposal with management entities, NATO Headquarters staff and the NATO Governance Structure

The Capability Forward Branch (Mons) coordinates with ACO, NCIA, NSPA, NATO HQ, territorial Host Nations, and NATO Centres of Excellence (COEs) to support the development of capabilities.

Strategic Plans and Policy (SPP) supports Allied Command Transformation in formalizing military advice to shape future military strategy, political guidance, and other policy documents supporting NATO’s strategic objectives.

Role ID: ACT-CDMS-27-01-A-LC08

Role and Duties

Provide hands-on digital workflow prototyping and citizendevelopment support to digitize CAPDEV work and information flows using approved platforms and development tools outside the Microsoft Power Platform environment.

The contractor is expected to work directly with operational users to identify workflow problems and opportunities, rapidly design and personally build proof-of-concept and pilot solutions, test those solutions in operational use, iterate based on evidence and user feedback, and prepare successful solutions for transition to enterprise development, DevSecOps, platform, or scaling organizations.

This is a hands-on rapid delivery role. The requirement is not primarily for enterprise architecture, strategic advisory, product management, programme management, softwaredevelopment team leadership, or supervision of development performed by others.

The objective is to allow CAPDEV to test digitally transformed workflows quickly and at relatively low cost before committing resources to enduring implementation, while ensuring successful prototypes generate sufficient operational, technical, and requirements evidence to support responsible scaling.

Taskings:

  1. Support CAPDEV organizations through hands-on rapid development of digital workflow proofs of concept, prototypes, and operational pilots using approved non-Microsoft lowcode, no-code, configurable-application, workflow, lightweight development, or comparable platforms and tools.
  2. Work directly with process owners, operational users, analysts, managers, and information stakeholders to understand existing work and information flows, decisions, handoffs, data requirements, pain points, and opportunities for digital transformation.
  3. Document current and desired workflows at sufficient detail to identify user roles, workflow states, decision points, information exchanges, business rules, data requirements, and minimum functionality needed to test a redesigned process.
  4. Translate operational needs into minimum viable prototype or pilot requirements that can be rapidly developed, demonstrated, tested, and iterated with users.
  5. Design, configure, develop, test, and improve digital applications and workflows that replace or materially reduce manual, spreadsheet-intensive, email-driven, form-based, document centric, or otherwise fragmented CAPDEV processes
  6. Configure structured data capture, user roles, workflow states, business rules, validations, routing, approvals, notifications, status tracking, role-based views, and other functionality required to operationally test redesigned workflows.
  7. Integrate prototype and pilot solutions with approved data sources or services using APIs, databases, web services, webhooks, structured file exchange, or other authorized mechanisms appropriate to the technical environment.
  8. Develop lightweight scripts, components, application logic, or integrations when configurable or low-code functionality alone is insufficient to test the operational requirement.
  9. Use approved AI-assisted development capabilities, where available and appropriate, to accelerate prototyping, code development, configuration, testing, documentation, or iterative solution improvement while maintaining appropriate human review and technical accountability.
  10. Conduct user testing and operational pilots with representative CAPDEV users and iteratively improve solutions based on observed use, stakeholder feedback, technical findings, and changes to the operational requirement.
  11. Establish appropriate baselines and assess prototype or pilot effects on factors such as cycle time, manual processing effort, data completeness, information availability, workflow visibility, traceability, usability, and user adoption.
  12. Identify security, data-management, information-management, architecture, integration, licensing, hosting, scalability, and sustainment constraints sufficiently early to inform whether and how a prototype should progress toward enduring implementation.
  13. Design prototypes to use authoritative information sources where practical and avoid unnecessary creation of duplicate, unsupported, or orphaned data stores.
  14. Apply proportionate development and lifecycle practices appropriate to rapid prototyping, including version or configuration control, documentation of business rules and dependencies, testing, management of development artifacts, and separation of prototype and operational environments where supported.
  15. Document process requirements, workflow logic, data structures, integrations, user roles, business rules, configuration, code or scripts, assumptions, known limitations, test findings, and operational lessons sufficiently to support reuse, assessment, and transition.
  16. Prepare transition packages for successful prototypes and pilots, including requirements, process design, user stories or equivalent functional descriptions, data structures, integrations, business rules, test results, known limitations, technical dependencies, and recommendations for enduring implementation.
  17. Collaborate with enterprise developers, DevSecOps teams, platform owners, system integrators, data teams, cybersecurity personnel, and other scaling organizations to support transition from CAPDEV prototype or pilot to enduring implementation.
  18. Maintain visibility of active prototypes and pilots, including purpose, users, status, dependencies, risks, technical debt, evidence of operational value, and recommended disposition such as continue testing, revise, transition for scaling, sustain locally, or retire.
  19. Present prototype and pilot findings, user feedback, technical constraints, trade-offs, implementation risks, and scaling recommendations to CAPDEV leaders and stakeholders.
  20. Perform additional tasks as required by the COTR that are directly related to this labor category and do not constitute a materially different labor requirement.

Essential Qualifications

  1. Education or Relevant Professional Experience: A University/Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, Human-Centered Design, Business Process Management, Business Information Technology, or a closely related field; or a minimum of five years of directly relevant professional experience in lieu of the degree. Directly relevant professional experience shall include work in at least two of the following areas: low-code/no-code or configurable-application development; workflow automation; software or web application development; business-process digitization; rapid prototyping or minimum-viable-product development. Either the degree or experience-in-lieu route fully satisfies this qualification.
  1. Recent End-to-End Hands-On Digital Solution Delivery: Demonstrated recent experience personally developing digital applications, workflows, prototypes, or pilots from identification of a user or business-process requirement through configuration or development, testing, user feedback, and operational use or pilot activity. The candidate shall demonstrate at least twelve calendar months within the last twenty-four months during which hands-on digital application, workflow, or prototype development constituted a substantial and recurring portion of the candidate's assigned duties, and at least one personally developed digital solution used by an identified user group as part of an active business process or operational pilot within the last eighteen months. The candidate shall identify the month and year of qualifying experience, approximate proportion of assigned duties devoted to hands-on development, business process addressed, personal technical contribution, technologies or platforms used, and user group. Experience limited to directing, supervising, managing, advising, governing, architecting, technical leadership, product ownership, programme management, coordinating, or overseeing development performed by others does not satisfy this requirement. Multiple components developed for the same user group to address the same business-process requirement shall be considered one example. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.
  1. Non-Microsoft Low-Code, No-Code, or Configurable Application Development: Minimum of two years within the last five years, including hands-on development within the last twenty-four months, personally designing, configuring, building, testing, and deploying applications or workflows using non-Microsoft low-code, no-code, configurable-application, workflow, or comparable rapid-development platforms. The candidate shall demonstrate at least two personally developed applications or workflow solutions, including at least one used by an identified user group as part of an active business process or operational pilot within the last twenty-four months and a second qualifying example within the last three years. Across the candidate's qualifying examples, the candidate shall demonstrate hands-on development using at least two distinct non-Microsoft rapid-development platforms, frameworks, or application-development technologies. The candidate is not required to demonstrate equal depth or duration of experience in each. At least one qualifying solution shall demonstrate three or more of the following characteristics, with at least one characteristic drawn from items 3, 5, or 7:
  1. multiple workflow states, screens, forms, or user roles;
  2. conditional or role-based behaviour;
  3. structured data model or relationships between data entities;
  4. custom validation, business rules, or workflow logic;
  5. integration with more than one data source, service, or application;
  6. automated routing, approvals, notifications, or task coordination; or
  7. reusable components, scripts, extensions, or comparable application logic, with the candidate identifying the component, script, or extension and describing what it performed.

For each example, the candidate shall identify the platform or technology used, business process addressed, personal technical contribution, qualifying characteristics, user group, and resulting operational or pilot use, and shall briefly describe how the claimed characteristics were personally implemented. Applications or workflows configured or developed primarily by others, basic forms or templates, or demonstration-only builds do not satisfy this requirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.

  1. Rapid Prototyping and Minimum Viable Solution Delivery: Demonstrated hands-on experience within the last five years, including at least one example within the last twenty-four months, rapidly translating an identified operational or business-process requirement into a testable digital proof of concept, prototype, minimum viable solution, or pilot. The candidate shall identify at least two examples in which they personally contributed to requirements discovery and personally developed the resulting prototype or pilot. At least one qualifying example shall have progressed from initial requirement or process discovery to a testable solution available to representative users within ninety calendar days or less. Across the two qualifying examples, at least one shall demonstrate at least two of the qualifying solution characteristics identified under Essential Qualification 3, including at least one characteristic from items 3, 5, or 7 of that qualification. The example demonstrating the required solution characteristics may be the same example that satisfies the ninety-day requirement or a different qualifying example. For each example, the candidate shall identify the initial requirement, timeframe from discovery to testable solution, personal contribution, platform or technologies used, users involved in testing, qualifying solution characteristics where applicable, and resulting disposition or next step. Experience involving only development against fully predetermined specifications without rapid iteration with users does not satisfy this requirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.
  1. Business Process Discovery and Workflow Redesign: Minimum of two years within the last five years, including at least one qualifying example within the last three years, working directly with operational users, process owners, managers, or information stakeholders to understand existing business processes and design digitally enabled future workflows. The candidate shall demonstrate at least two examples in which they personally analyzed an existing manual, spreadsheet-based, email-driven, document-centric, or otherwise fragmented process and identified user roles, process steps, handoffs, decisions, information requirements, pain points, and opportunities for redesign prior to development. For each example, the candidate shall identify the user or process-owner group, existing process or problem, findings from process discovery, proposed workflow changes, and resulting prototype, pilot, or digital solution. Experience limited to receiving predetermined requirements without direct engagement with users or process owners does not satisfy this requirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.
  1. Data Integration and Lightweight Technical Development: Demonstrated hands-on experience within the last five years, including at least one example within the last twenty-four months, personally extending, integrating, or supporting digital applications or workflows using technical methods beyond basic platform configuration. Across the candidate's examples, experience shall include at least two of the following:
  1. REST or other APIs;
  2. relational databases or SQL;
  3. webhooks or web services;
  4. structured data exchange between applications;
  5. Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C#, or another general-purpose programming or scripting language;
  6. custom scripts, functions, extensions, or components within a configurable platform, with the candidate identifying the artifact and describing the logic or function personally implemented; or
  7. another identified enterprise application or data-integration mechanism, with the candidate naming the application or mechanism used.

At least one of the two minimum claimed technical areas must be drawn from items 1 through 5. The second claimed area must be drawn from items 1 through 6. Item 7 may demonstrate additional breadth but does not satisfy either of the two minimum technical areas. At least one qualifying example shall use or integrate with an existing enterprise, authoritative, or system-of-record data source or service owned and maintained by another organization or system, rather than relying solely on a newly created standalone data store for the prototype.The candidate shall identify the applications or data sources involved, technical mechanism used, personal contribution, business or prototype requirement supported, ownership or source of the enterprise or authoritative data where applicable and briefly describe how each claimed technical method was personally applied. Experience limited solely to manually importing or exporting files, configuring basic forms, or using preconfigured platform connectors without additional integration or technical logic does not satisfy this requirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.

  1. Operational Pilot, User Testing, and Iterative Improvement: Demonstrated hands-on experience within the last five years, including at least one example within the last twenty-four months, conducting user testing or operational pilot activity for a personally developed digital application, workflow, or prototype. The candidate shall demonstrate at least two examples in which representative users tested or used the candidate's solution and the candidate personally collected or observed feedback, defects, usability issues, process effects, or changing requirements and subsequently modified the solution. For each example, the candidate shall identify the user group, solution tested, nature of the testing or pilot activity, findings or feedback received, changes personally implemented, and resulting disposition or improvement. Experience limited to demonstrations without representative user interaction or development without subsequent iteration does not satisfy this requirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.
  1. Lifecycle Discipline and Delivery within Constrained Environments: Demonstrated hands-on experience within the last five years, including at least one example within the last twenty-four months, personally applying lifecycle, configuration, testing, security, or sustainment practices to rapidly developed digital applications, workflows, prototypes, or pilots. The candidate shall demonstrate practical experience in at least three of the following:
  1. source, version, or configuration control;
  2. separation of development, test, pilot, or operational environments;
  3. controlled deployment or promotion between environments;
  4. management of application configuration, credentials, secrets, or service accounts;
  5. dependency or integration documentation;
  6. structured testing, defect tracking, or documented issue-and-resolution management, including lightweight methods appropriate to prototype or pilot activity application monitoring or logging; or
  7. administrator or sustainment documentation.

The candidate's qualifying experience must include item 6 and at least one of items 1, 2, or 3. The candidate shall briefly describe how each claimed area was personally applied.The candidate shall also identify at least one example within the last twenty-four months in which security restrictions, platform limitations, licensing, network constraints, administrative permissions, hosting limitations, unavailable services, or comparable technical constraints required the candidate to modify the design or implementation of a digital solution. The candidate shall identify the constraint encountered, resulting design or implementation adjustment, and personal contribution. General familiarity with software-development, security, testing, or governance concepts without evidence of personal application does not satisfy this requirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.

  1. Transition to Enterprise Development or Scaling: Demonstrated experience within the last five years, including at least one qualifying example within the last three years, preparing a personally developed prototype, pilot, application, or workflow for continued development, production implementation, enterprise scaling, or sustainment by another developer, DevSecOps team, platform owner, system integrator, or operational support organization. The candidate shall identify the solution, receiving individual or organization, transition purpose, candidate's personal role, and transition material provided.The transition material shall have included at least three of the following:
  1. functional requirements, user stories, or equivalent;
  2. process or workflow design;
  3. data model or data structures;
  4. business rules or application logic;
  5. integration or interface requirements;
  6. configuration, source code, scripts, or technical implementation material;
  7. test results or known defects;
  8. known limitations, risks, or technical debt; or
  9. deployment, hosting, security, or sustainment considerations.

Formal transfer between organizations is not required. Internal handover to another appropriately qualified development or support team satisfies this requirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.

  1. Prototype Assessment and Decision Communication: Demonstrated experience within the last five years, including at least one example within the last three years, evaluating and communicating the results of a digital prototype, pilot, application, or workflow to managers, process owners, product owners, or other decision makers. The candidate shall identify at least two examples in which they personally communicated findings concerning user feedback, operational value, technical feasibility, limitations, risks, implementation considerations, or recommended next steps. For each example, the candidate shall identify the audience, solution or pilot assessed, evidence or findings communicated, and resulting recommendation or decision concerning continuation, revision, scaling, sustainment, or retirement. Qualifying experience may overlap in time with experience used to satisfy other Essential Qualifications where the work demonstrates the required competencies.

Language Proficiency

Demonstrated proficiency in English as defined in STANAG 6001 (Standardized Linguistic Profile (SLP) 3333 - Listening, Speaking, Reading, and Writing) or equivalent.

title: Service Coordinator - COMPASS
company: Centre for Addiction and Mental Health
description:
Concurrent Outpatient Medical & Psychosocial Addiction Support Service (COMPASS) is currently seeking three (3) full-time, contract (12 months) Service Coordinators. COMPASS is an integrated research/clinical service incorporating medical treatment for the ill effects of addiction, including medical and non-medical treatment for opioid dependence, alcohol, stimulant, and cannabis use concerns, outpatient withdrawal management (day detox) as well as the treatment of clients experiencing chronic pain.

As a member of an interprofessional team, you will provide client-centred psychosocial support and assist clients in navigating services within COMPASS and the broader addictions and mental health system. Core responsibilities include:

  • Facilitate timely access to care by engaging clients and families at the point of entry, conducting brief screening and assessment, determining eligibility for services, and connecting individuals to the most appropriate pathways and supports.
  • Review and synthesize information from multiple sources to triage referrals, assess urgency and complexity of needs, assign appropriate priority levels, and match clients to suitable services.
  • Provide service navigation and ongoing support throughout the client's care journey at COMPASS, including at intake, transitions between services, and discharge planning.
  • Coordinate referrals and connections to internal and external resources, including making referrals for housing, financial supports, basic needs, community services, further treatment, and post discharge needs. Using your excellent interpersonal skills, you will also network with other referral sources in coordinating a smooth flow of clients from referral sources across community agencies and within CAMH and COMPASS.
  • Liaise with CAMH programs, healthcare providers, community agencies, referral sources, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated, timely, and client-centred care.
  • You will communicate treatment plan and goals with the COMPASS treatment team and social and community networks as needed and appropriate.
  • Advocate for clients by supporting equitable access to services and addressing social determinants of health.
  • Work within a harm reduction framework, including facilitating access to harm reduction education, resources, and supplies.
  • Contribute to quality improvement initiatives, stakeholder engagement activities, process evaluation, and data collection to support effective and equitable service delivery.
  • Participate in regional forums, knowledge exchange opportunities, and collaborative initiatives to strengthen service coordination across the Toronto region.
  • Foster and maintain positive working relationships with clients, families, community partners, referral sources, and service providers.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and protect the confidentiality of client information in accordance with professional, legislative, and organizational requirements.
  • Support a workplace that embraces diversity, promotes inclusion and teamwork, and complies with all applicable regulatory, professional, and legislative requirements.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
  • This position is located at 100 Stokes Street and is fully onsite. The successful candidate must be available to work Monday to Friday day and evening shifts, as well as weekend and statutory holiday shifts as required.

The successful candidates will possess a Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Health Sciences, Behavioural Sciences, Nursing, or, related field and have 3-5 years experience n the mental health and/or addictions sector, including intake, service navigation, or case management. A Regulated Healthcare Professional (Social Work, Occupational Therapy, Nursing) is preferred. Must be a member in good standing with the respective regulatory body. Experience in coordinated access for mental health and addiction services preferred. Ability to efficiently synthesize information from a variety of sources (referral form, patient and family interview, Connecting Ontario, previous medical records) to determine appropriate care need and match individuals to the right care is required. You will use good clinical judgement to identify urgency of care need and respond using established protocols (eg. 911 calls, transfer to crisis service). Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced clinical environment are essential. You will be proficient in Microsoft office, Hospital Medical Record Systems and electronic communication tools and have familiarity with navigation models. Incumbents are required to work effectively as a team member in a dynamic interprofessional environment and be a self-starter. Experience working with clients, staff, and organizations with diverse backgrounds is required. Bilingualism (French/English) or proficiency in a second language is an asset.

Salary Range: $35.38-$47.69 per hour
