Bij Incentro help je bedrijven zoals Hutten, Simon Loos en Alliander om hun data optimaal te benutten. Jij ontwikkelt robuuste, schaalbare en efficiënte data-oplossingen die bijdragen aan minder voedselverspilling, duurzamere logistiek en een slimmer energienetwerk én die het bouwen van AI agents mogelijk te maken.

Dit is hoe jij impact maakt

Als Data Engineer bij Incentro werk je aan state-of-the-art data-infrastructuren die bedrijven helpen om slimmer te opereren en hun processen te optimaliseren. Onze klanten verwerken enorme hoeveelheden data, maar zonder de juiste infrastructuur blijven kansen onbenut. Jij zorgt ervoor dat data real-time, schaalbaar en bruikbaar wordt.

Wat dit concreet betekent:

  • bij Alliander bouwden we een dataplatform dat helpt bij het slim beheren van energienetwerken. Dit zorgt ervoor dat piekbelasting beter wordt voorspeld en energie slimmer wordt verdeeld
  • bij Simon Loos verminderen we de CO₂-uitstoot met 15% door een real-time dashboard te ontwikkelen dat logistieke processen optimaliseert
  • bij Hutten verminderen we voedselverspilling met 20% door een slimme verspillingsmonitor, die realtime inzicht geeft in voorraadbeheer en derving minimaliseert.

Met Python, Snowflake, DBT en Kubernetes bouw je dataplatforms, ETL-pipelines en machine learning-oplossingen die direct bijdragen aan duurzaamheid, kostenbesparing en procesoptimalisatie.

Jouw team

Je bent onderdeel van onze Data Solutions-cel, waar je samenwerkt met 40 data engineers, data scientists, BI-specialisten en cloud-architecten. Wij bouwen samen slimme, schaalbare data-oplossingen en zetten data om in concrete impact voor toonaangevende bedrijven.

Wie jij bent

Je herkent jezelf in de bovengenoemde kernwaarden. Daarnaast heb je:

  • ervaring als data engineer (minimaal 3 jaar)
  • ervaring met Python & SQL voor dataverwerking en analyse
  • ervaring met cloudplatformen (AWS, GCP of Azure)
  • je spreekt (vloeiend) Nederlands en Engels

Dit is een pré, maar geen vereiste!

  • ervaring met Snowflake en DBT
  • kennis van Spark, Airflow en Kubernetes
  • ervaring met infrastructuur-as-code (Terraform, AWS CDK)

Daarnaast herken je je in onze CBAM-waarden:

  • Camaraderie – We zijn meer dan collega’s: we inspireren, ondersteunen en vieren successen samen
  • Boldness – We durven te experimenteren én kritisch mee te denken voor echte impact
  • Autonomy – Jij krijgt het vertrouwen en de ruimte om je werk zelf vorm te geven
  • Mastery – We blijven leren en groeien, met een persoonlijk ontwikkelpad en volop kennisdeling

Twijfel je of je helemaal past? We leren je graag kennen – ook als je niet aan elk vinkje voldoet.

We bieden jou:

title: Dog Sitter

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

  • Cleaning up waste

  • Sending visit updates and photos through our app
  • Following each client’s detailed care instructions
  • Bringing in mail or packages

  • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented
  • Strong written communication
  • Comfortable working independently in clients’ homes
  • Smartphone with reliable internet & camera
  • Medication experience (oral, injections, fluids)

Pay + Perks

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

  • Apply to one location only
  • No phone calls (we contact strong matches)

This is an opportunity to shape how a growing partner ecosystem delivers secure software solutions at scale while contributing to a collaborative, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead technical enablement programs for partners, equipping their engineering and technical teams with the knowledge and capabilities required to successfully implement and drive adoption of container and software library solutions for their customers.

  • Serve as a primary technical liaison between partners and Product and Engineering teams, communicating partner requirements, technical challenges, and feedback to help inform product development and roadmap priorities.
  • Assess partner technical competencies, identify capability gaps, and design targeted enablement programs that improve implementation readiness and delivery quality.
  • Maintain partner-level architecture documentation and systematically share lessons learned, implementation patterns, and technical best practices across internal teams and the wider partner community.
  • Collaborate across functions to strengthen partner relationships, improve customer outcomes, and ensure partners are equipped to deliver consistent and exceptional experiences at scale.
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor within the partner ecosystem, continuously learning from customers, partners, engineering teams, and fellow architects to solve complex technical challenges.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
    • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, alliances, sales, customer success, and external partner teams.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust with both technical and executive audiences.
    • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
    • Must be located in India.

description:
Professional Policing Degree Holder Entry

Have you completed, or are you close to completing, your Degree in Professional Policing? Your next step in policing starts here. The Pre-Join route is designed for graduates who have already studied the theory of policing and now want to gain practical, hands-on experience in a professional environment.

As a Police Officer, you’ll play a vital role in keeping communities safe, protecting the vulnerable, and maintaining law and order. This is a challenging but rewarding career where no two days are the same – from responding to emergency calls to supporting victims of crime, you’ll make a real difference in your community.

About the Pre-Join Programme

Please note: This is not a Detective route. After probation, you may apply for the internal Detective Academy pathway.

What’s in it for you?

  • Starting salary: £31,164 , rising annually up to £50,256 within seven years.
  • 25 days’ annual leave, rising to 30 after five years.
  • Extensive benefits, including a pension scheme, employee support, staff networks, and professional development opportunities. See our benefits website for more details.
  • A career that matters – make a lasting impact on communities while developing your skills and future.

Who can apply?

You must have:

  • A Degree in Professional Policing licensed and validated by the College of Policing, OR
  • Be in the final year of study for your Professional Policing Degree.

Only final certificates will be accepted, these must be uploaded with your application. Visit our careers website for more information about the qualifications required for different career routes.

Residency & Nationality

  • Lived in the UK for the past three years.

Application Process

  • Our careers website provides a step-by-step breakdown of the application process.

description:
Train to become a Detective while gaining practical, hands-on policing experience.

Do you have a passion for solving puzzles? Are you a seeker of truth? Do you want a career that supports your community and provides job satisfaction? If so, join West Midlands Police as a Detective Constable through our Detective PCEP route.

As a Detective Constable, you’ll investigate complex cases, uncover hidden truths, and deliver justice to those who need it most. You’ll provide critical support for victims of crime while engaging with the community to build trust and achieve successful case outcomes. No two days are the same, and you could work in departments such as the Public Protection Unit (PPU), FCID, Homicide, or Regional Organised Crime Unit (ROCU).

About the Detective PCEP Programme

  • Vocational Route – A two-year, work-based programme designed for individuals who want to pursue a career as a Detective without studying towards a degree.
  • Initial Training – 22 weeks at Tally Ho! Training Centre, combining classroom-based and practical on-the-job learning.
  • Frontline Experience – Year 1 focuses on training as a uniformed Police Constable with Response and Neighbourhood teams, responding to emergency calls and working shifts on a 24/7 basis.
  • Detective Specialism – Year 2 shifts focus to investigations, with attachments to operational teams handling complex and serious crimes.
  • Future Opportunities – Upon completion of probation, you will become a fully qualified Detective, with opportunities for promotion and specialisation in areas such as Counter Terrorism, Serious & Organised Crime, Fraud, and County Lines.

What’s in it for you?

  • Starting salary: £31,164 , rising annually up to £50,256 within seven years.
  • 25 days’ annual leave, rising to 30 after five years.
  • Extensive benefits, including a pension scheme, employee support, staff networks, and professional development opportunities. See our benefits website for more details.
  • A career that matters – make a lasting impact on communities while developing your skills and future.

Who can apply?

You must have:

  • Level 2 English (Grade C/4 or above) AND
  • Level 3 qualification, 2 A-levels, or an equivalent qualification recognised by UK NARIC.
  • OR 12 months relevant policing experience (e.g., Special Constables, PCSOs, PSI/PSIOs, Detention/Escort Officers, Force Contact).
  • OR 18 months current military service in place of Level 3 qualification.

Only final certificates will be accepted, these must be uploaded with your application. Visit our careers website for more information about the qualifications required for different career routes.

Fitness, Medical & Vetting

  • Must meet the bleep test standard of 5.4.
  • Must pass medical checks, which may include drug and fitness testing.
  • Must pass our required vetting checks. See our Vetting FAQ for more information.

Residency & Nationality

  • Lived in the UK for the past three years.
  • Must be a British, Irish, or EEA national, or have the right to work in the UK without restrictions.

Application Process

  • Our careers website provides a step-by-step breakdown of the application process.
  • Training & Probation – A two-year, vocational programme combining practical policing experience with Detective specialism training.
  • Detective Constable Entry Programme (DCEP)

title: Coal Technician - Mount Thorley
description:

  • Day to day upkeep of equipment.
  • Delivery of samples to both internal and external customers.

Previous coal sampling and testing experience would be an advantage.

The successful candidate will also have:

  • Unrestricted driver's license and reliable transport are mandatory.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • The ability to work in a team environment and the ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • A flexible schedule to cover various shifts and rosters.
  • The ability to keep pace with significant manual handling and labor throughout the shift.
  • A can do attitude to strive for better and be part of a dynamic team.
  • Forklift license and high-risk work ticket are desirable.

If you’re seeking a flexible casual opportunity and enjoy hands-on technical work, we encourage you to apply Now.

COME TO WORK AND BE 100% YOU

description:
Inspire health. Serve with compassion. Be the difference.

Job Summary

Assists in care of patients of all ages before, during and after surgical procedures by performing scrub duties and related functions as a member of the surgical team on a novice to advanced beginner level completing identified job competencies. Maintains patient safety, privacy and confidentiality. Complies with legal aspects of patient care. Accountabilities

  • Completes annual age specific accountabilities. - 5%

Job related course work beyond high school - Diploma in Surgical Technology

CST - Surgical Technologist

Night (United States of America)

title: Research Development Officer
description:

Working closely with the Head and Dean, Education and Professional Studies, research leaders and key stakeholders, you will drive initiatives that strengthen research performance, foster a vibrant research culture, and build research capacity across the School and Institute. This influential role offers the opportunity to lead research development projects, support the growth of collaborative research groups and strategic partnerships, and enhance the visibility, impact and engagement of world-class research.

If you are passionate about enabling research success, translating strategy into action, and supporting researchers to maximise their impact, this is an exciting opportunity to contribute to transformative research initiatives that make a difference in education and society.

Key responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead research development initiatives by coordinating research groups, capacity-building programs and strategic projects that strengthen research performance and culture across the School and GIER.

  • Drive research funding success through the coordination of grant development activities, funding opportunities and collaborative research partnerships.
  • Enhance research visibility and impact by implementing communication, engagement and knowledge translation activities that promote the profile and influence of School and GIER research.
  • Deliver research performance insights and governance support through data analysis, reporting, stakeholder engagement and the coordination of research planning and decision-making processes.

About you
The successful candidate will have a relevant postgraduate qualification and/or substantial experience in research development, research management, higher education administration or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and coordinating research development initiatives, strategic projects, research groups or capacity-building programs, with the ability to deliver outcomes in complex organisational environments.

  • Highly developed written and verbal communication skills, with experience developing and implementing strategies that enhance research visibility, engagement, reputation and impact across diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse complex data and information, prepare high-quality reports and briefing materials, and provide evidence-based advice to support strategic planning, governance and decision-making.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively, influence outcomes and build effective partnerships across a broad range of stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate multiple initiatives, and identify opportunities for process and service improvement.

Desirable:

  • Experience working within a university, research institute or knowledge-intensive environment.
  • Knowledge of the Australian higher education and research funding landscape, including competitive grant schemes, research impact and engagement frameworks.

This is a fixed term (available until 31 December 2026), full-time position primarily based at Griffith University Gold Coast (preferred) or Brisbane South (Nathan). Griffith University’s campuses are located on the lands of the Yugarabul, Yuggera, Jagera, Turrbal, Yugambeh and Kombumerri peoples.

Join a collaborative technology team where your ideas help shape the tools and platforms that support employees across JPMorganChase. You will build reliable, scalable solutions, contribute to modern engineering practices, and help advance AI-enabled capabilities that make work simpler, faster, and more effective. This is an opportunity to grow your technical expertise while delivering meaningful impact in a secure and inclusive environment. As a core technical contributor, you will conduct critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas, supporting the firm’s business objectives. We value your creativity and encourage you to think beyond routine approaches to build innovative solutions.

Job Summary:
As a Lead Software Engineer – AI Tooling in Employee Platforms, you will design and deliver trusted technology products that are secure, stable, and scalable. You will work with us in an agile environment to create new features, improve AI tooling, and support cloud platform integration. Your work will help empower employees through innovative solutions that improve productivity, resilience, and user experience. You will be an integral part of an agile team, enhancing and building market-leading technology products. You will help drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs and technical credentials.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design and deliver secure, high-quality software solutions that support employee-facing technology products
  • Develop, debug, and maintain production code using modern engineering practices and scalable design patterns
  • Contribute to architecture and design artifacts while ensuring software solutions meet functional, security, and resiliency requirements
  • Build and enhance AI-enabled tooling, including solutions that support agentic workflows and improved developer productivity
  • Analyze complex data sets and create insights, reporting, or visualizations that help improve applications and user outcomes
  • Collaborate with product, design, engineering, and cloud platform teams to deliver solutions in an agile environment
  • Apply continuous integration, continuous delivery, testing, and operational practices to improve software quality and reliability
  • Participate in software engineering communities and contribute to a culture of learning, inclusion, and technical excellence
  • Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation
  • Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and proficient applied experience
  • Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software in a large-scale technology environment
  • Proficiency with Python and experience applying it to production software development
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or AI-enabled engineering tools to improve development workflows
  • Understanding of AI agents, agentic flows, and how they can be applied to software solutions
  • Working knowledge of the software development life cycle, including design, build, test, deploy, and support activities
  • Experience with agile delivery practices, continuous integration, continuous delivery, application resiliency, and secure coding
  • Practical experience with cloud-native development, preferably using Amazon Web Services
  • Experience with one or more database querying languages and working with data to support application development
  • Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Familiarity with modern front-end technologies and user-centered application development
  • Experience working with relational or non-relational databases
  • Experience with Java, Kotlin, or Spring Boot
  • Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
  • Advanced in one or more programming language(s)
  • Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle
  • Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

title: Senior Dispute Resolution Specialist - Life Insurance
description:
We’re looking for experienced Senior Dispute Resolution Specialists to join our Life Insurance team and help deliver fair financial outcomes.

As a Senior Dispute Resolution Specialist, you’ll manage complex complaints with precision, professionalism and strategic insight. You’ll use your expertise in negotiation, conciliation, and case investigation to resolve disputes efficiently and fairly, applying relevant legislation, codes, and AFCA’s Fairness Jurisdiction.

In this role, you will play a central role in how we consider and resolve complaints. You will:

  • Review complaints from consumers that have not been resolved directly with the financial firm
  • Work with customers to gather information and understand the core issues
  • Determine key issues and investigate where further information is required from complainants and third parties and produce written decisions in plain English
  • Utilise alternative dispute resolution methods to help parties resolves complaints by negotiation
  • Apply a sound understanding of the AFCA complaint resolution criteria including relevant legal principles, applicable industry codes or guidance, good industry practice and previous AFCA decision to resolve financial complaints fairly and efficiently
  • Prepare preliminary assessments and draft decisions on complaints that are not able to be resolved by agreement.
  • Lead the resolution of challenging complaints involving multiple issues.
  • Contribute to operational improvements and align practices with broader strategy.
  • Collaborate across teams and support project delivery.
  • We consider a range of complaints relating to life insurance such as income protection as well as funeral, trauma, total and permanent disability (TPD), accidental death and endowment policies.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Demonstrated experience in life insurance, with a strong understanding of complaint handling and alternative dispute resolution processes.
  • A strategic mindset, as you will play a key part in aligning dispute resolution practices with our broader Operational Delivery strategy
  • Ability to investigate and identify complex complaints and the information we need to form a view
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to break down complex information and communicate it in Plain English to a variety of stakeholders
  • Excellent organisational skills that enable you to work across multiple complaints and activities simultaneously ensuring matters are progressing
  • Resilience and empathy to have difficult conversations with a focus on resolving complaints for consumers and financial firms in a timely manner
  • A highly responsive approach to your work
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a close and supporting team
  • An opportunity to thrive in and help contribute to a culture that values fairness, efficiency, and accessibility.
  • Gold AWEI Accreditation 2025 – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
  • Accredited Family Friendly Workplace – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing.
  • Additional and inclusive leave options – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.

title: Data Engineer (Trade Surveillance)
description:
Group Overview

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world's leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

The Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world's most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

Role Overview

Effective Market Abuse Surveillance is highly dependent on data of multiple types and from many different sources. Trade Surveillance requires complete Trade and Pre-Trade transactional data, Instrument and Client Reference Data and Market Data. Communications Surveillance requires ingestion of messages from multiple electronic platforms.

This role will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and compliance of data pipelines that support surveillance systems across communications and trading activities, covering the above structured and unstructured data.

The role bridges engineering and operations, enabling robust data ingestion, transformation, and monitoring to meet regulatory and internal compliance requirements. The Data Ops Engineer will play a critical role in collaborating with upstream teams to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness is as expected and that any data completeness or quality issues are visible.

The role will also work on other Surveillance data initiatives such as persisting Surveillance Alerts in the firm's data lake for analytics purposes.

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, build, maintain and optimise end-to-end data pipelines and workflows between the source data points and target destinations, working with the wider Surveillance Technology team to prioritise automation, scalability and strategy at the heart of the design.
  • Implement automated data completeness and quality checks, validation rules, and reconciliation processes to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of the data ingested and to make visible any data that is not processed.
  • Identify Critical Data Elements and implement failover and recovery strategies for the respective Data Flows.
  • Build AWS infrastructure using Terraform or CDK
  • Write unit, integration, and infrastructure tests
  • Monitor, investigate and resolve data anomalies through collaboration with, Business Analysts, Developers, and Testers across functions and verticals.
  • Implement data management and governance frameworks to ensure data is ingested and loaded per the requirements of the consuming platform; Scila for Trade Surveillance, and Global Relay for Communications Surveillance.
  • Partnering with the Data Strategy and Data Infrastructure team to ensure Data Lineage, auditability and retention policies are enforced across all necessary pipelines.
  • Ensuring that Data consumed and processed is compliance with regulatory, legal, and security protocols.
  • Work closely with surveillance analysts, compliance officers, and engineering teams to translate business rules into technical specifications.
  • Partnering closely with stakeholders and subject matter experts such as the Cloud Infrastructure team to optimise performance and costs.
Experience / Competences

Essential
  • Strong experience ETL/ELT data pipeline builds from design, to implementation, to maintenance in relation to financial market messaging platforms, and trade & order systems.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, ideally with a background in software engineering, product management or data analytics.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or Java, SQL, and data pipeline frameworks (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Spark), with solid experience with the AWS ecosystem.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Previous experience in Data Ops and Data Engineering.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong experience with Agile software delivery.
Desired
  • Experience with market data ingestion, metadata extraction, and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with some of EKS, Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, AWS Glue, Snowflake, Terraform and Transfer Family.
  • Knowledge of streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis) and API integrations, and hands-on experience with monitoring tools (e.g. Grafana) and observability practices.
  • Proficient with Terraform or CDK (infrastructure-as-code).
  • Experience in Business Communications Technology e.g. Bloomberg, ICE, Symphony, Teams Chat, etc.
  • Familiarity with security best practices, IAM, and VPN configuration.
  • Experience with regulatory compliance and data security in financial services.
  • Knowledge of financial markets and trading platforms.
  • Experience with GitLab, Qliksense & Alation
  • Certifications in DataOps, cloud platforms, or related areas.
  • Strong understanding of modern foundation models, including Claude (Sonnet / Opus), OpenAI GPT models, and other leading LLMs.
  • Practical experience building applications using agentic or multi-agent workflows (e.g., tool use, planning, orchestration, retrieval, reasoning patterns).
Band & Level - Professional, 5


Not The Perfect Fit?

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.

Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.

UK - City Quays 3 - Belfast

title: Dog Sitter
description:
Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— Altamonte Springs, FL Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

This is a flexible, part-time independent contractor position where all jobs are voluntary and you set your availability and service area, and we match you with clients. It’s a great fit if you want meaningful, independent work caring for dogs and cats, helping pet parents travel with peace of mind, and building trust with repeat clients.

What You’ll Do

Pet sitting visits may include:

  • Feeding and refreshing water
  • Cleaning up waste
  • Giving playtime, affection, or companionship based on each pet's personality
  • Sending visit updates and photos through our app
  • Following each client’s detailed care instructions
  • Bringing in mail or packages
  • Adjusting lights, blinds, or trash/recycling when requested
  • Administering medication when within your experience and comfort level
Most visits take place while clients are traveling, so weekend, holiday, morning, afternoon, and evening availability is especially valuable.

Service Types

  • Walks: 30-90 minutes (1-3x daily)
  • Drop-ins: 30 / 45 / 60 minutes (1–3x daily)
  • Extended daytime visits: 2-8 hours
  • Overnights: 10-12 hour stays
  • 24-hour care: live-in with overnight care

What We Look For

  • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented
  • Strong written communication
  • Comfortable working independently in clients’ homes
  • Smartphone with reliable internet & camera
  • Medication experience (oral, injections, fluids)
  • Holiday & weekend availability

Pay + Perks

  • Sitters are paid per visit, with rates typically starting around $25 per 30 minute visit, with higher pay for longer visits, overnight care, house sitting.
  • Weekly direct deposit
  • Bonus opportunities (holidays, short notice, strong feedback)
  • 100% of tips go to you

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

Notes:

  • Apply to one location only
  • No phone calls (we contact strong matches)

title: Mechanical Engineering Expert
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mechanical Engineering Expert based in Brazil.

This is an opportunity for an experienced mechanical engineer to contribute directly to the development of high-quality training and evaluation data for cutting-edge AI models. You will design rigorous, original engineering problems that challenge advanced systems to demonstrate genuine technical reasoning. Your work will span areas such as mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, dynamics, and mechanical systems. Each problem will need to be deterministic, technically precise, and supported by a complete, independently verifiable solution. You will combine engineering expertise, quantitative reasoning, and computational tools to validate complex problems and their expected answers. The role is highly focused and flexible, offering remote work on a part-time basis with an immediate start. It is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys challenging technical problems and wants to help shape the future of AI through expert-level engineering knowledge.

Accountabilities:

  • Design advanced and original mechanical engineering problems for AI training and evaluation.
  • Develop rigorous, deterministic problems that have exactly one verifiable correct answer.
  • Create complete, accurate, and independently verified solutions for each problem.
  • Develop challenges that assess genuine engineering analysis, multi-step reasoning, and problem-solving rather than simple memorization.
  • Work across mechanical engineering domains including mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, dynamics, and mechanical systems.
  • Apply engineering judgment to create problems that reflect realistic mechanical engineering scenarios and workflows.
  • Use computational and engineering tools such as Python, MATLAB, CAD/CAE platforms, or specialized simulation software where appropriate to validate calculations and solutions.
  • Check all assumptions, calculations, methodologies, and final answers to ensure technical accuracy and reproducibility.
  • Clearly document solution methodologies and reasoning in well-structured technical English.
  • Produce consistent, high-quality outputs suitable for use in AI training and evaluation pipelines.
  • Review problems and solutions critically to identify ambiguities, errors, or multiple possible interpretations before submission.
  • Maintain a high level of precision and attention to detail across all technical content.

    • Requirements

    • Master’s or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
    • Strong research or industry experience involving mechanical systems, engineering analysis, simulation, mathematical modeling, or related technical work.
    • Strong quantitative reasoning, analytical thinking, and advanced problem-solving capabilities.
    • Solid understanding of mechanical engineering principles and the ability to apply them to complex, multi-step scenarios.
    • Familiarity with numerical methods, computational engineering, and quantitative modeling.
    • Ability to design original and genuinely challenging engineering problems that reflect real-world mechanical engineering workflows.
    • Strong ability to develop deterministic problems with a single objectively verifiable solution.
    • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to technical accuracy.
    • Strong technical writing skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex engineering reasoning clearly and precisely.
    • Experience using engineering or computational tools such as Python, MATLAB, ANSYS, Abaqus, SolidWorks, COMSOL, or comparable platforms is advantageous.
    • Background in finite element analysis, computational fluid dynamics, optimization, simulation, or other computational engineering disciplines is a plus.
    • Experience developing technical assessments, engineering educational content, or evaluation frameworks is beneficial.
    • Experience evaluating AI reasoning, creating training data, or working with advanced AI systems is an additional advantage.
    • Ability to work independently and consistently deliver high-quality technical content within defined deadlines.

      • Benefits

      • Remote working opportunity with location flexibility.
      • Part-time commitment of approximately 20 hours per week.
      • Competitive compensation of up to $40 USD per hour.
      • Initial 2-month project duration, with potential for extension.
      • Immediate start availability.
      • Opportunity to contribute directly to the training and evaluation of advanced AI models.
      • Work on intellectually challenging problems that draw on advanced mechanical engineering expertise.
      • Exposure to emerging AI applications in technical and engineering domains.
      • Flexible contract-based working environment suited to experienced engineering professionals.
      • Opportunity to apply research, modeling, simulation, and engineering analysis skills in a new AI-focused context.
      • Potential to contribute expert knowledge that helps improve AI reasoning and performance in mechanical engineering.

title: Developer
description:
Werkomgeving

Het Nationaal Instituut voor Criminalistiek en Criminologie of kortweg het NICC is een federale wetenschappelijke instelling binnen de FOD Justitie. Op vraag van de gerechtelijke overheden verrichten ze onafhankelijk onderzoek.

De directie Criminalistiek identificeert en analyseert sporen van verdachten en modus operandi. Zo helpen we daders van misdrijven op te sporen en bewijslast op te bouwen.
De directie Criminologie onderzoekt hoe het strafrechtelijke systeem functioneert en hoe we het kunnen verbeteren.


Taakomschrijving

De persoon zal verantwoordelijk zijn voor het opzetten en ontwikkelen van applicaties voor onze verschillende wetenschappelijke laboratoria. Deze applicaties hebben betrekking op domeinen zoals drugs, toxicologie, ballistiek, DNA-analyse en criminologisch onderzoek.

De kandidaat zal zich engageren vanuit een langetermijnperspectief en zal op termijn de back-up worden van ons Head of Development.
  • De kandidaat zal instaan voor het verzamelen van de behoeften en aanvragen van onze klanten en zal toezien op de correcte naleving van de deadlines van de projecten waarvoor hij/zij verantwoordelijk is.
  • Hij/zij zal instaan voor het onderhoud van de applicaties en zal daarnaast proactief meedenken en voorstellen formuleren ter ondersteuning van het IT-team.
  • Hij/zij zal eveneens toezien op de naleving van de vereisten inzake applicatiearchitectuur en veiligheid.
  • In bepaalde gevallen zal hij/zij externe teams aansturen die ondersteuning bieden bij de uitvoering van de projecten. In dat kader zal de kandidaat, afhankelijk van zijn/haar senioriteitsniveau (meer dan 5 jaar ervaring), ook instaan voor het interviewen en selecteren van externe medewerkers.

Profielomschrijving

Een ervaren ontwikkelaar die AI gebruikt, moet diepgaande technische expertise combineren met het vermogen om AI-tools te orkestreren, methodologische nauwkeurigheid en geavanceerde ontwerpvaardigheden.

De kern van het profiel: een pragmatische architect, prompt engineer, integrator en bewaker van kwaliteit.

Fundamentele technische competenties:

Programmeertalen & frameworks
  • Beheersing van een moderne backendprogrammeertaal: Python, C#, Java, Go, Node.js.
  • Beheersing van een frontendframework: React, Vue, Angular. Cloudarchitectuur: Azure, AWS, GCP.
  • Databases: geavanceerde SQL, optimalisatie, NoSQL, vector databases (Pinecone, Redis Vector).
Architectuur & ontwerp
  • Moderne design patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing, Hexagonal Architecture).
  • Microservices en API's.
  • Applicatiebeveiliging: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Zero Trust.
  • Observability/monitoring: gestructureerde logs, gedistribueerde traces en metrics.
Essentiële AI-competenties:

Geavanceerde prompt engineering
  • Structureren van prompts (rol → context → beperkingen → outputformaat).
  • Technieken: chain-of-thought, self-consistency, RAG en prompt guards.
  • Optimaliseren van de kwaliteit en verminderen van hallucinaties.
Integratie van AI in applicaties
  • Gebruik van LLM-API's: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic en Mistral
  • RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): vectorisatie, embeddings en pipelines
  • AI-agents: orkestratie, tools en beveiliging
  • Fine-tuning: gespecialiseerde modellen en het samenstellen en beheren van datasets
AI-kwaliteit & governance
  • Evaluatie van modellen (BLEU, ROUGE, perplexity en menselijke evaluatie)
  • Detectie van bias, robuustheid en conformiteit met regelgeving en standaarden (NIS2, AVG/GDPR)
  • Implementatie van beveiligings- en controlemechanismen (guardrails, filtering en monitoring)
DevOps- en automatiseringscompetenties:

Intelligente automatisering
  • CI/CD-processen versterkt door AI, zoals het genereren van pipelines, tests en documentatie
  • AI-ondersteunde refactoring: modernisering van legacycode.
  • Geautomatiseerde testen: unit tests, integratietesten en mutation testing:
Moderne tools
  • GitHub Copilot, GitHub en GitLab.
  • Docker en Kubernetes.
Specifieke competenties van een “AI-augmented” ontwikkelaar:

Wat dit profiel werkelijk onderscheidt
  • Het vermogen om met behulp van AI betrouwbare code te genereren en deze vervolgens te auditen en optimaliseren.
  • Het creëren van AI-pipelines (prompt → test → verbetering → versionering).
  • Het gebruik van AI om het ontwerpproces te versnellen, bijvoorbeeld voor diagrammen, modellen en user stories.
  • Het automatiseren van repetitieve taken, zoals scripts, migraties, testen en documentatie.
  • Versnelde technologische monitoring: geautomatiseerde samenvattingen en vergelijking van oplossingen.
​Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid is volop aan het informatiseren: van cybersecurity-uitdagingen tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen ter ondersteuning van nieuwe manieren van werken tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en optimalisatietrajecten van bestaande applicaties.
Wil je hieraan meewerken en zo een maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je tegelijk werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en maximale kansen krijgt om je ambities waar te maken? Dan bieden wij:
  • Een duidelijke missie in een stimulerende werkomgeving
  • Een zeer competitief salarispakket met een uitgebreide waaier aan extralegale voordelen, waaronder:
    • Hospitalisatieverzekering
    • Maaltijdcheques
    • Mobiliteitsvoordelen
    • Pensioenfonds
Daarnaast hechten we veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, met telewerkmogelijkheden voor de meeste functies. Onze kantoren zijn bovendien zeer goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

The role:

We are seeking a Manager, Physical Security Enablement to lead the successful delivery and integration of physical security programs across new data centre developments, expansions and major customer initiatives throughout Asia-Pacific.

Reporting into the regional leadership team, this role combines program leadership, physical security expertise and stakeholder management to ensure security systems, processes and vendors are aligned throughout the design, construction, installation, commissioning and handover phases of our projects.

This is a highly visible regional role supporting construction and expansion projects across Asia, requiring regular travel sites. Candidates who enjoy working in dynamic environments, influencing cross-functional teams and seeing projects come to life from concept through to operational handover will thrive in this position.

Regular travel throughout Asia should be expected, including visits during design validation, installation, commissioning, operational readiness and handover phases. The successful candidate should enjoy being on-site and working directly with project teams, stakeholders and vendors to drive successful outcomes.

Key responsibilities:

Physical Security Program Enablement

  • Lead the deployment and integration of physical security programs across new data centre builds and expansion projects throughout Asia-Pacific
  • Partner closely with Global Design & Construction (GDC), Data Centre Operations and Security Program teams to ensure security requirements are successfully incorporated into project delivery
  • Support security readiness activities during design, construction, installation, commissioning and operational handover
  • Identify and mitigate physical security risks throughout the project lifecycle
  • Drive consistency and standardisation of physical security practices across the region

Project & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead multiple concurrent security enablement initiatives across geographically dispersed locations
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants and vendors to ensure successful project outcomes
  • Provide guidance and leadership to regional security teams supporting active project sites
  • Influence cross-functional teams to deliver security solutions that support both operational excellence and customer requirements

  • Provide leadership and oversight across physical security technologies including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection and associated infrastructure
  • Support installation, commissioning, testing and operational acceptance of security systems
  • Manage security vendor relationships responsible for hardware installation, upgrades, maintenance and support
  • Lead SPOF (Single Point of Failure) and End-of-Life (EOL) assessments and remediation initiatives
  • Support issue resolution, root cause analysis and vendor escalation for complex technical security challenges

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop a small regional team, and own performance management with direct reports currently based in Singapore
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement
  • Provide coaching, mentoring and guidance to security professionals supporting regional programs and projects

Qualifications, key skills and attributes:

  • Demonstrated experience leading physical security programs, projects or operations within a data centre, mission-critical, hyperscale, telecommunications, infrastructure or high-security environment
  • Experience supporting large-scale construction, commissioning, fit-out or infrastructure projects
  • Strong stakeholder management capabilities across engineering, construction, operations and vendor organisations
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of physical security systems and their deployment within operational environments
  • Experience supporting new builds, expansions and commissioning activities
  • Experience working with security systems integrators, consultants and technology vendors
  • Understanding of project lifecycle delivery from design through operational handover
  • Experience working within highly regulated, operationally critical or customer-facing environments.
  • Knowledge of business continuity, security governance and risk management practices.

Benefits of the role:

  • Direct impact on some of the largest digital infrastructure projects in Asia-Pacific.
  • Opportunity to shape physical security standards across a growing regional portfolio.
  • High visibility role with significant stakeholder engagement across Operations, Security, Engineering and Construction teams.
  • Leadership opportunity with regional scope and influence, including APAC travel
  • Salary package containing company shares, annual bonus and salary reviews.
  • Onsite gyms, access to company wellness, financial and other benefits and initiatives.
  • Exposure to industry-leading technology, innovation and mission-critical operations

title: Partner Integration Lead
description:
SEEK Pass is revolutionising how over 5 million people manage their verified credentials across Asia-Pacific. You will lead the strategic delivery of partner integrations that expand our ecosystem and drive growth. This newly created role reports to the Senior Growth Manager (Ecosystem) and requires someone who can think strategically about integration delivery while building the frameworks and processes that enable scale.

You will work across SEEK Pass Growth, product squads, sales teams, and external partners to ensure integrations deliver predictable business outcomes and partner value. As we expand our partner network with increasingly sophisticated organisations, you'll need a solid understanding of how APIs work combined with commercial judgment to design delivery approaches that balance speed, quality and business impact. This isn't about executing task lists—you'll be thinking through how to streamline partner journeys, identify bottlenecks in API integration processes, design scalable frameworks, and create visibility that drives better business decisions.

Success in your first 6-12 months means establishing delivery frameworks that improve integration velocity and quality, creating pipeline visibility that informs growth strategy, and building stakeholder confidence through predictable, business-focused delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and optimize end-to-end API integration delivery frameworks that enable ecosystem growth and partner success
  • Think strategically about integration scoping and solution design, understanding API architecture and technical trade-offs
  • Build scalable processes, governance and tooling that improve API integration predictability and reduce time-to-value
  • Create visibility and reporting frameworks that connect integration delivery to business health and growth metrics
  • Identify patterns, bottlenecks and opportunities to systematically improve how we deliver API-based partner integrations
  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment across internal teams and external partners through strong stakeholder management
  • Establish best practices and templates that enable consistent, high-quality API integration delivery as the partner network scales
  • Proven experience leading API integration delivery on large-scale projects with focus on process design and scalability
  • Solid understanding of how APIs work with ability to engage credibly in technical conversations about integration architecture
  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design frameworks, identify patterns and solve for scale
  • Growth-oriented mindset with understanding of how delivery excellence drives ecosystem expansion and partner value
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination across technical and commercial teams
  • Comfortable operating in high ambiguity environments, bringing structure and strategic thinking to complex problems

Desirable but not required

  • Experience scaling integration or partnership functions.
  • Familiarity with API-enabled products or platform ecosystems.
  • Domain knowledge in identity, verification or credentialling.
  • Experience in marketplaces, SaaS or B2B technology.
  • Exposure to release management or implementation governance.
  • Experience in start-ups, scale-ups or newly created functions.

At SEEK, we are passionate about fostering a culture of inclusion and wellbeing that embraces and values the diversity of our people. We are a purpose driven business that works with heart.

We know teams with diverse ideas, experiences and perspectives are more creative and are critical to ensuring effective delivery and innovating to enable our future success. As such, we welcome applications from people with a diverse group of backgrounds and life experiences, especially as they relate to gender, sexual identity, culture, faith, disability and life stages. title: Mental Health Specialist (MHS), Child & Adolescent, PT, Nights

Delivers care to patients (voluntary and involuntary) of all ages and demonstrates knowledge of population-specific developmental tasks gained through training and experience. Interacts and assesses assigned patients for level of functioning and mental status.

  • Observes, collects, and communicates relevant patient information and communicates this verbally and via the medical record to other treatment team members. Performs point of care testing as trained and delegated by RN. Properly documents and maintains data on medical record and informs RN of activities performed.

title: Pre-Award: MXM- Information System Security Manager III
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an Information System Security Manager III to directly support the anticipated Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division, Model Based Engineering Assessment Division (Code MXM). Code MXM's mission is mission engineering analysis and assessment of complex Naval, DoD, and joint kill chains — with a specialized focus on Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) enabled analysis. As an Information System Security Manager III, you will lead information systems security management for Code MXM's environments — applying specialized, master-level expertise in Specialty Area 72 (Information Systems Security Management) to keep classified systems secure, compliant, and authorized to operate in support of EMSO mission engineering and test. As a member of the Cybersecurity Workforce, you will maintain the certifications, clearances, and on-the-job qualifications required to manage the program's information systems security posture in a collaborative Government/contractor environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide specialized, master-level information systems security management across Specialty Area 72 (Information Systems Security Management).
  • Manage the information system security posture of program environments in support of EMSO mission engineering, modeling, and test.
  • Maintain Cybersecurity Workforce (CSWF) qualification, including a minimum of 40 continuing education hours per year.
  • Complete required On-the-Job Training (OJT) evaluations within directed timelines.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Current U.S. Government-issued SECRET security clearance (or interim) — required and must be maintained; U.S. citizenship required;
  • Graduate degree from an accredited university, OR CNSSI 4012, OR NDU CISO certificate, OR NDU CIO certificate, OR AQD GA8, OR successful completion of a military training course: NEC 2779 (CIN A-531-0009), 3372, EKMS Manager (CIN W-3B-1500), or A-4C-1340 (KMI) — or DoD Service equivalent.
  • Validated five (5) or more years of specialized, master-level experience in Specialty Area 72 (Information Systems Security Management).
  • One of the following certifications is required: GSLC, CISSP, CISM, CAP, or CASP.
  • As a member of the Cybersecurity Workforce, maintain a minimum of 40 continuing education hours per year.
  • Complete OJT evaluation within directed timelines: NAVEDTRA 43462-1C, or NAVEDTRA 43462-2, or NAVEDTRA 43469 watch station 304; or (if IP O1–3) NAVEDTRA 43360-2; or (if IP O4–5) NAVEDTRA 43360-3.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • TS/SCI clearance (candidate must, at minimum, be eligible to obtain and maintain a TS clearance).
  • Multiple Specialty Area 72 certifications from the required list (GSLC, CISSP, CISM, CAP, CASP).

EEO Commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

We weten dat een goede balans tussen werk en privé belangrijk is. Daarom bieden we jou de ruimte om te groeien, vrijheid in je werk en aantrekkelijke voorwaarden om met plezier bij ons aan de slag te gaan.

title: Senior Data Engineer BI
description:
Voor Nederlandse Spoorwegen zoeken wij een Senior Data Engineer BI. Datateam Knoop is een Scrum-team binnen het cluster Knoop & Service van de opdrachtgever, gericht op het optimaliseren van knoopprocessen binnen de operatie. Je gebruikt data om datagestuurde beslissingen te ondersteunen en bij te dragen aan de 4J-doelstellingen: het juiste materieel, op het juiste moment, op de juiste plek en met de juiste kwaliteit voor de reiziger.

Je ontwikkelt en levert informatieproducten, zoals dashboards en rapportages, ontsluit en verwerkt databronnen en levert analyses en adviezen die direct invloed hebben op knoopprocessen en operationele prestaties.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Het ontsluiten en integreren van databronnen voor verdere analyses en het ontwikkelen van rapportages
  • Het leveren van data-gedreven adviezen aan diverse afdelingen en teams binnen de operatie
  • Het analyseren van processen en het identificeren van verbeterpunten in de operatie

In de Microsoft Azure cloudomgeving vertaal je businesswensen naar concrete producten en bouw je BI-oplossingen. Je werkt intensief samen met collega’s binnen het team, de keten en de business en draagt bij in alle fasen van ontwikkeling tot productie. Je biedt oplossingen, zorgt voor verbeteringen en neemt gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid voor sprintresultaten.

Je bent kritisch, communicatief en flexibel. Als een discipline buiten jouw expertisegebied valt, pak je die op of ondersteun je teamleden zodat zij zelforganiserend worden. Je geeft en ontvangt feedback en ziet dat als een kans om te groeien. Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en tijdsdruk. Het team geeft interne gebruikers snel en betrouwbaar inzicht door informatie te verzamelen, combineren, analyseren en presenteren. Je functioneert als echte teamspeler binnen Datateam Knoop, samen met business analisten, data engineers, informatieanalisten, Power BI-specialisten, een Scrum Master en een Product Owner.

Je draagt bij aan duurzame mobiliteit en helpt bij het bereikbaar houden van Nederland. De opdrachtgever staat voor vrijheid in het werk, resultaatgerichtheid en vooruitgang, met kernwaarden als openheid en betrouwbaarheid.

title: Communications Associate - Uganda
description:
About CorpsAfrica:

Founded in 2011 by Liz Fanning, CorpsAfrica is an organization that offers Africans the opportunity to serve as volunteers in their own countries, modeled after the Peace Corps. We train young, college-educated Africans and send them to live for up to a year in high-poverty rural communities, where they initiate and facilitate small-scale, high-impact projects identified by the local population. CorpsAfrica aims to promote a culture of public service in Africa by giving participants the opportunity to apply their training, skills, and energy to helping their fellow citizens overcome extreme poverty.

CorpsAfrica has steadily expanded its operations from Morocco to Senegal, Malawi, Rwanda, Ghana, Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Gambia, South Africa, and Côte d’Ivoire.

Role Overviews

The Communications Department at CorpsAfrica/Uganda is responsible for documenting, packaging, and amplifying the impact of Volunteers and community-led projects. The department ensures that CorpsAfrica’s work is clearly and consistently communicated to donors, partners, stakeholders, and the general public through strong storytelling, visual content, and digital engagement. The Communications team works closely with Programmes, Monitoring and Evaluation, Partnerships, and Leadership to translate field activities and impact data into compelling narratives that build trust, visibility, and support for CorpsAfrica’s mission. Applications are invited for the role of Communications Associate, who will support the Communications Officer in executing daily departmental functions related to content creation, digital communications, event documentation, and partner communications.

The main objective of the Communications Associate is to create, manage, and disseminate high-quality communication materials, including videos, pictures, and graphics designs that accurately reflect Volunteer activities, community impact, and organizational priorities. Ability to record and produce high quality audio visual is essential.


Allowance and Benefits: CorpsAfrica offers a monthly salary in accordance with local regulations and laws.
Duty Station: Kampala
Reporting to: Communications Officer
Duration: 12 Months


Specific Responsibilities

1. Content Creation & Storytelling

  • Produce quality videos and pictures of CorpsAfrica activities.
  • Assist in writing, editing, and formatting Volunteer stories, blog posts, newsletters, and website content.
  • Collect impact stories, quotes, and visuals from Volunteers and field staff.
  • Support the production of photos and videos for social media and stakeholder communications.
  • Draft donor-friendly success stories and human-interest narratives.
  • Assist with content development for campaigns, special events, and organizational initiatives.

2. Digital & Media Communications

  • Support the management and updating of CorpsAfrica/Uganda’s social media platforms (Facebook, X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn).
  • Assist in designing basic graphics using Canva or similar tools.
  • Support content scheduling and posting across platforms.
  • Track media mentions and social media engagement metrics.
  • Assist in compiling basic analytics and performance summaries.

3. Research & Strategic Support

  • Conduct research on media outlets, partners, and communication opportunities.
  • Support mapping and updating of media and stakeholder contact lists.
  • Maintain communication and partnership databases and trackers.

4. Events & Field Documentation

  1. Assist in documenting events, workshops, trainings, and field visits.
  2. Capture photography, videography, and live social media content during events.
  3. Prepare short event summaries and post-event documentation.

5. Administrative Support

  • Organize and maintain digital folders and archives for communication materials.
  • Support updating communication calendars and trackers.
  • Assist with logistics, printing, branding, and production of communication materials.

6. Other Duties

  • Perform any other communication-related tasks as assigned by the Communications Officer or Leadership team.

Qualifications

  • Knowledge and skills in photography, videography, and or graphics design.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Fine Art, communications, Journalism, Media Studies, Marketing, Public Relations, Development Studies, or a related field.
  • Strong writing, storytelling, and editing skills.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and digital communication trends.
  • Experience using Canva or Adobe Creative Suite is an advantage.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

How to Apply for the Position

Along with your cover letter and resume sent as pdfs, please provide the following work samples:

  1. Two short videos you produced (inserted as links at the end of your cover letter).
  2. Two articles published either online, in a newsletter, newspaper, or other professional communications products (insert as links at the end of your cover letter or attach to your application documents).
  3. Two social media posts (insert as links at the end of your cover letter).
  4. Two graphics you have designed (insert as links at the end of your cover letter or attach to your application).

Interested candidates should submit their applications by 30th September 2026. Only complete applications will be considered.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, CorpsAfrica encourages applications from all individuals regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, marital status, physical ability or any other legally protected basis.

What’s in it for you?

In this role, you will play a pivotal technical leadership role in building the modern data foundation that powers digital products across the Orthopaedics Supply Chain. You will help design lakehouse architecture on Databricks and AWS while enabling governed, reusable, business-ready data products for analytics, reporting, AI, and operational decision‑making.

The role suits an expert professional who can lead across solution architecture, pipeline design, engineering standards, and cross‑team delivery. You will work closely with Product Owners, business teams, data engineers, machine learning teams, and external delivery partners to turn business problems into practical technical solutions and executable plans.

You will also help advance modern engineering practices, including AI‑assisted development, reusable patterns, data quality automation, and observability. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact if hands‑on architecture and solving complex data challenges at scale are what energize you.

title: Dog Sitter
description:
Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— San Rafael / Southern Marin County Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

This is a flexible, part-time independent contractor position where all jobs are voluntary and you set your availability and service area, and we match you with clients. It’s a great fit if you want meaningful, independent work caring for dogs and cats, helping pet parents travel with peace of mind, and building trust with repeat clients.

What You’ll Do

Pet sitting visits may include:

  • Feeding and refreshing water
  • Cleaning up waste
  • Giving playtime, affection, or companionship based on each pet's personality
  • Sending visit updates and photos through our app
  • Following each client’s detailed care instructions
  • Bringing in mail or packages
  • Adjusting lights, blinds, or trash/recycling when requested
  • Administering medication when within your experience and comfort level
Most visits take place while clients are traveling, so weekend, holiday, morning, afternoon, and evening availability is especially valuable.

Service Types

  • Walks: 30-90 minutes (1-3x daily)
  • Drop-ins: 30 / 45 / 60 minutes (1–3x daily)
  • Extended daytime visits: 2-8 hours
  • Overnights: 10-12 hour stays
  • 24-hour care: live-in with overnight care

What We Look For

  • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented
  • Strong written communication
  • Comfortable working independently in clients’ homes
  • Smartphone with reliable internet & camera
  • Medication experience (oral, injections, fluids)
  • Holiday & weekend availability

Pay + Perks

  • Sitters are paid per visit, with rates typically starting around $25 per 30 minute visit, with higher pay for longer visits, overnight care, house sitting.
  • Weekly direct deposit
  • Bonus opportunities (holidays, short notice, strong feedback)
  • 100% of tips go to you

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

Notes:

  • Apply to one location only
  • No phone calls (we contact strong matches)

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Agency:

Omnicom Media

Job Function:

Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction:

Data Engineering

Job Description:

This role sits within our Data and Technology team.

In this role, you will own and extend our config-driven data platform (DMI), which standardises ingestion, transformation, and delivery of paid media data across 26+ ad platforms for multiple global clients. You will work closely with our team to build and maintain ELT pipelines from Cloud Function ingestion into BigQuery through to dbt-powered transformation ensuring the highest standard in data integrity and scalability.

This is an exciting role with excellent career opportunities within a high-profile team and scope to strategically shape the agency. We are looking for someone who can hit the ground running, contribute to a mature mono-repo data platform, and help drive best practices across the engineering team. Experience with digital media data is highly beneficial.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and extend the end-to-end data pipeline from Cloud Function ingestion through dbt transformation (staging → intermediate → marts) to analysis-ready tables in BigQuery.
  • Develop and maintain dbt macros, Jinja templates, and platform YAML definitions that auto-generate models across 26+ ad platforms.
  • Manage and improve GCP infrastructure (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub) provisioned via Terraform.
  • Build and maintain the Python CLI tooling that orchestrates client onboarding, config compilation, and pipeline execution.
  • Mentor the team of data engineers, driving best practices in DataOps, code review, testing, and documentation.
  • Proactively review existing processes to identify opportunities to automate manual work, optimise data delivery, and re-design infrastructure for greater scalability.
  • Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, and BI teams (PowerBI, Looker Studio, Tableau, etc.) to maximise the value delivered from data models.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build), testing (pytest, dbt tests), and documentation (MkDocs, etc.).

About You

Required:

  • Strong experience with dbt - macros, Jinja templating, incremental models, seeds, testing, and packages.
  • Proficient in Python 3.11+ building CLI tools, data processing, and automation.
  • Proficient in SQL, ideally BigQuery dialect.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform especially BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Scheduler
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for provisioning and managing cloud resources.
  • Solid understanding of data modelling techniques (star schema, dim/fact architecture, slowly changing dimensions).
  • Comfortable with Git (GitHub, branching strategies, pull requests) and CI/CD (Cloud Build or similar).
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical specifications.

Highly Desirable:

  • Experience with Docker and containerised workloads (Cloud Run Jobs).
  • Familiarity with CLI frameworks (Click) and config-driven architectures (Pydantic, YAML-based configuration).
  • Knowledge of the digital media / paid media industry — we process data from 26+ ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, TikTok, etc.).
  • Exposure to multi-cloud integrations (Azure Blob, AWS S3, SFTP).
  • Mono-repo experience — managing multi-client configurations in a single codebase.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Databricks (and dbt-databricks).
  • Familiarity with modern Python dev tooling — Poetry, ruff, mypy, pre-commit.
  • Experience with docs-as-code (MkDocs or similar).

Qualities:

  • Ownership – an ability to manage multiple workstreams across clients with accuracy, and see things through from design to deployment.
  • Curiosity – a natural inclination to explore new tools, dig into unfamiliar systems, and understand how things work end-to-end.
  • Resourcefulness – an ability to unblock yourself, whether that means reading source code, querying logs, or finding creative workarounds when data or documentation is limited.
  • Problem-solving – an ability to think through complex data issues methodically and design clean, maintainable solutions.
  • Collaboration – a desire to work openly, share knowledge, and build a team culture where code reviews and pair programming are valued
