title: Business Intelligence Analyst 2
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Business Intelligence Analyst.

About the job

This position is needed to provide actionable insights into strategic operations initiatives through the application of your expertise in quantitative analysis, technical systems, and leadership in analytics.

Twilio’s Customer Experience Ops Customer Intelligence team is looking for a curious and action-oriented analyst with a passion for using data to influence decision making and deliver product insights. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating complex problems, determining the right data to focus on and is able to derive insights and recommendations based on disparate data. This role interacts with stakeholders at all levels throughout the organization and helps inform product, compliance, and delivery strategy.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Work with technical program managers to inject data into decision making and planning to increase confidence in strategic business outcomes via defining OKRs, designing and building insight generating reports and dashboards, and partnering cross functionally to source and process product data.
  • Leverage SQL programming skills and data visualization tools to communicate product insights and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels. Standardize, maintain, and document metrics, models, datasets, and dashboards leveraging tools such as Tableau, Confluence, Acryl, and code.
  • Source, identify, and leverage data and insights for time-critical and strategic decision making.
  • Partner with leaders to successfully roll out and enable the adoption of dashboards and metrics.
  • Work closely with product leadership to monitor and improve product performance while collaborating with business leaders to drive exceptional product offerings. Measure and analyze product value and value proposition through metrics.
  • Collaborate with data producers and consumers during the product development lifecycle to ensure consistent data quality and availability for reporting post launch.
  • Own and foster stakeholder partnerships by acting as a trusted advisor.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 3-5 years of professional experience performing quantitative analysis, building dashboards and reports, working with business partners to convert ambiguous, messy data into tangible and actionable results that influence product and business impacting decisions in a fast paced industry.
  • Ability to think strategically and initiate, refine, and complete projects with minimal guidance in an often ambiguous environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient level experience writing, developing, and performing data deep dives and writing complex queries in SQL and SQL-like relational data languages
  • Minimum 2 years Tableau experience developing and managing dashboards is required.
  • Demonstrated ability in building reports, metrics, dashboards, etc. for analytics projects that often require data preparation processes such as data extraction, cleansing, mapping, loading and operationalizing workflows in production.

Desired:

  • Familiarity or hands-on experience utilizing Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to optimize SQL query writing, data analysis workflows, and documentation is a plus.
  • Experience in telephony, email, messaging, social media, or other electronic communications is a plus.
  • Experience or familiarity with data warehousing and/or ETL processes, and distributed computing technologies (Hive/Presto/Spark/Zeppelin) is a plus.
  • Experience in BI reporting tools like Looker is a plus.
  • Experience with unstructured data is a plus.

Location

This role will be Remote, and based in Colombia

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior Regulatory and Start Up Specialist (Argentina)
description:
We’re expanding our capabilities across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru, and we’re hiring our first Senior Regulatory and Start Up Specialist (Senior RSS) in Argentina!

As the Senior RSS on our team, you are a seasoned, experienced professional in regulatory and site start-up activities. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the location of the Senior RSS and include but are not limited to initial and subsequent clinical trial submission to Competent Authorities and IRB/Ethics Committees, Informed Consent Form review and adaptation, Essential Document collection and quality review, supporting sites on IRB/EC submissions and providing support to the Site Contract Management group in budget and contract negotiation.

The Senior RSS may act as Subject Matter Expert for questions by other in-country members (CRAs, CSSs or others) supporting site start-up activities, trainer for less-experienced staff on site start-up activities and may be identified as Owner of country specific tools and guidance documents to increase knowledge share of country specific site start-up activities and ensure compliance with local and international clinical trials regulations and guidelines.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Responsible for delivery, in terms of timeliness and quality, of site activation readiness within the assigned country/sites and foreseeing and mitigating any risks
  • Preparation of Clinical Trial Application Forms as well as preparation of submission dossier (initial and amendments/notifications) for submission to Competent Authorities (CA), Ethics Committee (EC) and other applicable local bodies according to local requirements and within required timelines to obtain all necessary authorizations/approvals for the conduct of the Clinical Trial according to international and local/national applicable regulations, company SOPs and principles of ICH-GCP
  • Interaction with CA/EC for study purposes and handling responses to the CA/EC
  • Providing regular updates about CA and EC submissions to the Start Up Lead and/or Regulatory Lead assigned to the study and to Project Manager/Project Team as relevant
  • Maintenance of project plans, project trackers and regulatory intelligence tools as it pertains to assigned responsibilities and to keep Regulatory Leadership updated
  • Preparation/Support the development of study specific start-up plans, IMP release requirements and essential document review criteria
  • Partner with the assigned site CRA to ensure alignment in communication and secure site collaboration
  • Prepare, review and manage collection of essential documents required for site activation/IMP release
  • Customize country/site specific Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Forms.
  • Responsible for/facilitates the translation and co-ordination of translations for documents required for submission
  • Maintain communication with other key functions participating to country start up i.e., Feasibility, Clinical Operations, Project Management, Regulatory, and Site Contracts management group on project specific status and deliverables
  • Act as SME for collection and maintenance of site level critical path to Site Activation data points, including but not limited to Competent Authority, local IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) timelines, site contracts and budget negotiation requirements for and other required reviews to secure on time site activation for the assigned sites in the country
  • When required, participate/support the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee department
  • Keep an updated knowledge of the local clinical trial laws, regulations and help distributing this knowledge within Precision for Medicine to ensure the conduct of Clinical Trials according to international and local/national applicable regulations
  • Maintain audit/inspection readiness at all times and file documents as per TMF plan and/ or study specific plans in the relevant TMF
  • May support the clinical team performing Pre-Study Site Visits
  • May participate/support feasibility group in site outreach to assess potential interest of investigators to a potential study
  • May support development of country specific Country Start-up summary and process flow identifying timelines, risks, and success factors
  • May support development of training sessions to expand Country Start-up knowledge and act as Subject Matter Expert for queries
  • May mentor staff on local study start-up regulations, submissions, and internal procedures
  • May interact with clients to provide activation readiness status updates, request documents or document review, and participate in proposal activities, including slide development and client presentation as required
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management

Qualifications

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelors’ degree in life sciences or related field (ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline), or Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • 3.5 years or more as a Regulatory or SU specialist in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing at the English proficiently (Professional level)

Other Required:

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential
  • Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail required
  • Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based
  • Ability to prioritize workload to meet deadlines

Preferred:

  • Relevant regulatory and site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, CA/EC/IRB submissions) experience for the particular country
  • Experience using milestone tracking tools/systems
  • Can assist junior SU specialists in problem resolution
  • Advanced degree in medical or life sciences (MD, PhD, PharmD)/RAC certification/Masters in Regulatory Science

Competencies:

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Ability to follow task-specific procedures, be attentive to detail and place importance on accuracy of information
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Ability to effectively interact with project team(s) and effectively communicate in English and the local language of the country where located
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency to match the pace
  • Must demonstrate excellent computer skills
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade
  • Flexible attitude with respect to work assignments and new learning

title: IT Applications Specialist
description:
Library & Archives Solutions Pte Ltd (LAAS), incorporated in 2000, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the National Library Board (NLB) of Singapore.

LAAS provides a comprehensive and integrated suite of library and archives solutions that enable innovation and transformation. Our service offering includes providing professional manpower services, capability development, consulting, and digitisation solutions. We work closely with clients to enhance service delivery, improve operational efficiency, build organisational capabilities, and harness digital technologies to better serve their communities.

We welcome driven, motivated, and passionate individuals to join our close-knit team and contribute to meaningful work that makes a difference.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a proactive and service-oriented IT Applications Specialist to support and maintain business applications, the corporate website, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, the Training Management System, and client Integrated Library System (ILS) and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID)solutions.

You will cover the following:

Microsoft 365 & SharePoint Support

  • Support the company’s Microsoft 365 environment, including user accounts, email, licenses, and basic configuration.
  • Assist with SharePoint Online configuration, document libraries, permissions, and content management.
  • Provide basic user support and guidance for Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

Integrated Library System & RFID Systems Support

  • Provide application support for ILS and RFID solutions for clients.
  • Assist with system configuration, troubleshooting, testing, and user support.
  • Work with vendors and clients to follow up on ILS and RFID-related issues.

Testing, UAT & Documentation

  • Assist with UAT, system testing, and verification of new features, enhancements, and fixes for ILS and RFID solutions.
  • Prepare and maintain system documentation, test cases, UAT records, user guides, and other project documentation.
  • Assist with implementation and go-live activities as required.

Vendor & User Support

  • Liaise with vendors and clients on application support, maintenance, and technical issues.

Training Management System

  • Monitor the Training Management System and follow up on system issues when required.
  • Assist with system configuration, user support, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Maintain system and training-related documentation.

Corporate Website Support

  • Maintain and support the company’s corporate website.
  • Assist with website content updates, basic configuration, security updates, backups, and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate with external vendors or developers for website issues and enhancements.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field with 2–3 years of relevant experience in application support, system administration, IT support, or a related role.
  • Experience supporting business applications, websites, Microsoft 365, or SharePoint is an advantage.
  • Experience with library management systems or RFID solutions is an advantage.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Service-oriented, responsible, and able to work independently.

The successful candidate will be appointed into a position commensurate with his/her work experience.

Interested applicants are invited to submit your detailed resume, and contact details to: hr@laas.com.sg

We thank all applicants for your interest. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Workplace Safety & Health Officer (Tuas Avenue 2)
description:
We are the people who give possibilities purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.





Job Description

1. Support site leadership in implementing EHS plans, legal compliance activities, training programs, inspections, audits, investigations and related initiatives to maintain a safe, healthy and environmentally responsible workplace.
2. Partner with manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, facilities, quality, warehouse, contractors and support functions to identify hazards, assess risks and implement appropriate controls for routine and non-routine activities.
3. Establish, review and sustain standard work for assigned EHS processes to support consistency, compliance, audit readiness and continuous improvement.
4. Conduct or support risk assessments, job hazard analyses, ergonomic evaluations, machine safety reviews, compliance inspections and internal audits across Tuas Plant operations.
5. Lead or support investigation of incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and dangerous occurrences, including root cause analysis, corrective action planning and verification of action effectiveness.
6. Track, follow up and support timely closure of corrective and preventive actions from audits, inspections, incidents, ESOs, GEMBA walks, risk assessments, regulatory reviews and corporate EHS requirements.
7. Support BD Excellence safety component practices, SQDCP-related EHS measures, ESO trend review, gap analysis, action tracking, escalation routines, visual management and GEMBA engagement.
8. Monitor, analyze and communicate assigned EHS performance indicators, key risks, trends, open actions and improvement plans to relevant stakeholders and site leadership.
9. Support compliance with applicable Singapore regulatory requirements, including MOM WSH requirements, SCDF fire safety requirements, environmental obligations, permits, licenses and BD corporate EHS standards.
10. Manage or support environmental programs, including hazardous waste, chemical management, SDS and chemical inventory, air emissions, wastewater, stormwater, environmental aspect and impact reviews, reporting and ISO 14001/45001 sustainment.
11. Support technical EHS and high-risk work programs, including lockout/tagout, machine guarding, PPE, fall protection, confined space, hot work, lifting operations, contractor safety, traffic management, ergonomics, hazard communication and industrial hygiene.
12. Review, approve or provide technical EHS input for permits, method statements, risk assessments, contractor work, equipment upgrades, commissioning, qualification, validation and other non-routine activities.
13. Deliver, coordinate or support EHS training, onboarding, toolbox briefings and job-specific competency reinforcement for Associates, people leaders, contractors and visitors.
14. Support emergency preparedness, fire safety management, drills, crisis response coordination, emergency equipment readiness, fire safety submissions, inspections and related SCDF compliance activities.
15. Maintain EHS documents, procedures, records, legal registers, training matrices, audit evidence and action trackers, and perform other duties within the scope of EHS, compliance, fire safety, environmental management, emergency response or continuous improvement as assigned.

Education and Experience

1. Diploma or Degree from an accredited university, polytechnic or college in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Safety and Health, Industrial Hygiene or related technical discipline.
2. Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in EHS, manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering, facilities, or related technical environment; medical device or high-volume manufacturing experience is preferred.
3. Registered with the Ministry of Manpower as a Workplace Safety and Health Officer (WSHO).
4. Must be a certified Fire Safety Manager (FSM) and able to support SCDF fire safety management requirements, fire safety planning, inspections, drills and emergency preparedness activities.
5. Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, internal audits, compliance reviews and corrective action tracking is preferred.
6. Experience with security management, access control, contractor and visitor control, emergency response coordination or manufacturing-site security protocols is required or strongly preferred based on site scope.

Knowledge and Skills

1. Strong knowledge of Singapore WSH legislation, MOM requirements, SCDF fire safety requirements, environmental obligations and relevant permits or licenses applicable to manufacturing operations.
2. Strong working knowledge of incident investigation, root cause analysis, risk assessment, job hazard analysis, ergonomics, machine safety, lockout/tagout, contractor safety, permit-to-work and corrective action management.
3. Ability to work in a team-based operational environment where performance is measured, gaps are visualized and actions are managed through regular operating cadences and visual management.
4. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage hourly Associates, technicians, engineers, contractors, people leaders and site leadership.
5. Demonstrated ability to analyze issues, prioritize actions, drive execution, verify effectiveness and sustain improvements through standardization and follow-up.
6. Action-oriented, disciplined and practical, with commitment to safety, compliance, respect for people, continuous improvement and leading from the front.
7. Comfortable working both strategically and tactically, including shopfloor engagement, leadership reporting, data analysis, facilitation, coaching and hands-on problem solving.

Accountability

1. Accountable for supporting and sustaining assigned EHS programs, compliance obligations, site EHS performance, risk reduction plans and audit readiness.
2. Accountable for supporting assigned fire safety, emergency response, environmental, occupational safety, industrial hygiene and BD Excellence safety component activities.
3. Expected to create urgency around closing EHS gaps, escalating significant risks, sustaining improvements and coaching leaders and Associates on EHS responsibilities.

Physical Demands

1. Regular movement across manufacturing, warehouse, utility, facility, laboratory, office, contractor work and outdoor areas to conduct inspections, GEMBA walks, audits, investigations and emergency response support.
2. May require standing, walking, climbing stairs, accessing production areas, observing machine or maintenance activities, and occasional bending, kneeling or reaching during inspections and risk assessments.
3. May require use of required PPE such as safety shoes, safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, masks, respirators or other site-specific protective equipment depending on work area and task risk.
4. Must be able to respond to urgent EHS, fire safety, environmental or emergency situations during working hours and, where required, outside normal working hours based on site needs.

Work Environment

1. Work is performed in a mixed environment comprising office areas, medical device manufacturing production floors, clean or controlled areas, warehouses, utility and facility areas, laboratories, contractor work zones and outdoor plant areas within Tuas Plant.
2. The role may be exposed to operational hazards such as moving equipment, forklifts and pedestrian traffic, noise, heat, chemical handling areas, compressed gases, high-risk maintenance activities, work at height, confined space, hot work, machine guarding and energy isolation activities.
3. The role requires regular interaction with Associates, contractors, vendors, visitors, auditors, regulatory representatives and site leadership in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
4. Work may require flexibility to support audits, drills, shutdown activities, incident response, regulatory inspections, contractor works and urgent operational priorities beyond standard office routines.


Why Join Us?

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

title: Data Engineer Coordinator (AI Engineering)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Engineer Coordinator (AI Engineering) based in Brazil.

This role combines advanced data engineering with the rapidly evolving field of AI Engineering, offering the opportunity to shape modern, scalable data and AI capabilities. You will serve as a technical reference for strategic initiatives, designing reliable data platforms and intelligent, agentic solutions. The position spans data architecture, Snowflake, Databricks, cloud platforms, RAG, LLMs, and AI agents. You will help build secure, observable, and cost-efficient solutions that connect enterprise data with generative AI applications. The role also involves establishing engineering standards, improving automation and performance, and supporting strong data governance. Working closely with technology, analytics, and business teams, you will help turn complex data and AI opportunities into sustainable enterprise solutions.

Accountabilities:

  • Design and implement enterprise AI agent architectures, including LLM orchestration, reasoning workflows, external tools, APIs, and integration with corporate data.
  • Architect and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines covering indexing, retrieval, and context enrichment to improve accuracy and reduce hallucinations.
  • Build secure integrations and connectors that enable AI agents to interact with knowledge bases, analytical platforms, and corporate systems while maintaining strong authentication and access controls.
  • Drive LLMOps and production readiness by implementing observability, inference cost management, appropriate LLM selection, and cloud security practices.
  • Design, develop, and optimize scalable, secure, and high-performance data pipelines and analytical solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for data engineering initiatives using Snowflake, Databricks, and modern cloud platforms.
  • Establish and promote best practices across development, testing, observability, automation, CI/CD, and deployment.
  • Lead data modeling efforts and develop reusable, sustainable solutions that support analytics and business needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, operational efficiency, scalability, and technology costs.
  • Conduct technical reviews and contribute to the development and mentoring of less experienced data engineers.
  • Ensure data engineering solutions comply with established standards for security, governance, quality, and reliability.
  • Partner with business, analytics, and technology stakeholders to translate requirements into effective data and AI solutions.
  • Contribute to the broader adoption of AI Engineering capabilities, including generative AI applications, intelligent agents, and solutions built on enterprise data.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in data engineering and the delivery of analytical solutions at scale, with the ability to provide technical direction on complex initiatives.
    • Advanced expertise in Snowflake, including data modeling, query optimization, performance tuning, security, cost management, and modern platform capabilities.
    • Hands-on experience with Databricks and modern cloud-based data architectures.
    • Strong proficiency in advanced SQL and the development and optimization of production-grade data pipelines.
    • Solid Python experience for automation, data processing, integrations, and engineering workflows.
    • Experience with dbt or equivalent tools for data transformation and modeling.
    • Knowledge of CI/CD, source control, automated deployments, and modern software engineering practices.
    • Strong understanding of Data Governance, Data Catalog, Data Quality, lineage, observability, metadata management, and related practices.
    • Experience working with Azure or comparable cloud platforms and services.
    • Practical AI Engineering experience, including consuming AI models through APIs, implementing RAG solutions, developing AI agents, and integrating AI capabilities with enterprise data platforms.
    • Familiarity with advanced Snowflake capabilities such as Clustering, Materialized Views, Time Travel, Zero-Copy Cloning, Resource Monitoring, and Data Sharing.
    • Experience with Databricks technologies such as Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows, and Asset Bundles is highly desirable.
    • Knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Data Lake Gen2, Azure Functions, and cloud integration services is a plus.
    • Familiarity with GitHub, Azure DevOps, DevSecOps practices, and automated delivery workflows is beneficial.
    • Exposure to AI Engineering frameworks, LLMOps, and Agentic AI technologies is strongly valued.
    • Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, analytics, and business teams.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work opportunity in Brazil.
      • Opportunity to work at the intersection of modern data engineering and AI Engineering.
      • Technical ownership of strategic data, cloud, generative AI, and agentic AI initiatives.
      • Exposure to technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, RAG, LLMs, and AI agents.
      • Opportunity to influence engineering standards, governance, automation, security, and platform scalability.
      • Collaboration with multidisciplinary technology, analytics, and business teams.
      • Opportunity to mentor other engineers and contribute to the evolution of data engineering capabilities.
      • Professional growth in a rapidly evolving data and AI environment.

title: Platform Engineer Big Data
description:
Voor onze klant Defensie zijn wij op zoek naar een Platform Engineer Big Data

Bedrijf informatie

Met jou kennis en vaardigheid help je (in)direct mee aan het tegengaan van zichtbare en onzichtbare dreigingen voor onze samenleving.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Als Data Engineer draag je bij aan de instandhouding en innovatie van onze Big Data Infrastructuur. Je zorgt samen met de collega's van je team en
  • (andere) technische specialisten ervoor dat de infrastructuur altijd beschikbaar zodat onze afnemers (militaire eenheden en besluitvormers) een actueel dreigingsbeeld hebben waarop beslissingen kunnen worden gebisseerd, dit noemen we informatie gestuurd optreden.
  • Met je collega's werk je in Agile teams aan de wendbaarheid en doorontwikkeling van onze Big Data-Infrastructure
  • Je helpt afnemende technische teams met innovatieve (maatwerk-) oplossingen, je werkt dit uit in een technisch ontwerp en werkt mee aan de implementatie hiervan
  • Je draagt je kennis over aan collega’s met minder ervaring door inhoudelijke begeleiding bij de werkzaamheden
  • Je wordt ingezet om de IT infrastructuur op het Big data gebied flexibel en robuuster te maken waarbij continuïteit en beschikbaarheid voorop staan, hiervoor zijn verschillende programma en projecten uitgezet. Hierbij moet worden gedacht aan Business Continuity Management en multi datacenter strategieën.
  • Je draagt bij aan de instandhouding, wendbaarheid en innovatie van onze Big Data Infrastructuur. Onze afnemers eisen dat binnengekomen data snel wordt omgezet naar informatie zodat beslissingen door besluitvormers op een gedegen manier kunnen worden genomen.Defensie heeft hiervoor een programma wat Informatie Gestuurd Optreden heet.

Opdracht informatie

Continuïteit, beschikbaarheid en veiligheid zijn belangrijke randvoorwaarden voor het gebruiken van applicaties en data voor de verwerking van inlichtingengegevens, je werkt in een innovatieve, inspirerende omgeving van een hoog niveau. Bij het team platform beheer binnen het bureau Data Infrastructure en Automation wordt de infrastructuur en applicaties beheerd die grote hoeveelheden data verwerkt die nodig is voor de uitvoering van ons werk. Deze data komt, in de meest uiteenlopende formats en vanuit allerlei bronnen. De beschikbaarheid van deze data moet 24/7 gegarandeerd zijn. Je collega’s variëren van Linux-beheerders tot netwerkspecialisten.

Als senior systeembeheerder/data engineer ben je onderdeel van een team van engineers dat onze fysieke infrastructuur stabiel en toegankelijk houdt. Dat betekent installatie, monitoring, beheer en lifecyclemanagement van de toepassingen die gedistribueerde dataopslag en verwerkingsprocessen mogelijk maken. Deze toepassingen variëren van datamanagement met NiFi of virtuele omgevingen met Ansible tot frameworks als Hadoop en open source zoekmachines als Elasticsearch. Alles draait op onze eigen, on-premise en grotendeels offline servers. Bij problemen komt het dus aan op je eigen kennis én op de samenwerking met je collega’s. In samenwerking met de engineers van de diverse DevOps-teams lever je daarnaast jouw bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling en verdere automatisering van de platformen en onze infrastructuur.

Wat heb je nodig

  • Kandidaat heeft minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met het gekozen ; eCF profiel of soortelijke functie

Wat wij bieden

  • Kandidaat heeft bij voorkeur meer dan aangegeven eis aantoonbare werkervaring met de gevraagde functie binnen het eCF profiel

title: Senior Agentic Software Engineer - GTM Intelligence Platform
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We are looking for an innovative engineer for the GTM Product Team to strengthen the technology beneath OPSWAT's marketing operations. Marketing runs on HubSpot today, and it works hard for us: 1.1 million contacts, 817 active workflows, and the integrations that connect it to SugarCRM, Salesloft, My OPSWAT, websites and our data master. Your first job is to make that foundation more reliable — keeping the integrations healthy, resolving the sync and data-quality issues that slow the team down, and giving Marketing Operations a technical partner who understands their platform from the inside.

From there, you will help us build the next generation of that capability in house. The four functions HubSpot performs for us are the roadmap: marketing automation and email; lead capture from web, portal, events and webinars; lead management, meaning scoring, lifecycle and routing; contact data governance and consent and tight integration with our OPSWAT Data Master (ODM). Along the way you will bring AI into the product to enable smarter lead qualification, routing and scoring and more automated campaign managements.

What You Will Be Doing

Build the Platform

  • Build one governed front door for every lead, whatever the source — web forms, My OPSWAT, webinars, field events, partner and list imports — so each lead is validated, de-duplicated, consented and enriched once, at the gate, and nothing reaches the CRM or the data spine any other way.
  • Build AI-native lead qualification: a model that reads fit and engagement across every signal we hold — product usage in My OPSWAT, Academy progress, web behavior, intent, firmographics — ranks the whole database with real resolution, explains every score in plain language, and learns from what SDRs actually convert.
  • Build intelligent lead routing: the right lead to the right rep at the right moment, with territory, capacity, availability and priority held as data that Marketing Operations can shape and preview themselves, and a decision record behind every assignment so anyone can see why a lead went where it did.
  • Make every hand-off dependable: each lead tracked from capture to first touch, stalls surfaced automatically, every priority tier followed up, and nothing lost between systems.
  • Give Marketing Operations a self-service campaign layer: per-campaign behavior — routing, priority, nurture — configured in minutes with a preview of what it would have done to yesterday's leads, so new campaigns stop requiring new workflows and old overrides expire on their own.
  • Build the platform AI-native from day one: expose its data and actions through an MCP server so OPSWAT's internal agents and assistants can look up a lead, explain a routing decision, or trigger a campaign action in natural language — and design every capability so an agent can use it as readily as a person can.
  • Make consent and suppression a single source of truth, enforced at the gate and impossible to bypass, and stream every signal and every decision into OPSWAT Data Master so marketing, product and sales data finally join in one place.
  • Build the seams to SugarCRM, the email service provider, visitor identification, enrichment and My OPSWAT so that a failure in any one of them is contained, retried and visible — never silent, never lossy.
  • Leveraging OPSWAT Agentic SDLC — use the Platform team's agentic coding platform as your primary means of production, own the quality and security of what ships, and document the system as you go so it stays knowable.

Keep HubSpot Running Through the Transition

  • Own the health of HubSpot's existing integrations until each one is retired: the SugarCRM sync through the Sugar Data Tool, Salesloft, the My OPSWAT feed (portal and Academy), 6sense enrichment, web forms and the Forms API.
  • Triage and resolve integration incidents across HubSpot and its neighbors — root-cause them, fix them permanently, and write down what happened.
  • Make safe, minimal changes in HubSpot when the business needs them, and hold the line against new workflow and list sediment that the migration would only have to unwind.
  • Build the Forms Gateway pull-forward so website capture decouples from HubSpot early, and run the interim enrollment connector that keeps Salesloft working through cutover.
  • Reconcile HubSpot and platform data continuously during the parallel run so drift is caught long before a cutover gate.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 6+ years building and operating production backend systems, with at least 3 in Python
  • Demonstrated, recent, daily practice building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode, Codex or similar). You can show us the workflow, the review and test loop, and something real that shipped through it.
  • Production support of a marketing automation platform's integrations — HubSpot strongly preferred; Marketo or Pardot considered — including its APIs, its data model, and its sync to a CRM. You have kept one of these healthy while other things changed around it.
  • Production experience with event-driven and durable-execution patterns: message queues, outboxes, idempotency keys, replay. Temporal or a comparable workflow engine strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on integration engineering against real vendor APIs — REST, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, rate limits, retries — built and operated, not configured through a wizard.
  • PostgreSQL to a strong level: schema design, JSONB, partitioning, migrations with Alembic, and query performance work you can describe.
  • Cloud deployment on Azure or AWS: containers, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, secrets management, observability.
  • Experience shipping LLM features into a product: structured outputs, evaluation discipline, confidence thresholds, fallbacks and guardrails — consuming a provided model gateway rather than building the infrastructure.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the skill to explain a technical trade-off to a marketing operations lead in their terms.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

  • SugarCRM logic hooks and REST API, or another CRM's server-side extension model; Salesforce Apex or triggers transferable.
  • Marketing technology domain knowledge: lead scoring and routing, consent and suppression, deliverability and ESP warm-up, campaign attribution.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java Especialista I - Lojas
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java Especialista I - Lojas based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to design, develop, and evolve software solutions using Java within a complex, high-scale technology environment. You will contribute to challenging technical initiatives while ensuring solutions remain aligned with broader product architecture and ecosystem needs. The position combines software development, legacy system modernization, automated testing, monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams, contributing technical expertise while helping remove obstacles and deliver value incrementally. A high degree of autonomy, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making will be essential to your success. You will also have opportunities to mentor less experienced developers and actively contribute to engineering quality and knowledge sharing. This is an impactful opportunity for a senior Java professional who enjoys solving complex problems in collaborative, agile environments.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop scalable software solutions for complex problems using Java, ensuring implementations are aligned with product architecture and the broader technology ecosystem.
  • Design and evolve applications while maintaining architectural integrity, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Perform corrective and evolutionary maintenance of legacy systems, identifying opportunities for modernization and continuous improvement.
  • Build and maintain automated tests using practices such as unit testing, TDD, and BDD to ensure high standards of software quality.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive technical feedback and promoting engineering best practices.
  • Create, adjust, and monitor operational alerts and monitoring solutions to improve system observability and reliability.
  • Take ownership of incidents and failures within the team's domain, using operational data to identify root causes and recommend stability improvements.
  • Support the creation of post-mortems and contribute to initiatives that prevent recurring incidents.
  • Make realistic delivery commitments and prioritize incremental value while maintaining technical quality.
  • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, risks, and delivery delays before escalation becomes necessary.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams through clear, concise, and audience-appropriate technical communication.
  • Support colleagues in overcoming technical challenges and completing team objectives.
  • Take ownership of personal development and actively manage an individual development plan through continuous feedback and learning.
  • Share technical knowledge and mentor developers at earlier career stages.

    • Requirements

    • Solid, proven professional experience with Java development.
    • Strong knowledge of designing, developing, consuming, and integrating REST APIs and microservices.
    • Practical experience with event-driven architecture and system integration.
    • Advanced debugging skills and the ability to analyze code performance and SQL query efficiency.
    • Structured knowledge of Git and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
    • Experience working with high-volume environments and applying security best practices in day-to-day development.
    • Ability to work with broad direction and a high level of autonomy.
    • Strong technical reasoning, communication, and ability to articulate and defend technical decisions.
    • Strong alignment with agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.
    • Experience with Python and/or Node.js is a plus.
    • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as New Relic and Grafana is a plus.
    • Knowledge of messaging technologies such as Kafka and integrations using Apigee is desirable.
    • Experience with serverless architectures and continuous deployment tools, particularly Azure DevOps, is advantageous.
    • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure environments such as AWS or Azure is desirable.
    • Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.
    • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership, collaboration, and a proactive approach to technical challenges.

title: Retail Backroom Coordinator
description:
TJ Maxx

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

The Opportunity: Grow Your Career

Responsible for executing receiving and merchandising standards while ensuring Associates are processing efficiently and effectively, and working as a team. Ensures an excellent customer experience by engaging and interacting with all customers, and maintaining a clean and organized store. Role models exceptional customer service.

  • Creates a positive internal and external customer experience
  • Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
  • Orchestrates truck delivery, prioritizing the processing of merchandise onto the sales floor
  • Trains and mentors Associates on merchandising and processing principles
  • Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
  • Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
  • Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
  • Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
  • Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
  • Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
  • Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
  • Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
  • Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
  • Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
  • Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
  • Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
  • Promotes credit and loyalty programs
  • Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
  • Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
  • Other duties as assigned

Who We’re Looking For: You.

  • Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
  • Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Capable of multi-tasking
  • Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
  • Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
  • Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Able to train others
  • 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience

Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care & cell phone discounts; pet & legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

title: [CLS] Senior Lastmile Management Specialist [L5] (Rocket Install Planning)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

CLS (Coupang Logistics Services)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다. CLS 는 국토교통부로 지정 받은 택배운송사업자로서 전국단위의 배송캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업전담인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다. 로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS 는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

직무 소개

Rocket A/S팀은 쿠팡에서 판매 된 가전,전자 제품의 구매 후 발생 될 수 있는 문제에 대해 신속하고 효과적으로 대응 하여 고객경험의 향상을 목표로 합니다. 전국 서비스 네트워크를 활용한 출장A/S와 전문인력을 통한 택배수리로 TV,냉장고,세탁기를 비롯한 대형가전과 생활가전,주방가전, 랩탑 등 다양한 가전제품을 대상으로 서비스를 확대하고 있습니다.

업무 내용

  • A/S 운영 전략 수립 및 실행방안 도출
  • 데이터 기반 지표 설계,성과 측정 및 서비스개선
  • A/S Process, Infra(Router/CAPA) 개선 및 최적화

자격 요건

  • 경력이 7년 이상 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 기반 인사이트 도출 및 비즈니스 문제 해결 경험 보유하신 분
  • 유관부서와 원활한 협업 및 논리적인 커뮤니케이션 역량 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • A/S관련 업무 경험 및 이해도 보유하신 분
  • 가전 제조/유통Biz관련 경험 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangls.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

title: Dayton OH - PA or NP for Endocrinology Practice
description:
Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) – Endocrinology & Diabetes Care | Skilled Nursing / Long-Term Care

Location: Dayton, OH area (on-site at skilled nursing and long-term care facilities) Compensation: $150,000 – $220,000 annually Specialty: Endocrinology | Diabetes Management | Geriatrics | Post-Acute Care

Elaya Health is a rapidly growing endocrinology practice specializing in high-quality care for patients in skilled nursing and long-term care facilities. We are seeking an experienced, compassionate Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant to join our expanding team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a provider seeking a high level of clinical autonomy, flexible scheduling, strong administrative support, and the chance to grow within an established and respected specialty group.

About the Role

Our providers deliver on-site endocrine care to residents of skilled nursing and long-term care facilities throughout the Dayton area. You will manage patients with diabetes, thyroid disease, and other common endocrine conditions while collaborating closely with facility nursing teams, primary care providers, and administration.

What You'll Do

  • Perform on-site patient evaluations and follow-up visits
  • Manage diabetes, thyroid disorders, and other common endocrine conditions
  • Review blood glucose trends, laboratory results, and medication regimens
  • Optimize diabetes management and help reduce unnecessary finger sticks and medication burden
  • Collaborate with nursing staff, DONs, facility leadership, and primary care teams
  • Provide clear clinical recommendations and ongoing follow-up
  • Document in facility EMRs (training and administrative support provided)
  • Help reduce avoidable hospitalizations through proactive specialty care

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation: $150,000 – $220,000 annually
  • Flexible scheduling — no traditional office-based patient panel
  • Strong clinical and administrative support
  • Training and ongoing guidance in our clinical protocols and workflows
  • Significant clinical autonomy
  • Clinical leadership from Medical Director Dr. Don Zwickler, an endocrinologist with decades of experience
  • Opportunities for advancement as Elaya Health continues to expand
  • The chance to work with a respected, rapidly growing specialty practice

Qualifications

  • Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) in Ohio, or willingness to obtain licensure
  • Experience in endocrinology, internal medicine, geriatrics, or skilled nursing preferred
  • Endocrinology experience is a plus — not required for the right candidate
  • Strong clinical judgment and communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a larger clinical team
  • Patient-centered and committed to high-quality care for the long-term care population

How to Apply

We would love to hear from you. Apply directly through this posting, or email your resume to contact@elayahealth.com for more information.

title: Associate Data Analyst
description:
Vortexa is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Analysis team, based in our Singapore office. This is a junior role, ideal for a recent graduate with strong analytical instincts or a candidate with up to two years’ experience.You will join a global team headquartered in London.

In this role, your core responsibilities will center on the quality and integrity of Vortexa’s proprietary datasets. You will also support internal and external data queries, including client-facing validation requests routed through our support function, and contribute to data quality initiatives raised by the Analyst team or other teams. You will learn and take ownership of our internal tools and processes to help maintain data excellence on a day-to-day basis, and over time help to develop and refine those tools and processes.

You will work closely with experienced data and market analysts across our global team, collaborating on data quality initiatives and presenting your findings. You will also work in close collaboration with our R&D team,helping to identify patterns of systematic data errors that can be escalated for longer-term engineering fixes. You will be encouraged to propose more systematic solutions to problems that are currently being addressed manually,leveraging scripting skills in Python and/or Excel and leveraging AI tools such as Claude to enhance the efficiency and quality of your work.

You must be highly analytical, detail-oriented and be genuinely curious about data. Motivated to investigate and understand why something looks wrong,not just flagging it. You need to be a driven self-starter capable of working independently as well as collaboratively depending on the task at hand, and comfortable operating as part of a small local team embedded within a larger global organisation. Above all, you must be inquisitive, patient, and persistent when it comes to solving challenging data problems.

title: Graphic Designer - Tempe
description:
Graphic Designer

Reports to: Chief Branding Officer
Department: Marketing
Location: 5210 S Priest Dr., Guadalupe, AZ 85283 (Tempe)
Pay Range: $20-22 per hour

Position Summary:

The Graphic Designer is responsible for conceptualizing, designing, and producing high-quality visual materials that support Mint Cannabis’s brand, marketing initiatives, and retail operations. This position plays a critical role in creating compliant, visually compelling, and on-brand designs across a variety of formats, including print, packaging, large-format signage, digital graphics, and photo/video assets.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, typeset, and lay out artwork using Adobe Creative Suite applications, including Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, and Premiere.
  • Develop creative concepts from briefs and bring them through to finalized, production-ready artwork.
  • Collaborate with internal departments and the Creative Director to ensure alignment with brand standards and marketing goals.
  • Create assets for packaging, retail displays, digital campaigns, laser engraving, and promotional materials.
  • Revise and refine creative based on stakeholder feedback, ensuring all versions meet quality and compliance standards.
  • Maintain organized project files and asset libraries for efficiency and consistency.
  • Manage multiple projects with varying timelines and priorities.
  • Utilize project management software (e.g., Asana or equivalent) to track progress and meet deadlines.
  • Support photo and video shoots as needed, including editing and basic content preparation.
  • Perform general office or departmental duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional graphic design experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Reliable transportation and consistent attendance.
  • Must be 21 years of age or older.

title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Overview
The Senior Project Controls Specialist is responsible for executing technical project control activities across multiple projects to ensure efficient, timely, and compliant delivery of work in accordance with Government and Plant directives. This role provides advanced technical aptitude, leadership, and integration across planning, scheduling, monitoring, configuration control, cost analysis, and performance reporting. The specialist ensures Project Managers have accurate and timely tools, data, and reporting mechanisms to validate project performance, budget adherence, and schedule compliance.

This position interacts extensively with internal stakeholders, external clients, and DOE/NNSA representatives, and plays a key role in supporting the organization’s strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

Project Controls Execution & Leadership

  • Plan, coordinate, and direct project control activities to meet the demands of the Project Management mission in alignment with organizational authority and responsibilities.
  • Provide integration and oversight for project planning, scheduling, configuration control, monitoring, analysis, and reporting across multiple scopes of varying size, complexity, and risk.
  • Support development, monitoring, and control of project scope, cost, schedule, and risk plans.
  • Utilize project control tools and systems to proactively manage, track, and report cost and schedule performance for concurrent projects.
  • Ensure Project Managers receive accurate, timely tools and data to confirm projects are on track, within budget, and compliant with all requirements.

Cost, Schedule, and Performance Management

  • Manage development of cost, schedule, and risk plans; collect performance data; track progress; perform variance analyses; and prepare forecast of estimate-to-complete.
  • Identify and track changes or potential changes to project scope; evaluate cost and schedule impacts, and ensure visibility with clients and PMs.
  • Integrate cost and schedule data with company accounting and management information systems to support performance and financial goals.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Interface with internal and external customers, including DOE, NNSA, and NPO representatives, ensuring project control outputs meet requirements and expectations.
  • Collect and analyze business inputs and ensure accurate distribution of resulting reports and documentation.
  • Support organizational vision and objectives by providing leadership, guidance, and high-level project controls insight.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, plus 10 or more years of relevant project controls experience.
  • Demonstrated 10–14 years of verifiable experience using Primavera P6 and performing project controls work.
  • Strong demonstrated knowledge of project control systems, Earned Value Management (EVM), and project management processes.
  • Proven ability to evaluate project issues logically and systematically and recommend effective solutions.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including reporting to customers and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work across all levels of an organization and engage effectively with external agencies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 25+ years of scheduling experience.
  • 15+ years of scheduling experience on DOE 413.3B projects, with strong understanding of DOE policies, procedures, and project control requirements.
  • Advanced competency in planning and schedule compliance, cost control, change management, and variance reporting.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, strong self-motivation, high professional standards, and ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, Primavera P6, SAP, WebEVM (CloudEVM), Empower, and other project controls systems.
  • Cross-functional experience in Project Management or Control Account Management for DOE projects, including management of multiple scopes and vendors.

As an Impairment Benefits Specialist, you’ll be responsible for proactively managing, assessing, and determining impairment benefit claims. You’ll navigate the requirements of the Accident Compensation Act 1985, the Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013, and WorkSafe guidelines, including the Online Claims Manual.

You’ll also manage disputes related to impairment benefits and ensure all actions are completed within legislative, policy, and performance timeframes. This role calls for strong attention to detail, confident decision-making, and a focus on achieving fair and timely outcomes for injured workers.

  • Experience with Victorian workers compensation disputation and litigation processes

  • Full understanding of the Accident Compensation Act 1985 (AC Act) and Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (WIRC Act)

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the American Medical Association’s Guides to the Evaluation of Permanent Impairment, fourth edition (AMA4) and any subsequent editions as required and its applicability/modification to impairment benefits claims based on Victorian worker compensation legislation

  • Companywide events to stay connected and celebrate success

title: Visiting Professor in Game Design and Game Studies/Ludology
description:
The School of Art, Design and Media (ADM) at Nanyang Technological University Singapore (NTU) invites applications for a one-year Visiting Professor position in Video Game Design and/or Game Studies and Ludology. ADM is part of the College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (COHASS).

This position is intended for eminent overseas academics-such as international prize recipients or distinguished scholars-whose presence will enhance the academic standing and creative output of the faculty. The primary responsibility of this role is teaching and academic mentorship; therefore, candidates should be able to demonstrate a strong teaching track record in a current or previous Professor academic level position.

We seek candidates with extensive expertise in Video Game Design, including specialized knowledge in areas such as game mechanics, level design, interactive narrative, player experience (UX), and emerging creative technologies. The appointed faculty will play a key role in supporting ADM's position as a leader in contemporary digital media and video game education in the region, bridging the gap between industry-standard practice and academic innovation.

Applicants must be confident navigating the rapidly evolving landscape of digital media and technology and demonstrate a strong commitment to teaching innovation and student mentorship. The role is teaching-focused; applicants should bring an established record of tertiary-level teaching experience and curricular engagement.

As a creative practitioner and educator with expertise in game design, ludology, or gaming theory, the candidate will demonstrate:

· A strong record in tertiary education (A terminal MFA (or its equivalent) or PhD degree in a relevant field is required), with the ability to guide student-led projects from concept to completion across video game development, game mechanics design, and interactive media.

· A recognized practice in video games or related fields, with an impactful portfolio showcasing innovation, storytelling, and design across emerging technologies such as real-time engines, AR/VR, or generative AI in game systems.

· Evidence of scholarly output in contemporary forums related to game studies, gaming theory, or creative computing, and a commitment to advancing the discipline through research or creative practice.

· A willingness to engage with cultural, ethical, and philosophical dimensions of gaming practice, and the ability to connect with fields like digital humanities, ludic studies, or social gaming platforms.

· A passion for education and the ability to foster a supportive, inclusive, and diverse learning environment, with strong interpersonal and organizational skills.

· National or international recognition by academia or industry, with a track record of leadership and contribution to the evolution of game design and gaming theory.

Requirements

Located in multi-cultural Singapore, the School of Art Design Media (ADM) in Nanyang Technological University (NTU) offers a studio-based education in a comprehensive university setting, providing students with the knowledge and skills needed to develop and produce groundbreaking creative works and scholarly activity. ADM also promotes Singapore’s creative culture and identity and is positioned to play a central role in the transformation of Singapore into a regional center of media and creativity.

Designed and taught by international faculty drawn from nearly 20 countries, the school offer4-year BFA programs in Design Art and Media Art, with an adaptive and evolving curriculum building upon excellence in our core disciplines of Animation, Film, Game, Photography, Interaction, Product Design, and Visual Communication, The programs are designed to meet the highest professional and academic standards worldwide and are responsive to student interests and evolving global needs. Post-graduate programs combine theory and practice, offering MA and PhD by research and a MA in Museum and Curatorial Practice. In 2026 ADM will start an innovative MSc Game Design Art & Technology, taught jointly with the College of Computer and Data Sciences (CCDS). ADM ranks amongst the top 5 art and design schools in Asia and top 20 worldwide (QS World University Rankings by subject 2025).

NTU is a research-intensive university, home to 33,000 undergraduate and postgraduate students in Engineering, Science, Humanities, Social Science, Business, Education and Medicine. Ranked amongst the world’s top 30 universities by QS,NTU has also been named amongst the world’s top young universities for the past7 years.

Further information about the University and the School can be viewed at the following websites:

NTU : www.ntu.edu.sg

ADM : www.ntu.edu.sg/adm

Application Procedure

Applicants are invited to submit their applications through the NTU career portal.

Please provide the following in your application:

1. Cover letter;

2. Curriculum vitae (including records of competitive grants and graduate supervision, significant creative works and scholarly publications; if applicable);

3. Teaching statement;

4. Research statement;

5. Creative portfolio

The closing date for applications is 24 June 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email.
