title: Director, Medical Affairs – Molecular Diagnostics
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

WORKING AT ABBOTT:

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

The Director, Medical Affairs – Molecular Diagnostics provides medical leadership for the development, regulatory approval, commercialization, and lifecycle management of Abbott Molecular's global diagnostic portfolio. The role serves as the medical expert in molecular diagnostics and laboratory medicine, partnering across multiple functions to ensure products are clinically relevant, scientifically robust, and compliant with global regulatory requirements.

The Medical Director contributes to product strategy, intended use and claims development, clinical evidence generation, regulatory submissions, reimbursement strategy, risk management, quality activities, and post-market surveillance. Through expertise in the clinical application of molecular diagnostic technologies and methods, the individual helps drive the development of innovative diagnostic solutions that improve patient care and support healthcare providers worldwide.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

  • Serve as the medical subject matter expert for Abbott Molecular's diagnostic portfolio.
  • Provide medical and scientific leadership across Abbott Molecular's diagnostic portfolio by evaluating emerging clinical evidence, diagnostic technologies, biomarkers, disease management trends, and evolving standards of care that inform product strategy, development, regulatory approval, commercialization, and post-market activities.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define clinical use cases, target patient populations, specimen requirements, intended use claims, clinical utility, clinical differentiation, and evidence strategies supporting product development and commercialization.
  • Lead the development and review of Intended Use statements, clinical claims, and supporting evidence to ensure products are clinically meaningful, scientifically supported, reimbursable, and aligned with regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to the development and review of User Needs, CRDs, PRDs, IFUs, labeling, and other product development documentation.
  • Ensure that product designs, performance claims, and intended use statements are medically appropriate, scientifically supported, and clinically meaningful.
  • Provide medical leadership for clinical evidence generation activities, including study design, performance evaluation strategies, endpoint selection, clinical claims development, product labeling, and evidence plans to support product development, regulatory submissions, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Review and provide medical oversight of clinical, scientific, and regulatory documentation supporting product development, performance evaluation, and global regulatory submissions.
  • Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs and Clinical Affairs to support global regulatory submissions and interactions with health authorities, including FDA, IVDR requirements, and interactions with global regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with the Market Access team to support reimbursement strategies, including engagement with CMS, MACs, commercial payers, and other healthcare stakeholders. Provide medical leadership for evidence generation and assessment to support coding, coverage, and payment and patient access to Abbott Molecular's diagnostic solutions.
  • Participate in risk management activities throughout the product lifecycle, including hazard analyses, benefit-risk assessments, Risk Management Files, and FMEAs.
  • Provide medical assessment of product performance issues, design changes, complaints, adverse events, field actions, and emerging safety signals, including authoring and reviewing HHAs, participating in CAPA investigations, supporting root cause analyses, evaluating potential patient impact, and recommending appropriate risk mitigation activities.
  • Provide medical oversight for post-market surveillance activities, including the review of complaint trends, safety information, scientific literature, real-world performance data, and the development of medical assessments and reports supporting product lifecycle management and regulatory compliance.
  • Support regulatory inspections, quality audits, health authority responses, and other compliance-related activities as required.

Medical Expertise and Problem-Solving:

  • Apply expertise in molecular diagnostics, laboratory medicine, and disease biology to support product development, regulatory, reimbursement and lifecycle management decisions.
  • Exercise sound judgment in balancing clinical, technical, regulatory, quality, and business considerations.

Leadership Activities:

  • Collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams and business leaders through medical expertise, scientific credibility, and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Effectively communicate complex medical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Foster alignment among stakeholders with differing clinical, technical, regulatory, quality, and commercial perspectives.
  • Demonstrate the highest standards of integrity, ethics, and professional judgment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MD degree or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of industry experience in IVD, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device organizations, with demonstrated leadership in product development, clinical affairs, medical affairs, regulatory affairs, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in molecular diagnostics, laboratory medicine, and the clinical application of molecular technologies.
  • Experience supporting diagnostic product development, regulatory submissions, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Experience reviewing and interpreting clinical and scientific evidence supporting diagnostic claims and regulatory submissions.
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements applicable to IVD products, including FDA and IVDR regulations.
  • Knowledge of healthcare reimbursement, coding, coverage, and payment processes relevant to molecular diagnostics and IVD products including experience supporting interactions with CMS, MACs, and commercial payers.
  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and the ability to influence, collaborate with, and build trust across highly matrixed organizations.
  • Influence global portfolio strategy by integrating clinical practice insights, scientific evidence, market needs, and regulatory requirements to advance innovative molecular diagnostic solutions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Residency in Pathology is highly preferred.
  • Fellowship training in Molecular Genetic Pathology or a related subspecialty.
  • Experience in one or more clinical areas relevant to Abbott Molecular's portfolio, including infectious diseases, transplant diagnostics, women's health, oncology, or precision medicine.

APPLY NOW:

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Skip is building the fastest, most intelligent home loan platform in Australia - and we increasingly run on data: credit performance, acquisition economics, settlements and servicing, and the numbers our board, warehouse funders and regulators rely on. This is our first dedicated data hire. The job is to turn raw, ingested data from a wide array of sources into trusted, decision-ready answers - and to build the modelling discipline so those numbers stay trustworthy as we scale many times over.

About the role

We’re hiring the person who, faced with a new business question, instinctively asks: how do we model this once, test it, and make it self-serve? - and then builds the clean, tested data models and shared definitions that make the answer obvious to everyone - whether querying and interpreting from a dashboard or from an agent chat. A founding generalist who is genuinely disciplined at modelling and a strong, business-literate communicator and the founding owner of a function we expect to grow - you may build and lead the data team that follows.

You will own three parts that most companies split across two or three people:

  • The ingestion layer - the pipelines that land raw data from our source systems into Snowflake reliably and on time, so everything downstream is built on complete, fresh data.

  • The model layer - the transformation, dimensional modelling, testing and documentation that turn raw Snowflake data into clean, reconciled, business-ready tables (dbt-style: staging → intermediate → marts).

  • The analysis - partnering with all teams and Execs to answer the questions that actually move the business, and turning the numbers into decisions.

The thread connecting them is the same: make the trusted number the easy number. You measure your success not by how many dashboards are shipped, but by how many decisions get made confidently on numbers people trust.

The opportunity

We are a small, high-talent-density team scaling our business with technology. The companies that win this phase keep their teams small and their leverage high. Data is usually where that breaks: trust erodes, every team defines metrics differently, and answering a simple question turns into a week of reconciliation. The opportunity here is to prove the opposite - that one excellent person, building the right models and definitions early, can give the whole business trusted, self-serve answers while the team stays lean.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the data stack end to end - from ingesting raw source data into Snowflake through to the clean, reconciled, business-ready models the whole company relies on (the loan book, arrears, originations and the acquisition funnel).

  • Model for trust: the right grain, keys and structure so marts are business-ready and reconcile across all reporting levels — with testing and version control as the default, not an afterthought.

  • Establish and own metric definitions and a data dictionary - so numbers mean the same thing in credit, finance and the board pack.

  • Build the core dashboards and reporting the business runs on - high-signal views people actually use - and own board, warehouse-facility and regulator-facing reporting so the numbers we report externally are trustworthy and defensible.

  • Build toward a single source of truth and governed self-service, so the data function scales without becoming a bottleneck as request volume grows.

  • Partner with Growth, Credit, Ops, Finance and Treasury - clarifying vague questions and ending with a concrete recommendation, not just a chart, and pushing back when a request is wrong.

  • Use AI and technology to move fast on the mechanical work while owning the judgement and verification that keeps the numbers honest.

What you will bring

We’re looking for senior capability, expressed as autonomy and breadth more than years — but as a guide, this typically looks like 5+ years across analytics engineering, data analysis or BI, with the seniority to own outcomes end-to-end and set standards from scratch.

  • You have owned a production data stack - the pipelines feeding the warehouse and a tested, documented, version-controlled model layer on top - not just “used dbt” once.

  • Strong, demonstrable business-facing analysis - you have good instincts about which insights matter, can manage stakeholders and metric definitions, and reliably turn numbers into decisions.

  • You think in definitions and trust - your instinct on seeing inconsistent numbers is to model and define them once, not to patch another query.

  • You use AI deliberately and verify it - you wield agents to move fast on the mechanical work and own the verification that keeps outputs honest.

  • You communicate trade-offs clearly, make pragmatic calls about what is fit-for-stage versus over-engineered, and are happy being the founding owner who sets the standard others build on.

Our stack today (a starting point - you’ll shape where it goes): Fivetran for ingestion, Snowflake as the warehouse, and Hex for reporting.

On requirements: we care far more about skills, approach and the ability to learn than about specific certifications or a particular industry background. If you have strong modelling discipline and genuine business instinct, we want to hear from you - even if your résumé doesn’t tick every box above. But we won’t relax on git and testing fundamentals.

Why Join us

  • Build the data function, don't maintain one. This is the first dedicated data hire - you're not inheriting a tangle of broken pipelines and conflicting metrics, you're defining how Skip models, defines and trusts its numbers from scratch. Real founding ownership, not a delegated slice.

  • Own the numbers the whole company runs on. From ingestion through to the board pack, warehouse-funder and regulator reporting - you sit at the centre of credit, growth, finance and exec, turning vague questions into decisions. Few roles give one person this much leverage over how a business actually thinks.

  • A path to build and lead a team. We're hiring one excellent founding owner today - but as request volume and the business scale, the opportunity to grow this into a data team you lead, or to deepen as the principal who sets the standard, will be explicitly on the table.

  • Competitive comp and ESOP. We pay competitively and back it with equity that reflects the founding nature of this role. As Skip scales many times over, you share in the upside you help build.

  • Work at the frontier of data and AI. Full support from an internal product and engineering team, a modern stack you'll shape (Fivetran, Snowflake, Hex), and a mandate to wield AI on the mechanical work while you own the judgement that keeps numbers honest. This is analytics engineering for the modern era, not hand-built spreadsheets and reconciliation weeks.

  • Serious company, serious scale, real impact. Backed by leading US venture funds and global credit partners Skip is in a true hyper-growth phase - loan book scaling rapidly, major distribution partnerships live. Your work helps hard-working Australians Skip to home ownership sooner, on a team that moves fast and backs each other to do the best work of our careers.

title: Producer-in-Residence (multiple locations)
description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

TEGNA’s Producer-in-Residence (PIR) program is the largest and most successful producer development program in the country. PIR is redefining what it means to be a journalist in a live streaming age. Far from a legacy media role, today’s producers are cutting-edge storytellers, using innovative tools — including streaming. social media and AI-powered systems — to deliver impactful journalism that meets audiences where they are. We’re hiring the top 70 journalism students graduating between December 2026 and June 2027 to join our award-winning team.

Who We’re Looking For:

  • Strong writers passionate about impactful, ethical journalism in a multiplatform world
  • News junkies with sharp editorial judgment
  • Innovators ready to harness emerging tools like AI and streaming systems while upholding journalism values
  • Courageous candidates who embrace change and use tech to elevate — not diminish — our reporting
  • Future newsroom leaders eager to grow; several former PIRs have already been promoted to management roles
  • Journalists active in campus media, especially streaming
  • Candidates who thrive under pressure and want to deliver trustworthy live coverage

This Program is Not For:

  • On-camera reporters (look for “Multi-Skilled Journalist” roles instead)
  • Field-only journalists — this is a newsroom-based role
  • Aspiring filmmakers, marketers, influencers, or activists
  • Anyone not committed to objective, ethical journalism that presents all sides of a story

Why This Role Matters:

Producing isn’t yesterday’s job. It’s the newsroom’s most future-focused role. At TEGNA, producers drive how stories come alive on streaming, digital, and social platforms — powered by the latest tools. It’s a cutting-edge position at the center of innovation and community impact.

The Process:
We receive hundreds of applications and select a small group for interviews and a timed writing assessments. Top candidates are matched with a newsroom in one of 40+ TEGNA markets.

What to Expect:

  • Full-time, two-year contract (not an internship or fellowship)
  • Start date: June 21, 2027 (Jan.11, 2027 start date available for small group of selected 2026 grads)
  • Onboarding, a weeklong, in-person producer bootcamp with top TEGNA journalists, and hands-on newsroom training
  • Ongoing support from mentors and monthly training sessions
  • Career path toward promotion into permanent producer or management roles (80%+ of PIRs are promoted)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce content across streaming, digital and social platforms
  • Innovate and pitch original story ideas
  • Collaborate and adapt in a fast-paced content creation environment

Requirements:

  • BA/BS in journalism or related field
  • Experience producing original journalism-oriented content for campus platforms
  • Strong social media skills focused on hard news
  • Prior internships or news media experience preferred
  • Familiarity with ENPS, CUEZ, Edius or similar programs is a plus

Pay Range
$20—$24.04 USD

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

title: Commercial Counsel
location: San Francisco, CA (Preferred) OR Remote (Americas, UTC-3 to UTC-10)
description:
Commercial Counsel

You'll run a large share of Firecrawl's day-to-day commercial contracting. Enterprise deals, data-licensing agreements, vendor paper, partnership terms: you'll draft them, negotiate them, and get them closed. This is not a role where you review other people's paper and send back comments. You'll be across the table from counterparties yourself, sitting next to sales and BD while deals are live, and you'll help build the templates and playbooks that let the company move faster without taking on risk it shouldn't.

You'll work alongside the Senior Commercial & Product Counsel and report to the General Counsel on a legal team that's being built from scratch. The questions here are genuinely novel: who owns AI-generated output, what data access is permissioned and by whom, how liability works for infrastructure that other AI companies build on. Very few lawyers this early in their career get real reps on them.

Salary Range: $251,000–$272,000/year plus eligibility for up to $50,000 in semi-annual performance bonuses, totaling up to $100,000 annually. (Range shown is for U.S.-based employees in San Francisco, CA. Compensation is adjusted fairly based on your location's cost of living.)

Equity Range: Competitive equity - details shared during the process.

Location: San Francisco, CA (Preferred); Open to Remote (US, UTC-5 to UTC-10)

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 3–8 years of commercial, technology, or product counseling experience

Visa: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We're not able to sponsor visas right now, though that may change down the line.

About Firecrawl

Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data - the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 175k+ GitHub stars, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves - no hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web.

What You'll Do

  • Draft and negotiate enterprise customer agreements, data-licensing deals, vendor contracts, NDAs, and partnership agreements

  • Be the legal partner sales and BD actually want in the room, not the one they route around

  • Advise on data rights, privacy, confidentiality, security, IP, indemnification, and limitations of liability

  • Work with product and engineering on data access and AI questions as they come up in deals

  • Help build and maintain the templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and approval thresholds that keep deals moving without a lawyer in every loop

  • Support the compliance programs and company policies the legal team is standing up

  • Spot the matters that need the GC, senior counsel, or outside counsel, and escalate them early and cleanly

  • Pick up whatever else the company needs legally as we grow, because early legal teams don't get to have narrow scopes

What We're Looking For

  • You've negotiated real technology agreements. Not reviewed them. Negotiated them, across the table, with a counterparty's counsel pushing back, and you've held the positions that mattered and conceded the ones that didn't.

  • You can carry a deal on your own. You don't need someone to structure the negotiation for you or check every redline before it goes out. You take a matter and bring it to signature.

  • You know exactly when to escalate. This role has real autonomy and that only works if you're good at telling routine from novel, and you flag the novel one early rather than after it's a problem.

  • You give business advice, not legal cover. Our teams need a recommendation and a risk read they can act on, not a memo listing every possible exposure. If your default answer is no, this will be frustrating for both of us.

  • You work well with non-lawyers. Most of your internal clients are engineers and salespeople. They'll trust you if you're fast, clear, and unpretentious.

  • You're an AI super user. Non-negotiable. You should already be using AI heavily in your own practice, and you should want to push it further than anyone has taken it in this profession. We'll give you room to try things that don't have a precedent.

  • Membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar. Preferred: a J.D. from a T14 law school or comparable academic credentials, and prior experience at an Am Law 100 firm or a comparably sophisticated firm. Exposure to data licensing, privacy, IP, or data-access issues is a plus.

What We're NOT Looking For

  • A lawyer who runs commercial legal as a gatekeeping function and measures success by deals slowed down

  • Someone who needs a fully staffed team, a CLM platform, and defined process before they can be effective

  • A pure litigator or generalist looking to pivot into commercial work on the job

  • Someone who wants to stay in a specialty lane. This team is four people and the work is whatever comes in

A Note On Pace

We operate at an absurd level of urgency because the window for what we're building won't stay open forever. If that excites you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings, but this role probably isn't for you.

If you're a strong lawyer looking for an interesting escape from BigLaw, this is the one. It won't be boring, and you'll build skills at the absolute frontier of AI and the legal profession.

Benefits & Perks

Available to all employees

  • Salary that makes sense — $251,000–$272,000/year plus eligibility for up to $50,000 in semiannual performance bonuses, totaling up to $100,000 annually, based on impact, not tenure

  • Own a piece — Gain competitive equity in what you're helping build

  • Generous PTO — 15 days mandatory, anything after 24 days, just ask (holidays excluded); take the time you need to recharge

  • Parental leave — 12 weeks fully paid, for all parents

  • Wellness stipend — $100/month for the gym, therapy, massages, or whatever keeps you human

  • Learning & Development — Expense up to $1,000/year toward anything that helps you grow professionally

  • Team offsites — A change of scenery, minus the trust falls

  • Sabbatical — 3 paid months off after 4 years, do something fun and new

Available to US-based full-time employees

  • Full coverage, no red tape — Medical, dental, and vision (100% for employees, 50% for spouse/kids) — no weird loopholes, just care that works

  • Life & Disability insurance — Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance — coverage for life's curveballs

  • Supplemental options — Optional accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and voluntary life insurance for extra peace of mind

  • Doctegrity telehealth — Talk to a doctor from your couch

  • 401(k) plan — Retirement might be a ways off, but future-you will thank you

  • Pre-tax benefits — Access to FSAs and commuter benefits (US-only) to help your wallet out a bit

  • Pet insurance — Because fur babies are family too

Available to SF-based employees

  • SF HQ perks — Snacks, drinks, team lunches, intense ping pong, and peak startup energy

  • E-Bike transportation — A loaner electric bike to get you around the city, on us

Interview Process

Application Review — send us your resume and a short note on why this excites you. Tell us about a deal you owned, what you fought for, and what you gave up.

Intro Chat (~25 min) — a quick conversation to get to know each other before we go deep. What you've been working on, what drew you to Firecrawl, and what you're looking for. Time for your questions too.

Case Chat (~45 min) — we'll work through a real problem from our world, a data-licensing structure or an enterprise redline where the standard position doesn't fit, and talk through how you'd approach it. Come ready to think out loud. We care how you reason, not whether you know the market term.

Redline Exercise (paid, ~90 min): one scoped, realistic document. You mark it up and give us a short read on the two or three issues you'd actually escalate.

Founder Chat (~25 min) — Culture, pace, ownership, and how you like to work. Time for your questions too.

Decision — We move fast

If you want real ownership of commercial legal work at the infrastructure layer of AI, before anyone has written the playbook, you should join us.

👉 Apply now.

title: Queue Specialist
description:
FORTNA partners with the world’s leading brands to transform omnichannel and parcel distribution operations. Known world-wide for enabling companies to keep pace with digital disruption and growth objectives, we design and deliver solutions, powered by intelligent software, to optimize fast, accurate and cost-effective order fulfillment and last mile delivery. Our people, innovative approach and proprietary algorithms and tools ensure optimal operations design and material and information flow. We deliver exceptional value every day to our customers with comprehensive services and products including network strategy, distribution center operational design and implementation, material handling automated equipment, robotics and a comprehensive suite of lifecycle services.

At FORTNA, we believe in fostering a workplace that isn't just a job but a movement – a collective effort to redefine success and transform challenges into opportunities. "Join the Movement" encapsulates our commitment to a workplace culture that thrives on collaboration, celebrates diversity, and empowers every individual to contribute to something greater than themselves. Our Team. Our Passion. Our Approach.

Position Summary

The QueueSpecialistis an individual contributor responsible for the day-to-day performance of the support ticket queue within the Customer Service organization. The role maintains visibility into queue health, service-level performance, workload distribution, case quality, and timely routing and escalation across all priorities.

The QueueSpecialstmonitors real-time and interval ticket performance, coordinates workload adjustments with support leaders and technical teams, and drives follow-up when ticket service levels are at risk. The role partners with Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, and leadership to improve routing, accelerate ticket progression, and prevent backlogs from stagnating.

This position has no direct reports. Success depends on strong operational judgment, data analysis, clear communication, and the ability to influence timely action across teams without formal people-management authority.

Key Responsibilities

1. Queue Performance & Operational Coverage

  • Monitor ticket queue performance throughout the day and identify emergingservice-level, capacity, and coverage risks.

  • Coordinate with support leaders and technical teams to rebalance workload, adjust routing, and address volume spikes, absences, and major incidents.

  • Track staffing coverage and agent availability against demand and promptly communicate gaps or schedule risks to the appropriate leaders.

  • Maintain queue operating procedures, prioritization rules, routing standards, escalation paths, and customer communication requirements.

  • Drive follow-up on unassigned, aging, stalled, or at-risk work until ownership and next actions are confirmed.

  • Provide real-time operational guidance and recommendations without direct supervisory or performance-management responsibility.

2. Ticket Queue Management & Case Progression

  • Maintain operational visibility into ticket volume, unassigned work, backlog, aging, severity mix, assignment status, SLA performance, and customer update compliance.

  • Prioritize P1/P2 incidents, aging P3/P4 tickets, stalled cases, repeat contacts, reopened tickets, and work at risk of breaching service commitments.

  • Coordinate ticket assignment and rebalancing based on priority, skill, workload, geography, customer impact, and coverage.

  • Review tickets for complete issue details, business impact, troubleshooting history, evidence, ownership, status, and next-update commitments.

  • Conduct daily queue reviews and coordinate corrective action when progress, documentation, ownership, or customer communication does not meet standards.

  • Identify and help resolve assignment gaps, duplicate tickets, routing errors, workflow failures, and other barriers to timely case progression.

3. Escalation, Communication & Operational Coordination

  • Serve as the operational coordination point for queue risk, ownership gaps, priority questions, and cross-functional follow-up.

  • Ensure urgent and high-impact issues are escalated promptly to Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, or leadership using defined criteria.

  • Apply warm-handoff standards covering priority, impact, symptoms, timeline, diagnostics, evidence,current status, customer expectations, and next action.

  • Provide concise operational reporting on ticket backlog, SLA risk, coverage, escalations, and major service events.

  • Monitor customer update commitments and coordinate follow-up when communications are overdue or incomplete.

  • Represent queue operations in service reviews, post-incident reviews, and improvement initiatives as requested.

4. Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor compliance with ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation requirements, documentation standards, and audit expectations.

  • Track and report measures such as first-contact resolution, ticket response time, backlog aging, reopen rate, update compliance, quality scores, and customer satisfaction.

  • Analyze demand trends, repeat contacts, misrouted tickets, escalation delays, knowledge gaps, and capacity constraints to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Maintain queue dashboards, operating procedures, routing guidance, and reporting materials.

  • Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with process owners, technical teams, and stakeholders and track improvements through measurable outcomes.

  • Recommend tools, automation, routing, workflow, self-service, and coverage improvements that increase responsiveness and customer experience.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of service desk, technical support, call center, or ticket operations experience.

  • Demonstrated experience monitoring or coordinating high-volume ticket queues in a 24x7 or extended-hours support environment.

  • Experience with real-time queue monitoring, workload balancing, ticket assignment, SLA tracking, and escalation coordination.

  • Strong knowledge of incident prioritization, ticket lifecycle management, routing, documentation, escalation, and customer communication.

  • Ability to interpret ticket and operational metrics, identify trends and service risks, and recommend corrective actions.

  • Experience using case-management, reporting, and knowledge-management platforms.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence action across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to make timely operational decisions during high-volume periods and critical incidents.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to support nights, weekends, holidays, and non-traditional schedules as operational needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years leading technical support teams or queue management.

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • ITIL, HDI, contact-center, or workforce-management certification.

  • Experience with enterprise telephony, automatic call distribution, or workforce-management platforms.

  • Experience supporting business-critical, technical, or industrial environments.

  • Experience improving queue performance through workflow automation, skill-based routing, self-service, analytics, or knowledge-centered support practices.

title: HV/ MV Electrical Lead Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres)
description:
You will work on complex HV and MV electrical infrastructures at the heart of mission critical and data centre projects worldwide. This role offers real technical ownership, exposure to high-impact projects and the opportunity to shape reliable, future-proof power systems together with leading experts.

What will you do as HV/ MV Lead Electrical Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres)

You act as the client side HV/ MV electrical engineer on mission critical and data centre projects, with a strong focus on substation design, grid connections and technical governance. You support clients from early feasibility through design development and delivery, ensuring that electrical infrastructure solutions are robust, compliant and future-ready.

Key Activities Include

  • Defining HV and MV system concepts and substation design strategies from an owner engineer perspective;
  • Developing and reviewing HV substation layouts, including primary equipment selection, system architectures, protection strategies and earthing philosophies;
  • Proposing system optimisations to clients to improve reliability, increase future flexibility, reduce cost or shorten time-to-market in line with their decision drivers;
  • Leading and interpreting electrical studies to support grid connection and design decisions;
  • Managing technical interfaces with utilities, clients and delivery partners and reviewing contractor designs and technical submissions to safeguard quality, compliance and performance.

Where you will work

At Haskoning, you will join an independent, employee-owned international consultancy that combines engineering, design, and consultancy services with software and technology. Our mission, "Enhancing Society Together," drives us to create a positive impact on the world.

We offer purpose-driven and challenging work in diverse international projects, leveraging our 140+ years of expertise. With over 6,800 employees in more than 25 countries, we work together to turn challenges into opportunities and make a real impact on society. We collaborate with leading clients in markets such as infrastructure, climate resilience, renewable energy, decarbonisation of industry, and sustainable mobility.

As our new HV/ MV Electrical Lead Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres) you will become part of our Global Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) team.

Our global MCF team provides multidisciplinary consultancy services to datacentre clients, including colocation datacentres, internet service providers, and telecom companies. The team is diverse, with expertise in areas like electrical and mechanical engineering, construction, architecture, fire safety, control engineering, and security technology. Together, this knowledge is used to develop integrated designs for Data Centres. You will be part of a dedicated, passionate team that is globally recognized as one of the best in Data Centre design and engineering. Curious about our work? Here you will find examples of some our projects.

The role will be based in our Nijmegen office. As our team is located throughout the EU, travel between offices may be required to meet the project demands. The role may also require occasional travel to client offices/ project sites both in the EU and overseas.

What you bring

You are able to take ownership of complex technical scopes and act confidently in a client facing, advisory role. You communicate clearly, structure complex information effectively and work comfortably across disciplines, organisations and cultural contexts.

In Addition, You Possess The Following

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline, required to provide the technical depth needed for HV and MV system and substation design;
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in HV and MV electrical engineering within European projects, needed to independently lead client side, owner engineer and substation related scopes;
  • Proven experience with client-side substation design and grid connections, essential for managing utility interfaces and safeguarding technical quality from the client perspective;
  • Experience with electrical power system studies and review of contractor designs, required to assess risks, validate solutions and support sound decision making;
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken, necessary for effective collaboration with international clients, utilities and multidisciplinary project teams.

What you can expect from us

  • A solid foundation: A competitive base salary (€ 5.564 – € 7.948, based on experience and skills) with annual increases;
  • An attractive compensation package: Including a strong pension scheme with an 18.3% employer contribution, a 2.15% personal budget, and annual profit sharing. You will also have the opportunity to purchase company shares and share in our success;
  • Work-life balance: 28 vacation days (based on full-time employment), with the option to purchase an additional 16.5 days per year and to exchange three public holidays for days that are personally meaningful to you. We work in a hybrid model with flexible hours, home office allowance, and a fully equipped home workspace.
  • Development opportunities: A wide range of training and development programs, including tailored learning paths, learning weeks, and various knowledge-sharing groups.
  • Travel allowance: A conveniently located workplace at our office in Nijmegen, with travel expense reimbursement and an NS Business Card. If you walk or bike to work, you will receive a higher travel allowance—encouraging sustainable commuting.
  • Informal and inclusive culture: A welcoming and open environment with voluntary social and sports activities, and employee networks such as Pride and Young Haskoning.

Do you have any questions about the role or the process? You can contact Devika Jagmohan, Recruiter Industry & Buildings, at devika.jagmohan@haskoning.com.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer

    • Strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex infrastructure issues.
    • Ability to take ownership of systems from design through deployment, operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve and engineers are trusted to make decisions independently.
    • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

title: Corporate Biller
description:
Skilled Nursing Facility Billing & A/R Specialist
Location: OhioJob Type: Full-TimeDepartment: Revenue Cycle / Billing
About the Position
We are looking for an experienced Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) Billing & A/R Specialist to join our Revenue Cycle team. This position will be responsible for accurate and timely billing, account follow-up, and resolution of outstanding accounts receivable for our skilled nursing facilities.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with SNF billing and A/R follow-up, understands Ohio Medicaid and managed care billing, and is comfortable working independently while communicating closely with facility and billing teams.
Key Responsibilities

Complete monthly billing for skilled nursing facility residents
Submit Medicare, Medicaid, Managed Care, commercial insurance, and private-pay claims
Review claims for accuracy and completeness prior to submission
Monitor claims and follow up on unpaid or denied claims
Work outstanding A/R by payer and aging category
Research and resolve claim denials, rejections, underpayments, and payment issues
Follow up with insurance companies and Medicaid managed care plans regarding outstanding claims
Review and resolve eligibility, authorization, coordination of benefits (COB), and other billing issues
Identify trends and recurring billing issues and communicate them to management
Maintain detailed and accurate account notes and follow-up documentation
Work with facility Business Office Managers and other departments to obtain information needed to resolve accounts
Review payer payments and identify potential underpayments or incorrect reimbursement
Submit appeals, reconsiderations, and medical record requests as needed
Maintain assigned A/R within established goals and follow-up timelines
Assist with other Revenue Cycle projects and duties as assigned

Qualifications

2+ years of healthcare billing and A/R experience preferred
Skilled Nursing Facility billing experience strongly preferred
Knowledge of Medicare, Ohio Medicaid, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance
Experience working denials and unpaid claims
Strong understanding of insurance eligibility and coordination of benefits
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple accounts and deadlines
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and comfortable digging into an account to find out why it has not been paid. The right candidate will take ownership of their A/R, communicate issues early, and consistently follow accounts through to resolution.
This is a great opportunity for someone who understands that successful billing is more than submitting a claim—it’s about getting the claim paid and bringing the A/R back to the facility.
Perks & Benefits

Health, dental, vision, disability & life insurance (subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements)
Career advancement opportunities
401(k) with company match through Fidelity
Daily Pay: Get up to 50% of your earnings the next day

Healthcare is a calling—and we’re here to help you answer it.Ready to nourish lives and grow your career?

title: Graduate Real Estate
description:
QIC Real Estate is the real estate investment and management business of QIC, one of Australia's leading institutional investment managers. Together, we are committed to creating long-term value for clients, communities and future generations through expertise spanning real estate investment, development, asset management, capital markets and funds management. Our portfolio includes some of Australia's most recognised retail and mixed-use destinations, where innovative thinking and exceptional people drive sustainable outcomes and enduring value.

About the Role

As part of QIC Real Estate's Graduate Program, you'll gain exposure to our Development and Asset Management, Capital Markets, Funds Management and Analytics teams through structured three-month rotations designed to build your understanding of the full real estate investment lifecycle.

During your first year, you'll gain practical experience across key areas of the business, contributing to major projects that support investment strategy, capital transactions, portfolio management, asset performance, development projects and data-driven decision making. This exposure will provide a holistic understanding of the real estate investment lifecycle and the way value is created and delivered for our investors and clients.

Working alongside experienced industry professionals, you'll contribute to project planning and delivery, financial analysis, stakeholder engagement, portfolio performance initiatives and strategic decision-making. You'll develop a broad understanding of how development and asset management work together to deliver long-term outcomes for investors, customers and communities.

The rotational structure provides a unique opportunity to experience multiple distinct career paths while building relationships with experts across the business. You'll learn from industry leaders who are passionate about sharing their knowledge, investing in your development and supporting your long-term career growth.

As a graduate, you'll join QIC's Graduate Program and benefit from structured development, mentoring, hands-on experience and exposure to senior leaders across the business.

About You

We're seeking motivated, collaborative and commercially minded individuals who are passionate about real estate and eager to build a career in the property investment industry.

You may be:

  • In your final year of study and graduating in 2026; or
  • A recent graduate seeking to commence a career in property, development, asset management or funds management.

You'll be studying, or have recently completed, a degree in:

  • Property Economics
  • Property Development
  • Commerce
  • Finance
  • Economics
  • Or a related discipline

You'll also bring:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  • A genuine interest in property, real estate investment and development.
  • Commercial curiosity and a desire to understand how value is created across the property lifecycle.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Initiative, adaptability and a willingness to learn.
  • Strong organisational and project coordination skills.

.

The three-month rotations make every stage of the program different and engaging, providing exposure to a variety of projects, teams and challenges. You'll work alongside highly experienced professionals who are leaders in their field and genuinely invested in helping graduates build successful long-term careers in real estate

About the Teams:

Development

QIC Real Estate's Development team is responsible for creating, transforming and enhancing places that deliver long-term value for investors, customers and communities. The team works across a diverse range of retail, mixed-use, commercial and urban regeneration projects, overseeing developments from concept through to delivery.

Asset Management

QIC Real Estate's Asset Management team is responsible for maximising the performance and value of a diverse retail property portfolio across QLD, NSW and VIC. Working closely with investment, leasing, development, finance and operational teams, Asset Managers develop and implement strategies that enhance asset performance, improve customer experiences and deliver long-term investment outcomes for QIC’s clients.

Together, these teams provide graduates with a unique opportunity to gain exposure to both the creation of places and the ongoing management of institutional real estate assets.

Capital Markets

Our Capital Markets team is responsible for sourcing, structuring and executing transactions that support the growth and performance of QIC Real Estate's portfolio. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the team provides exposure to acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, capital raising and investment strategy, helping shape some of Australia's most significant real estate investments.

Funds Management

The Funds Management team oversees the performance and strategic direction of QIC Real Estate's investment funds and mandates. The team works closely with investors and investment professionals to deliver strong outcomes through portfolio construction, fund strategy, financial management, investor reporting and stakeholder engagement.

Data Analytics

Our Real Estate analytics team provides the insights that support investment, portfolio and capital management decisions across the real estate platform. You will maintain and develop financial models, analyse asset and portfolio performance, support investor queries and reporting, undertake benchmark analysis. You will gain exposure to budgeting, forecasting, capital management, and performance measurement, while developing strong technical skills in financial modelling, data analysis and reporting.

Our Culture

At QIC Real Estate, graduates are treated as valued members of the team from day one. You'll be given meaningful work, encouraged to contribute ideas and supported by experienced professionals committed to helping you build a successful career. Many of our graduates have progressed into permanent roles across asset management, development, investment and broader real estate functions, demonstrating our commitment to developing future industry leaders.

During your first year you can expect:

Development Rotation

  • Assist with development feasibility analysis and project evaluations.
  • Support project planning, design coordination and development approvals processes.
  • Contribute to development reporting, presentations and project documentation.
  • Assist with procurement, contract administration and financial tracking.
  • Participate in meetings with consultants, tenants, contractors and project stakeholders.

Asset Management Rotation

  • Support the analysis of asset performance, business plans and portfolio strategies.
  • Assist with budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting activities.
  • Gain exposure to the quarterly valuation process.
  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to support asset initiatives.
  • Collaborate with leasing, operations, marketing and development teams.
  • Help prepare investment papers, presentations and asset performance reporting.
  • Develop an understanding of how institutional property portfolios are managed to deliver long-term value.

Capital Markets Rotation

  • Support financial analysis and due diligence for potential acquisitions, divestments and joint venture opportunities.
  • Conduct market research on real estate sectors, assets, pricing benchmarks, investor activity and broader capital markets trends.
  • Assist with the preparation of transaction materials, including investment papers, presentations, process updates and supporting analysis.
  • Assist with data room management, document review and tracking of due diligence requests throughout transaction processes.
  • Prepare briefing notes and analysis to support investment strategy, asset sale processes and capital partnering initiatives.
  • Help coordinate transaction workstreams with internal teams, advisers, valuers, legal counsel and other external stakeholders.
  • Opportunity to participate in discussions and engagement with existing and prospective investors, gaining exposure to investor communications and relationship management.
  • Gain exposure to how major real estate transactions are originated, assessed, structured and executed within an institutional investment platform.

Funds Management Rotation

  • Support the preparation and execution of fund business plans, connecting portfolio priorities, capital requirements and expected investment outcomes.
  • Analyse fund and portfolio performance against budgets, forecasts and benchmarks, identifying the factors driving returns and emerging risks.
  • Assist with investor reporting, presentations and queries, translating financial and operating results into clear explanations linking strategy and performance.
  • Contribute to portfolio construction and capital-allocation analysis, assessing how acquisitions, disposals and asset investment may affect the fund’s risk and return profile.
  • Support capital management work, including analysis of liquidity, debt, interest rate hedging and future funding needs.
  • Help prepare fund governance papers and decision materials, bringing together investment analysis, portfolio performance and strategy.
  • Work with Asset Management and Analytics teams to understand how asset-level decisions flow through to fund performance and investor outcomes.
  • Work with Capital Markets team on fundraising and product development, including investor materials, market analysis and the assessment of new investment structures aligned with investor demand.

Data Analytics Rotation

  • Analyse asset, portfolio and fund-level financial and operating performance against budgets, forecasts and benchmarks.
  • Support the preparation of investor, client and management reporting packs.
  • Assist with capital management analysis, including debt, liquidity and interest rate hedging reporting.
  • Develop financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate investment, leasing and capital expenditure decisions.
  • Prepare data visualisations, dashboards and insights to support decision-making.
  • Contribute to annual business planning, forecasting and budget processes.
  • Assist with performance benchmarking using internal and external data sources.
  • Support data quality, reporting automation and continuous improvement initiatives across the real estate platform

This is an opportunity to launch your career with one of Australia's leading institutional investment managers while gaining exposure to some of the country's most significant real estate assets and projects. If you're curious, commercially minded and ready to learn from industry leaders, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Data Engineer (PostgreSQL DBA)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Engineer (PostgreSQL DBA) based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical database infrastructure within a data-driven, international environment. You will focus heavily on PostgreSQL administration, performance optimization, security, reliability, and scalability across core data systems. Beyond hands-on DBA responsibilities, you will translate business needs into actionable data engineering priorities and help ensure technical solutions support broader organizational objectives. You will collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders while guiding the team on database, reporting, and data management best practices. The position also places a strong emphasis on modern AI and automation, using emerging tools to improve database operations, testing, reliability, and software delivery. It is an ideal opportunity for a senior data professional who combines deep technical expertise with leadership, communication, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Accountabilities:

  • Administer, maintain, and optimize PostgreSQL databases, with additional responsibility for SQL Server and Oracle environments, ensuring strong performance, availability, scalability, and security.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, partitions, and related structures to support efficient queries, growing data volumes, and long-term scalability.
  • Monitor database health and performance, identify bottlenecks, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement query and infrastructure optimizations.
  • Manage database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes to support operational resilience and business continuity.
  • Implement and maintain database security practices, including access controls, encryption, auditing, and other measures designed to protect sensitive data.
  • Ensure database environments comply with applicable data governance requirements, internal security policies, and relevant industry standards.
  • Participate in daily standups, prioritize technical work, and align engineering activities with evolving business needs and organizational priorities.
  • Translate business requirements into well-defined data engineering and database administration tasks, helping the team focus effort where it delivers the greatest business value.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data solutions and Power BI-related initiatives are technically sound and aligned with business objectives.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members while promoting best practices across database management, reporting, data quality, and operational processes.
  • Apply modern AI models and developer tools to improve PostgreSQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, testing, and operational runbook automation.
  • Use AI-assisted approaches to generate test scenarios, expand regression coverage, identify edge cases, and improve the efficiency of engineering workflows.
  • Build practical automation that reduces repetitive manual work while maintaining appropriate standards for quality, security, reliability, and auditability.
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, select appropriate models and tools for specific tasks, and apply secure approaches when working with sensitive or business-critical data.
  • Identify opportunities for measurable efficiency gains, including faster delivery cycles, improved system stability, reduced operational effort, and greater predictability across engineering activities.

    • Requirements

    • Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL database administration, particularly performance tuning, optimization, security, monitoring, backup, and recovery.
    • Experience administering or supporting additional relational database technologies such as SQL Server and Oracle.
    • Strong understanding of database architecture, schema design, indexing, partitioning, query optimization, availability, and scalability.
    • Practical experience with database monitoring, troubleshooting, disaster recovery planning, and operational reliability.
    • Solid knowledge of database security principles, including access management, encryption, auditing, governance, and protection of sensitive information.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with exceptional attention to detail and a structured approach to diagnosing technical issues.
    • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated ability to prioritize workloads, manage competing requirements, and align technical execution with business objectives.
    • Leadership and mentoring capabilities, with the confidence to guide team members and establish effective data management and engineering practices.
    • Experience translating business requirements into actionable technical tasks and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
    • Familiarity with Power BI and data reporting environments is beneficial, although direct Power BI development is not required.
    • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling, with the ability to apply AI to software delivery, database operations, and engineering productivity.
    • Experience using AI for PostgreSQL performance tuning, reliability validation, migration planning, operational automation, and testing workflows.
    • Ability to create automation that delivers measurable improvements while preserving quality, security, and auditability.
    • Sound judgment when evaluating AI-generated outputs, including the ability to select suitable tools and apply secure patterns when handling sensitive data.
    • Demonstrated track record of using automation or AI to improve efficiency, stability, delivery speed, or operational predictability.
    • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours while based in Brazil.
    • Ability to provide a resume in English.

      • Benefits

      • Remote opportunity for candidates based in Brazil.
      • Work schedule aligned with U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours.
      • Opportunity to work in an international, data-driven environment.
      • Senior-level ownership of critical database infrastructure and data engineering initiatives.
      • Opportunity to work extensively with PostgreSQL and additional enterprise database technologies.
      • Exposure to modern AI models, automation, and emerging developer tools applied to real-world engineering challenges.
      • Opportunity to influence database reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
      • Collaboration with cross-functional teams and international stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to mentor colleagues and contribute to data engineering best practices.
      • Professional growth through work spanning database administration, data engineering, business alignment, AI, and automation.

title: Business Acquisition Specialist
description:
About Us

CIC Insurance Group is a leading insurance and financial services organisation with more than five decades of experience helping individuals, families, and organizations achieve financial security.
We have grown into a dynamic Group offering life, general, micro insurance, asset management, and investment solutions, with operations in Kenya, Uganda, South Sudan, and Malawi, and are listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange.
Our tagline, “We Keep Our Word,” reflects our unwavering commitment to integrity, transparency, and delivering on our promises to our clients, partners, and communities.
CIC Group is passionate about innovation, digital transformation, and inclusive insurance solutions that meet the evolving needs of cooperatives, SMEs, corporates, and individuals. By joining us, you will be part of a team that is shaping the future of financial protection across Africa.

About the Role
Reporting to the Underwriting Manager, the role will support the acquisition and onboarding of Group Life business by preparing accurate quotations in line with approved pricing requirements, completing KYC/AML checks, setting up scheme records and ensuring complete handover to the Underwriting Manager.

Key Responsibilities
  • Receive and review quotation requests to confirm that the required member data, benefits and supporting information have been provided.
  • Prepare Group Life quotations accurately and within the agreed turnaround times.
  • Ensure quotations comply with approved products, rates, pricing tools, underwriting guidelines and authority limits.
  • Verify quotation calculations, benefits, commissions, taxes and other applicable charges before release.
  • Escalate non-standard benefits, pricing exceptions and complex risks to the relevant underwriter or manager.
  • Register and track quotation requests, revisions, outcomes and conversion status.
  • Review onboarding documents, including accepted quotations, proposal forms, member schedules, premium evidence and intermediary documents.
  • Perform KYC, AML and sanctions screening and escalate incomplete or adverse findings.
  • Follow up on outstanding onboarding requirements before the scheme is handed over for underwriting.
  • Create the scheme folder in SharePoint and upload all required documents using the approved naming and filing standards.
  • Prepare a complete onboarding pack and hand over the scheme to the Underwriting Manager for allocation.
  • Prepare reports on quotations, turnaround times, conversion rates, production, acquisition pipeline, onboarding status and KYC/AML compliance.
  • Maintain accurate records of pending quotations, incomplete onboarding requirements and ageing items.
  • Support process improvement, quotation automation and enhancement of acquisition and onboarding controls.
  • Ensure confidentiality of member, salary, pricing and other sensitive information.
Who We’re Looking For
Essential Knowledge/Skills and Experience Required:
  • Degree in actuarial Science, BCOM Insurance, Statistics or a business related degree
  • Progress in Diploma in Insurance
  • 4 years’ relevant work experience in Group Life Underwriting or similar role
  • Good knowledge of group underwriting
  • Analytical skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Technology oriented with interest in emerging technologies like AI and ML
  • Exceptional Interpersonal skills
Why Join Us?
Joining CIC Insurance Group as a Business Acquisition Specialist offers an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in converting business opportunities into sustainable growth within the Group Life business. You will be at the heart of the acquisition journey, managing quotation preparation, client onboarding, KYC/AML compliance, and seamless handover to underwriting while ensuring accuracy, speed, and a strong customer experience. The role provides valuable exposure to Group Life products, pricing, underwriting processes, intermediary relationships, and acquisition analytics, while also offering opportunities to contribute to automation and continuous process improvement. If you are commercially minded, detail-oriented, and energized by delivering high-quality solutions within demanding turnaround times, CIC provides a dynamic platform to develop your expertise and make a direct contribution to business growth and customer value.

If you have the aforementioned professional and academic qualifications and you are ready to execute the above mandate, strictly apply through: clearly indicating the position being applied for.

The application should reach us by close of business on 11th September, 2026. Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us by 30th September 2026 consider your application unsuccessful.

CIC Group is an equal opportunity employer and does not solicit or require any form of payment for employment opportunities.

N/B: This job advert is open to both internal and external candidates.

title: Dog Sitter
description:
Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— Arlington, VA Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

This is a flexible, part-time independent contractor position where all jobs are voluntary and you set your availability and service area, and we match you with clients. It’s a great fit if you want meaningful, independent work caring for dogs and cats, helping pet parents travel with peace of mind, and building trust with repeat clients.

What You’ll Do

Pet sitting visits may include:

  • Feeding and refreshing water
  • Cleaning up waste
  • Giving playtime, affection, or companionship based on each pet's personality
  • Sending visit updates and photos through our app
  • Following each client’s detailed care instructions
  • Bringing in mail or packages
  • Adjusting lights, blinds, or trash/recycling when requested
  • Administering medication when within your experience and comfort level
Most visits take place while clients are traveling, so weekend, holiday, morning, afternoon, and evening availability is especially valuable.

Service Types

  • Walks: 30-90 minutes (1-3x daily)
  • Drop-ins: 30 / 45 / 60 minutes (1–3x daily)
  • Extended daytime visits: 2-8 hours
  • Overnights: 10-12 hour stays
  • 24-hour care: live-in with overnight care

What We Look For

  • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented
  • Strong written communication
  • Comfortable working independently in clients’ homes
  • Smartphone with reliable internet & camera
  • Medication experience (oral, injections, fluids)
  • Holiday & weekend availability

Pay + Perks

  • Sitters are paid per visit, with rates typically starting around $25 per 30 minute visit, with higher pay for longer visits, overnight care, house sitting.
  • Weekly direct deposit
  • Bonus opportunities (holidays, short notice, strong feedback)
  • 100% of tips go to you
