title: Senior Data Engineer BI
description:
Bij NS ga je als Senior Data Engineer BI aan de slag binnen Datateam Knoop, een Scrum Team binnen het cluster Knoop & Service, gericht op het optimaliseren van knoopprocessen binnen de operatie. In onze Microsoft Azure cloudomgeving speel je een belangrijke rol: zowel in het vertalen van businesswensen naar concrete producten als in het bouwen van BI-oplossingen.

Dit ga je doen

Datateam Knoop is een Scrum Team binnen het cluster Knoop & Service van de NS, gericht op het optimaliseren van knoopprocessen binnen de operatie. We maken slim gebruik van data om datagestuurde beslissingen te ondersteunen en onze 4J-doelstellingen te behalen: het juiste materieel, op het juiste moment, op de juiste plek en met de juiste kwaliteit voor de reiziger.

We ontwikkelen en leveren informatieproducten, zoals dashboards en rapportages, die door verschillende teams binnen de operatie worden gebruikt. Daarnaast ontsluiten en verwerken we databronnen en leveren we analyses en adviezen die direct invloed hebben op de knoopprocessen en de operationele prestaties.

Onze belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:
  • Het ontsluiten en integreren van databronnen voor verdere analyses en het ontwikkelen van rapportages;
  • Het leveren van data-gedreven adviezen aan diverse afdelingen en teams binnen de operatie;
  • Het analyseren van processen en het identificeren van verbeterpunten in de operatie.

In onze Microsoft Azure cloudomgeving speel je een belangrijke rol: zowel in het vertalen van businesswensen naar concrete producten als in het bouwen van BI-oplossingen. Je werkt veel samen met collega’s in de keten binnen je team, de afdeling en de business. Je bent een schakel in het bouw- en deliveryproces waarbinnen informatie- en dataproducten worden gerealiseerd van ontwikkeling tot productie. Je biedt oplossingen en zorgt voor verbeteringen.

Je bent kritisch en neemt de gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid voor de sprintresultaten. Ligt een discipline buiten jouw expertisegebied? Geen probleem, ook die pak je op. Je teamgenoten rekenen op jouw ondersteuning en jij helpt andere teamleden zelf-organiserend te worden. Feedback geef je gevraagd en ongevraagd, en krijg jij feedback, dan zie je dat als een kans om te groeien. Je bent communicatief, flexibel, snel van begrip en kan goed omgaan met deadlines en tijdsdruk.

Wat je doet als Senior Data Engineer BI:
  • Het ontsluiten van nieuwe databronnen;
  • Het opwerken van de ontsloten data via raw en business data vault naar datamarts;
  • Het ontwerpen en realiseren van een effectief DWH, inclusief data pipelines van bron tot eindgebruiker;
  • Zorgen voor robuuste codekwaliteit met relevante controles op dataprocessing en datakwaliteit;
  • Ondersteuning bieden bij het ontwikkelen van Power BI dashboards en het opstellen van specificaties;
  • Je zorgt voor goede inproductiename met een geteste en gedocumenteerde oplossing;
  • Actief meewerken aan testen en signaleren van datakwaliteitsissues;
  • Documenteren van metadata en andere relevante beschrijvingen;
  • Samen bouwen aan de Microsoft Cloud-omgeving binnen een multidisciplinair team;
  • Delen van kennis en coachen van collega’s binnen het team en DIA;
  • Maken van datamodellen en analyseren van brondata;
  • Verstoringen adequaat afhandelen en stakeholders informeren.

Hier ga je werken

We bundelen als Data, Innovatie & Analyse onze krachten en zijn met ruim 200 collega’s. Bij DIA werkt een mix van ervaringen en persoonlijkheden, die elkaar graag opzoeken om met elkaar te sparren en kennis te delen. De afdeling geeft (interne) gebruikers snel en betrouwbaar inzicht om tot juiste acties te komen door het verzamelen, combineren, analyseren en presenteren van informatie.

Binnen het cluster Knoop en Service ga je werken binnen Datateam Knoop. Het team bestaat uit business analisten, data engineers, informatie analist, Power BI specialisten, Scrummaster en Product Owner. De focus van het team ligt op het optimaliseren van de knoopprocessen in de operatie van NS. Door slim gebruik te maken van data draag je bij aan de doelstellingen van het team. Dit doen we door het leveren van adviezen, data-analyses, rapportages en dashboards aan diverse teams binnen het cluster en in de operatie die direct invloed hebben op de 4J-doelstellingen en knoopprocessen.

Dit zijn de eisen

Om de functie van Senior Data Engineer BI succesvol uit te voeren beschik je onder andere over:

  • Minimaal een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding;
  • Minimaal 7 jaar recente ervaring op gebied van Data Engineering;
  • Ervaring in soortgelijke organisaties als NS (minimaal 5000 plus werkplekken);
  • Ervaring met data-analyse en DWH/BI-ontwikkelprocessen;
  • Ervaring met Snowflake, Python en SQL;
  • Ervaring met data-integratie, deployment automation en versiebeheer (git);
  • Ervaring met het opstellen van dimensionele datamodellen is een pre;
  • Ervaring met Agile/scrum-methodiek;
  • Sterke mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands, waarbij je je weg vindt in zowel de taal van de business als die van de techniek;
  • Proactieve houding in continue verbetering en innovatie binnen BI-processen;
  • (Basis)kennis van wet- en regelgeving, zoals AVG (Data Compliancy), is een pre;
  • Ervaring met of kennis van enterprise-architectuurframeworks zoals TOGAF en tools zoals Enterprise Architect om datastromen en architectuur beter te begrijpen en te documenteren is een pre;
  • Kennis van Data Vault 2 is een pre.

Op NS kun je rekenen

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. De kernwaarden van NS zijn open en betrouwbaar. Wij gaan voor resultaat en willen vooruit.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja, Suvelan asukaspuisto
description:
Etsimme Suvelan asukaspuistoon positiivista, tasapainoista ja oma-aloitteista varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajaa vakituiseen tehtävään. Suvelan asukaspuisto tarjoaa kohtaamispaikan, jossa toiminnan kohderyhminä ovat koululaiset, vauvaperheet ja muut lapsiperheet.

Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajana
- tuet lasten ja perheiden turvallista, osallistavaa ja kehittävää arkea
- kohtaat asiakasperheitä ja lapsia erilaisissa tilanteissa
- toimit aktiivisesti osallisena asukaspuiston toiminnan suunnittelussa ja toteutuksessa
- annat asiakkaille tilaa toimia ja olla osallisina, hyödynnät hyviä itsesi johtamisen taitoja
- työskentelet myös 2-5-vuotiaiden lasten kerhossa, jossa toteutat toimintaa yhdessä toisen lastenhoitajan kanssa lasten ikä- ja kehitystason mukaisesti

Tarjoamme sinulle yhteisöllisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön. Sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja tuoda omia vahvuuksiasi näkyväksi. Asukaskaspuistossa yhdenvertaisuus ja monimuotoisuus ovat tärkeitä arvoja.
Työaika on 25 h/viikko ja sijoittuu pääsääntöisesti klo 8-13 välille.

Tervetuloa joukkoomme!

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Suvelan asukaspuisto, Kirstintie 24, 02760 Espoo
Työaika: 25 h/viikko.
Tehtävä on vakituinen 5.10.2026 alkaen.

Otamme huomioon kaikki hakuaikana tulleet hakemukset. Voimme käsitellä hakemuksia ja aloittaa haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Valinta tehdään hakuajan päätyttyä sen jälkeen, kun haastattelut on saatu päätökseen.

Tämä työpaikka on esteetön.


Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018, 28 § asetus 753/2018 3 § ja 4 §) mukainen kelpoisuus.

Tehtävään soveltuva kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perustutkinto, sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto tai muu vastaava tutkinto, joihin sisältyy tai joita olet täydentänyt riittävän laajoilla lasten hoidon, kasvatuksen ja opetuksen tutkinnonosilla. Esim. lastenhoitaja, päivähoitaja ja lähihoitaja (lasten ja nuorten hoidon ja kasvatuksen koulutusohjelma).

Edellytämme sensitiivistä, vuorovaikutuksellista ja kehittävää työotetta sekä valmiutta työskennellä monen ikäisten lasten parissa. Edellytämme hyviä tiimityötaitoja, joustavuutta ja innokkuutta työhön.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.
Tartuntatautilaki velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen.

Arvostamme ja etsimme lastenhoitajaa, joka:
- on positiivinen ammattilainen, jolla on kehittävä, oma-aloitteinen ja aktiivinen ote työhön
- on rohkea erilaisissa ja yllättävissäkin asiakastilanteissa ja uskaltaa olla esillä
- on valmis kohtaamaan monen ikäisiä lapsia ja erilaisia perheitä yksilöllisesti ja sensitiivisesti
- hallitsee itsensä johtamisen taidot ja osaa antaa asiakkaille tilaa
- on musikaalinen

Tervetuloa joukkoomme kasvattamaan vastuullista ja välittävää uutta sukupolvea!

Espoo on edelläkävijöiden kaupunki. Työnantajalupauksemme - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää - näkyy arjessamme sujuvana työnä, osaamisen pitkäjänteisenä kehittämisenä ja fiksuna johtamisena. Rakennamme yhdessä kaupunkia, jossa työn merkitys on selkeä ja asiantuntijuutta arvostetaan.

Tuemme ammatillista oppimistasi ja kehittymistäsi sekä työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista joustavilla käytännöillä.

title: Ahupua'a Experience Ambassadors
description:
Location: On-Site - Kaneohe, HI.
Relocation Package: None
Schedule: Full-time; open availability including weekends and holidays is required.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Ahupuaʻa Experience Facilitator is responsible for leading engaging, age-appropriate educational tours and hands-on activities for Kualoa’s Education Department. This role works directly with keiki and students from Pre-K through 12th grade, as well as adult groups, delivering lessons that integrate Kualoa’s ranch history, Hawaiian culture and language, and ʻāina-based (place-based) education.
This position supports curriculum delivery and continuous program improvement, and also contributes to the daily care and upkeep of the education campus through landscape work, loʻi (taro patch) maintenance, ʻāina restoration, and animal husbandry.

This position requires successful completion of a background check due to working closely with minors.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead educational tours and activities tailored to specific age and grade levels, with a focus on Hawaiian culture, language, sustainability, and environmental learning
Facilitate hands-on learning experiences such as Hawaiian crafts (ex: lei making, hana noeau, etc.)
Support curriculum research, evaluation, facilitation, and ongoing improvement of educational content
Help maintain and care for the education campus, including landscape work, loʻi care, ʻāina restoration, and animal care
Foster a positive, safe, and engaging learning environment for participants of all ages, especially youth groups

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge of Hawaiian culture, language, sustainability, and environmental awareness
Strong communication skills with a positive and professional attitude
High school diploma or equivalent required
Minimum two (2) years of experience working with children and/or adults in an educational or facilitation setting
Experience in group facilitation, curriculum development, lesson planning, and team-building across various age groups preferred
Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record
Must be able to successfully pass a background check

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Ability to sit or stand for extended periods
Ability to lift up to 50 lbs
Ability to swim and/or stand in water
Physical ability to perform duties related to animal care, landscape maintenance, farming, and canoe paddling
Physical capability to hike uphill/downhill slopes

title: Cabin Crew - Universal Assessment Package - DEMO
description:

title: Dog Sitter
description:
Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— Tampa, FL Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

This is a flexible, part-time independent contractor position where all jobs are voluntary and you set your availability and service area, and we match you with clients. It’s a great fit if you want meaningful, independent work caring for dogs and cats, helping pet parents travel with peace of mind, and building trust with repeat clients.

What You’ll Do

Pet sitting visits may include:

  • Feeding and refreshing water
  • Cleaning up waste
  • Giving playtime, affection, or companionship based on each pet's personality
  • Sending visit updates and photos through our app
  • Following each client’s detailed care instructions
  • Bringing in mail or packages
  • Adjusting lights, blinds, or trash/recycling when requested
  • Administering medication when within your experience and comfort level
Most visits take place while clients are traveling, so weekend, holiday, morning, afternoon, and evening availability is especially valuable.

Service Types

  • Walks: 30-90 minutes (1-3x daily)
  • Drop-ins: 30 / 45 / 60 minutes (1–3x daily)
  • Extended daytime visits: 2-8 hours
  • Overnights: 10-12 hour stays
  • 24-hour care: live-in with overnight care

What We Look For

  • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented
  • Strong written communication
  • Comfortable working independently in clients’ homes
  • Smartphone with reliable internet & camera
  • Medication experience (oral, injections, fluids)
  • Holiday & weekend availability

Pay + Perks

  • Sitters are paid per visit, with rates typically starting around $25 per 30 minute visit, with higher pay for longer visits, overnight care, house sitting.
  • Weekly direct deposit
  • Bonus opportunities (holidays, short notice, strong feedback)
  • 100% of tips go to you

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

Notes:

  • Apply to one location only
  • No phone calls (we contact strong matches)

title: Guest Relations Agent
description:
Live Your Passion. Add Your Magic.

At Montage International, we are doing something different, something exciting and it takes passionate people to bring our vision to life. We have built a culture that leads with the important notion we live by every day; do what you love. If this resonates with you, we look forward to receiving your application.

We welcome applicants with disabilities and provide reasonable accommodations as needed to our applicants. Please discuss with our hiring managers during our selection processes.

If you are an internal applicant, please log into Workday and apply for your application to be considered.

Please Click Here to apply internally.

Guest Relations Agent

POSITION SUMMARY

The Guest Relations Agent serves as a central point of contact for guests and colleagues at Pendry Park City. The role combines the responsibilities of the traditional PBX Operator, Restaurant Reservationist and In-Room Dining Order Taker positions into one centralized guest service and communications role. The position is designed to provide guests with a seamless, one-stop experience while supporting multiple hotel departments from a single communications center.

Rather than simply transferring calls to another department, the Agent will assist the guest whenever possible, enter and dispatch service requests, coordinate with the appropriate department, and follow requests through completion.

The Agent must maintain a strong working knowledge of the entire hotel, including Rooms, Housekeeping, Engineering, Food & Beverage, Spa, Transportation, Resort Operations and local Park City information.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Guest Communications & PBX

  • Answer all internal and external telephone calls in accordance with Pendry service standards.
  • Assist callers directly whenever possible rather than automatically transferring calls.
  • Provide accurate information regarding hotel services, restaurants, hours of operation, amenities, events and resort activities.
  • Monitor and respond to guest communications through approved hotel text messaging, email and digital communication platforms.
  • Handle guest messages, wake-up calls and other traditional PBX responsibilities.
  • Maintain knowledge of hotel emergency procedures and properly coordinate emergency communications when required.

Guest Request Management & Dispatch

  • Serve as the central dispatch point for guest requests throughout the hotel.
  • Enter and track guest requests through the hotel's service request management system.
  • Dispatch requests to Housekeeping, Engineering, Bell/Door, Front Office, Food & Beverage and other departments as appropriate.
  • Monitor open requests and follow up when requests are not completed within established service standards.
  • Escalate delayed or unresolved requests to the appropriate manager.
  • Take ownership of the guest's request through completion rather than simply transferring responsibility to another department.
  • Follow up with guests when appropriate to confirm the request has been completed satisfactorily.

In-Room Dining

  • Answer In-Room Dining telephone calls and take guest orders.
  • Maintain complete knowledge of current In-Room Dining menus, hours of operation, pricing and available offerings.
  • Accurately enter orders into the appropriate ordering/POS system.
  • Identify and properly communicate food allergies and dietary restrictions in accordance with Pendry Park City procedures.
  • Use suggestive selling and menu knowledge to assist guests with their selections.
  • Communicate special requests and timing requirements to the In-Room Dining and Culinary teams.
  • Assist guests with questions regarding existing orders and coordinate follow-up when necessary.

Restaurant & Food and Beverage Reservations

  • Serve as the primary reservation contact for all Pendry Park City Food & Beverage outlets.
  • Make, modify and cancel restaurant reservations for all hotel-operated Food & Beverage outlets.
  • Maintain complete knowledge of outlet hours, menus, reservation policies, seating options and seasonal operations.
  • Accurately enter reservations and guest information into the hotel's approved restaurant reservation systems.
  • Capture relevant guest information, preferences, special occasions and dietary restrictions within the reservation.
  • Assist guests in selecting the most appropriate restaurant and reservation time based on their needs.
  • Manage reservation inquiries from both hotel guests and outside guests.
  • Communicate special requests and important reservation information to outlet management and host teams.
  • Identify large parties, private dining requests, group inquiries and special events and route them to the appropriate Food & Beverage or Catering contact.
  • Maintain current knowledge of KITA, Après Pendry, Dos Olas, Pool House and all seasonal Food & Beverage operations.
  • Provide information regarding special dining experiences, holiday programming and Food & Beverage events.

Housekeeping & Engineering Dispatch

  • Receive and enter requests for additional linens, towels, toiletries, housekeeping service and guest room amenities.
  • Dispatch Housekeeping requests and monitor completion.
  • Receive and document guest room maintenance concerns.
  • Create and dispatch Engineering work orders through the appropriate system.
  • Properly prioritize urgent issues involving guest safety, water, heating, electrical systems or other significant room deficiencies.
  • Follow up on unresolved requests and escalate when necessary.

Concierge Support & Resort Information

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Pendry Park City facilities, services and operating hours.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of Canyons Village and Park City, including restaurants, transportation, skiing, shopping, activities and local attractions.
  • Support the Concierge team with guest requests and straightforward bookings.
  • Assist with outside restaurant reservations, activity reservations, transportation arrangements and other simple guest bookings when appropriate.
  • Receive requests from the Concierge team and complete the necessary legwork to fulfill them, including contacting vendors, confirming availability, making reservations and documenting confirmation details.
  • Communicate completed booking information and any relevant details back to the Concierge team or directly to the guest as appropriate.
  • Follow up on outstanding requests and maintain ownership until the booking is confirmed or additional Concierge assistance is required.
  • Maintain accurate records of reservations, confirmation numbers, cancellation policies and other important booking information.
  • Provide basic concierge-style assistance directly to guests when the request can be handled efficiently by the Guest Services & Communications Agent.
  • Recognize requests requiring personalized itinerary planning, extensive research, VIP handling or specialized local knowledge and refer those requests to the Concierge team.
  • Work closely with Concierge during periods of high guest request volume to help ensure requests are completed accurately and in a timely manner.

The intent of this support is to allow the Concierge team to focus on personalized guest interaction, complex requests and itinerary planning while the Guest Services & Communications Agent assists with the administrative work and execution of straightforward guest bookings.

OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain detailed knowledge of daily hotel operations, including occupancy, groups, VIPs, events, outlet hours and operational changes.
  • Review daily communications and shift information at the beginning of each shift.
  • Maintain accurate guest profiles, preferences and request history when appropriate.
  • Communicate relevant guest information to operational departments.
  • Maintain confidentiality of guest information at all times.
  • Participate in pre-shift meetings and hotel training as required.
  • Maintain a clean, organized and professional communications workspace.

SERVICE EXPECTATIONS

The Guest Services & Communications Agent is expected to function as a problem solver rather than a call transfer operator.

Receive the Request → Own the Request → Dispatch the Request → Track the Request → Confirm Completion

The goal is to reduce the number of times a guest must contact the hotel or repeat a request while creating one consistent point of communication between the guest and hotel operations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Previous luxury hotel, Front Office, PBX, Reservations, Concierge, In-Room Dining or guest service experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional while managing multiple requests simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with multiple hotel technology systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to learn Food & Beverage menus and accurately take In-Room Dining orders.
  • Ability to learn and effectively manage restaurant reservation systems and policies.
  • Strong knowledge of Pendry Park City and the Park City area or willingness to develop that knowledge.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends and holidays based on hotel business levels.
  • Ability to exercise good judgment and recognize when a guest request requires management involvement.

TECHNOLOGY & SYSTEMS

The position will be expected to become proficient in the systems utilized by Pendry Park City for:

  • PBX and telephone communications
  • Property Management System
  • Guest request and dispatch management
  • Guest text messaging and digital communications
  • In-Room Dining/POS order entry
  • Restaurant reservations
  • Hotel email and internal communications

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

  • Speed of answer and response
  • Accuracy of information provided to guests
  • Guest request completion times
  • Percentage of requests resolved without unnecessary call transfers
  • Accuracy of In-Room Dining orders
  • Accuracy of restaurant reservations and guest information
  • Proper documentation and dispatch of guest requests
  • Effective communication between departments
  • Adherence to Pendry and Forbes service standards

title: Facility Foreman
description:

The Facility Foreman is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of one or more departments within the facility. This position serves as a first-line leader, ensuring employees follow Clean Harbors’ Health & Safety, operational, and compliance standards. The Facility Foreman also provides employee training and guidance, maintains accurate operational records, and supports hands-on facility operations when needed.

  • Promote and enforce all Health & Safety, operational, and compliance standards.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.

description:
Comfort starts with our 10,000+ team members across the globe, who are transforming the power of comfort every day. Our employees have the power to change lives, in our homes, work and communities.   • Assist with the design of domestic water, sanitary waste and vent, storm drainage, fuel gas, medical gas, fire sprinkler, and specialty plumbing systems.

  • Participate in interdisciplinary coordination with mechanical, electrical, structural, architectural, and civil teams.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification obtained or ability to obtain certification within six months of hire.
  • Strong interest in thermal and fluid systems and building engineering.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Internship, co-op, or professional experience in MEP consulting, construction, or building systems design.
  • Familiarity with Revit, AutoCAD, or other building design software.
  • Exposure to plumbing design principles, construction documents, and engineering calculations.
  • Knowledge of applicable codes and standards such as IPC, UPC, NFPA, FGI Guidelines, or ASPE standards.
  • Interest in pursuing Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.

What We Offer

  • Mentorship from experienced plumbing engineers and licensed professionals.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Analytics Engineer

Kingston-on-Thames (4 Days in Office, 1 Day from home)

37.5 hours per week

About The Business

Crew Clothing Company is a British lifestyle brand operating across four brands — Crew Clothing, Pringle of Scotland, Saltrock and Ben Sherman — with 120+ stores, a growing digital channel and an omnichannel customer experience. We are in the middle of a significant technology transformation: a new eCommerce platform, a new third-party logistics partner, and an upgrade to our ERP platform, all running concurrently and targeting delivery before the end of 2027.

Our IT team is small and highly capable. We are building an internal integration function and strengthening our in-house Data & Analytics capability — and these four roles are the foundation of that work.

Purpose Of The Role

Crew Clothing’s Data & Analytics team has built a modern data platform — a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse sitting and a growing Power BI semantic model spanning sales, stock, returns and customer data. As Analytics Engineer, you will turn that infrastructure into the analytical products the business actually uses to make decisions.

This is a genuinely AI‑first role. You will work daily with Claude Code and the latest Microsoft MCP (Model Context Protocol) tooling to build our data lakes, semantic models, and dashboards at a pace that a traditional tools simply cannot match — this is one of the most cutting‑edge roles in UK retail analytics today, and you will help shape what AI‑native analytics engineering looks like at Crew.

Your primary focus will be driving forward our integration and dashboard roadmap of data products, semantic models, and natural language AI interfaces that let trading, buying, retail and finance teams make decisions on live data rather than instinct.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own delivery against the Crew D&A Strategic Roadmap — the team’s single source of truth for integration and dashboard priorities
  • Build, maintain and document Fabric Lakehouse — owning the Python and SQL transformation logic that turns our raw data into business-ready datasets
  • Extend and maintain the Power BI semantic model — building DAX measures, calculation groups and relationships as new data sources and brands (Ben Sherman, Pringle, Saltrock) come online
  • Use Claude Code and the latest Microsoft MCP tooling as a core part of your daily workflow — this is an AI‑first role and you will be expected to use cutting‑edge AI tooling to build and document faster than a traditional tools allow
  • Apply basic DevOps practice to analytics engineering — Git‑based version control, structured deployment pipelines (Dev → Prod), and clear environment governance
  • Own and monitor Fabric Data Pipelines ingesting data from multiple sources — incremental load logic, agent driven failure alerting and data quality checks
  • Design and build the complex dashboards senior leaders and trading teams use directly to make decisions — trading performance, stock health, buying analysis, customer behaviour, store performance
  • Use Python (Pandas, PySpark) for data manipulation and automation wherever SQL and DAX are not the right tool
  • Lead the technical onboarding of Ben Sherman, Pringle and Saltrock data onto the shared Fabric platform, enabling group-level reporting
  • Maintain a data dictionary and clear documentation of view logic, naming conventions and the deployment process

Skills & Experience Desired

  • 3+ years’ experience in analytics engineering, BI development or data engineering
  • Strong SQL — able to write and optimise complex views, CTEs and window functions
  • Hands‑on Power BI experience, particularly DAX measure development and semantic model design
  • Comfortable with Python for data manipulation and automation (Pandas, PySpark)
  • Familiarity with basic DevOps practices — Git‑based workflows, deployment pipelines and version control
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or a similar cloud data engineering platform
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI‑assisted development — comfortable using tools like Claude Code and MCP‑based tooling to work faster and think differently about how analytics engineering gets done
  • Commercial awareness — able to translate a retail business problem into data requirements without heavy specification
  • Experience in retail, fashion or ecommerce data environments is a strong advantage

title: Programme Operations Industrial Placement
description:
The Role

Brackley, UK

Build your skills. Make an impact. Race towards excellence.

Every dream needs a team.

Join the Planning and Programme Department as we take on the challenge of Formula One’s exciting new era of sustainable technical regulations.

By spending your year in industry with us, you will:

The Test Operations function is responsible for coordinating and delivering the car development and validation test programme across Test & Development, Dyno and Track activities. Working across multiple engineering functions, this role plays an important part in ensuring tests are planned, prepared and executed efficiently to support car performance and programme objectives.

As a Placement Student, you will work with a wide range of engineering departments to improve planning, visibility, automation and operational processes across the test programme. You will contribute to the development of new tools, systems, dashboards and reporting solutions that enhance decision-making and improve programme delivery.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in programme engineering, operational management, data analysis, automation and continuous improvement within a high-performance Formula One environment. It is ideally suited to someone who enjoys solving complex problems, improving processes and developing practical solutions using engineering and data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and support the delivery of engineering test programmes, ensuring readiness of parts, resources and facilities across multiple departments.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, planning tools and automation solutions to improve programme visibility, decision-making and operational efficiency.
  • Analyse programme and operational data to identify risks, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities, supporting continuous improvement and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Planning and Test teams to resolve issues, coordinate activities and ensure successful programme delivery.
  • Maintain project documentation, processes, action trackers and performance metrics, while supporting programme reviews and stakeholder communication.
  • Support the Cost Analysis Department as well as operational and technical areas with a variety of cost cap related activities. This will include:
    • Costing data quality improvements and data analysis
    • Process optimisation and automation.
    • Identifying cost saving opportunities
    • FIA / Finance reporting
  • Work with Finance and other Cost Analysts to ensure consistency of approach and methodologies, aligning processes and standardising practices.
  • Have a comprehensive understanding of the F1 Financial Regulations.

About You

We're looking for someone who is curious, enjoys understanding how complex systems work and is motivated by finding better ways of doing things.

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Confidence working with data and presenting insights clearly.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, with a desire to learn and a willingness to challenge and improve existing processes.

Essential:

  • Studying towards a degree in Engineering Management, Business Engineering, Manufacturing, Data Science or a related discipline.
  • Must be undertaking a placement year as part of the degree programme.
  • Must have at least one year of study remaining following the placement.

We recognise that valuable skills and experiences can be developed through a wide range of degree programmes. Candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational capabilities are also encouraged to apply.

Desirable:

Experience with any of the following would be advantageous, although training will be provided.

We recognise that valuable skills and experiences can be developed through a wide range of degree programmes. Candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational capabilities are also encouraged to apply.

  • Experience working with engineering, manufacturing or technical projects.
  • SQL or database concepts.
  • Project planning and scheduling tools.
  • Automation tools (Python, Power Automate)
  • Data Analysis and reporting (Power Bi, Excel)
  • CAD and engineering drawing awareness.

Key Skills You Could Gain From Your Placement

This placement provides exposure to a broad range of engineering and operational disciplines within Formula One, including:

  • Programme and project management.
  • Engineering operations and test delivery.
  • Data analysis and business intelligence.
  • Process improvement and operational excellence.
  • Automation and digital transformation.
  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Engineering decision-making in a fast-paced environment.

You will have the opportunity to work with experienced engineers and programme leaders while contributing directly to the tools, systems and processes used to support the development of a Formula One car.

About Us

At the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, every win starts with the energy to exceed our exceptional standards.

It’s the belief and focus you give that powers our performance.

Whether you’re leading innovation, bringing precision to our manufacturing or supporting trackside operations around the world, every detail matters.

We’re setting new standards in our sport, together. More growth, more pride, more of what makes our team exceptional.


Give all. Gain more.

Benefits

When you put the effort in, we give it back. Start with a competitive salary, a generous joining bonus, add in a world-class wellbeing programme (including a free on-site gym), delicious, subsidised food, and private medical cover - all on our riverside campus powered by 100% renewable energy.

You’ll have everything you need to thrive both inside and outside of work.

Why Us

We believe that building a more inclusive and diverse culture helps us go faster and further.

From recruitment and building our future talent pipeline to internal communications and leadership training, we’re building a team where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

Our aim is to attract, develop and retain exceptional people from all backgrounds, creating a workplace where all team members feel respected, supported and able to fulfil their potential.

Your Application

We will ask you to complete our application form as well as submitting a cover letter and CV. Please note, if you are making multiple applications please ensure to update your cover letter on subsequent applications.

Our IP programme is designed with the intent to progress into available graduate roles in the future. You will be required to meet the eligibility criteria of the IP programme including any right to work requirements for your application to progress.

As these roles are based in the UK, any visa sponsorship must meet current Home Office immigration rules.

Next Steps

As part of the selection process, you may be required to complete a combination of the following tests at various stages (if you have not completed the same test within the last 6 months):

Meet with customers and their account managers and solution architects for the largest and most strategic customer accounts to discuss opportunities to transform their workloads with AWS. Discuss the same opportunities with supporting AWS service specialist teams, cloud economics and partner teams to fine tune architectures, solutions and migration strategies. Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Associate Staff Engineer, Workday integrations
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Staff Engineer, Workday Integrations based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of complex Workday integration solutions across a broad enterprise ecosystem. You will design, develop, deploy, and support integrations connecting Workday with critical third-party and downstream platforms. You will work across Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Extend, and SOAP/REST web services. The role also combines integration engineering with automation, AI capabilities, reporting, security, and production support. You will collaborate closely with functional Workday teams to translate business needs into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. As a technical leader, you will contribute to design decisions, mentor through peer reviews, and help drive quality and operational excellence. You will also play an important role in Workday release readiness and the continuous improvement of the integration landscape.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support end-to-end Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Extend, and Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Build and maintain custom applications, orchestrations, and extensions on the Workday Extend platform, including custom business objects, APIs, and UI pages.
  • Develop and support inbound and outbound integrations with payroll providers, benefits carriers, ATS platforms, financial systems, data warehouses, and middleware platforms such as MuleSoft.
  • Apply Workday AI and automation capabilities, including Workday Illuminate, AI Gateway, Extend-based ML capabilities, and intelligent automation features, to streamline processes and improve integration and reporting workflows.
  • Develop and optimize XSLT, XPath, Groovy, and Workday Custom Report-based transformations for complex data mapping and integration requirements.
  • Configure and troubleshoot PECI and other payroll and financial interface protocols as required.
  • Build advanced calculated fields, custom reports, including matrix and composite reports, and RaaS endpoints for downstream data consumption.
  • Own integration security design, including ISUs, security groups, X.509 certificates, OAuth 2.0, and API access policies following least-privilege principles.
  • Lead technical design sessions, create integration design documentation, and review peer solutions to ensure quality, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Monitor, tune, and troubleshoot production integrations while managing incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation.
  • Partner with functional Workday teams across HCM, Payroll, Financials, and ATS to translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Support Workday semi-annual release cycles by assessing impacts on integrations, Extend applications, and reports, and coordinating regression testing.
  • Implement and use integration event monitoring, alerting, and log analysis capabilities to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Package and promote Workday configurations and integrations across tenants while maintaining deployment quality and consistency.

    • Requirements

    • 4+ years of relevant professional experience in Workday integration development and engineering.
    • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
    • Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting Workday integrations across multiple integration technologies.
    • Proven experience with Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Extend, and SOAP/REST web services.
    • Practical experience building custom Workday Extend applications, orchestrations, APIs, custom business objects, and UI pages.
    • Experience integrating Workday with third-party and downstream systems, including payroll, benefits, ATS, financial, data warehouse, and middleware platforms.
    • Strong knowledge of XSLT, XPath, Groovy, Workday Custom Reports, calculated fields, matrix and composite reports, and RaaS.
    • Experience with Workday integration security, including ISUs, security groups, X.509 certificates, OAuth 2.0, and API access policies.
    • Experience with PECI and other payroll or financial interface protocols is highly valuable.
    • Familiarity with Workday AI and automation capabilities and the ability to identify opportunities to improve integration and reporting workflows.
    • Strong troubleshooting and production support capabilities, including monitoring, incident management, root cause analysis, and performance tuning.
    • Ability to lead technical discussions, document integration designs, review solutions, and collaborate effectively with functional and technical stakeholders.
    • Experience supporting Workday semi-annual releases and coordinating regression testing.
    • Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a focus on building scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and market standards.
      • Opportunity to work on complex, enterprise-scale Workday integration initiatives.
      • Exposure to Workday Extend, AI-driven automation, integration architecture, and modern enterprise technologies.

title: Education - Education Officer
description:
Hours: 37.5 Hours (Term time) & 22.5 Hours (School holidays)
Work pattern: Varied according to calendar (Weekend work may be required)
Duration: Permanent varied hourly
West Midlands Safari Park has an exciting opportunity for the position of Education Officer to join our team.
Your role will include providing educational talks, tours and activities to visiting schools and groups. The role also includes assisting in the teaching of Level 1, 2 and 3 Animal Care and Management Diplomas ensuring lesson plans, schemes of work and assessment are kept to a high standard at all times.
About you
The role requires someone who is confident, motivated and enthusiastic about conservation education and has excellent communication skills. You will have gained a degree level qualification in an animal related subject. Ideally, we are looking for someone with previous experience within a teaching, presenter or educator role. Teaching qualifications of PTLLS, CTLLS or PGCE would be advantageous, although full training will be provided.
The post is subject to a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. This disclosure will need to be satisfactory to the company for employment to commence.
Benefits
As well as benefiting from working in a unique and beautiful setting, you’ll also receive a range of additional perks to employment including:

WMSP Annual Pass which gives you and your family and friends free admission and theme park wristbands, and free entry to our sister site Drayton Manor Park also Water World Stoke On Trent
20% Discount in our retail Shops.
50% of Food & Beverage while on shift (Individual)
35% of VIP Experiences. Discounts do not apply to guided Minibus Tours.
35% off at selected Food & Beverage Purchases whilst visiting the park.
10% off stays in Safari Lodges
24 Hour access to an online doctor and access to online prescriptions.
Counselling access.
Online retailer discount portal.

What we are
West Midlands Safari Park is an award-winning visitor attraction, located in Worcestershire in the heart of England. It is home to some of the world’s most beautiful and critically endangered species, with a four-mile safari drive-through, walk-through Discovery Trail, African Village and Lemur Woods, as well beautiful walking trails, allowing guests to experience up close encounters with hundreds of amazing animals. Guests can also choose from a wide range of catering and retail outlets, as well as enjoying a large amusement area with over 25 rides and attractions providing the ideal venue for family days out.
In 2021, the Park introduced Safari Lodges – luxury accommodation allowing guests to stay overnight for the first time. Guests can wake up to incredible sights of elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos and red pandas, or sleep just a ‘whisker’ away from lions, white lions, tigers and cheetahs.
In addition, the Park is home to three incredible venues – Spring Grove House, Treetops Pavillion and Cellarz, which play host to weddings, corporate events and social celebrations.
What we do
Our mission is to bring people together to create unique wildlife experiences that exhilarate, educate and leave memories to last a lifetime.
Our 200-acre site allows us to do just that, whether you’re a day guest, wedding guest or overnight guest! We create experiences unlike no other, attracting visitors from across the Midlands and beyond.
Our brand and our team members live by our core values. We’re passionate and work with a sense of togetherness, always striving to be progressive, with preservation at the heart of everything we do, all while creating unforgettable experiences.
Through these principles we aspire to achieve our vision: to be the number one UK wildlife attraction through the creation of immersive animal habitats and unique visitor experiences.

title: Principal Program Manager - OCI Product Marketing
description:

You will own the program mechanisms that make complex work move: priorities, dependencies, readiness criteria, status reporting, risk escalation, stakeholder alignment, and adoption. You thrive in ambiguity, build consensus across diverse teams, and create practical processes that scale.

Responsibilities

OCI Website Migration to Website Builder (WSB)

  • Drive migration readiness, validation, prioritization, and issue resolution across the OCI website portfolio, including 239 product and solution pages on oracle.com/cloud and the assessment of a further 183 AI pages.
  • Coordinate dependencies across WSB, Web Publishing, Product Marketing, Product Management, page owners, and reviewers to maintain a clear migration plan and timely decisions.

  • Create operating cadences and reporting for migration status, quality, risks, decisions, and executive escalation.

Content Operations and CMS Governance

  • Define and operate service-level expectations, change controls, quality checks, and governance for ongoing web content operations.
  • Build repeatable self-service processes, training, and support that enable Product Marketing Managers to manage page updates and edits after WSB migration.
  • Reduce unnecessary dependence on centralized publishing by clarifying ownership, approval paths, and maintenance expectations.

Website Measurement and KPI Development

  • Maintain website-performance reporting and operating reviews across traffic, engagement, conversion, and content-performance measures.
  • Define and track new KPIs, including AI Engine Optimization (AEO), and establish a consistent framework for measuring content and platform impact.
  • Translate performance insights into prioritized content and website improvements that improve discovery, engagement, and business outcomes.

Oracle AI World Content Operations and Demo Hub Oversight

  • Own CMS updates for core session titles, abstracts, speakers, and metadata across Learn, Hands-on Labs, Bootcamps, and Theater sessions.
  • Own the integrated operating plan for Demo Hub content, including content readiness, publishing, AV coordination, on-site updates, and last-minute change management.
  • Coordinate Demo Hub staffing schedules and train Hub staff on booth-duty expectations and attendee, speaker, and content support.
  • Track dependencies, staffing coverage, readiness risks, and timely resolution across content, event, and booth stakeholders.

Lead Strategic Programs

  • Own and drive complex, cross-functional programs that span Product Marketing, Partner, and Product Management organizations, bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous, fast-moving initiatives.
  • Coordinate concurrent initiatives while maintaining clear priorities, timelines, risks, dependencies, and executive-level status reporting.
  • Serve as the operational lead for time-sensitive strategic projects, rapidly stepping into high-priority initiatives to accelerate execution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 6-8+ years of experience in program management, product marketing, technical marketing, product management, web operations, or a related strategic role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and high-visibility deadlines.
  • Strong operational judgment and the ability to establish governance, operating cadences, clear accountability, and practical decision-making mechanisms.
  • Experience with CMS or website operations, content lifecycle management, and web analytics; familiarity with migration, publishing, and quality-assurance workflows.
  • Exceptional organizational and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without authority and maintain high quality in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, AI, or a large-scale digital property.
  • Experience defining performance metrics or operating reviews for content, web, digital marketing, or customer experience programs.
  • Experience supporting a major event, content program, or other time-sensitive field operation.

Successful candidates will:

  • Create a durable operating model that enables consistent website migration, content governance, ownership coverage, and self-service publishing.
  • Use measurement and AEO insights to identify high-value improvements and demonstrate the impact of website and content investments.
  • Deliver a coordinated, well-staffed, and responsive Oracle AI World Demo Hub and content operation.
  • Create alignment across diverse stakeholders while navigating ambiguity, changing priorities, and time-sensitive business needs.

description:
Job Title: QA Engineer — Electrical & Instrumentation

Location: Singapore

About the Role:

Detail-oriented and proactive QA Engineer to support the Project/QA Manager in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of electrical systems within a semiconductor manufacturing facility. You will drive rigorous inspection, testing, and commissioning of electrical infrastructure — from cleanroom power distribution and tool hookups to ESD grounding and critical life-safety systems — while continuously improving QA processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Assist in developing, reviewing, and executing Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) for electrical installation works, including cable containment, cable pulling, termination, and pre-commissioning/commissioning.

• Support the development of SOPs, Method Statements (MOS), and checklists for electrical and instrumentation works; ensure contractors adhere to approved procedures and industry best practices.

• Conduct quality inspections for cleanroom electrical systems, busway distribution, UPS/critical power, ESD grounding, lighting, fire alarm, and ELV systems to ensure compliance with project specifications.

• Monitor and track punchlist items and defects; drive timely closure and maintain accurate documentation.

• Maintain constant, effective communication with contractors and subcontractors to ensure full understanding of electrical quality requirements, drawings, and specifications.

• Communicate internally with engineering, construction, and commissioning teams on work progress, test results, defect trends, and closure status.

• Assist in the issuance and tracking of Site Observation Reports (SORs) / Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) related to electrical works, and ensure root-cause analysis and corrective actions are completed.

• Witness and verify electrical testing protocols (e.g., insulation resistance, continuity, polarity, earth resistance, torque verification, high-pot testing, and functional testing).

• Support factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) for major electrical equipment where required.

• Continuously improve QA processes, tools, and reporting for electrical scope efficiency and accuracy.

Requirements:

• Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.

• Proven experience in QA/QC or commissioning of electrical systems within semiconductor, data center, pharmaceutical, or other high-tech facility projects.

• Familiarity with cleanroom electrical protocols, ESD/grounding requirements, and critical power infrastructure in semiconductor environments.

• Working knowledge of relevant codes and standards (e.g., NEC / NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, SS 638, IEC 60364, or local Singapore electrical regulations).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Good communication, documentation, and teamwork abilities.

description:
Job Description: Electrical Site Installation Supervisor

Job Summary

The Electrical Site Installation Supervisor is responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising all electrical installation activities at the project site. The role ensures that electrical works are completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with project specifications, quality standards, applicable codes, and project schedules. The supervisor manages electrical technicians, contractors, and subcontractors while coordinating with engineering, construction, commissioning, and client teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Electrical Installation Management, supervise and coordinate all electrical installation activities on site.

2. Ensure electrical works are executed according to approve drawings, specifications, procedures, and project requirements.

3. Oversee installation of:

  • LV, MV, and HV electrical systems
  • Power distribution systems
  • Transformers and switchgear
  • Motor Control Centers (MCCs)
  • Electrical panels and distribution boards
  • Cable trays, conduits, and supports
  • Power and control cables
  • Lighting, grounding, and lightning protection systems
  • UPS and battery systems
  • Monitor installation productivity and progress against project schedules.
  • Ensure proper electrical equipment handling, storage, and Installation practices.

4. Safety Management

  • Enforce compliance with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) requirements.
  • Conduct daily toolbox talks and safety briefings.
  • Ensure implementation of Permit-to-Work (PTW) procedures.
  • Verify proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • Identify and mitigate electrical hazards and risks.
  • Participate in safety inspections, audits, and incident investigations

5. Quality Assurance and Control

  • Ensure installations comply with project specifications applicable standards, and client requirements.
  • Support QA/QC inspections and testing activities.
  • Review Inspection and Test Plans .
  • Ensure proper completion of installation checklists and inspection records.
  • Address construction defects and non-conformance reports (NCRs).
  • Monitor punch list completion and close-out activities.

6. Team Supervision

  • Supervise electricians, electrical technicians, and subcontractors.
  • Assign daily work activities and monitor workforce productivity.
  • Provide technical guidance and practical solutions for field issues.
  • Evaluate workforce performance and training requirements.
  • Ensure adequate manpower and resources are available to meet project objectives.

7. Project Coordination

  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, mechanical, instrumentation, and commissioning teams.
  • Attend construction coordination meetings.
  • Assist in planning and scheduling installation activities.
  • Monitor material deliveries and identify shortages.
  • Resolve site installation conflicts and technical issues.
  • Support pre-commissioning and commissioning activities.

8. Documentation and Reporting

  • Review and interpret:
    • Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
    • Electrical Layout Drawings
    • Cable Routing Drawings
    • Wiring Diagrams
    • Equipment Datasheets
    • Load Schedules
  • Maintain daily construction progress reports.
  • Track installation quantities and project status.
  • Ensure as-built drawings are updated accurately.
  • Prepare turnover documentation for commissioning and project handover

    Education

    • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering,
      Electrical Technology, or a related field.
    • Relevant electrical trade certification is preferred

    Experience

    • Minimum 5-10 years of electrical construction experience
    • At least 3 years in a supervisory role.
    • Experience in industrial or infrastructure projects such as:
      • Power Plant
      • Oil & Gas Facilities
      • Petrochemical Plants
      • Manufacturing Facilities
      • Data Centers
      • Pharmaceutical Plants
      • Water Treatment Plant
      • Commercial and Industrial Buildings

    Technical Skills

    • Strong knowledge of electrical installation practices and construction methods.
    • Experience with:
      • LV/MV/HV systems
      • Switchgear and transformers
      • MCCs and VFDs
      • Power distribution systems
      • Cable installation and termination
      • Earthing and lightning protection systems
    • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and schematics.
    • Familiarity with electrical testing and commissioning requirements
    • Knowledge of industry standards such as:
      • IEC
      • NEC
      • NFPA
      • IEEE
      • ISO Standards
      • Local Electrical Codes and Regulation

title: Analytics Engineer - Hybrid, London
description:
Who We Are:

Datassential is a leading global intelligence platform for the food and beverage industry. Leveraging billions of data points and cutting-edge AI, we provide a suite of innovative solutions that empower more than 90% of the world’s largest food and beverage brands to develop, market, and sell their products more effectively.

Based in Chicago, USA, Datassential has expanded its global reach through strategic acquisitions of CHD Expert (France) in 2022 and Brizo Data, Inc. (Canada) in 2025. In 2024, we secured investment from top-tier private equity firms New Mountain Capital and Endicott Capital—a milestone that fuels our accelerated product roadmap and strengthens our research and development, enabling us to deliver even greater value to our clients.

Note: This is a hybrid role requiring an in-office presence on a weekly basis.

Why You Should Join Us:

  • Our team is technically proficient, quick to learn, and highly adaptable, ensuring we can tackle any challenge with expertise and agility.
  • We are dedicated to building data pipelines that bridge customers with Datassential Operator data across global markets, and we are passionate about doing that work well.
  • As our EMEA Senior ETL Analyst, you will have a direct impact on how we structure, automate, and evolve our data operations.
  • We manage a complex data pipeline requiring attention to scalability, orchestration, quality control and embedded AI — and we are looking for someone who finds that kind of challenge genuinely exciting.
  • We value work-life balance and you will be joining a team and company that wants you to grow.

Who You Are:

  • Passionate about data and love thinking about how pipelines should be structured and optimised
  • Driven by a desire to eliminate manual processes and replace them with reliable, automated workflows
  • Curious about where new technologies — including AI and LLMs — can be embedded into data pipelines to create smarter, more autonomous processing
  • Comfortable evaluating tools and making architecture recommendations, not just executing within a prescribed stack
  • A collaborative communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into plain language for non-technical stakeholders
  • Equally comfortable building and advising — you can get your hands dirty in Alteryx while also stepping back to assess whether the architecture around it is right
  • Automation is always front of mind

What You Will Do:

  • We are seeking a full-time Senior ETL Analyst to join our Client Data Solutions team, with a focus on our EMEA data operations. Our primary ETL environment is Alteryx, operated by a team of analysts and data specialists using a low-code approach.
  • You will assess how our processing environment is structured, identifying the paths to improving orchestration and automation, and help us streamline and get faster and more flexible as our data processing cycles grow shorter.
  • You will also work on the ground: building and maintaining data workflows, implementing processes to support new data sources and improved processing across 80 countries, with a focus on increasing speed, reducing manual intervention, and improving automated QC practices.
  • Assess our current EMEA Alteryx environment and provide structured recommendations on how to improve scalability, concurrency, and automation within our existing low-code model
  • Build, maintain, and optimise Alteryx workflows for EMEA data processing, with a focus on reusability and low manual-touch operation
  • Embed LLM-based processing steps (using Claude via the Anthropic API) into data pipelines for automated QC checks, data classification, and other AI-assisted manipulation tasks
  • Analyse data from different sources and design pipelines that produce clean, reliable output delivered to databases, SFTP, S3, or downstream systems
  • Develop and incorporate domain expertise in foodservice data to apply in meeting required standards for data integrity and relevant insights creation
  • Create and maintain process documentation for EMEA pipelines, ensuring workflows are understandable and maintainable by the broader team
  • Design and manage ad hoc client-related data projects throughout the year
  • Manage project communications with internal stakeholders across EMEA and global teams
  • Evaluate emerging tooling relevant to our pipeline architecture, and make grounded recommendations on adoption
  • Work with Developers, DevOps, and Product teams to understand Datassential's broader data infrastructure and ensure EMEA pipeline architecture aligns with it

What You Bring:

  • Demonstrated experience working in data operations, ETL development, or a closely related role
  • Hands-on proficiency with Alteryx or an equivalent low-code ETL platform (KNIME, EasyMorph, Dataiku, or similar) — you build workflows, not just describe them
  • Demonstrated experience improving or redesigning ETL pipeline architecture, not just executing within one
  • Familiarity with orchestration concepts: dependency management, event-driven triggers, scheduling, retry logic, and exception routing
  • Strong SQL knowledge across one or more environments
  • Genuine interest in how AI and LLMs can be embedded in data workflows — experience with API-based LLM integration is a strong plus
  • Ability to evaluate tools critically and communicate trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Familiarity with Jira/Confluence
  • Minimum of BA/BS in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice To Have:

  • Experience with Alteryx Server administration, including scheduling, publishing workflows, and managing concurrency
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as n8n, Apache Airflow, or Prefect
  • Familiarity with cloud storage environments (AWS S3, SFTP, or similar)
  • Experience with Python or equivalent scripting for lightweight automation tasks
  • Familiarity with project management frameworks such as Kanban or Scrum

Our Table Welcomes All.

We embrace diversity of both background and thought and foster an inclusive environment that extends an open landscape of opportunities to everyone. We invite each of us to simply be ourselves. We operate with respect and without judgment, celebrating both the power of the individual as well as our shared humanity.

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact careers@datassential.com.

title: Clinical Lead Psychologist - Intensive Residential Parenting Unit (IRPU) (534208)
description:
The Team

The Child Health and Parenting Service provides Primary Healthcare services to Families in Tasmania with children under the age of five, including health and development assessment, connection to other services, and a wide range of Parenting Support. The new Intensive Residential Parenting Unit will add to the current community support available, offering families the option of admission to a residential setting with focussed support for a wide range of parenting concerns, including parent and caregiver mental health and wellbeing. The unit is staffed by a nursing-led multidisciplinary team, working alongside the wider CHaPS network and with core connections with services across the Tasmanian service landscape, to deliver co-ordinated, comprehensive care in partnership with families.

The Role

As the Clinical Lead Psychologist within the Intensive Residential Parenting Unit, you will provide specialist psychological assessment, intervention and care coordination for parents and caregivers experiencing challenges to their mental health and wellbeing. Working as part of the multidisciplinary team, you will lead the planning and delivery of care for families, provide expert clinical advice, build strong partnerships with internal and external service providers, and contribute to the development of policies, programs and services that support positive outcomes for parents, infants and families. You will also play a key leadership role through supervision, mentoring and quality improvement activities.

You will need

  • Extensive experience and clinical expertise in perinatal, parental and infant mental health.
  • Experience coordinating psychological care and developing holistic support plans for families in community and/or residential settings.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with health and community service providers.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience within a multidisciplinary team, including the ability to support, supervise and guide staff.
  • Highly developed communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide expert advice to professionals, caregivers and families.
  • A commitment to continuous improvement, evidence-based practice and delivering high-quality family-centred care.

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. Additionally, it provides community health, mental health, and primary healthcare services to the Tasmanian community through more than 300 sites.

Tasmania, Australia's only island state, offers unparalleled natural beauty and a luxurious lifestyle. Pursuing your health career in Tasmania’s public health system means building strong connections with colleagues and patients. It also means embracing a lifestyle where you can enjoy extraordinary experiences outside of work while making a significant impact on the community during work.

Details of appointment

Permanent, full time, day worker position, working 76 hours per fortnight, commencing as soon as possible.

*Notwithstanding hours to be negotiated with the successful applicant.

Allowances

In addition, the following allowances calculated on the salaried incremental point may be available:

  • Professional Development Allowance of up to $1200 per annum, paid on a fortnightly, pro rata basis.

Benefits available to eligible candidates

  • Travel and relocation assistance support available up to $15,000 for eligible appointees from overseas, and up to $10,000 for appointees from interstate.
  • Professional development and accelerated pathways.
  • A range of leave entitlements, including study leave and Professional Development Support.
  • Fitness Passport – You, and your family can access 40+ fitness facilities across Tasmania for just $14.50 per week per person, or $28.05 for a family.

More information about our Employee Benefits can be found here

Eligibility

Successful applicants will be required to meet the essential criteria.

  • Registered with the Psychology Board of Australia.
  • Working with Children Registration (where applicable and as determined by individual position requirements)

Applicants should note the following criteria are desirable:

title: Electronics Technician 1
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: None

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems sector is seeking an Electronics Technician to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. The qualified applicant will become part of Northrop Grumman's Amherst Systems in Buffalo, New York; an organization focused on development and production of state-of-the-art Simulation Systems solutions and focused assembly cells supporting other Northrop Grumman operations and products.

Why You'll Love Working Here:

  • Enjoy a 9/80 Schedule – Every other Friday off

  • Work in a Clean, Modern Facility – Bright, tidy, and organized

  • Full Benefits – Health insurance, 401(k) match, paid time off (including end of year shutdown), and more.

  • Company Culture – Join our Employee Networks and participate in regular on-site and off-site employee events

  • Defining Possible – Our products are on the cutting edge of electronic warfare technology and play an important role in protecting our brave service members.

What You Will Get to Do:

  • Test and troubleshoot RF products including RF Microelectronic, RF amplifiers, switches, mixers, etc.

  • Test and troubleshoot digital circuit cards.

  • Analyze equipment operating characteristics to isolate malfunctions in products and integrated test systems.

  • Diagnose non-conformances using schematics, wiring diagrams, source control drawings and other test procedures and equipment.

  • Perform RF tuning on microelectronics, which requires working under a microscope for much of workday.

  • Perform maintenance or calibration on test equipment.

  • Record and ensure validity of entries into data collection and test systems.

  • Interpret and recommend corrective action to test findings.
