title: Project Risk & Governance Analyst
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Risk & Governance Analyst supports the organisation’s risk management and governance framework by ensuring risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies are effectively identified, documented, tracked, and reported through established governance processes and tools.

Working closely with project teams, business stakeholders, and leadership, the role ensures that risk information is accurately maintained, governance forums are effectively supported, mitigation activities are monitored, and project and operational risks are properly captured within a governance tracking tool (e.g., Jira Service Management or equivalent system).

The role also leads or supports small-scale projects and improvement initiatives, particularly those focused on risk reduction, governance enhancement, operational effectiveness, and process improvement. This position is suited to someone with experience in project management, PMO, governance, or risk management who can work across multiple stakeholders to provide visibility, challenge assumptions, and ensure proactive risk and issue management.



Key Responsibilities

Risk Management

  • Support the execution of the organisation’s established risk management framework and processes.
  • Identify, document, assess, and track risks across projects and operational activities.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date risk registers within Jira Service Management (JSM).
  • Ensure project risks are regularly reviewed, updated, and appropriately escalated when required.
  • Monitor risk mitigation plans and follow up with risk owners to ensure timely completion of actions.
  • Track emerging risks, issues, dependencies, and control gaps across initiatives.
  • Support risk review sessions and workshops with stakeholders across the business.
  • Assist in preparing risk summaries, trend analysis, and reporting for leadership forums.

Governance

  • Coordinate governance activities and support governance meetings and review forums.
  • Maintain logs for risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies (RAIDD logs).
  • Ensure governance artifacts, reports, and documentation are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Support adherence to internal governance standards, policies, and audit requirements.
  • Track completion of governance actions and agreed remediation activities.
  • Prepare governance packs, dashboards, and reporting materials for leadership and stakeholders.

Project Delivery

  • Lead small-scale projects and improvement initiatives from initiation through to completion.
  • Support project planning, scheduling, tracking, and reporting activities.
  • Manage project risks, issues, actions, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure delivery of project objectives and outcomes.
  • Support implementation of recommendations arising from risk assessments, audits, and governance reviews.

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Produce regular risk and governance reports, dashboards, and status updates.
  • Provide insights into project and operational risk exposure.
  • Engage with stakeholders to ensure timely updates to risks, actions, and mitigation plans.
  • Support leadership decision-making through accurate and structured reporting.
  • Build effective working relationships across project teams and business functions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve risk reporting, governance processes, and project tracking practices.
  • Contribute to enhancements within Jira Service Management (JSM) and related governance tools.
  • Support lessons learned activities and implementation of process improvements.
  • Promote proactive risk management and governance best practices across teams.


Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in risk management, PMO, project management, governance, or related disciplines
  • Experience maintaining risk registers and tracking risk mitigation activities
  • Working knowledge of project delivery methodologies and governance frameworks
  • Experience using Jira Service Management (JSM) or similar risk/governance tools
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to engage confidently with stakeholders across multiple business functions

Preferred

  • Experience in PMO, governance, project delivery, or operational risk environments
  • Familiarity with audit, compliance, or control management activities
  • Experience creating dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools
  • PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile Foundation, or equivalent project management certification
  • Risk management certifications or formal training is an advantage


Impact of the Role

This role plays a key part in strengthening governance discipline, improving risk visibility, and supporting effective decision-making across projects and operations. By ensuring risks are proactively managed and governance processes are consistently applied, the Project Risk & Governance Analyst contributes directly to operational stability and delivery effectiveness.

title: Market Intelligence Lead, Donor Growth
description:
At Vitalant, the impact you make doing work that is purposeful, meaningful, and worthwhile is vital. As a member of our non-profit organization, you can be impact-inspired to provide vital clinical services to communities nationwide, vital products to those in need of a donor's generosity, or vital scientific research that advances blood safety worldwide.

Work Shift (if applicable):

Shift 1 (United States of America)

Job Description:

Turn insights into impact. As the Donor Growth Strategy Market Intelligence Lead, you'll play a pivotal role in helping Vitalant connect more donors to our lifesaving mission. In this highly visible role, you'll uncover opportunities that strengthen donor growth and help ensure a stable blood supply for the communities we serve. By leveraging market intelligence, donor analytics, and business insights, you'll help shape innovative growth strategies, influence organizational priorities, and drive meaningful outcomes. If you're energized by translating data into action and want your work to have a direct impact on saving lives, this is an opportunity to make a difference every day.

As a Market Intelligence Lead, Donor Growth Strategy, your impact is vital. You will analyze donor, market, and performance data to identify growth opportunities across geographies, demographics, and donor segments, transforming complex information into clear recommendations that guide strategic decision-making. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll develop dashboards, reports, and intelligence tools that support donor acquisition and retention initiatives, prioritize market opportunities, and measure success. The ideal candidate brings advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills, expertise in business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel, strong communication and data storytelling abilities, and a strategic mindset with the ability to influence stakeholders, manage multiple priorities, and deliver actionable results in a fast-paced environment.

What to Expect:

Salary: $65,353.60 - $86,257.60 salary

Compensation is commensurate with geographic location, skills, and directly related experience.

Our total rewards package will support you, your family, and your future with

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) retirement savings with 5% company match

  • Tuition assistance and professional development opportunities

  • Employee assistance and wellness resources

  • A commitment to work-life balance through generous paid time off, paid holidays, and wellness-focused benefits.

  • Health savings and flexible spending accounts

  • Employee recognition and service award programs

  • Discounted event tickets, gym memberships, Hinge Health support, and exclusive employee offers.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Statistics, Marketing, Data Analytics, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, required.

  • 5–7 years of experience in market intelligence, business analytics, strategy, growth analytics, or related functions.

  • Demonstrated experience developing market analyses, business intelligence reporting, and strategic recommendations.

  • Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives through data-driven insights and performance measurement.

  • Advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to transform complex data into actionable business insights.

  • Strong knowledge of market intelligence, business analytics, donor growth, customer segmentation, and performance measurement.

  • Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and executive-level reporting.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to align recommendations to organizational growth objectives.

  • Ability to influence decision-making through data storytelling and strategic communication.

  • Demonstrated project management and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities across cross-functional teams.

  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Proficiency with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, and other analytics and visualization tools.

Location:

Vitalant Remote Work
Little Rock, AR 72201


Job Category:

Sales / Community Outreach

Contact Information: careers@vitalant.org

If you are impact-inspired to help others, and making a difference is vital for you, you'll experience a career built on purpose, a company created to care, and a team committed to lead - together.

title: AI-Enabled Data Analytics Engineer
description:
• 12-month contract
  • £80,000 per annum
  • Hybrid - 3 days per week in London

We are hiring an AI-Enabled Data Analytics Engineer to join a global technology organisation, building scalable data, analytics and AI-assisted automation solutions that improve business decision‑making.

This is a hands‑on engineering role for someone strong in Databricks, SQL and Python who is already using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT to accelerate development.

You won't just use AI-generated outputs- you'll be expected to validate, challenge and improve them, ensuring solutions are technically accurate, reliable and relevant to the business.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and improve AI agents, reusable workflows, prompt templates and automation solutions

  • Apply prompt engineering and context engineering to improve the reliability of AI-generated outputs
  • Validate AI-generated code, analysis and recommendations before production/business use
  • Build and maintain documentation, context files, knowledge sources and business rules governing AI behaviour
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data and AI solutions
  • Maintain strong standards around data quality, governance and performance

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years' experience across Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering or Data Analytics
  • Strong hands‑on Databricks
  • Advanced SQL
  • Strong Python
  • Experience with ETL/ELT, data modelling and data pipelines
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT
  • Exposure to AI agents, prompt engineering or context engineering

  • Ability to independently review and validate AI-generated outputs
  • Strong stakeholder communication and problem-solving skills.

Contract Benefits

  • 3% pension

title: Hospitality Internship
description:
Eterniti is the leading operator of vacation rentals in iconic holiday destinations, led by a passion for excellence, authentic adventures, and hospitality. With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4* brand), Bo House (our 5* & palace brand) and Verbier Exclusive (25 chalets in Verbier). Our guests can discover our properties in more than 25 exceptional destinations across Europe and North America.

At Emerald Stay, our Centralized Operations Team, based in sunny Barcelona, is the engine that keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes for our guests. We’re looking for a sharp, curious, and proactive intern to join us for a 6-month adventure.

To describe our workplace culture in a nutshell: we’re demanding and caring. As an intern, expect to be challenged, empowered and to grow through this professional experience.


RESPONSIBILITIES

You’ll be part of a small (but mighty!) team of 8, helping deliver top-tier hospitality from our head office. Think of it like running a hotel. Here’s a taste of what you’ll get involved in:

FRONT & BACK OFFICE
  • Managing communication with guests before, during and after their stay, via phone, chat or email.
  • Managing our mailbox; your goal is Inbox Zero
  • Liaising with guests so they complete their online check-in prior to arrival
  • Handling check-ins and check-outs from our central office and coordinating with our on-the-ground staff
  • Upselling and cross-selling
  • Closing and sending the invoice to our guests at the end of their stay; collecting extra money if needed, liaising with them in case of damages
  • Collecting feedback from guests to keep improving our services
RESERVATIONS
  • Controlling and managing reservations booked instantly in our Property Management System
  • Preparing proposals for individuals and groups
  • Closing and managing direct reservations
CONCIERGE
  • Arranging some extra services for our guests, such as airport transfers and at-home massages
  • Coordinate and organize extra services with our partners and on-the-ground staff
  • Handling the invoices for such extra services
HOUSEKEEPING & MAINTENANCE
  • Organize and coordinate cleaning with our different providers
  • Communicate and coordinate maintenance issues with our on-the-ground staff
Depending on the seasonality as well as your bandwidth, skills and interest, you may be involved with other aspects of our operations.


KEY INFORMATION
The application journey has 4 key steps:
  • Step 1: screening call for selected candidates
  • Step 2: case study
  • Step 3: video interview with our Operations Supervisor
  • Step 4: reference check

We’d love to hear from you if…
  • You are available for a period of 6 months (Starting date : January 2027)
  • You are flexible : work days and work hours may vary, we work in hospitality; our shifts start at 9am at the earliest and finish at 8pm at the latest, and you'll be on shift 2 weekends per month at most
  • You are currently enrolled in or have just finished your studies in hospitality or business administration/management; we are offering a becario, i.e. an agreement between the university, yourself and Emerald Stay
  • You speak (and write) English and French fluently.
  • You have at least 6 months of experience in a working environment, preferably in English
  • You are eligible to work in the EU and willing to relocate to Barcelona

ABOUT US
At Emerald Stay, we’re not your typical company. We’re a growing team, obsessed with quality and always looking for ways to raise the bar. We are recognized as a Great Place to Work®, and are accredited HappyAtWork®. The way we work, think, and grow is shaped by a set of values we actually live by:
  • Make Mistakes - We foster a creative environment where the best ideas win, where it is okay to make mistakes and unacceptable not to learn from them.
  • Question - We don't accept the status quo and look for ways to leverage technology while empowering people.
  • Speak Up - We are true people who give honest feedback, who are not afraid to share opinions and who don't talk behind one's back.
  • Think Big - While staying humble, we aim for the stars and work towards established goals and metrics.
  • Don’t Compromise - We are obsessed with quality, like a Swiss watchmaker.
  • Care - We care about our team members, our partners and our clients, and make our passion and our work one and the same.
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic unrelated to their skills and experience.

Oh, we’ve got perks.
  • Emerald Stay membership:
    • All-year-round discount of 10% off on Emerald stays
    • Discount of 50% off on Emerald stays during low season, on selected properties
    • Discount on services in all our destinations
  • Paid internship: 750€/month
  • Quarterly performance bonus linked to personal objectives
  • You’ll get 6 days of paid vacation during your internship
  • Birthday off
  • Flexible work environment : we have a flexible home office policy; you'll work at the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, the rest of the time, it's up to you. Feeling like working with another view? We offer 15 days yearly of remote work from wherever you'd like
  • Well-being program: we will contribute up to 300€ annually to your wellbeing expenses from 1st anniversary
  • Coaching program for Supervisor level and above from 1st anniversary
  • Team member referral program
  • Property referral program
  • Regular optional team events
Ready to join?

If you're willing to bring your creativity, passion for service, and high-energy vibe to Emerald Stay, we want to hear from you. Apply today and let's start this exciting journey together!

title: Senior Associate — Projects, Energy & Infrastructure Finance | Int'l Law Firm | SGP

title: Head of Technology Chapter - Software and Quality Engineering
description:
• Lead and drive technology and engineering standards, whilst driving AI adoption within our Product Innovation Centre.

  • A fantastic opportunity to work across cross functional teams to uplift our software engineering and quality engineering capability

  • Full-time and permanent position based at our Adelaide Head Office.

Qantas has established a new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide, a hub that will transform how we design, build and deliver digital experiences for millions of customers. At its core is a shift to a product-led operating model: moving away from traditional project-based IT delivery toward empowered, cross-functional product teams that own outcomes end-to-end.

The Head of Technology Chapter is accountable for the end-to-end engineering and quality engineering capability across the Product Innovation Centre, leading Chapter Leads for Mobile Engineering, Web Engineering, Backend & Integration Engineering, and Quality Engineering. Through this chapter structure, the role provides hardline leadership to all software and quality engineers, while maintaining alignment with product and platform squads where engineers contribute day-to-day delivery outcomes.

The role is responsible for defining engineering strategy, establishing technical standards, and driving the adoption of modern software engineering and AI-native development practices. It provides leadership on engineering priorities and capability development. This role ensures consistent quality, scalability, and operational excellence across the organisation.

In partnership with the Senior Manager, Applied AI, the Head of Technology Chapter co-leads our AI-native engineering transformation. This role is accountable for embedding AI-native practices into engineering teams and ensuring sustained adoption through strong chapter leadership and accountability.

Operating across a distributed chapter structure, the role translates enterprise technology strategy into execution. Success is measured through engineering excellence, widespread adoption of AI-native ways of working and the ability to sustain consistent standards as the Centre scales beyond hundreds of engineering and quality professionals.

You’ll have:

  • 15+ years in software engineering or technology roles, including 10+ years in senior engineering leadership across multiple teams or disciplines

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent experience

  • Demonstrated hands-on fluency in AI-assisted and agentic engineering practice

  • Enterprise-level leadership across engineering and quality engineering capability, including strategic direction setting and leading leaders through coaching and accountability.

  • Capability strategy design and maturity uplift at scale, including workforce planning across engineering and quality disciplines.

  • Governance of enterprise engineering standards across engineering, testing, security, reliability, and deployment, with genuine enforcement authority

  • Systems thinking across complex technology environments, with ownership of technical debt strategy and systemic risk management.

  • Proven ability to align Engineering, Quality Engineering, Platform, Design and Delivery practice to reduce friction and improve outcomes.

  • Executive-level influence and decision support through governance forums

Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.

  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.

  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.

  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Applications close on 22nd of September

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

title: Jewellery General Foreman
description:
The job scope of a Jewelry Maker Foreman involves overseeing and managing the production of jewelry within a workshop or manufacturing environment. Here are some key responsibilities and tasks associated with this role:


Production Management:

Supervise and coordinate the activities of jewelry makers and craftsmen in the workshop.

Plan and organize workflow to meet production schedules and deadlines.

Ensure that production processes are efficient, and quality standards are met.


Quality Control:

Inspect finished jewelry pieces to ensure they meet design specifications and quality standards.

Implement and enforce quality control measures to address any issues during the production process.

Collaborate with designers and other stakeholders to maintain high-quality standards.


Training and Development:

Train new jewelry makers on production processes, techniques, and quality standards.

Provide ongoing training and development opportunities for existing staff to enhance their skills.

Ensure that the team stays updated on industry trends and new techniques.


Resource Management:

Manage and allocate resources, including materials, tools, and equipment, to ensure smooth production.

Monitor inventory levels and reorder supplies as needed.

Optimize resource utilization to minimize waste and maximize efficiency.


Safety and Compliance:

Ensure that all safety protocols and regulations are followed in the workshop.

Stay informed about industry regulations and compliance requirements.


Cost Management:

Monitor production costs and work towards cost-effective solutions.

Identify areas for cost reduction without compromising quality.


Continuous Improvement:

Drive continuous improvement initiatives in the production process.

Seek opportunities to enhance efficiency, quality, and overall productivity.

The Jewelry Maker Foreman plays a crucial role in ensuring that the jewelry production process runs smoothly, meeting both quality and deadline requirements. They need a combination of technical skills, leadership abilities, and a strong understanding of jewelry production techniques.

title: AI Data Platform Engineer — Build Lakehouse Pipelines

Candidates should have strong programming in Python/Java, SQL proficiency, and experience with Spark. The role offers training opportunities and a path to technical leadership for senior engineers.

title: Senior Engineer - Wet Utilities
description:
Hydraulic and Hydrological modelling

  • Lead and manage hydraulic and hydrological engineering projects from conceptualization to completion, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery.
  • Conduct thorough research and analysis to design and optimize hydraulic and hydrological systems, including water supply networks, wastewater treatment facilities, stormwater management systems, and river engineering projects.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop detailed designs, technical specifications, and construction plans, considering factors such as water quality, flow rates, pressure levels, and environmental impact.
  • Perform hydraulic and hydrological modelling and simulations using specialized software to predict system performance, identify potential issues, and propose effective solutions.
  • Conduct site visits and inspections to assess existing infrastructure, identify areas for improvement, and propose modifications or upgrades as necessary.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports, presentations, and documentation to communicate project progress, findings, and recommendations to stakeholders, clients, and regulatory bodies.
  • Stay up to date with emerging trends and advancements in hydraulic and hydrological engineering, actively seeking opportunities to apply innovative technologies and methodologies in project designs.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, offering support and expertise to ensure their professional development and project success.
  • Collaborate with external contractors, consultants, and suppliers to ensure the timely delivery of materials, equipment, and services required for project execution.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols and regulations, promoting a culture of safety within the team and on project sites.

Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of hydraulic and hydrological engineering principles, practices, and methodologies.
  • Proficiency in hydraulic and hydrological modelling software, such as Mike Plus, MIKE SHE, HEC RAS, Inforworks ICM, SewerGems, ArcGIS, SWMM etc.
  • Strong ability to analyze complex hydraulic and hydrological systems and problem-solve to develop effective solutions.
  • Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage time efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to diverse audiences.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, ensuring the highest quality in design calculations, technical drawings, and reports.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, demonstrating strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in computer-aided design (CAD) software, such as AutoDesk Civil3D, AutoCAD or Bentley MicroStation.
  • Strong understanding of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, such as SMHI, Svenskt Vatten, Trafikverket EN, ISO, AWWA, or local municipalities codes.
  • Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and effectively manage multiple concurrent tasks.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Hydraulic Engineering, Hydrology, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Professionally qualification such as Chartered Engineer from ICE-UK, CIWEM or progressing towards Chartership.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in hydraulic and hydrological engineering, with a proven track record of successful project delivery.
  • Experience working on large-scale hydraulic and hydrological engineering projects, such as water distribution systems, wastewater treatment plants, flood management projects, or river engineering projects.
  • Strong knowledge of environmental impact assessment processes and sustainable design practices.
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools.
  • Experience with hydraulic and hydrological laboratory testing and analysis is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in computer software applications, such as Microsoft Office Suite and hydraulic and hydrological modelling software.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting and financial management as it relates to engineering projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and innovatively.

Conclusion: In conclusion, the Senior Hydraulic and Hydrological Engineer job description highlights the critical role that these professionals play in the design, analysis, and implementation of hydraulic and hydrological systems. With a focus on optimizing fluid flow, maintaining safety standards, and ensuring environmental sustainability, Senior Hydraulic and Hydrological Engineers are essential for a wide range of industries, including construction, civil engineering, and water resource management. This role is a challenging and rewarding one that plays a crucial part in urban development and infrastructure projects. It requires a high level of expertise and a commitment to staying up-to-date with the latest innovations and developments in the field. The successful candidate will be a key player in delivering high-quality, innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Senior Administration Officer - Inpatient Services
description:
About the role

Mater has an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic Senior Administration Officer to join the Inpatients Administration Team working part-time as a ward clerk in the Mater Private Hospital South Brisbane.

This Senior Administration Officer role is a permanent part-time opportunity (56 hours per fortnight) and will see you working varied day shifts 630 – 1500 and every 2nd Saturday 800 - 1200. Flexibility in availability will provide opportunities for additional shifts.

Your experience and organizational skills will see you become an integral part of the team that is committed to delivering outstanding care and improving the experience and outcomes for patients.

Salary: $39.79 - $44.25 per hour plus superannuation and access to not-for-profit salary packaging up to $15,900 + access to many staff benefits!

What you’ll be doing

Key Accountabilities and experience required for this role include but are not limited to:

  • Manage, organize, and provide confidential administrative support to the various wards ensuring areas are efficiently managed, representing Mater with strong customer focus to staff, patients and visitors
  • Ability to respond competently in emergency situations, remaining calm and composed and to ‘think on your feet.’
  • Performing administrative functions as required, in accordance with departmental policies and procedures working closely with the Nursing Unit Manager and Clinical Team
  • Ensure effective, accurate and timely communications with staff and clients, communicating with sensitivity and discretion

title: Account Management Lead
description:
We are looking for an experienced Account Management Lead to strengthen our Client Partnership function and help drive the stability, performance, and growth of our existing client portfolio.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining client management, team leadership, executive reporting, and cross-functional coordination. The successful candidate will initially work closely with the Client Partnership Director while progressively taking broader ownership of the Account Management function.

The role is particularly suited to someone who is comfortable operating in a fast-moving IT outsourcing environment, can bring structure to ambiguity, and is able to lead both people and stakeholders with confidence.

1. Account Management Leadership

  • Lead and coach a team of Account Managers responsible for existing client relationships, retention, renewals, and account growth.
  • Provide hands-on guidance to Account Managers on client situations, commercial discussions, escalations, QBRs, renewals, and upselling opportunities.
  • Establish clear priorities and help the team translate broader business objectives into practical account actions.
  • Maintain visibility across the client portfolio and proactively identify accounts requiring management attention.
  • Support the development of Account Managers through regular coaching, review, and structured follow-up.
  • Build greater ownership, confidence, and independence within the Account Management team while providing the level of support needed to ensure consistent execution.

2. Client Partnership & Account Governance

  • Maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders and step into strategic or sensitive client discussions when required.
  • Oversee account health, client satisfaction, renewal risks, delivery concerns, and expansion opportunities.
  • Ensure appropriate governance is in place across key accounts, including regular business reviews, escalation management, action tracking, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Help Account Managers navigate complex client situations while balancing client expectations with delivery and commercial realities.
  • Drive proactive engagement rather than reactive account management.
  • Ensure risks and concerns are identified early, communicated clearly, and followed through until resolution.

3. Leadership & Executive Reporting

  • Provide clear, concise, and decision-oriented reporting to the leadership team on account performance, portfolio health, risks, renewals, upsell pipeline, and key priorities.
  • Consolidate information from multiple teams and convert operational detail into meaningful management insights.
  • Highlight issues early, recommend actions, and ensure follow-through.
  • Prepare materials, summaries, and talking points for management reviews and leadership discussions.
  • Communicate confidently with senior leadership and provide clear recommendations when decisions or escalation are required.
  • Maintain strong visibility of overall portfolio status and ensure leadership has an accurate view of both current performance and forward-looking risks.

4. Cross-Department Alignment

  • Act as a strong connector between Account Management, Delivery, Project Management, Sales, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and other supporting functions.
  • Drive alignment when responsibilities, ownership, or next steps are unclear.
  • Ensure client commitments are understood internally and that internal dependencies are actively followed up.
  • Facilitate difficult conversations where different teams have competing priorities.
  • Bring structure, accountability, and momentum to topics involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Escalate appropriately while also taking ownership of driving practical resolution.

5. Team Stabilization & Operational Improvement

  • Help establish a stable and effective operating rhythm within the Account Management team.
  • Identify gaps in processes, ownership, communication, or governance and implement practical improvements.
  • Maintain composure and direction when working with incomplete information or changing priorities.
  • Create clarity for the team during periods of organizational or operational change.
  • Balance hands-on involvement with developing greater independence and accountability within the Account Management team.
  • Strengthen consistency in account governance, reporting, follow-up, and internal communication.
  • Minimum 5+ years of professional experience in an IT outsourcing / software development services company, with strong exposure to client-facing account management, customer success, business development, delivery coordination, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience managing strategic B2B client relationships within an IT outsourcing environment.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, ideally at near-native or fully professional proficiency.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or closely coaching Account Managers or other client-facing team members.
  • Strong executive communication and management reporting skills, including the ability to consolidate operational information into clear risks, priorities, recommendations, and action plans for senior leadership.
  • Strong understanding of IT outsourcing engagement models such as staff augmentation, dedicated teams, managed services, and project-based delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across Account Management, Delivery, Project Management, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Sales, and other internal functions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to drive alignment where ownership or responsibilities are unclear.
  • Highly structured and able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, risks, and dependencies simultaneously.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and able to create clarity, direction, and momentum without requiring fully defined processes.
  • Strong judgment in handling client escalations, commercial discussions, delivery challenges, and sensitive internal situations.

Strongly Preferred

  • Previous experience in an Account Management Lead, Client Partnership, Customer Success Lead, or similar leadership position within an IT outsourcing company.
  • At least 2 years of direct experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Client Partnership, or another client-facing commercial role.
  • Experience managing and developing a small Account Management team.
  • Experience overseeing account portfolios covering renewals, retention, upselling, resource fulfilment, delivery risks, and profitability.
  • Familiarity with commercial topics including pricing, contract extensions, change requests, rate negotiations, and account growth.
  • Experience preparing and leading QBRs, client governance meetings, portfolio reviews, and executive management reporting.
  • Experience working with international clients and multicultural teams across APAC, Europe, the US, or other global markets.

BENEFITS

  • International working environment with AI-driven strategic direction.
  • 20 days of annual leave – Hybrid working mode.
  • Premium healthcare package with PVI and comprehensive annual health check-ups
  • Competitive salary & 13th salary bonus
  • Lunch allowance to fuel your productivity.
  • Engaging company culture with fun activities
  • Global collaboration – Work with both Vietnamese and international colleagues.

title: Data Engineering Lead
company: Cardiff and Vale University Health Board
description:
Be a senior member of the Data & Analytics team (within the Insight & Data Services department), responsible for leading the team that develops and maintains the local data warehouse and data acquisition solutions and supports delivery of the National Data Resource (NDR). Be responsible for the architectural design, development and management of the local data warehouse environment used for data analytics, publishing and reporting, and responsible for the delivery of WAST data and information into the NDR to support agreed strategic plans. Be an NHS data specialist, with hand-on expertise and knowledge encompassing the extensive range of operational, clinical, managerial and Government performance datasets and national submissions. Work with the Head of Data & Analytics to formulate the strategic direction of data storage, acquisition and processing for WAST. This includes evolving the architecture of the current local portfolio and aligning with the emerging National Data Resource. Have an excellent eye for quality to ensure the highest levels of integrity and governance across all of the appropriate data and data quality management. Have strong team management skills and mentor/develop staff to ensure the whole team can contribute. The post holder will manage direct reports and their teams and have cross site management responsibility. You will be able to find a full Job description and Person Specification attached within the supporting documents or effective positive relationships internally, for example with departments, programmes and projects, and externally with key partners including NHS Wales organisations, local authorities and Welsh Government, and suppliers, to ensure the potential of insight from WAST intelligence is maximised. Work collaboratively with other NHS Wales organisations and Welsh Government Leads to agree and support their data and reporting requirements. Work collaboratively with the National Data Resource Programme to identify areas of commonality and alignment of service provision Ensure that procedures and protocols are complied with, particularly around information governance, data protection and use of patient-identifiable information. Enable communication, planning and sharing of good practice within the team. Communicate complex technical information relating to queries, updates, faults and changes to the Data Warehouse system with non-experts in WAST in a way that is understandable, persuasive and overcoming barriers to understanding or acceptance of this information. Communicate highly complex or technical proposed changes to Senior management, the directorate and team members where there could be resistance to change, due to impact on the service. Engage in highly complex, technical discussions and ideas regarding changes in direction or strategic decisions within senior management meetings, with heads of information, and other senior level meetings and groups, within NHS Wales and with external stakeholders. This will involve using skills of influencing, persuading, motivational, and negotiating. Exercise own judgment based on the interpretation of highly complex facts, figures and situations which require the analysis, interpretation and comparison of a range of options for the purpose of service planning and delivery. Create reports from internal and external sources, that allow evaluation of Information Services plans and services. In-depth knowledge and experience of programming languages, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and scripting languages, and ability to write complex SQL queries, stored procedures. Work with data providers/owners on the acquisition of additional/new data into the local data warehouse and suitable and compliant onward sharing to the national warehouse. Undertake horizon scanning to identify new, valuable data sources. Diagnose complex data/processing problems or inefficiencies, suggesting and providing solutions. Ensure data is made available in a timely manner, establishing automation of reports and processes whenever possible. Establish a standard approach for data science projects. Develop methodologies for the analysis and interpretation of data to support service redesign and research, including prediction of demand, conducting what if analysis, identifying risks, exploring gains in productivity and efficiencies, and discovering opportunities to improve clinical quality. Within the national data warehouse and acquisition areas, monitor and review plans which may be long term in nature, and ensure they are adjusted for changes in local need and in response to changes in national policy, Welsh Government guidelines and best practice. Plan and prioritise own work to ensure effective support to all areas and delivery of key objectives. Promote to Directorates and departments, the opportunity and value of the national data warehouse and to be proactive and influential in WASTs contribution to the design and delivery of the NDRs strategic and operational plans. Support the planning and development of major organisational change projects which may be contentious and impact across the whole of WAST, requiring the post holder to gain agreement from all grades of staff in the organisation. Formulate long term, strategic plans around the development of the WAST Data Warehouse, in conjunction with the National Data Resource or other cloud data storage opportunities. This will involve understanding and evaluating the available options and formulating the best solution for the long‑term which may involve uncertainty. The postholder will require standard keyboard skills for regular use of Microsoft packages, Teams, software systems and Visio. The postholders duties will not require any direct contact with patients however any contact would be incidental. Responsibility to lead on implementation of a range of national data warehouse and acquisition service policy, service development and corporate initiatives which may impact across the organisation as agreed with the Head of Data & Analytics and the Assistant Director of Digital Services. Work across the organisation(s) as appropriate in relation to collaborative schemes for delivery of joint strategy, planning and service developments. As appropriate, identify any engagement issues where Insight & Data Services (IDS) input is required. Support the implementation of WASTs policies and procedures that facilitate the development of a learning culture. Participate in the learning and development agenda within Insight & Data Services. Manage any developments of the local and national data warehouse and data acquisition services by contributing to business cases and bids for funding to add additional functionality that may enhance the Insight & Data Services portfolio. Liaise with external suppliers to ensure service delivery is in line with agreed or contractual terms. Comply with all legal, regulatory and WASTs requirements including policies, standing financial instructions, standing orders and procedures. Work with the Information Governance team on ensuring GDPR and Data Protection compliance where necessary. Take responsibility for expenses within the team and sign off where appropriate. Research and procure suitable training for the team, providing value for money and high-quality resources. Responsible as line manager for the Data Engineering function, with responsibility for recruitment and selection, staff appraisals, managing sickness absence, disciplinary and grievance matters, personal and career development and departmental workload and allocation. To both lead and support relevant training and education initiatives in order to facilitate service improvement and skills development at team level, and knowledge sharing to help develop the competency of others by encouraging and developing teamwork. Ensure that data engineers manage portfolios of tasks and that projects are planned, managed and delivered effectively. Promote a culture where staff feel empowered and accountable for the service they provide, and managers are supported to lead, motivate and develop staff who feel valued and respected. Safeguard the integrity of data contained within the national data warehouse and acquisition services by maintaining the systems security patching schedules, and to include the robust encryption and pseudonymisation of data held within the Department. Develop and implement plans and procedures for the provision of local and national data warehouse services within an ITIL framework as part of any NHS Wales Service Management Strategy. Lead on any development plans where there is a requirement for data engineering and warehousing involvement in line with the IMTP, Annual Plan and any New Service Requests. Ensure that both electronic and hard copy documentation relating to data engineering services is stored appropriately and accessible to those who may require it. Develop and use appropriate resources including online information resources such as databases, shared files, internet/intranet information and evidence bases to support the development of service planning skills, knowledge and expertise both within and external to the Insight & Data Services department. Responsible for the overall maintenance and operation of the WAST data warehouse and systems and processes, including taking responsibility for updates and setting the strategy. The post holder is responsible for the service planning and improvement qualitative and quantitative audits across Insight & Data Services to evaluate the impact of service planning and improvement services and relevant research to inform future service improvements. Ensure an evidence-based approach to service redesign and consider the outcomes of relevant audit and/or evaluation work on all aspects of the role. The post holder is expected to regularly research and explore opportunities for innovation and good practice in their portfolio area. Working autonomously, responsible for the day‑to‑day organisation of own diary and tasks within the post holders portfolio, balancing the need for proactive service development and portfolio management against the reactive demand of organisational priorities and timescales. The post holder will be guided by key organisational policies, NHS Wales, specific local and national guidelines, advising on how these should be interpreted and implemented within specific projects. The post holder will need to assimilate and summarise complex documents, compare facts and analyse situational data from a range of sources, develop options and assess risks and opportunities to Insight & Data Services in order to inform decision-making.

  • Advanced qualification or equivalent experience in Data Warehouse Management or Data Engineering
  • Advanced SQL query writing ability and Integration Services package creation.
  • Extensive experience and knowledge in the data warehouse development cycle including change control, documentation, upgrades and archiving., ITIL qualified or demonstrable equivalent experience
  • In-depth knowledge of NHS data sets
  • Big Data analytic technologies, including evaluating developing technologies and solutions, designing and developing distributed processing of large data sets, data mining, scalable machine learning., Previous NHS managerial experience, including experience in managing and planning across multiple teams.
  • Experience of managing change within a complex environment.
  • In-depth knowledge and understanding of WG NHS policies and IM& T strategies.
  • Demonstrable success in building, leading, motivating and developing teams.
  • Significant experience of managing performance monitoring and reporting processes across multiple teams.
  • Significant experience of working with staff at all levels within the NHS and external partner agencies., Ability to analyse and appropriately present highly complex information.
  • Able to interpret relevant legislation and national guidance.
  • Ability to communicate verbally and in writing in a manner which is clear, fluent and persuasive.
  • Ability to work on own initiative and organise workload to operate effectively.
  • Ability to prioritise, make judgments and decisions, problem solve., Welsh Language Skills are desirable levels 1 to 5 in understanding, speaking, reading, and writing in Welsh (please delete as appropriate)
  • The Welsh Ambulance Services University NHS Trust is an ambitious organisation undergoing significant transformation with a new Ambulance Performance Framework having been introduced in 2025., As such, significant data warehousing developments are required that will make a significant difference to staff and the people of Wales, including more focus on patient outcome data, linked information across NHS Wales patient records and services, and more connected intelligence on clinical quality and practice.
  • This post holder will lead the data engineering team, be part of the leadership team for the Data & Analytics function and help develop the data strategy - making recommendations on the cloud migration approach and adoption of new data storage, processing and analytical tooling and technologies.
  • #RemarkablePeople Our workforce is made up of over 4,000 remarkable people who contribute to the delivery of world-class patient care across Wales, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Whether you work in a patient-facing role or within our range of support services, the work that you do enables us to provide high quality care, wherever and whenever we're needed. The Trust recognises the need for its workforce to represent the diversity of the population it serves across the whole of Wales and seeks to create an environment where diversity is celebrated and inclusivity matters. We are also keen to break down any barriers into the Trust, and would encourage applications from under-represented groups, including those from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, LGBTQ+ communities and disability groups. Careers within the Welsh Ambulance Services University NHS Trust are diverse and varied, with opportunities arising right across the service. Whatever your skills and background, you're sure to find a career with us which is fulfilling, challenging, and rewarding.

title: [쿠팡] 로켓배송 셀렉션 플래닝 운영기획 (Platform Biz Intelligence)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Selection Strategy Operation팀은 마켓에서의 고객의 수요가 높은 상품을 타겟팅 및 분석하는 팀입니다. 마켓 데이터를 바탕으로 구체적인 Selection 계획을 수립하고, 이를 위한 타겟 Pool을 선정하여 우선 순위를 제공합니다. 쿠팡 Retail Selection의 빠른 확장을 위한 Category별로 기준을 운영합니다. 효율적인 Retail Selection 타겟을 확보하기 위하여 프로세스를 수립하고, 개선합니다.

직무 소개

Selection Strategy Operation은 고객 수요와 시장 데이터를 기반으로 쿠팡 Retail Selection의 성장 전략을 수립하고 실행하는 조직입니다. 본 역할은 데이터 기반의 의사결정을 통해 Selection 확대를 주도하고, Selection Identification운영의 프로세스를 설계하고 개선하며, 다양한 이해관계자와의 협업을 통해 비즈니스 목표 달성을 지원합니다. 타겟팅 고도화, 운영 표준화 및 Playbook 구축을 통해 조직의 실행력을 높이고, 신규 비즈니스 및 카테고리 확장 과정에서 핵심적인 역할을 수행하게 됩니다.

업무 내용

  • 주요 제조사 및 Brand사 등의 마켓조사를 통한 Sourcing 전략을 제시하고 비즈니스 우선순위를 고려하여 Brand, Selection 타겟 선정 및 제공
  • 내/외부 환경분석 결과 기반의 Selection Planning 시사점을 도출하고 Selection 운영 관련 주요 유관부서와의 원활한 커뮤니케이션을 진행
  • 데이터 기반으로 프로세스 병목을 제거하고 Insight 도출을 통해 셀렉션 프로세스의 관리 및 개선안을 제시
  • Selection 타겟팅 최적화를 수행할 수 있는 Playbook을 만들고 신규 비즈니스에 따른 운영 업무를 확장

자격 요건

  • 유통사 및 제조사에 대한 경험이 6년 이상 있으신 분
  • 상품 전략, 마켓 리서치 등 전략/기획 실무 경력을 가지신 분
  • 유관부서와의 원활한 협업 및 커뮤니케이션 능력을 지닌 분
  • 우수한 MS 오피스 능력을 갖추신 분

우대 사항

  • SQL 사용이 가능하고 다양한 DB 데이터에 익숙하신 분
  • 온/오프라인에서 상품전략, 소싱 전략 등의 경험이 있으신 분

  • 조직 / 인력 관리 경험 혹은 역량이 높으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: DV Cleared Data Engineers Wanted - Mid to Senior AWS Data Platforms

title: Dog Sitter

Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— Orange County, CA Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

This is a flexible, part-time independent contractor position where all jobs are voluntary and you set your availability and service area, and we match you with clients.   • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role - what’s your purpose?

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our newly formed Business Analytics team, working closely with Engineering, Operations & Product teams to design & build analytical models for both our premium enterprise clients and internal data users to drive impactful business decisions and enable self-service analytics.

The role will need to manage data pipelines, quality and delivery methods across multiple projects. You'll work closely with various stakeholders to understand and identify the correct data for the proper use case. This role should have a strong level of confidence in managing and optimising data models and processes (with and without LLMs) to ensure data products are flexible, pragmatic, and fit for purpose.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities - What you will be doing?

  • Managing the development and maintenance of ETL pipelines and data models using tools like SQL, dbt, and Airflow.

  • Creating & maintaining interactive dashboards and leading user engagement of them with both our largest clients and internal users in Power BI & Tableau.

  • Transforming, analysing & optimising large sets of quantitative and qualitative data.

  • Taking ownership of reporting processes to ensure accuracy and reliability for the end-users with strong governance and version control.

  • Testing, unpicking & refining areas such as analytical scoring, user behaviour, product performance to identify trends & opportunities and set up the most relevant KPIs.

  • Collaborating with product managers, engineers, and ops analysts to provide data-driven insights from well-designed data models.

Who are we looking for?

  • You have strong expertise in SQL & Python for relational database systems such as Redshift/S3 and SQL Server.

  • You have several years of strong experience with ETL/ELT processes and APIs with tools such as dbt, Airflow, and Talend.

  • You are proficient in using BI visualisation tools, in particular Power BI, Tableau & Metabase.

  • You have good knowledge of data modelling & transformation techniques within data pipelines.

  • You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.

  • You love building products as part of a cross-functional team, focused on an iterative, outcome-driven approach.

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable expressing your ideas and listening to multiple different audiences.

  • You have a positive attitude and are keen to learn new skills in order to succeed.

Not sure you meet every requirement?

Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.

We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.

title: Director, GTM Enablement
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, GTM Enablement based in Canada.

As Director, GTM Enablement, you will shape the enablement strategy that helps sales, BDR, and customer success teams perform at their best. You’ll partner closely with GTM leadership to turn performance signals, funnel data, and frontline observations into practical programs that improve business outcomes. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, from diagnosing performance gaps and reviewing customer conversations to building onboarding, messaging, coaching, and lifecycle programs. You’ll establish scalable enablement systems that managers can sustain independently rather than relying on one-off training. As the function grows, you’ll build and lead an enablement team spanning technical enablement and field coaching. You’ll work across Sales, BDR, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations in a collaborative environment where autonomy and measurable impact are highly valued.

Accountabilities:

  • Act as a strategic thought partner to GTM leadership, translating early observations, performance concerns, and business priorities into clearly diagnosed problems, practical solutions, and measurable enablement programs.
  • Diagnose performance gaps using funnel data, conversation intelligence, rep feedback, manager input, and collaboration with Revenue Operations, identifying the specific behaviors or process gaps affecting performance.
  • Build and own scalable onboarding programs for new GTM hires, with a clear focus on accelerating ramp time and ensuring new team members develop the knowledge, skills, and confidence required to perform effectively.
  • Develop sharp, practical messaging and positioning that sellers can confidently use in customer conversations, collaborating with Marketing and technical subject matter experts to translate complex offerings into compelling sales narratives.
  • Design and deliver enablement programs across the full GTM lifecycle, including pipeline generation, discovery, stage conversion, deal progression, customer onboarding, retention, expansion, and post-sale effectiveness.
  • Launch programs in partnership with functional leaders, establishing structured checkpoints, adoption measures, and success metrics from the beginning and continuously evaluating their impact on business performance.
  • Equip Sales, BDR, and Customer Success managers with the frameworks, tools, and coaching approaches required to reinforce and sustain enablement programs after launch.
  • Build and lead the enablement organization, establishing the strategy and operating model for technical enablement, field coaching, and broader GTM capability development.
  • Use conversation intelligence platforms such as Gong or Chorus to review calls, identify patterns, and translate observations into targeted coaching plans and performance improvements.
  • Measure enablement initiatives against rep performance and business outcomes, continuously improving successful programs and discontinuing initiatives that fail to deliver meaningful impact.

    • Requirements

    • 6–8+ years of experience across sales, sales leadership, enablement, training, instructional design, or related functions, ideally including experience within B2B SaaS.
    • Sufficient experience working directly within or alongside revenue organizations to establish credibility with sales and customer-facing teams from day one.
    • Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring, or developing people, with the ability to build a high-performing enablement function as the team grows.
    • Proven track record of designing and delivering enablement programs that generated measurable improvements in rep performance, productivity, conversion, ramp time, or other business outcomes.
    • Hands-on experience with conversation intelligence platforms such as Gong or Chorus, including the ability to independently review calls, identify recurring patterns, and turn findings into actionable coaching programs.
    • Strong ability to work directly with funnel and performance data, either independently or in partnership with Revenue Operations, and use quantitative insights to guide enablement priorities.
    • Strong understanding of sales processes, methodologies, full-funnel metrics, and the factors that influence pipeline generation, conversion, deal progression, onboarding, retention, and expansion.
    • Experience enabling post-sale teams such as Customer Success, or a demonstrated willingness and ability to expand enablement beyond the sales organization.
    • Excellent communication, facilitation, writing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with frontline representatives, managers, executives, and cross-functional partners.
    • Strong ability to write positioning and messaging from the ground up rather than simply package existing marketing materials.
    • Comfortable working with complex or technical products and partnering with subject matter experts to translate technical concepts into practical, customer-facing guidance.
    • Entrepreneurial and highly autonomous mindset, with the initiative to identify problems, form a point of view, build solutions, and drive implementation without waiting for detailed specifications.
    • Data-driven, diagnostic approach with strong problem-solving skills and a focus on building programs that create lasting organizational capability.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead and shape the GTM enablement strategy across Sales, BDR, and Customer Success.
      • High-impact leadership position with direct influence on rep performance, ramp time, pipeline conversion, and broader revenue outcomes.
      • Opportunity to build and develop an enablement team spanning technical enablement and field coaching.
      • Cross-functional exposure and collaboration across Sales, BDR, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations.
      • Significant autonomy to identify business problems, design solutions, and establish scalable enablement programs.
      • Opportunity to work in a growing B2B SaaS environment where enablement is positioned as a strategic business function.
      • Role based in Canada, with the opportunity to contribute to a globally oriented GTM organization.

title: Med Tech - Burlington Creek - 7p-7a
description:
7p-7a

12 Hour Shifts!

Must have active certification.

Medication Technician Position Summary

Under the general direction of the Executive Director and Wellness Director, primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to, administer medications to the residents in a safe, accurate, and timely manner.

Qualifications and Required Experience for Medication Technician:

  • Excellent communication skills and a compassion for older adults
  • Must possess valid driver’s license

Primary Responsibilities for Medication Technician:

  • Administers medications according to the physician order on the medication administration record (MAR)
  • Documents medications administered on the MAR in accordance with company policy
  • Checks MARs immediately after administration and prior to end of shift to ensure documentation is complete and accurate
  • Conducts change of shift report with oncoming/outgoing shift personnel
  • Maintains security of medication cart and narcotic keys during entire shift. Conduct narcotic count at the beginning and end of every shift in accordance with company policy and procedure.
  • Provides all necessary care and services to assigned residents and assists other caregivers as needed
  • Works collaboratively with peers and other team members
  • Provides assistance with Activities of Daily living such as with bathing, dressing, personal hygiene (includes shaving, oral care, nail care, hair care, foot care), toileting, eating and ambulation/mobility
  • Maintains professional demeanor at all times when interacting with residents and families.
  • Reports any suspected or witnessed instances of verbal, mental, or physical abuse to licensed staff immediately
  • Utilizes safe transfer techniques when assisting residents with mobility
  • Participates in and supports the resident-centered activities program
  • Care for sensory enhancement devices such as eyeglasses and hearing aids
  • Completes housekeeping tasks such as bed-making, linen changes, vacuuming, emptying trash, and cleaning bathroom
  • Washing residents’ laundry as needed
  • Escorts residents and coordinates internal transportation needs
  • Assists residents with personal correspondence/telephone usage when requested
  • Observes and reports changes in residents’ physical condition and cognitive/emotional status to Wellness Director or charge nurse, as needed
  • Conducts room checks and resident rounds
  • Monitors for environmental safety hazards
  • Assists in a variety of tasks related to dining (escort residents to dining room, assist with set up and clean tables, serve meals, bus tables, etc.)
  • Assists residents without swallowing difficulty with eating
  • Responds to emergencies in a prompt and calm manner. Immediately reports such emergencies to the charge nurse.
  • Attends and participates in staff meetings and mandatory in-services
  • Documents provision of services on company forms
  • Uses tactful, diplomatic communication techniques in potentially sensitive or emotionally charged situations
  • Follows-up with appropriate staff, residents, or other individuals regarding reported complaints, problems and concerns
  • Acts as ambassador and public relations representative to guests and other off-campus visitors
  • Communicates with physicians and third party specialists, such as homecare providers, labs and hospice professionals
  • Copies special paperwork or forms
  • Demonstrates an appreciation of the heritage, values, and wisdom of the residents and an understanding of the aging process
  • Collaborates with associates in other departments to assure necessary care and services are provided
  • Participates in projects or committees as assigned
  • Performs related duties as assigned

Company Overview

Founded in 1979, American House Senior Living Communities’ vision is to provide high-quality housing for senior at a price affordable for retirees and their families. That vision of excellence has endured for nearly 40 years and expanded to serve residents at a number of senior housing communities. Our mission is to enrich the lives of those we serve, providing an environment that fosters meaningful relationships. Our vision is to be an innovative senior housing company that created sustainable excellence and stakeholder value, with an unparalleled commitment to passionate care provided by compassionate people.
