title: Sr. Desktop Support Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Desktop Support Specialist based in India.

This role is an opportunity to provide high-level technical support across a distributed, remote environment while serving as a key escalation point for complex end-user technology issues. You will troubleshoot laptops, desktops, peripherals, operating systems, applications, and mobile devices across multiple platforms. The position combines hands-on support with Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Active Directory, endpoint security, and IT service management. You will also contribute to hardware lifecycle planning, ticket analytics, documentation, and continuous improvement of support processes. As a senior technical resource, you will mentor junior and outsourced team members and help drive consistent service delivery. You will work closely with employees and stakeholders, balancing technical expertise with strong customer service and communication. The role is well suited to an experienced support professional who enjoys solving challenging problems and taking ownership of escalated issues.

Accountabilities:

  • Provide Tier I, II, and III troubleshooting for laptops, desktops, workstation hardware, peripherals, Windows operating systems, Microsoft applications, and associated end-user technologies.
  • Deliver advanced remote support and resolve complex technical issues across Windows 11, macOS, iOS, Android, and enterprise applications.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange, SharePoint, Endpoint, and Teams.
  • Manage and support endpoint configuration, monitoring, security, and inventory tools across the end-user device environment.
  • Support Microsoft Azure and Intune environments while maintaining working knowledge of AWS and core networking principles.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Active Directory, Group Policy, user accounts, access management, and related Windows Server environments across cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Manage antivirus and endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions to help maintain a secure end-user computing environment.
  • Use ITSM and ticketing platforms, preferably ServiceNow, to manage incidents, identify recurring issues, analyze trends, and improve service delivery.
  • Develop basic PowerShell scripts to support Active Directory, Microsoft 365 administration, and routine technical operations.
  • Support enterprise-wide purchasing, planning, deployment, and distribution of laptops and other hardware while following established IT purchasing practices.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge resources for the support team.
  • Analyze ticket data and provide daily updates, reports, and actionable insights to management.
  • Support audio/video conferencing equipment, printers, print services, door security systems, and other infrastructure-related end-user devices.
  • Act as a technical subject matter expert for escalations, coordinating troubleshooting efforts and driving issues through to resolution.
  • Train and mentor junior-level and outsourced support staff while promoting consistent technical and customer service standards.
  • Communicate effectively with end users and stakeholders, including in challenging or high-pressure situations, while maintaining a customer-focused approach.

    • Requirements

    • 7–10 years of hands-on experience in helpdesk, desktop support, or end-user computing within a professional environment.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
    • Expert-level troubleshooting skills across desktop and laptop hardware, workstation operating systems, peripherals, and end-user applications.
    • Strong experience providing advanced remote support and resolving complex end-user issues independently.
    • Proficiency with Windows 11 and macOS environments, with additional experience supporting iOS and Android devices.
    • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting, including Exchange, SharePoint, Endpoint, and Teams.
    • Solid understanding of Active Directory, user administration, access management, Group Policy, and Windows Server fundamentals.
    • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Intune, with basic familiarity with AWS and networking principles.
    • Experience with endpoint security, antivirus, EDR, and device management technologies.
    • Strong understanding of ITSM/ITIL practices and experience working with ticketing platforms, preferably ServiceNow.
    • Experience troubleshooting printers, print services, conferencing equipment, and other workplace technology.
    • Familiarity with remote support tools such as BeyondTrust/Bomgar.
    • Basic PowerShell scripting capabilities for administration and automation tasks.
    • Experience with ticket analysis, trend identification, reporting, and generating actionable service insights.
    • Ability to act as a technical SME, lead escalations, perform root-cause analysis, and drive issues to resolution.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills, combined with excellent customer service and stakeholder management abilities.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, mentor colleagues, and maintain a high standard of service in a fast-paced environment.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work opportunity within India.
      • Full-time position supporting a distributed technology environment.
      • Opportunity to work across a broad range of enterprise technologies, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Active Directory, endpoint security, and ITSM platforms.
      • Exposure to complex technical escalations and opportunities to serve as a senior subject matter expert.
      • Opportunities to mentor junior and outsourced team members and contribute to support-process improvements.

      • Competitive compensation and employee benefits aligned with the local employment package.

title: Architect and Lead Software Engineer
description:
As an Architect and Lead Software Engineer on a large-scale platform of modernization engagement, you will drive the end-to-end architecture from the data layer through the API and services tier to the front-end presentation layer. The client environment spans both Microsoft Azure cloud services and on-premises infrastructure, so you must be equally comfortable designing cloud-native workloads and hybrid integration patterns. You will lead architectural decision-making across multiple workstreams, produce reference architectures and migration roadmaps, and work hands-on with engineering teams to validate designs through prototypes and proofs of concept. This is a high-visibility role that requires you to present architectural options, trade-offs, and recommendations directly to senior technical and business leaders.


What qualifications make you an Aubrant Architect and Lead?

  • You are a full-stack thinker. You see the system, from the user interface to the database, and you design architectures that optimize across all layers rather than shifting complexity from one tier to another.
  • You lead through technical authority. Engineering teams trust your judgment because you combine deep hands-on experience with the ability to articulate clear, defensible rationale for every architectural decision.
  • You are comfortable navigating hybrid environments. You understand that modernization is rarely a clean lift-and-shift; you know how to design transitional architectures that bridge on-premise systems and cloud services without disrupting business operations.
  • You communicate architecture in business terms. When you present to senior leaders, you translate technical trade-offs into cost, risk, timeline, and capability impact.
  • You have a builder's instinct. You validate your designs with working prototypes and proofs of concept, not just diagrams. You believe architecture should be proven, not assumed.
  • You thrive in ambiguity. Legacy modernization is messy; you bring structure, prioritization, and clarity to environments where documentation is sparse and tribal knowledge is the norm.


Responsibilities:


Architecture & Design:

  • Define the target-state architecture for the modernized platform, spanning front-end frameworks, API/services layer, data persistence, integration middleware, and infrastructure (Azure and on-premise).
  • Produce reference architectures, architectural decision records (ADRs), and migration roadmaps that guide engineering teams through phased modernization milestones.
  • Design hybrid integration patterns that allow cloud-native and on-premise components to coexist during transitional phases, including networking, identity, and data synchronization strategies.

Technical Leadership:

  • Lead architectural reviews and design sessions across front-end, back-end, data, and infrastructure workstreams, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with the target architecture.
  • Mentor and guide senior engineers and tech leads on architectural patterns, modernization strategies, and Azure best practices.
  • Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, and platforms; produce decision memos with clear trade-off analysis for leadership review.

Modernization Execution:

  • Conduct legacy system assessments, including codebase analysis, dependency mapping, performance profiling, and data architecture review, to inform modernization sequencing and risk mitigation.
  • Design and validate migration strategies (re-platform, re-architect, re-factor) for individual system components, balancing speed, risk, and long-term maintainability.
  • Build and oversee proofs of concept and reference implementations that de-risk critical architectural decisions before full-scale engineering begins.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Present architectural strategies, options, and progress to senior technical and business leadership, translating complex technical concepts into clear business impact.
  • Collaborate with the client's existing architecture, engineering, and infrastructure teams to align standards, governance, and shared technical direction.
  • Partner with program management to ensure architectural decisions are reflected in delivery plans, resource needs, and risk assessments.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • MUST be proficient in written and spoken English (85%).
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a solutions architect or enterprise architect capacity.
  • Demonstrated mastery of architectural design across the full application stack: front-end (React, Angular, or equivalent modern frameworks), API/services tier (RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures), and data layer (relational databases, NoSQL, data pipelines).
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure cloud services, including App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure DevOps, and Azure Networking (VNets, Private Link, ExpressRoute).
  • Proven experience designing and implementing hybrid architectures that span Azure cloud and on-premise infrastructure, including identity federation (Entra ID/Active Directory), data synchronization, and network connectivity.
  • Expert-level proficiency in API design and integration architecture, including API gateway patterns, service mesh, and enterprise integration patterns for bridging legacy and modern systems.
  • Strong experience with application modernization strategies: monolith decomposition, strangler fig pattern, database migration, and phased re-platforming.
  • Expert-level knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates), and DevOps practices for hybrid environments.
  • Experience with performance and scalability engineering, including load testing, capacity planning, caching strategies, and observability (Application Insights, Grafana, or equivalent).
  • Security architecture expertise, including zero-trust principles, identity and access management, encryption at rest and in transit, and compliance considerations.
  • Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert) are a plus.
  • Experience in life sciences, diagnostics, healthcare, or regulated industries is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts (ETL/ELT, data lakes, data warehousing) is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate effectively when requirements are ambiguous or the path forward is unclear.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams. Aubrant is a client-facing consultancy; every team member must be able to interact confidently with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centered solutions.
  • Willingness to anticipate and adopt innovations in digital and technology practices.

title: Head of Customer Operations
description:
Mission:

To own the customer at Skip - every escalation, every sensitive decision, every broken process - and turn what we learn into systems that make Skip the easiest lender in the country to deal with.

Skip is scaling fast. Volumes are multiples of last year, we have major distribution partnerships live, and every one of those loans is someone’s home. As we grow, the number of customer moments that really matter - the delayed settlement, the declined application, the hardship call, the case that does not fit the policy - grows with us. Today too many of those moments land on the Head of Operations.

This role exists to change that. It gives Skip a single, senior owner of the customer: someone accountable for both the hard individual calls and the systemic fixes that stop those calls recurring. It is real leverage for the Head of Operations, and real ownership for you.

This is not a complaints-handling role and it is not a role for someone who wants to administer a queue. It is for an operator who takes the customer’s side, makes the call, and then rebuilds the process so nobody has to make that call again.

About the role:

You will lead Customer Operations at Skip, with our Operations Lead and Home Loan Specialists reporting to you. Between them, your team touches the customer at every stage of the journey - first conversation, application, approval, settlement and servicing. You own how that feels.

You are the decision-maker on escalated and sensitive customer matters. Complaints, hardship, distressed settlements, cases where the policy answer and the right answer are not the same. You will make fast, commercially sound calls with real money and real reputation attached, know when to spend to protect a customer relationship and when to hold the line, and be able to explain your reasoning to a founder, a funder or a regulator without flinching.

The other half of the job is building. Every escalation is a signal. You will root-cause them, redesign the process, rewrite the communication, work with Product and Engineering to automate the fix, and then measure whether it actually worked. Over time the escalation volume should fall because of what you built, not because you got faster at firefighting.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, high-calibre team and grow it as we scale, but you will also stay close to the work - reading the real conversations, taking the hardest calls yourself, and making sure the systems you design hold up in practice. At Skip, our leaders roll up their sleeves and contribute alongside their teams.

It is a high agency, high ownership role in a business that moves quickly. If you want a defined lane and a stable playbook, this is not it. If you want to own the customer end of a fast-growing lender and build the function that carries it to the next stage, it is.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the customer

  • Own the end-to-end customer experience across the lending journey - from first

  • contact through application, settlement and servicing

  • Be the final decision-maker within Operations on escalated customer issues, sensitive matters and exceptions - make the call and own the outcome

  • Own complaints end-to-end: intake, investigation, resolution, response and reporting - meeting our internal dispute resolution obligations and, more importantly, leaving customers feeling heard

  • Own hardship, distressed settlements and other high-sensitivity situations with both empathy and rigour

  • Own the customer measures that matter - NPS and CSAT, complaint volumes, repeat contact rate, time to resolution - and be accountable for moving them

Build and improve the process

  • Root-cause every escalation and close it out with a structural fix - a repeat escalation is a process failure, not a customer problem

  • Map, redesign and continuously improve customer-facing processes across origination, settlement and servicing, removing friction wherever you find it

  • Own our customer communications -the templates, the tone, the timing - so customers are told what is happening before they must ask

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to turn manual workarounds into product, and to introduce automation and AI-driven efficiency where it improves the customer outcome

  • Build the playbooks, decision frameworks and escalation matrix that let the team make good calls quickly without needing you in the room

  • Improve the handoffs between Sales, Credit, Operations and Settlements so nothing is dropped between teams

Lead and grow the team

  • Lead, coach and develop the Customer Operations team - our Operations Lead and Home Loan Specialists - and scale it as volumes grow

  • Set the standard for how Skip speaks to customers: clever, thoughtful, honest, and always in the customer’s long term interest

  • Build a high-performance culture with clear standards, real feedback and genuine career growth

  • Operate as a player-coach - stay close to live customer conversations and step in on the hardest cases yourself

Provide commercial leverage

  • Give the Head of Operations genuine leverage - customer issues should stop with you, not travel further up

  • Own decision authority on goodwill, remediation and commercial resolutions, and make transparent, defensible trade-offs between customer outcome, cost and risk

  • Represent the voice of the customer at leadership level with evidence, not anecdote - and push the roadmap accordingly

  • Work across Credit, Sales, Marketing and our external partners (brokers, solicitors, valuers, funders) to resolve issues that cross organisational boundaries

  • Escalate the right things at the right time - and decide everything else yourself

What you will bring:

  • 7-12 years in customer operations, service delivery or operations leadership - ideally in a high-growth startup, fintech, lender or bank - including 2+ years leading a team of teams or leading leaders

  • Experience owning a customer function end-to-end - you have carried the number, not just run the process

  • A track record of turning escalations into structural fixes: you can point to problems that stopped happening because of something you built

  • Genuine customer centricity - you instinctively take the customer’s side, and you can tell the difference between what is convenient for us and what is right for them

  • Genuine operational capability - you can map a process, find the friction, redesign it, document it and land the change with the people who have to live with it

  • Commercial judgement - you are comfortable making decisions with money and reputation attached, and you can explain your reasoning clearly

  • Calm under pressure - angry customers, tight timeframes, incomplete information, and a decision still required today

  • Excellent written communication - you can write the difficult email, and you set the standard for how the team writes

  • A hands-on builder mindset and a high ownership instinct - you move quickly, independently, and without waiting for permission

  • Comfort with modern tooling and automation - CRM, workflow tools, data and AI - and no tolerance for repetitive manual work

  • Experience with complaints, hardship or regulated dispute resolution frameworks (IDR, AFCA, NCCP) is advantageous but not essential

Mortgage industry experience is not required. We are looking for someone who can learn the domain quickly and bring best-in-class thinking about customers and operations from wherever they have done it well.

Why join us:

  • Own the customer at a company where that actually means something. Customer Centric is one of our four values, and this role is where it gets tested every day

  • Real decision rights. You will have a mandate, a budget and the authority to use them - not a delegated slice of someone else’s job

  • Build, don’t maintain. The function is small and the processes are young. You will design them, not inherit them

  • A clear path. This is a leadership role with a growing team beneath it, reporting into the Head of Operations. If you perform, the scope grows with the business

  • Serious company, serious scale. Backed by leading US venture funds, global credit partners and prominent Australian investors, with a loan book scaling rapidly and major distribution partnerships already live

  • A positive impact. Your work helps hard working Australians Skip to home ownership sooner

title: Defence Engineers - Consultants & Senior Consultants
description:
At Coras, we fuse expertise with humanity, rigor with creativity and innovation with curiosity. At the core of our business is the belief that a diversity of perspectives is the key to new thinking. That’s why our team brings together deep industry experience with some of the brightest young minds in Australia. The Role:

We have opportunities for engineers with professional experience to join our growing Maritime Sustainment team in Sydney.

Working alongside experienced consultants, engineers and Defence professionals, you will support the sustainment and asset management of maritime platforms, systems and capabilities.

In this role, you will:

  • Apply engineering and systems thinking to help solve practical sustainment and technical challenges.
  • Support the development and improvement of engineering, sustainment and through life management processes.

  • Work across a broad range of maritime sustainment activities, platforms and systems while developing your consulting and engineering capability.
  • Contribute to a collaborative and growing Maritime Sustainment team, with opportunities to take on greater responsibility as your experience develops.

Our Ideal Candidate:

You are an early career engineer with strong technical foundations and an interest in applying your skills to complex engineering and sustainment challenges within the Defence Maritime environment.

You do not need to be an expert in maritime sustainment, but you will bring strong engineering fundamentals, sound professional judgement and the ability to contribute effectively from the outset. We are looking for engineers who are capable, curious and proactive, who can think critically, solve problems and take responsibility for delivering high quality work. You will work alongside experienced engineers and consultants while building broader experience across Defence Maritime sustainment and consulting.

You will bring:

  • A Bachelor degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant Engineering discipline.
  • Professional engineering experience.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply structured thinking to technical problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to produce clear, high quality technical documentation.
  • The ability to take ownership of your work while seeking guidance when required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • An interest in developing relationships and working collaboratively with clients and stakeholders.
  • An interest in building your knowledge of Defence Maritime sustainment and developing your career within a consulting environment.

Having experience in any of the following would be advantageous, but is not essential:

  • Defence, Navy, maritime or naval shipbuilding environments.
  • Maritime sustainment or asset management.
  • Systems Engineering.
  • Integrated Logistics Support or through life support.
  • Reliability, maintenance, configuration or engineering management.
  • Engineering policy, processes, governance or technical assurance.
  • Consulting or contracting within Defence.

As we are a Defence consultancy, you must also have the ability to obtain and maintain an AGSVA security clearance.

Why join Coras?

Coras prides itself on being a management consultancy with a difference. Underpinned by our core values, we are trailblazers for innovative consulting models and strategic solutions. As a result, we have built a culture that has our people’s aspirations, development and wellbeing front and centre.

Some of our employee benefits include:

  • Access to external and internal training, including a consulting skills program

title: AI Engineer Data Solutions · Utrecht Papendorp · Hybride
description:
Als AI Engineer bij Incentro heb je end-to-end ownership: van idee tot live agent. Je bedenkt en bouwt AI-agents die zelfstandig kunnen redeneren, beslissen en handelen.

Wat ga je doen

In deze rol combineer je moderne machine-learningvaardigheden met software-engineering. Je ontwikkelt AI-agents en generatieve AI-toepassingen, maar ook de infrastructuur voor evaluatie, observability en continuous improvement zodat AI-Agents betrouwbaar en meetbaar blijven.

Samen met een snel groeiend team van 35 data & AI experts bouw jij AI-oplossingen die ertoe doen. Projecten waarin je vakmanschap zichtbaar is en jouw bijdrage direct impact heeft.

Concreet:

  • Je ontwikkelt production-grade AI-agents en multi-agent oplossingen voor verschillende klanten en use cases. Dit doe je met behulp van agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph en andere frameworks als AutoGen, CrewAI, ADK ).
  • Je evalueert en fine-tuned generatieve AI modellen door het implementeren van evaluatie-frameworks, metrics en observability. Jij snapt als geen ander hoe je generatieve AI-modellen kan fine-tunen, afgestemd voor verschillende klantcases.
  • Je ontwikkelt & traint machine-learningmodellen in Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn) met focus op performance, explainability en betrouwbaarheid.
  • Je brengt modellen naar productie via CI/CD, versiebeheer (Git) en containerisatie (Docker). Jij houdt grip op kwaliteit.
  • Je bouwt en integreert modellen in de cloud (Vertex AI, SageMaker of Azure ML) en denkt actief mee over schaalbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid.
  • Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert knowledge bases op basis van RAG-gebaseerde kennis-retrievelsystemen.
  • Je past Generative AI toe via API’s (bijv. OpenAI of Anthropic) en bouwt met vector search en RAG slimme, persoonlijke oplossingen.

Met wie ga je dit doen (jouw team)

Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team dat werkt aan AI projecten met impact, denk aan AI-gedreven sales-assistenten, service-agents en zelfs hele Agent eco-systemen binnen toffe enterprise-omgevingen.

We werken als product-minded AI-team aan één gedeelde multi-client oplossing, met onder andere:

  • LangGraph-georkestreerde agents
  • RAG met vector search
  • strikte guardrails en evaluaties
  • elke verbetering schaalt direct mee via CI/CD en onze modulaire platformcomponenten.

Wat breng je mee?

Je wil groeien in je vak én iets betekenen met je werk. Je zoekt een plek waar jouw ideeën welkom zijn, waar je autonomie krijgt en waar je wordt uitgedaagd om verder te denken dan het model alleen.

Essentieel:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met Python en cloud platforms als GCP, AWS of Azure
  • Kennis van ML-libraries zoals TensorFlow, PyTorch en scikit-learn
  • Kennis van GenAI & Agentic Frameworks Denk aan: LangChain, LangGraph, ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc. maar ook agentic AI cloud platforms als Azure AI Foundry, Copilot en AgentSpace.
  • Interesse in (of ervaring met) Generative AI, LLM’s, RAG en vector search
  • Je communiceert helder – in het Nederlands én in het Engels

Nice to have:

  • Ervaring met AI oplossingen bouwen in de cloud ( SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML, etc. )
  • Ervaren met Docker, Git, CI/CD en het bouwen van ETL-pipelines

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • een vast contract bij de start
  • de mogelijkheid om 32u tot 40u per week te werken
  • een salaris tussen de €4.000,- & €5.500,- + 8% vakantiegeld
  • een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, zónder studieschuld
  • een elektrische leaseauto naar keuze of een extra €520,- bruto én km-vergoeding
  • een NS-Business Card voor je zakelijke reizen (én prive reizen, indien je geen gebruik maakt van een leaseauto)
  • 27 vakantiedagen, 10 bij te kopen, vrije invulling religieuze vakantiedagen
  • een premievrij-pensioen
  • elke 4 jaar €2.250,- budget to pick-your-own laptop & gear
  • de mogelijkheid om aandeelhouder worden (en zo samen met 150+ andere collega's mede-eigenaar te zijn van Incentro)
  • mastery money: een jaarlijkse uitkering van €650 om jouw potentieel te ontketenen. Jij kiest wat jou helpt om het beste uit jezelf te halen: een cursus Spaans, een vakantie of nieuwe hardloopschoenen. It’s up to you!
  • maandelijkse onkosten- & sportvergoeding en een tegemoetkoming voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek
  • een team waar serieuze aandacht is voor diversiteit & inclusiviteit en waar je ondersteunt wordt bij zowel fysieke als mentale gezondheid

Incentro biedt daarnaast nog veel meer. Samen organiseren we de nodige borrels, feestjes of meerdaagse ‘even met elkaar weg'-trips en om het jaar gaan we samen op Wincentrosport. Wil je meer weten over onze secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden? Kijk dan in ons handboek!

Hoe wij werken

Onze CBAM-waarden vormen de basis van hoe wij werken:

  • Camaraderie– We zijn meer dan alleen collega’s. We bouwen samen aan een fijne en open werkomgeving waarin we elkaar ondersteunen, uitdagen en inspireren. Samen vieren we successen en staan we voor elkaar klaar, zowel op professioneel als persoonlijk vlak.
  • Boldness –We durven te experimenteren met de nieuwste technologieën, maar ook om klanten uit te dagen en mee te denken. We doen niet klakkeloos wat wordt gevraagd, maar leveren échte waarde door kritisch te kijken naar wat beter kan en wat écht impact maakt.
  • Autonomy –We nemen eigenaarschap en krijgen de vrijheid om ons werk zelf vorm te geven. Geen micromanagement, maar vertrouwen in jouw expertise. Je bepaalt zelf hoe je het beste resultaat behaalt, en krijgt de ruimte om daarin te groeien.
  • Mastery –Groei stopt nooit. We inspireren elkaar om continu beter te worden, niet alleen via kennissessies, hackathons en deep-dives, maar ook met een persoonlijk groeipad dat aansluit bij jouw ambities. We dagen elkaar uit om te leren, te experimenteren en onze kennis te verdiepen.

We werken regelmatig samen op kantoor, zodat we snel kunnen schakelen, brainstormen en elkaar versterken. Hier bouw je niet alleen aan impactvolle data-oplossingen, maar ook aan een inspirerende, open en gezellige werkomgeving.

Over Incentro

Incentro is een digital agency met meer dan 300 collega’s in Nederland, Kenia, Zuid-Afrika, Spanje en Bali. Samen bouwen we next-gen techoplossingen waarmee onze klanten niet volgen, maar vooroplopen. Wat ons anders maakt? Onze mensen. We creëren ruimte om zelf keuzes te maken, te groeien en onze cultuur te bewaken. Precies daarom zijn we al sinds 2010 een Great Place to Work.

Interesse?

title: Operational Trainer - Operations
description:
As an Operational Trainer, you will play a key role in supporting the onboarding and development of new colleagues across our Operations teams. This role ensures that new recruits gain the technical knowledge and skills required to achieve competence and thrive in their roles, using a blended approach aligned to the 70:20:10 learning model: practical on-the-job experience, learning through others, and targeted formal training. You will also contribute to the design and delivery of colleague academies and the overarching Together framework, supporting cohort-based recruitment and development. Additionally, the role will monitor the success of new recruits and provide feedback to improve future recruitment and training strategies.

As an Operational Trainer, we are looking for someone to:

  • Deliver engaging and effective onboarding programmes for new colleagues
  • Ensure new recruits understand business processes, systems, and compliance requirements
  • Support individuals in achieving role competence within agreed timeframes
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders, including Risk, Central Talent and Development, HR, recruitment, operations and business stakeholders, to design and run colleague academies that align to the overarching Together framework
  • Deliver structured training programmes to cohort groups, ensuring formal learning is reinforced through workplace application, coaching, feedback and peer learning in line with the 70:20:10 model
  • Continuously improve content based on feedback, business needs and strategic priorities, avoiding disconnected local solutions or “cottage industries”
  • Track progress and performance of new recruits during onboarding and academy phases
  • Identify development needs and provide coaching or additional support where required
  • Provide insights and feedback to the recruitment team to enhance future hiring decisions
  • Work closely with team leaders, HR, and recruitment to align training with business goals
  • Act as a point of contact for training-related queries and support
  • Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements
  • Stay up to date with industry best practices and regulatory changes
  • Support colleagues to design and develop learning that contributes to a consistent Together framework, ensuring local activity connects to the wider strategy rather than creating standalone approaches

Essential

  • Proven experience in training delivery, ideally within financial services or a regulated environment
  • Strong understanding of onboarding processes and adult learning principles
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills
  • Ability to analyse performance data and provide actionable feedback
  • Experience designing training materials and programmes
  • Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to apply the 70:20:10 model when designing learning journeys, balancing experiential, social and formal learning activities
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work across Risk, Central Talent and Development and business teams to maintain alignment with the wider learning strategy

Desirable

  • CIPD Level 3 or above in Learning & Development (or equivalent)
  • Experience with LMS platforms and digital learning tools
  • Coaching or mentoring qualifications

If you feel you have some of the skills mentioned above, but not all, please do still apply and we would be happy to have a further discussion with you in regard to your suitability for the role.

title: Army Program Manager
description:
Company Description

Dcode is a team of doers dedicated to bridging the gap between the speed of technology and the federal government. We align people, culture, policies, and processes to get tech in the hands of those who need it most. Operating at the nexus of government leaders, emerging tech companies, and venture capital, we turn roadblocks into results.

Job Description

Dcode is seeking a high-performing Program Manager to support a dynamic, fast-paced innovation environment embedded within the U.S. Army. This role is central to driving mission outcomes by bridging the gap between rapid technology prototyping and formal Army acquisition pathways.

You will design and implement sustainable innovation intake and governance processes, bringing order to complex environments. By ensuring technology solutions align with mission-critical requirements and acquisition milestones, you will transform ambiguous problem spaces into clear, data-driven outcomes.

As a trusted partner to senior leadership, you will guide operational commands through the full capability lifecycle. From identifying needs and prototyping solutions to executing transitions, ensuring every solution is vetted for technical viability and acquisition readiness. You’ll facilitate alignment across operators, developers, and acquisition authorities, turning complex mission needs into actionable recommendations.

This role blends project management, agile delivery, and technical fluency. Whether you are leading a delivery workstream, running sprint planning, or facilitating a high-stakes workshop, you are helping to scale innovation in a mission-critical environment.

Duty Station: Joint Base Lewis-McChord

Salary range: $98,000-$130,000 plus bi-annual bonuses.

Top Secret clearance or higher is strongly preferred. Eligibility for clearance is required.

Job Responsibilities

Client & Mission Success

  • Develop, implement, and improve sustainable innovation intake and governance processes, ensuring alignment between emerging technology solutions and formal acquisition requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted partner to senior DoW stakeholders, translating complex mission needs into data-driven, actionable outcomes.
  • Support operational commands in identifying capability gaps and translating needs into actionable, rapid solutions.
  • Help design and stand up agile operational structures that enable fast delivery and experimentation.
  • Lead workshops, write assessments, and convert complex operational and technical challenges into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Facilitate alignment across diverse stakeholders including operators, developers, and acquisition authorities.
  • Continuously collect feedback and refine delivery approaches to improve outcomes and user experience.

Program and Project Delivery

  • Manage day-to-day delivery for assigned workstream(s), producing high quality deliverables and measurable outcomes for your clients.
  • Define and track performance metrics to evaluate progress towards objectives, ensuring Dcode’s support drives outsized mission and organizational value.
  • Apply agile and Scrum methodologies to plan, execute, and adapt projects based on real-time feedback.
  • Identify and help implement automation opportunities to make processes faster and more efficient.
  • Work closely with technical contributors and Systems Developers to ensure requirements, timelines, and dependencies are aligned.
  • Coordinate closely with Dcode leadership and Field Experts to bring the right expertise into projects at the right time.
  • Track progress against milestones and communicate updates clearly and frequently to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support rapid prototyping and experimentation efforts tied to software-enabled capabilities.

Technical & Systems Support (Program-Level)

  • Partner with Systems Developers and technical teams supporting technical capability efforts.
  • Contribute to planning and oversight of technical development and integration activities, including testing, deployment, and sustainment considerations.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and software development best practices to inform planning and decision-making.
  • Help ensure interoperability, security, and compliance with DoD/DoW regulations throughout delivery efforts.
  • Support documentation efforts, including requirements, design artifacts, user guidance, and lessons learned.

Operational & Contract Management

  • Understand and manage contract requirements to ensure compliance and effective delivery.
  • Identify risks early and work with leadership to mitigate issues quickly.
  • Audit organizational workflows to identify structural bottlenecks and implement scalable, data-driven improvements.
  • Identify and remove policy, acquisition, and operational barriers to innovation through process optimization.
  • Implement solutions that make delivery more efficient and scalable.

Qualifications

KEY SKILLS

  • 5+ years of relevant DoD/DoW work experience (US Army and/or SOF community experience preferred).
  • Proven experience establishing governance frameworks for intake, prioritization, and decision-making in complex environments.
  • Strong understanding of the DoD acquisition process, with specific experience bridging the gap between rapid innovation and formal acquisition pathways.
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex, messy information into decision-ready materials and brief senior leadership with clarity and impact.
  • Strong technical fluency; ability to scout, evaluate, and integrate emerging technologies into complex environments.
  • Comfort operating in collaborative environments with military personnel, government civilians, and senior leaders.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or demonstrated Scrum Master experience preferred.
  • PMP, Agile certifications, or relevant Security+/CISSP certifications are a plus.

Additional Information

You’ll love it here if:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, mission-driven environments.
  • Love figuring out how to make big, complex things run smoothly.
  • Are energized by working with smart, passionate teammates.
  • Don’t wait for permission to fix problems or seize opportunities.
  • Can give and take feedback without ego.
  • Bring energy, creativity, and persistence to everything you do.

We look for resilient hustlers:

Our CEO busted her face on the balance beam in college and got back up… our CRO knocked on a thousand doors, was rejected 999 times, and kept on knocking... What is your story?

Equal Opportunity Statement

We provide equal opportunity to all persons without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We believe diversity is a strength and aim to build an innovative and welcoming culture where people from all backgrounds feel respected and included. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has the tools, resources, and opportunities to excel.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to build enterprise-grade digital products and high-performance applications within a global, engineering-focused environment. You will work across frontend, backend, mobile, cloud, and data layers, contributing to complex systems designed for scale, reliability, and security. The position combines hands-on software development with architectural thinking, technical problem-solving, and close collaboration with clients and cross-functional teams. You will develop critical product capabilities, scalable microservices, robust integrations, and resilient mobile experiences, including offline-first scenarios. Strong emphasis is placed on engineering quality, automated testing, secure data handling, and maintainable architecture. You will also contribute to technical mentorship and engineering practices while working autonomously from solution design through deployment.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop high-quality client and server-side software that is performant, scalable, secure, testable, maintainable, and aligned with established engineering standards.
  • Design and implement core platform functionality, including identity management, cross-system profile synchronization, conditional event state machines, and complex business logic.
  • Build scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, microservices architectures, and appropriate software design patterns.
  • Develop responsive and reliable web and mobile experiences using React and React Native, with the ability to work with native iOS or Android technologies where required.
  • Design high-performance client-side data persistence and synchronization mechanisms, supporting reliable local data access and offline operation in connectivity-constrained environments.
  • Develop and maintain local database and synchronization architectures for mobile platforms, including SQLite, CoreData, Room, and offline delta-sync patterns where applicable.
  • Implement secure field-level encryption and sensitive data protection using AWS KMS customer-managed keys and appropriate access-control mechanisms.
  • Build advanced third-party integration adapters connecting messaging platforms, profile systems of record, payment gateways, and other external services.
  • Design and implement REST/BFF APIs, data aggregation models, and integration layers that support scalable and maintainable enterprise systems.
  • Develop comprehensive unit, integration, and contract tests using frameworks such as Jest to validate complex functionality and boundary conditions.
  • Improve automated verification and testing infrastructure to increase confidence in releases and reduce defects across the development lifecycle.
  • Work with AWS services, Docker, and cloud-based infrastructure to support reliable development and production environments.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, demos, and other project governance activities.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, managers, product stakeholders, and clients to understand user needs, anticipate challenges, and deliver solutions that drive client success.
  • Gather technical and functional requirements, contribute to estimation and planning, and organize and present completed features to stakeholders.
  • Independently drive project delivery from conceptualization through deployment while maintaining accountability for technical quality and outcomes.
  • Conduct detailed code reviews and mentor other engineers on modular architecture, defensive coding, SOLID principles, maintainability, and domain safety.
  • Contribute to engineering communities and Communities of Practice, helping strengthen technical capabilities and share best practices across teams.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade, scalable, high-availability applications or multi-tenant web and mobile platforms.
    • Strong expertise in Node.js as a primary backend technology, with hands-on experience in TypeScript, Express, TypeORM, and class-validator.
    • Solid experience with React, React Native, and modern frontend development, with additional mobile expertise in native iOS using Swift/SwiftUI or Android using Kotlin/Jetpack Compose being highly valuable.
    • Proven experience designing and developing microservices and setting up effective local development environments.
    • Strong understanding of Docker and containerized application development, with Kubernetes experience being advantageous.
    • Experience with PostgreSQL and relational databases such as Oracle or SQL Server, including SQL queries, joins, views, GROUP BY, HAVING, and relational data modeling.
    • Strong understanding of exception handling, data structures, multithreaded programming, memory management, concurrency, and application performance tuning.
    • Excellent experience with unit testing, particularly Jest, as well as integration and automated testing practices.
    • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming principles, including abstraction and encapsulation, as well as SOLID principles.
    • Good understanding of software architecture and design patterns, including Factory, Singleton, Observer, and similar patterns.
    • Experience creating high-level designs using approaches such as UML, C4, or ArchiMate.
    • Proven ability to design and implement well-tested, scalable, performant, and maintainable enterprise-level systems.
    • Strong understanding of cloud environments, particularly AWS, including services such as S3, parameter stores, serverless compute, and secure access mechanisms.
    • Experience implementing secure cloud solutions and familiarity with OWASP principles and application security practices.
    • Strong knowledge of relational data architecture, including tenant isolation, row-level access controls, and multi-tenant data considerations.
    • Experience with ORM technologies and modern architectural approaches such as microservices and serverless architectures.
    • For mobile-focused work, advanced proficiency with native iOS or Android development, local database architectures, and offline synchronization patterns is desirable.
    • For backend-focused work, strong proficiency in modular backend engineering, contract-driven REST/BFF API design, data aggregation, and multi-tenant schema isolation is desirable.
    • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containers, and cloud-based development environments is advantageous.
    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, contribute to technical decision-making, manage multiple priorities, and work effectively under deadlines.
    • Experience working in Agile software development environments.
    • Professional proficiency in English.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible, remote-first work environment with the ability to work from home, an office, or a combination of both.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with a global team and work closely with talented professionals across different cultures and regions.
      • English-speaking international work environment with exposure to diverse clients, projects, industries, and technologies.
      • Strong focus on employee wellbeing, including fitness offerings, mental health support where available locally, and generous time off.
      • Professional development opportunities across different projects, technology offerings, and industries.
      • Exposure to modern technologies spanning AI-enabled products, cloud platforms, microservices, mobile applications, data systems, and enterprise software.
      • Opportunity to take significant technical ownership and contribute from solution design through deployment.
      • Mentorship and knowledge-sharing opportunities through engineering communities and technical practice groups.
      • Inclusive and collaborative culture committed to equal opportunity, diversity, and professional growth.
      • Opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact technology initiatives within a global engineering community.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role - what’s your purpose?

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our newly formed Business Analytics team, working closely with Engineering, Operations & Product teams to design & build analytical models for both our premium enterprise clients and internal data users to drive impactful business decisions and enable self-service analytics.

The role will need to manage data pipelines, quality and delivery methods across multiple projects. You'll work closely with various stakeholders to understand and identify the correct data for the proper use case. This role should have a strong level of confidence in managing and optimising data models and processes (with and without LLMs) to ensure data products are flexible, pragmatic, and fit for purpose.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities - What you will be doing?

  • Managing the development and maintenance of ETL pipelines and data models using tools like SQL, dbt, and Airflow.

  • Creating & maintaining interactive dashboards and leading user engagement of them with both our largest clients and internal users in Power BI & Tableau.

  • Transforming, analysing & optimising large sets of quantitative and qualitative data.

  • Taking ownership of reporting processes to ensure accuracy and reliability for the end-users with strong governance and version control.

  • Testing, unpicking & refining areas such as analytical scoring, user behaviour, product performance to identify trends & opportunities and set up the most relevant KPIs.

  • Collaborating with product managers, engineers, and ops analysts to provide data-driven insights from well-designed data models.

Who are we looking for?

  • You have strong expertise in SQL & Python for relational database systems such as Redshift/S3 and SQL Server.

  • You have several years of strong experience with ETL/ELT processes and APIs with tools such as dbt, Airflow, and Talend.

  • You are proficient in using BI visualisation tools, in particular Power BI, Tableau & Metabase.

  • You have good knowledge of data modelling & transformation techniques within data pipelines.

  • You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.

  • You love building products as part of a cross-functional team, focused on an iterative, outcome-driven approach.

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable expressing your ideas and listening to multiple different audiences.

  • You have a positive attitude and are keen to learn new skills in order to succeed.

Not sure you meet every requirement?

Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.

We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.

title: Senior data engineer bi (zzp - freelance)
description:
Dit ga je doen

Datateam Knoopis een Scrum Team binnen het clusterKnoop & Servicevan de NS, gericht op het optimaliseren van knoopprocessen binnen de operatie. We maken slim gebruik van data om datagestuurde beslissingen te ondersteunen en onze4J-doelstellingente behalen: het juiste materieel, op het juiste moment, op de juiste plek en met de juiste kwaliteit voor de reiziger.

We ontwikkelen en levereninformatieproducten, zoals dashboards en rapportages, die door verschillende teams binnen de operatie worden gebruikt. Daarnaast ontsluiten en verwerken wedatabronnenen leveren weanalysesenadviezendie direct invloed hebben op de knoopprocessen en de operationele prestaties.

In onze Microsoft Azure cloudomgeving speel je een belangrijke rol: zowel in het vertalen van businesswensen naar concrete producten als in het bouwen van BI-oplossingen. Je werkt veel samen met collega´s in de keten binnen je team, de afdeling en de business. Je bent een schakel in het bouw en deliveryproces waarbinnen informatie- en dataproducten worden gerealiseerd van ontwikkeling tot productie. Je biedt oplossingen en zorgt voor verbeteringen.

  • Het ontsluiten en integreren van databronnen voor verdere analyses en het ontwikkelen van rapportages;
  • Het leveren vandata-gedreven adviezenaan diverse afdelingen en teams binnen de operatie;
  • Het analyseren van processen en het identificeren van verbeterpunten in de operatie.

Je bent kritisch en neemt de gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid voor de sprintresultaten. Ligt een discipline buiten jouw expertisegebied? Geen probleem, ook die pak je op. Je teamgenoten rekenen op jouw ondersteuning en jij helpt andere teamleden zelf-organiserend te worden. Feedback geef je gevraagd en ongevraagd, en krijg jij feedback, dan zie je dat als een kans om te groeien. Je bent communicatief, flexibel, snel van begrip en kan goed omgaan met deadlines en tijdsdruk.

Wat je doet als Senior Data Engineer BI:

  • Hetontsluiten van nieuwe databronnen;
  • Het opwerken van de ontsloten data viarawenbusiness data vaultnaar datamarts;
  • Hetontwerpenen realiseren van een effectiefDWH, inclusief data pipelines van bron tot eindgebruiker;
  • Zorgen voor robuustecodekwaliteitmet relevante controles opdataprocessingendatakwaliteit;
  • Ondersteuning bieden bij hetontwikkelen van Power BI dashboardsen het opstellen vanspecificaties;
  • Je zorgt voor goede in productie name met een geteste en gedocumenteerde oplossing;
  • Actief meewerken aan testen en signaleren van datakwaliteitsissues;
  • Documenteren van metadata en andere relevante beschrijvingen;
  • Samen bouwen aan de Microsoft Cloud-omgeving binnen een multidisciplinair team;
  • Delen van kennis en coachen van collega’s binnen het team en DIA;
  • Maken van datamodellen en analyseren van brondata;
  • Verstoringen handelen wij adequaat af en informeren stakeholders.

Hier ga je werken

We bundelen als Data, Innovatie & Analyse onze krachten en zijn met ruim 200 collega´s. Bij DIA werkt een mix van ervaringen en persoonlijkheden, die elkaar graag opzoeken om met elkaar te sparren en kennis te delen. De afdeling geeft (interne) gebruikers snel en betrouwbaar inzicht om tot juiste acties te komen door het verzamelen, combineren, analyseren en presenteren van informatie. We zoeken een echte teamplayer!

Binnen het cluster Knoop en Service ga je werken binnen Datateam Knoop. Het team bestaat uit business analisten, data engineers, informatie analist, PowerBi Specialisten, Scrummaster en Product Owner. De focus van het team ligt op het optimaliseren van de knoopprocessen in de operatie van NS. Door slim gebruik te maken van data draag je bij aan de doelstellingen van het team. Dit doen we door het leveren van adviezen, data analyses, rapportages en dashboards aan diverse teams binnen ons cluster en in de operatie die direct invloed hebben op de 4J doelstellingen en knoopprocessen.

In deze opdracht werk je hybride 50/50 vanuit huis en op kantoor in Utrecht. Het team is minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Utrecht.

Deze opdracht is alleen geschikt voor kandidaten die in loondienst zijn en waarvoor loonbelasting en premies volks- en werknemersverzekeringen (WW, WAO, WIA en ZW) worden afgedragen. Deze opdracht is niet geschikt voor zelfstandig ondernemers en professionals (waaronder zzp’ers) die zichzelf uitlenen. Deze opdracht is ook niet geschikt voor de directeur-grootaandeelhouder die niet is verzekerd voor de werknemersverzekeringen. Ik verklaar dat de aangeboden kandidaat geen zelfstandig professional is, ook niet via een doorleenconstructie.

Op NS kun je rekenen

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. De kernwaarden van NS zijn open en betrouwbaar. Wij gaan voor resultaat en willen vooruit.

title: Detective Constable - Degree Holder Entry Programme (DCDHEP)
description:
Do you have a passion for solving puzzles? Are you a seeker of truth? Do you want a career like no other, with the opportunity to earn a professional qualification while you learn? If so, join West Midlands Police as a Detective Constable through our Degree Holder Entry Programme (DCDHEP).

As a Detective Constable, you’ll investigate complex cases, uncover hidden truths, and deliver justice to those who need it most. You’ll provide critical support for victims of crime while building trust with communities to achieve successful case outcomes. This is a demanding, fast-paced role – but one that comes with huge rewards and job satisfaction.

About the DCDHEP Programme

  • Graduate Route, open to degree holders in any subject, this two-year programme equips you with the skills to become a fully qualified Detective.
  • Graduate Diploma, alongside your policing career, you’ll work towards a Graduate Diploma in Professional Policing, recognised internationally.
  • Blended Learning, a combination of in-house training, university-led learning, and practical frontline experience. Training is delivered in WMP classrooms and virtually.
  • Structured Pathway:
    • Year 1: Train as a uniformed Police Constable, working with Response and Neighbourhood teams, wearing uniform, and responding to emergency calls on a 24/7 shift pattern.
    • Year 2: Specialise in the Detective pathway, training with units such as the Force Criminal Investigation Department (FCID) and Investigations teams to build the expertise needed for detective work.
  • Future Opportunities – Once fully qualified, you can apply for promotion or specialise in areas such as Counter Terrorism, Serious & Organised Crime, Fraud, or County Lines.

You could find yourself working in departments including the Public Protection Unit (PPU), FCID, Homicide, or the Regional Organised Crime Unit (ROCU) – no two cases or days are the same.

It is important to note that alongside your role as a Police Officer, you will study toward a Graduate Diploma in Professional Policing Practice. If you are not interested in completing a further educational qualification, please explore our PCEP or DCEP routes.

What’s in it for you?

  • Starting salary: £31,164 , rising annually up to £50,256 within seven years.
  • Graduate Diploma in Professional Policing (on successful completion).
  • 25 days’ annual leave, rising to 30 after five years.
  • Extensive benefits, including pension scheme, employee support, staff networks, and professional development opportunities. See our benefits webpage for more details.
  • A rewarding career – bring justice to victims, protect communities, and uncover the truth.

Who can apply?

You must have:

  • A degree (Level 6 or above) in any subject, at any grade, OR
  • Be in the final academic year of your degree (eligibility dependent on completion).

Only final degree certificates will be accepted, these must be uploaded with your application.

Fitness, Medical & Vetting

  • Must meet the bleep test standard of 5.4.
  • Must pass medical checks, which may include drug and fitness testing.
  • Must pass our required vetting checks. See our Vetting FAQ for more information.

Residency & Nationality

  • Lived in the UK for the past three years.
  • Must be a British, Irish, or EEA national, or have the right to work in the UK without restrictions.

Application Process

  • Our careers website provides a step-by-step breakdown of the process.
  • Training & Probation – A two-year blended learning programme, combining academic study with specialist detective training.
  • Detective Constable - Degree Holder Entry Programme (DCDHEP)

title: Terreinmedewerker
description: Wil jij mee zorgen voor betrouwbaar wateronderzoek in Vlaanderen? Als Terreinmedewerker Meetnet Water bij de Vlaamse Milieumaatschappij (VMM) draag je rechtstreeks bij aan de kennis waarop het Vlaamse waterbeleid steunt. Je verzamelt gegevens die essentieel zijn voor het beschermen van onze waterlopen en leefomgeving. Dankzij jouw nauwkeurige terreinwerk kunnen experten, onderzoekers en beleidsmakers rekenen op objectieve, actuele en kwaliteitsvolle informatie. Je komt terecht in de afdeling Monitoring Waterkwaliteit, binnen de dienst Monsterneming en Inventarisatie Waterkwaliteit. Deze afdeling volgt de kwaliteit van afvalwater, oppervlaktewater en waterbodem op, is verantwoordelijk voor het VMM-laboratorium en staat in voor de alarm- en incidentenwerking rond waterkwaliteit. Je komt terecht in een gemotiveerd en ervaren team van 8 collega’s, elk met een eigen specialisatie, maar waar samenwerking, expertise en maatschappelijke impact centraal staan. Wat houdt de job in? In deze functie ben je veel onderweg. Je bereidt staalnames voor, voert ze uit op het terrein en verwerkt de gegevens zorgvuldig volgens vastgelegde procedures. Je controleert bedrijfsafvalwater in het kader van de milieuvergunning, stelt automatische monsternametoestellen op voor het uitvoeren van heffingscampagnes en je controleert de impact op waterlopen d.m.v. staalnamen. In de zomer spring je eveneens bij in het bacteriologische meetnet voor controle van de zwemwaterkwaliteit en de biologische meetnetten macro-invertebraten, macrofyten en fytobenthos voor de bepaling van de ecologische waterkwaliteit. Sporadisch spring je bij voor projectmatige opdrachten. Je werk is afwisselend: Het ene moment sta je voor een staalname op een bedrijventerrein, het volgende moment bereid je je administratief voor op een heffingscampagne. Je hebt interesse in milieuthema’s zoals waterkwaliteit, waterbodem en natuur, en je voelt je comfortabel in een rol die zowel technische als communicatieve vaardigheden vraagt. Dagelijks fysiek terreinwerk schrikt je niet af; je werkt veilig en zorgvuldig in uiteenlopende omstandigheden. Er wordt verwacht dat je jouw werkdag begint en eindigt op de standplaats VMM Hasselt. Je werkt in een organisatie die inzet op innovatie, samenwerking en maatschappelijke impact. Je krijgt de kans om mee richting te geven aan oplossingen voor de wateruitdagingen van vandaag én morgen. title: Research Scientist, Philosophy Program
description:
About Resolution

Resolution does research on how to align artificial superintelligence (ASI). ASI may be developed in the next few years, but it is unclear whether alignment is on track to be ready in the same timeframe. We aim at higher a priori confidence in aligned outcomes by pursuing a portfolio of theory and empirics bets, any one of which — if it succeeds — would meaningfully advance the field. We invest heavily in research automation to accelerate progress, and we believe that stronger alignment theory unlocks higher automation: more principled approaches give us better filters for which directions of automated research are promising.

Resolution was founded in 2026 by researchers from UK AISI's Alignment Team, who ran the £30m Alignment Project, and Timaeus, who pioneered applying singular learning theory to alignment.

For more information, see our announcement.

About Philosophy at Resolution

Work on AI alignment raises philosophical questions, including what concepts like honesty mean, what character is, what moral competence looks like, which moral theories should guide model behavior, and what research can be delegated to models. Resolution's philosophy team seeks to advance alignment by examining these questions and testing empirical claims where experimentation can help. Some projects will be primarily conceptual; others will involve collaboration with empirical researchers.

Our initial research agenda is under development, and early hires will help refine its priorities and develop new lines of work. The following gives a flavor of the areas of research we are considering:

  • Conceptual engineering. Alignment research depends on concepts such as honesty, harm, autonomy, and deference, each of which carries multiple senses in ordinary language. We want to understand what it means for a model to represent or operationalize one sense rather than another; how that representation can be changed through training data, context, or other interventions; and which version of a concept a model should employ in a given setting. The goal is to characterize alignment-relevant concepts precisely enough to inform training targets, experimental hypotheses, and evaluation criteria.

  • Character, traits, and constitutions. AI developers increasingly attempt to align models by shaping their character rather than specifying comprehensive sets of rules. But the underlying notions, including trait, persona, disposition, and character, remain poorly understood. We want to clarify the relationships among these concepts, determine which, if any, provides the right unit of analysis for alignment targets, investigate which traits advanced systems should possess, and study empirically how those traits persist, generalize, and interact across contexts.

  • Normative evaluation of models. What would moral competence in a model consist in? Does it require distinctive capacities, or does it emerge from more general forms of conceptual and practical competence? We want to design experiments that clarify how models make normative judgments and develop evidential standards for determining when, and in which contexts, reliance on those judgments may be warranted.

  • Moral theories and alignment. Alignment methods presuppose some normative commitments and assumptions. These assumptions can enter system design through, for example, objectives, constitutions, training examples, or evaluation criteria. Sometimes, an explicit commitment to some moral theory is made in model development. Systems shaped by different normative frameworks may behave similarly at current capability levels while diverging substantially as their capabilities increase. We want to understand how different normative structures and moral theories are instantiated in AI systems, and what evidence could help us compare their likely alignment properties.

  • Epistemic and safety risks of automating conceptual reasoning. Conceptual reasoning work is increasingly being delegated to models, including within alignment research itself. There is a prior question of whether this should happen at all — and, if so, where the limits should be. We want to map the risks and help determine which forms of conceptual work can be delegated, under what conditions, and with what forms of oversight. We are also interested in methods for validating model-generated conceptual work, and in the scientific norms and evidential standards that can help govern AI-assisted alignment research.

We are interested in proposals for new philosophical research that could substantially improve our understanding of alignment or alter how alignment research is conducted.

About the Role

The team is new, and the people we hire now will play a significant role in shaping what it becomes. We are hiring research scientists across multiple levels. The scope of the role will depend on the candidate's experience, research interests, and level of seniority.

All research scientists may:

  • Lead or contribute to original research projects in philosophy and AI alignment.

  • Identify important but underspecified problems and turn them into projects.

  • Connect philosophical analysis to empirical hypotheses, experimental designs, training approaches, or evaluation methods.

  • Collaborate closely with researchers from machine learning and other relevant disciplines.

  • Communicate research clearly through papers, internal reports, presentations, and external engagement.

  • Contribute to the intellectual culture and development of the philosophy team and Resolution.

Depending on seniority, research scientists may also:

  • Define and lead broad or ambiguous areas of research.

  • Help set the team's research agenda and strategic priorities.

  • Initiate and lead collaborations across Resolution and with external researchers.

  • Supervise, mentor, or manage more junior researchers.

  • Represent the philosophy team in organization-wide research planning.

You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Hold a PhD in a relevant field, such as philosophy, cognitive science, psychology, mathematics, or machine learning, or have a record of rigorous research experience.

  • Can demonstrate your motivations to work on AI alignment, including through previous publications in the field, relevant experiences, or a clear explanation of why you are pivoting your research focus to alignment.

  • Can identify important questions in areas where the problems, concepts, or success criteria remain unclear.

  • Are interested in connecting philosophical analysis with empirical and technical research.

  • Can communicate clearly and collaborate productively with researchers from different disciplinary backgrounds.

Strong Candidates May Also Have

  • Research experience in AI safety, AI alignment, or other domains relevant to making ASI futures go well.

  • The ability to design, run, or help develop experiments.

  • Previous experience working in interdisciplinary research teams.

  • The interest and capacity to translate conceptual questions into hypotheses, interventions, or evaluation criteria.

  • Relevant expertise in areas such as epistemology, philosophy of science, philosophy of language, philosophy of mind, action theory, moral psychology, or ethics.

You do not need to meet all of these criteria. If you are uncertain whether your background fits, we encourage you to apply.

Application Process

  1. Initial screener. CV and cover letter review.

  2. Interview. Short interview with the research area lead.

  3. Work test. This will be a timed work test. We'll share the expected time commitment and other details in advance. You will be compensated for your time, subject to right-to-work constraints.

  4. Final conversation(s). You may be invited to a follow-up conversation with the philosophy research lead or another member of Resolution's senior research leadership.

  5. Reference checks. With your permission, we'll contact your references.

How to Apply

Please submit the following:

  • A 1–2pp CV. Please make sure your CV includes links to your publications.

  • A cover letter of no more than 500 words addressing:

  • your motivation for applying;

  • the experiences and abilities that make you a good fit for the role;

  • the areas of research you would be most excited to contribute to or lead at Resolution.

  • Names and contact details for 2–3 academic or professional references. Please list references who can speak to your abilities as a researcher. We will ask for your permission before contacting references.

Application deadline. We will begin reviewing applications as soon as they are submitted. There is no hard deadline, but preference will be given to applications received by 28 September 2026.

Logistics

Salary: Your salary depends on the scope of work, experience levels, and impact we expect you to have while working at Resolution. The expected range of salaries for this in-person role is:

  • L3: $236,000

  • L4: $346,000

  • L5: $451,000

  • L6: $670,000

  • L7: $930,000

Strong research scientists who can reliably own well-scoped projects from conception to completion will typically join at level 3 or 4. Someone capable of leading a larger and more ambiguous area of responsibility would likely join at level 5. We are open to hiring at higher levels for exceptional candidates.

Location: This role is based in our Berkeley office.

Benefits:

  • 5 weeks of paid vacation per year, in addition to public holidays.

  • Comprehensive healthcare insurance (medical, dental, vision).

  • Unlimited sick leave to prioritize your well-being.

  • An unconditional 401(k) contribution equal to 4% of your salary.

Visa sponsorship: We can sponsor visas for relocation to Berkeley.

Start date: The start date is flexible, although we are prioritizing candidates who can begin as soon as possible.

AI usage: We may use automated systems and AI tools to support recruiting and hiring activities. Final hiring decisions are made by human decision-makers.
