title: Head of Product, Connected Experience
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Product, Connected Experience based in Brazil.

This is a senior product leadership opportunity focused on shaping the shared experiences, services, and integrations that connect an enterprise platform together. You will own critical product surfaces such as user access, knowledge, shared components, and external integrations that impact multiple applications and customer journeys. The role combines strategic product leadership with hands-on delivery, commercial judgment, customer insight, and cross-functional influence. You will translate platform strategy and business priorities into a clear roadmap while guiding product managers toward measurable outcomes. Working closely with engineering, design, sales, marketing, legal, finance, and customer teams, you will ensure products are valuable, scalable, compliant, and ready for adoption. You will also establish standards across teams, even where you do not have direct reporting authority, creating consistency across the broader platform. This is an ideal role for a strategic, technically fluent product leader who enjoys solving complex problems, developing people, and driving growth in a global environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the overall product experience across shared surfaces and services that connect applications and enable consistent customer journeys.
  • Govern shared product components in partnership with design leadership, ensuring changes to widely used capabilities are deliberate, scalable, and consistently implemented.
  • Own the product strategy for external integrations and the ways external systems connect with the platform.
  • Embed regulatory, compliance, security, and data-access requirements into product development, particularly across integrations, white-label solutions, and client data.
  • Translate platform strategy and commercial priorities into a clear, prioritized roadmap for the connected experience area.
  • Recommend which initiatives should be built, deferred, or retired, and build compelling investment cases that demonstrate expected value, payback, and trade-offs.
  • Maintain accountability for delivery against commitments, ensuring initiatives meet agreed timelines and quality standards.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design leadership from early discovery through launch, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, and delivery speed.
  • Coordinate with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and legal teams to ensure new capabilities are understood, commercially viable, supportable, and compliant at launch.
  • Sequence shared capabilities so dependent teams can deliver their work efficiently and identify cross-application conflicts early.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, integration partners, and internal stakeholders to maintain continuous insight into pain points, needs, and market opportunities.
  • Ground product decisions in customer feedback, product usage data, market evidence, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Raise the quality of discovery, experimentation, and validation across product teams.
  • Define expected outcomes for major investments and measure the value delivered against those commitments.
  • Identify cross-sell and expansion opportunities using platform adoption and usage data, partnering with sales teams to act on them.
  • Represent the product area in senior customer, prospect, and partner conversations when it supports growth and retention.
  • Lead, coach, and develop product managers within the area by setting clear expectations, providing direct feedback, and addressing performance challenges proactively.
  • Support product managers in developing their capabilities through tailored coaching and ongoing professional development.
  • Encourage thoughtful adoption of AI across product activities, recognizing where AI can create meaningful value and where human judgment remains essential.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of experience in product management or product leadership roles.
    • Proven track record of driving product-led growth, commercial outcomes, and measurable business value through product teams.
    • Strong experience owning platform, integration, or API products within B2B SaaS environments.
    • Experience building products used by external developers, integration partners, or other technical users.
    • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain shared standards across teams outside your direct reporting structure, such as design systems, component libraries, or integration patterns.
    • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to confidently discuss integrations, APIs, data flows, access models, and data products with engineering teams without needing to be an engineer.
    • Experience developing products within regulated environments where compliance, security, and legal requirements influence product design and delivery.
    • At least 5 years of people leadership experience, including managing globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones.
    • Strong strategic thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to connect customer needs, market trends, platform strategy, and commercial objectives.
    • Strong delivery leadership skills, with the ability to maintain predictable execution and quality across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across all organizational levels, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
    • Strong influencing skills and the ability to gain alignment and adoption without relying solely on formal authority.
    • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to evaluate investment opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and clearly articulate business cases.
    • Customer-focused mindset with strong curiosity and an ability to seek diverse perspectives and identify meaningful problems worth solving.
    • Strong analytical and decision-making abilities, with a focus on measurable outcomes and product performance.
    • Ability to operate strategically while remaining close enough to execution and technical detail to make informed decisions.
    • Resilient, determined, and comfortable navigating obstacles and ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
    • Warm, open, honest, collaborative, and engaging leadership style.
    • Experience with AI-enabled product development or a strong interest in adopting AI to improve product management effectiveness is advantageous.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation based on the hiring location.
      • Base salaries in target EU markets starting from €100,000 gross in Spain and €95,000 gross in Portugal.

      • Supportive culture that values employee contributions, collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Akara is a fast-growing international healthtech startup on a mission to build the intelligence layer for the modern hospital - using AI to help hospitals understand what is happening in real time and deliver more care with the resources they already have.

A spin-out from Trinity College Dublin, Akara builds on more than a decade of research in AI and robotics. Our technology is deployed across the US, Ireland, and the UK, and an Akara device was named one of TIME Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2025.

With offices in Los Angeles and Dublin, we are scaling quickly and building an ambitious international team across AI, robotics, software, and healthcare.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design and build the interfaces, services, and infrastructure behind Akara's products.

This is a senior, broad-scope role. You'll work across the stack - user-facing frontend, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and edge deployment - and you'll be a technical anchor for the wider engineering team, helping others ship code reliably into live clinical environments. You'll report into the software leadership team and work closely with engineers across ML, infrastructure, and internal tooling.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving practical problems, and working in a fast-moving environment where their contribution will have a visible impact.

What you will do

Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting Akara's products.

Develop user-facing web applications and interfaces for real-time hospital data.

Build and maintain systems for moving data reliably between edge devices, cloud services, databases, and frontend applications.

Develop infrastructure for managing deployed devices, including configuration, software updates, monitoring, and model management.

Design and maintain scalable databases and data pipelines capable of supporting increasing deployment volumes and healthcare integrations.

Help develop integrations with hospital systems, including EHR platforms such as Epic.

Build and maintain cloud infrastructure and services, primarily within AWS.

Support the development of infrastructure for Akara's AI agent, computer vision, ML and training architectures.

Improve how we deploy, monitor, test, and operate software across cloud and edge environments.

Build internal tools that allow our AI and operations teams to inspect, manage, and work with data more efficiently.

Contribute to containerisation, CI/CD, code review, testing, observability, and engineering standards.

Work closely with engineers across AI, robotics, computer vision, and product to move new capabilities from prototype to production.

Review code and help improve engineering quality across the team.

Use data and customer feedback to inform decisions.

Identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

Communicate progress, priorities, and results clearly.

Contribute to the broader development and growth of Akara.

What success looks like in the first 12 months, you will:

Have shipped and be operating production features across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure in live clinical deployments.

Be a trusted reviewer and technical resource for other engineers moving code to deployment.

Have strengthened Akara's deployment, CI/CD, and ML devops practices in ways the rest of the team can see and rely on.

What we are looking for

Significant industry experience as a professional software engineer (excluding internships and not purely academic or research background).

Strong professional experience across the full stack, with proficiency in Python, React, and Node.js.

Proven experience designing and building production, backend services, APIs, and databases.

Experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS.

Experience with containerised deployments.

Good understanding of software architecture, testing, code review, and deployment practices.

Comfortable working close to hardware/edge constraints on-device model management, edge processing, or similar.

Strong system design judgement - able to make and defend architectural trade-offs, not just implement a spec.

Ability to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment, and to support and unblock other engineers.

Eligibility to work in Ireland without requiring visa sponsorship.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

How we work

Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Customer understanding: We take time to understand hospital workflows and the people using our technology.

Ambition: We are building technology that can meaningfully improve healthcare delivery at scale.

Why join Akara

Work on technology with a direct and measurable impact on healthcare.

Join a highly experienced team working across AI, robotics, software, and hospital operations.

Take meaningful ownership from an early stage.

Work directly with healthcare providers and leading hospital systems.

Help shape products, processes, and company strategy as Akara grows.

Report directly to the CTO.

Develop your career within a rapidly scaling international company.

Compensation and benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Annual leave: 20 Days
  • Pension or retirement contribution: 3% employer matching PRSA contribution
  • Potential to work remote for periods of time
  • Professional development in a fast paced startup environment with the opportunity to move up as the company grows

title: Dog Sitter
description:
Professional Pet Sitter & Dog Walker— Las Vegas, NV Metro Area

Do you love dogs (or cats) and enjoy working independently? The Comforted Kitty is looking for reliable, responsible pet lovers to provide in-home dog or cat sitting visits and dog walking while clients are away.

This is a flexible, part-time independent contractor position where all jobs are voluntary and you set your availability and service area, and we match you with clients. It’s a great fit if you want meaningful, independent work caring for dogs and cats, helping pet parents travel with peace of mind, and building trust with repeat clients.

What You’ll Do

Pet sitting visits may include:

  • Feeding and refreshing water
  • Cleaning up waste
  • Giving playtime, affection, or companionship based on each pet's personality
  • Sending visit updates and photos through our app
  • Following each client’s detailed care instructions
  • Bringing in mail or packages
  • Adjusting lights, blinds, or trash/recycling when requested
  • Administering medication when within your experience and comfort level
Most visits take place while clients are traveling, so weekend, holiday, morning, afternoon, and evening availability is especially valuable.

Service Types

  • Walks: 30-90 minutes (1-3x daily)
  • Drop-ins: 30 / 45 / 60 minutes (1–3x daily)
  • Extended daytime visits: 2-8 hours
  • Overnights: 10-12 hour stays
  • 24-hour care: live-in with overnight care

What We Look For

  • Experienced with dog or cat care, especially in a pet sitting capacity
  • Confidently handle dogs from small to large
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented
  • Strong written communication
  • Comfortable working independently in clients’ homes
  • Smartphone with reliable internet & camera
  • Medication experience (oral, injections, fluids)
  • Holiday & weekend availability

Pay + Perks

  • Sitters are paid per visit, with rates typically starting around $25 per 30 minute visit, with higher pay for longer visits, overnight care, house sitting.
  • Weekly direct deposit
  • Bonus opportunities (holidays, short notice, strong feedback)
  • 100% of tips go to you

Apply

Apply through our quick, mobile-friendly application.

Notes:

  • Apply to one location only
  • No phone calls (we contact strong matches)

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
We`re looking for an experienced Data Engineering Lead to join our Data & Insight team and help shape the future of our data capabilities.

You`ll lead and develop a talented team of Data Engineers, providing technical direction and coaching while remaining hands‑on with complex engineering challenges. You`ll play a key role in strategic transformation initiatives, including the continued evolution of our Databricks data platform.

This is an exciting opportunity to:

  • Lead and inspire a talented Data Engineering team.
  • Shape our data strategy and influence key technology decisions.
  • Stay hands‑on and solve complex technical challenges.
  • Make a real impact by delivering trusted, scalable data solutions that support business growth.

If you`re passionate about data, technology and people leadership, this is your opportunity to help shape our data future and make a lasting impact.

What You`ll Be Doing

  • Provide technical leadership for scalable, reliable and secure data platforms and products.
  • Lead, mentor and develop a team of Data Engineers, promoting collaboration and technical excellence.
  • Ensure the stability, performance and continuous improvement of critical data platforms and pipelines.
  • Lead the migration from our existing data warehouse to Databricks.
  • Support major transformation programmes, including our SaaS migration and wider business integration initiatives.
  • Design and maintain data pipelines, models and curated datasets for analytics, reporting and data science.
  • Collaborate with BI, Data Science, Architecture, Technology and business teams to deliver trusted data solutions.
  • Champion engineering best practices, including testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation and code reviews.
  • Support Agile delivery, from prioritisation and sprint planning through to delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve our data platforms, tooling and ways of working.

What We`re Looking for in You

  • Proven experience leading Data Engineering teams in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands‑on experience building and operating modern, cloud‑based data platforms.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with extensive experience in Databricks, Spark and lakehouse architectures.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering, modelling and architecture best practices.
  • Experience delivering data solutions for reporting, analytics and data science.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands‑on technical delivery.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.
  • Experience delivering large‑scale technology or business transformation programmes.
  • Experience with data migration, system modernisation or enterprise platform change.
  • Experience integrating data following acquisitions, mergers or major business change.
  • Familiarity with Tableau and low‑code integration platforms such as SnapLogic.

What You`ll Get in Return

  • A discretionary annual bonus so you can share in the company`s success
  • 25 days` paid holiday and an annual holiday buying scheme, with 5 additional days awarded for long service
  • A generous pension scheme - employer contributions between 5% and 11% depending on how much you save
  • Various benefits to support your health and wellbeing including a Healthcare Cash Plan, an Employee Assistance Programme, a Wellbeing platform and a Gym benefit that you can share with your family and friends
  • Enhanced Family Leave including 18 weeks full pay for birthing parents and 4 weeks for non‑birthing parents
  • Lots of other great benefits including an annual ShareSave scheme, Employee Life Assurance, a discounts portal and more!

title: Senior / Lead Data Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior / Lead Data Analyst based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to shape data-driven strategy for subscription products within a collaborative Decision Science environment. You will analyze customer behavior across the full subscription lifecycle, from acquisition and engagement to retention and churn. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Finance, and Data teams, you will turn complex datasets into insights that influence product and business decisions. You will play a key role in defining KPIs, improving measurement frameworks, and identifying opportunities for growth and customer retention. The position combines advanced SQL, experimentation, statistical analysis, data visualization, and customer analytics. You will also help strengthen tracking, data quality, and analytics best practices across subscription products. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced analyst who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and translating data into meaningful business outcomes.

Accountabilities:

  • Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Data teams to define and evolve KPIs and performance metrics across acquisition, engagement, retention, and churn.
  • Analyze subscription customer behavior to identify trends, patterns, growth opportunities, engagement drivers, and retention challenges.
  • Develop actionable insights that help inform product strategy, customer experience, and broader business decisions.
  • Design and support A/B tests and experimentation programs, including hypothesis development, experiment design, statistical analysis, and post-test evaluation.
  • Apply statistical methods and causal inference techniques to assess the impact of product and business initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to improve behavioral tracking, data models, data quality, and analytical reliability.
  • Build, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using BI platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Identify analytical and measurement gaps and implement improvements to the data and reporting processes supporting subscription products.
  • Establish and promote best practices for customer tracking, analytics, experimentation, KPI definition, and measurement.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Use customer and product data to proactively surface business opportunities and support evidence-based decision-making.
  • Contribute to a culture of data-driven product development through knowledge sharing, analytical standards, and cross-functional collaboration.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Decision Scientist, or in a similar analytical role.
    • 5+ years of hands-on experience working with complex, production-level SQL and independently developing high-quality queries.
    • Strong expertise in experimental design, A/B testing, statistical analysis, and causal inference.
    • 3+ years of experience implementing custom tracking and establishing analytics best practices using a Customer Data Platform (CDP), such as Segment.
    • Professional experience with BI and data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
    • Experience working with dbt and/or ETL environments and an understanding of data transformation workflows.
    • Hands-on experience with client-side analytics and tagging technologies such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or Amplitude.
    • Strong understanding of customer behavior and subscription data modeling.
    • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns, trends, opportunities, and potential business risks.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
    • Upper-Intermediate English proficiency (B2+) or higher.
    • Ability to work effectively across Product and Data teams in a fast-paced, collaborative, and international environment.
    • Python experience for data analysis and automation is a plus.
    • Experience with AWS and Databricks is a plus.
    • Experience in subscription-based businesses, particularly consumer-facing industries such as healthtech, e-commerce, or streaming, is highly valued.
    • Experience working in compliance-driven environments, such as HIPAA- or PCI-regulated settings, is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with the healthcare industry and its evolving landscape is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time position based in Brazil.
      • Opportunity to work on subscription products and high-impact data-driven initiatives.
      • Ability to influence product strategy, customer experience, retention, and business growth through data.
      • Exposure to large-scale customer and product datasets and sophisticated analytical challenges.
      • Collaboration with experienced professionals across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Finance, and Data.
      • International and highly collaborative working environment.
      • Opportunities for professional development, knowledge sharing, and expanding expertise in Decision Science and product analytics.
      • Opportunity to contribute to analytics best practices, experimentation frameworks, and data-driven decision-making.
      • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and market standards.
      • Flexible remote working environment designed to support distributed collaboration.

title: Data Engineering Lead - INTERNAL TO NHS WALES
description:
Data Engineering Lead - INTERNAL TO NHS WALES

You will be able to find a full Job description and Person Specification attached within the supporting documents, for example with departments, programmes and projects, and externally with key partners including NHS Wales organisations, local authorities and Welsh Government, and suppliers, to ensure the potential of insight from WAST intelligence is maximised. Work collaboratively with other NHS Wales organisations and Welsh Government Leads to agree and support their data and reporting requirements. Work collaboratively with the National Data Resource Programme to identify areas of commonality and alignment of service provision Ensure that procedures and protocols are complied with, particularly around information governance, data protection and use of patient-identifiable information. Enable communication, planning and sharing of good practice within the team. Communicate complex technical information relating to queries, updates, faults and changes to the Data Warehouse system with non-experts in WAST in a way that is understandable, persuasive and overcoming barriers to understanding or acceptance of this information. Communicate highly complex or technical proposed changes to Senior management, the directorate and team members where there could be resistance to change, due to impact on the service. Engage in highly complex, technical discussions and ideas regarding changes in direction or strategic decisions within senior management meetings, with heads of information, and other senior level meetings and groups, within NHS Wales and with external stakeholders. This will involve using skills of influencing, persuading, motivational, and negotiating. Exercise own judgment based on the interpretation of highly complex facts, figures and situations which require the analysis, interpretation and comparison of a range of options for the purpose of service planning and delivery. Create reports from internal and external sources, that allow evaluation of Information Services plans and services. In-depth knowledge and experience of programming languages, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and scripting languages, and ability to write complex SQL queries, stored procedures. Work with data providers/owners on the acquisition of additional/new data into the local data warehouse and suitable and compliant onward sharing to the national warehouse. Undertake horizon scanning to identify new, valuable data sources. Diagnose complex data/processing problems or inefficiencies, suggesting and providing solutions. Ensure data is made available in a timely manner, establishing automation of reports and processes whenever possible. Establish a standard approach for data science projects. Develop methodologies for the analysis and interpretation of data to support service redesign and research, including prediction of demand, conducting what if analysis, identifying risks, exploring gains in productivity and efficiencies, and discovering opportunities to improve clinical quality. Within the national data warehouse and acquisition areas, monitor and review plans which may be long term in nature, and ensure they are adjusted for changes in local need and in response to changes in national policy, Welsh Government guidelines and best practice. Plan and prioritise own work to ensure effective support to all areas and delivery of key objectives. Promote to Directorates and departments, the opportunity and value of the national data warehouse and to be proactive and influential in WASTs contribution to the design and delivery of the NDRs strategic and operational plans. Support the planning and development of major organisational change projects which may be contentious and impact across the whole of WAST, requiring the post holder to gain agreement from all grades of staff in the organisation. Formulate long term, strategic plans around the development of the WAST Data Warehouse, in conjunction with the National Data Resource or other cloud data storage opportunities. This will involve understanding and evaluating the available options and formulating the best solution for the long-term which may involve uncertainty. The postholder will require standard keyboard skills for regular use of Microsoft packages, Teams, software systems and Visio. The postholders duties will not require any direct contact with patients however any contact would be incidental. Responsibility to lead on implementation of a range of national data warehouse and acquisition service policy, service development and corporate initiatives which may impact across the organisation as agreed with the Head of Data & Analytics and the Assistant Director of Digital Services. title: Laytime Specialist (Dry Bulk)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Laytime Specialist to manage dry-bulk laytime calculations and demurrage and despatch claims. The successful candidate will review Charter Parties and voyage documentation, prepare accurate calculations and negotiate claims with owners, charterers, brokers and counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review laytime calculations for dry-bulk voyages.
  • Assess demurrage and despatch claims in accordance with Charter Party terms.
  • Interpret laytime clauses, rider clauses and applicable contractual exceptions.
  • Review Notices of Readiness, Statements of Facts, time sheets, Bills of Lading and supporting documents.
  • Identify discrepancies or missing information and coordinate with relevant parties to obtain clarification.
  • Prepare, submit and follow up on claims within contractual time-bar periods.
  • Review claims received from owners, charterers and counterparties.
  • Negotiate disputed calculations and support the timely settlement of claims.
  • Maintain accurate records of open, settled and outstanding claims.
  • Monitor ageing and provide regular reports on claim status and financial exposure.
  • Work closely with Chartering, Operations, Legal, Finance and commercial teams.
  • Provide advice on laytime wording and potential exposure during Charter Party review.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to documentation and claims processes.
  • Support audits and provide relevant claim documentation when required.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Diploma or degree in Maritime Studies, Shipping, Logistics, Business or a related discipline.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in dry-bulk laytime, demurrage, post-fixture operations or claims.
  • Strong knowledge of dry-bulk Charter Parties and laytime principles.
  • Hands-on experience calculating demurrage and despatch claims.
  • Familiarity with common Charter Party forms and dry-bulk shipping documentation.
  • Able to interpret complex contractual clauses and present calculations clearly.
  • Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Meticulous and able to manage multiple claims and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Confident communicating and negotiating with owners, charterers, brokers and other counterparties.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and relevant laytime or voyage-management systems.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

title: Police Constable Degree Apprenticeship (PCDA)
description:
Police Constable Degree Apprenticeship Route (PCDA)

Are you looking for a career like no other? Do you want the opportunity to study for a degree while gaining hands-on experience from day one? If so, join West Midlands Police through our Police Constable Degree Apprenticeship (PCDA) programme.

As a Police Constable, you’ll play a vital role in keeping our communities safe, protecting the vulnerable, and tackling crime. This is a challenging but hugely rewarding career where no two days are the same.

About the PCDA Programme

  • Earn & Learn, you’ll be a fully employed police officer from day one, while studying towards a Level 6 Degree in Professional Policing Practice over three years.
  • Blended Learning, most of your training will be delivered in-house at West Midlands Police, supported by a partner university. Classroom learning will be combined with frontline policing and digital study.
  • Ongoing Support, training is practical and designed to prepare you for real-life policing, with guidance from experienced officers.
  • Future Opportunities, once you’ve completed your probation, you’ll have access to a wide range of career paths, from specialist units such as Firearms, Dogs, Roads Policing, and Investigations, to progression into leadership roles.

Please note: This is not a direct Detective route. However, after initial training, you may apply to join our Detective Academy pathway.

What’s in it for you?

  • Starting salary: £31,164 , rising annually up to £50,256 within seven years.
  • BA Degree in Professional Policing Practice (on successful completion).
  • 25 days’ annual leave, rising to 30 after five years.
  • Extensive benefits, including a pension scheme, employee support, staff networks, and professional development opportunities. See our benefits webpage for more details.
  • A career that matters – make a lasting impact on communities while developing your skills and future.

Who can apply?

You must have:

  • Level 2 English (Grade C/4 or above) AND
  • One of the following:
    • Level 3 qualification worth at least 80 UCAS points, OR
    • Level 4 or 5 qualification

Only final certificates will be accepted – these must be uploaded with your application.

Fitness, Medical & Vetting

  • Must meet the bleep test standard of 5.4.
  • Must pass medical checks, which may include drug and fitness testing.
  • Must pass our required vetting checks. See our Vetting FAQ for more information.

Residency & Nationality

  • Lived in the UK for the past 3 years.
  • Must be a British or EEA national, or have the right to work in the UK without restrictions.

Application Process

  • Our careers website provides a step-by-step breakdown of the application process.
  • Training & Probation, a three-year blended learning apprenticeship combining policing experience with academic study.

  • Sterilizes instruments, equipment, linen and supplies using various types of autoclaves and aerators. Reprocesses equipment via high level disinfection as appropriate. Loads and operates machinery in prescribed manner and sets controls to correct specifications for the items being sterilized.
  • Properly documents all activities related to instrument/equipment decontamination, assembly, disinfection, and sterilization in the Instrument Tracking System (SPM, Censitrac) or established manual systems.
  • Observe and interpret biological, mechanical and chemical monitors relevant to processing/sterilizing. Record results and maintains required records. Initiates recalls as required.
  • Issues items to customers and departments according to established procedures.
  • Observes and reports to supervisor any unfamiliar items with or without appropriate processing literature. Reports equipment requiring repair as needed. Is self-directed and intervenes with corrections to variances in the processing practice.

Supervisory/Management Responsibility

This is a non-management job that will report to a supervisor, manager, director, or executive.

Minimum Requirements

Job-related coursework beyond high school: Surgical Tech, Sterile Processing Tech, or Dental Assistant training program.

No previous experience is required.

Required Certifications/Registrations/Licensure

Certification as either 1) Sterile Processing Technician from either CBSPD or IAHCSMM or 2) Surgical Technologist from either NBSTSA or NCCT is preferred

Applicants without Sterile Processing or Surgical Technologist certification (CRCST, CSPDT, CST) are required to obtain CRCST certification via IAHCSMM within ONE (1) year of meeting the eligibility requirements to sit for the certification exam. Eligibility is defined by IAHCSMM as "10 weeks (400 hours) experience" in a Sterile Processing hospital setting.

Current incumbents of this job role, as of November 1, 2020, must obtain CRCST or CSPDT certification by December 31, 2021.

In Lieu Of The Above Minimum Requirements

In lieu of the education requirement only, will accept High School diploma or equivalent and 6 months experience in a hospital or clinical setting.

Other Required Skills and Experience

  • 1 year of Sterile Processing or Surgical Technology preferred
  • Experience with sterilization equipment (autoclaves, Sterrad, VPro, HLD equipment) and tray management systems (SPM, Censitrac) is preferred
  • Knowledge of Decontamination, Assembly, Packaging and Sterilization Procedures. Knowledge of various types of Surgical Instrumentation preferred
  • As of Jan 2002, any Prisma Health employee working in a sterile processing role is grandfathered from the High School diploma or GED requirement of this job.

title: Head of Commercial
location: New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA / Denver, CO
description:
Company
The earth beneath our feet holds extraordinary, untapped capacity to accelerate the clean energy transition. Bedrock Energy is on a mission to transform the heating and cooling of buildings, using carbon-free, hyper-efficient, and ultra-safe geothermal energy to radically reduce costs for people and the environment. Incorporated in 2022, Bedrock has raised over $25M in capital from investors like Titanium Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, and Wireframe Ventures, and we are gathering exceptional talent to scale up geothermal heating/cooling for real estate and infrastructure developers in any city in the world. We seek creative, collaborative, proactive team members who inspire us with their high standards of excellence, integrity, and commitment to our shared mission.
Bedrock is now in its second year of commercialization and ready to build foundations for scale up. We are beginning to accelerate business development with real asset operators who seek to grow long-term value, asset resilience, and sustainability across their portfolios.
Role
This position leads Bedrock’s commercial function. You build the sales team, win the deals that get built, and find the repeatable motion that carries us from early traction to scale. It is a critical leadership role accountable for Bedrock’s growth.

Geothermal heating and cooling is a complex, high-stakes purchase: sophisticated buyers, long sales cycles, and deals financed over fifteen to twenty years, won on trust as much as economics. Success means working closely with our engineering and delivery teams to shape what we can credibly promise, and with customers to set expectations, structure creative deals, and build the relationships that move a long-term commitment forward. Bedrock sells both as a long-term financed asset (Geo-as-a-Service) and through direct energy system sales. You know the decision-makers in large corporate real estate portfolios, and you own the go-to-market strategy that decides who we target and how we sell.

You are an executive leader and a closer in equal measure — senior enough to set the strategy, own the number, and grow a team but also willing to sit across the table from a building owner and close the deal yourself. You bring a network in our priority segment and act as our lead closer while the team is small, then hire and coach around yourself as we scale, building the playbook from real, won deals. As Bedrock's first commercial leader, reporting to the CEO, the strategy, team, and standards you set will define Bedrock's success.

Responsibilities

Drive Market Adoption: From first outreach through contract signing, you will lead the full sales cycle, crafting compelling value propositions that resonate with C-level decision makers.
  • Bring and build the enterprise relationship, personally driving to close on the highest priority deals
  • Structure and close long-term, investment-grade offtakes yourself while the team grow
  • Model the motion you want the team to run and convert into repeatable playbooks
  • Close collaboration with Solutions Engineering is essential, covering mechanical engineering and energy system performance concepts, as well as construction cost and pricing estimations.
  • Travel is expected 1-2x per month.
Shape Go-to-Market Strategy: Lead the data-driven rationale on which segments we pursue and in what order, our value proposition, deal structuring playbook, quantitative targets, and the path from beachhead to scale
  • Refine Bedrock’s customer targeting, sales motion, and partnership models. Translate customer insights into actionable strategy, ensuring our commercial approach scales alongside our technology and operations.
  • Communicate the pipeline status, forecasts, and the revenue commitments to the company and the board.
  • Close collaboration with Product and Field Operations is required. You will be a key commercial voice in internal discussions, helping shape product roadmap and deployment strategies based on the perspectives of real estate owners, investors, and developers.
Build Sales Team: Stand up the foundational org, processes, tools, and culture for a sales function that can support start-up scale.
  • Recruit, lead, and grow the commercial organization: project developers, account executives, project managers, sales engineers as a single leader providing one clear set of priorities
  • Set the commercial operating rhythm: pipeline reviews, deal cadence, and cross-functional planning with operations, strategy, and finance
  • Architect the CRM/pipeline tracking systems, forecasting models, and sales/marketing collateralm creating repeatable playbooks that allow Bedrock to scale its commercial impact.
  • Hold the bar for high deal velocity, deal discipline, customer relationship quality, and mission-oriented culture through hiring, coaching, and performance management
  • Do-it-yourself end-to-end project execution is required, as we are a lean early-stage team

Qualifications

  • Substantial experience leading a commercial, business-development, or origination function in distributed energy, infrastructure, or a comparable capital-intensive, project-based business
  • Personal network and credibility to generate leads with building owners or developers in a relevant C&I segments that you can activate from day one
  • Experience working with project finance to structure and close long-cycle, multi-stakeholder offtakes such as PPAs or ESAs
  • Sufficient domain fluency to comfortably manage sales (MEP) engineers, construction project managers, project finance, and external counsel
  • A track record of building high performing teams: org design, hiring, coaching, and performance management
  • Comfort operating in early-stage ambiguity: building the go-to-market motion and team from an early base, and selling around a new product and delivery model
  • Excellent executive presence, with a balance of communications skills, quantitative comfort, and technical fluency in contractual details, for credibility with senior customers, investors, and a board
  • Willingness to be hands-on with travel up to 30%, including time with customers
  • Previous roles in early/growth-stage start-ups, with direct involvement in building sales processes, systems, and teams; comfort with hands-on "rolling up sleeves" contribution in a fast-moving environment

Qualities

  • Proactivity: You take ownership, offer hypotheses, and hold yourself accountable.
  • Coachability: You welcome & react constructively to feedback and seek new skills with gusto.
  • Excellence: You hold yourself, and your team members, to high standards of performance.
  • Creativity: You enjoy finding resourceful, unconventional, flexible solutions to problems.
  • Integrity: You take pride in ethical, honest behavior, no matter who is around to see it.
  • Compassion: You remember empathy, respect, and care in your interactions with others.
  • Commitment to Diversity: You actively look to surround yourself & collaborate inclusively with people who are different from you in experience, background, worldview, and resources.
Bedrock Energy is building a strong culture based on our Organizational Values.
In addition, we are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Bedrock Energy is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

Allied Command Transformation (ACT) is NATO’s leading agent for change: driving, facilitating, and advocating the continuous improvement of Alliance capabilities to maintain and enhance the military relevance and effectiveness of the Alliance. The main objectives of ACT are: providing appropriate support to NATO missions and operations; leading NATO military transformation; and improving relationships, interaction and practical cooperation with partners, nations and international organisations. ACT therefore leads Alliance concept development, capability development, training and lessons-learned initiatives and provides unfettered military support to policy development within NATO.

The program

Capability Development & Management Support (CDMS)

The Requirements Division will execute all tasks and activities needed to support requirements management for NATO capabilities

The Capability Requirements (CR) Branch will develop the Capability Requirements Brief and recommended courses of action to resolve issues through the life cycle management of requirements using matrixed, cross-functional project-specific Requirements Management teams.

Strategic Plans and Policy (SPP) supports Allied Command Transformation in formalizing military advice to shape future military strategy, political guidance, and other policy documents supporting NATO’s strategic objectives.

Role ID: ACT-CDMS-27-01-A-LC07

Role and Duties

Provide hands-on data integration, engineering, data collection modernization, analytics, and decision-support support to the Enabling Capabilities Portfolio, with an initial emphasis on Infrastructure Programmes. This is a hands-on delivery role. The contractor is expected to personally design, configure, develop, test, document, and improve working data and analytical solutions in direct collaboration with operational users. The requirement is not primarily for strategic advisory, enterprise architecture, programme management, or supervision of development performed by others. The objective is to transform fragmented programme information and manual data operations into structured, trusted, reusable information that improves programme and portfolio decision making and delivery.

Taskings:

  1. Support the Enabling Capabilities Portfolio, with an initial emphasis on Infrastructure Programmes, through hands-on data integration, data engineering, analytics, and decisionsupport activities.
  2. Work directly with programme managers, portfolio staff, analysts, data owners, and other stakeholders to understand priority decisions, information requirements, existing data sources, data gaps, and opportunities to improve programme delivery through better use of data.
  3. Design, develop, test, and maintain repeatable data integration processes that ingest, transform, reconcile, and prepare information from multiple programme and enterprise sources for operational use and analysis
  4. Develop and maintain structured data models, common definitions, business rules, reference data, and data-quality controls required to produce trusted programme and portfolio-level information.
  5. Design, prototype, configure, and improve digital data-collection applications and workflows that replace or materially reduce spreadsheet-intensive, manually consolidated, emaildriven, or otherwise fragmented data operations.
  6. Support the continued development, maturation, and operational use of digital Management and Oversight Review (MOR) data collection and decision-support solutions for Infrastructure Programmes and other Enabling Capabilities Portfolio requirements.
  7. Develop dashboards, metrics, visualizations, analytical products, and other decision-support solutions that improve visibility of programme status, delivery performance, schedule, resources, risks, dependencies, and emerging issues.
  8. Apply descriptive and diagnostic analytical techniques, and predictive or prescriptive techniques when directed and appropriate to the decision requirement, to identify trends, relationships, anomalies, risks, and opportunities relevant to programme or portfolio management.
  9. Integrate programme and portfolio information with authoritative NATO or enterprise data sources through approved mechanisms including relational databases, APIs, data services, structured file exchange, or other available interfaces.
  10. Identify data-quality, ownership, lineage, governance, stewardship, and authoritative-source issues affecting delivered solutions and implement or recommend practical remediation measures in coordination with responsible stakeholders.
  11. Use appropriate development and engineering practices, including source or configuration control, documented transformations and business rules, reproducible processing, configuration management, and separation of development and operational artifacts where supported by the technical environment.
  12. Document data sources, data models, transformations, business rules, analytical logic, dependencies, assumptions, operating procedures, and solution configuration sufficiently to support transparency, auditability, reuse, sustainment, and transition.
  13. Conduct user testing and iteratively improve solutions based on operational use, stakeholder feedback, data-quality findings, and changes to programme or portfolio information requirements.
  14. Establish appropriate baselines and assess the effect of delivered solutions on factors such as data quality, timeliness, manual processing effort, information availability, workflow efficiency, and usefulness to decision makers.
  15. Present analytical findings, assumptions, limitations, risks, and decision implications to programme managers, portfolio leadership, and other stakeholders.
  16. Support transition of successful prototypes, pilots, data products, and analytical solutions to enduring enterprise platforms, production-support organizations, or designated scaling teams, including preparation of sufficient technical and operational documentation to enable another appropriately qualified individual or team to sustain the solution.
  17. Perform additional tasks as required by the COTR that are directly related to this labour category and do not constitute a materially different labour requirement.

Essential Qualifications

  1. Education or Relevant Professional Experience: A University/bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field; or a minimum of five years of directly relevant professional experience in lieu of the degree. Directly relevant professional experience shall include work in at least two of the following areas: data integration or data engineering; analytical programming; business intelligence, analytics, or decision-support development. Either the degree or experience-in-lieu route fully satisfies this qualification.
  2. Recent End-to-End Hands-On Solution Delivery: Demonstrated recent experience personally, developing operational data or analytical solutions from identification of a user or decision requirement through data preparation or integration, solution development, user testing, and operational use. The candidate shall demonstrate at least twelve calendar months within the last twenty-four months during which hands-on technical delivery was a regular part of the candidate's assigned work, and at least one data or analytical solution personally developed and used by an identified user group as part of an active business or decision-making process within the last eighteen months. The candidate shall identify the month and year of the qualifying experience, the business or information requirement addressed, the candidate's personal technical contribution, technologies or methods used, and the user group. Experience limited to directing, supervising, managing, advising, coordinating, or overseeing development performed by others does not satisfy this requirement. Multiple components developed for the same user group to address the same business or information requirement shall be considered one example.
  3. Data Integration and Engineering: Minimum of three years within the last five years, including hands-on experience within the last twenty-four months, performing data integration or data engineering activities using relational databases, ETL/ELT, APIs, data pipelines, data services, structured data exchange, or comparable methods. The candidate shall demonstrate at least one example integrating data from two or more separately administered systems, databases, services, or authoritative data sources and shall identify the source systems and integration mechanism used. Two tables, files, or other objects within the same administered system do not constitute separate sources. Transformation or combination of data performed solely within a business intelligence, visualization, or reporting tool does not by itself satisfy this requirement.
  4. SQL and Analytical Programming: Minimum of two years within the last five years, including hands-on use within the last twenty-four months, using SQL against relational data sources and at least one of Python, R, Scala, Julia, SAS, MATLAB, Stata, or an equivalent general-purpose or statistical analytical programming language to prepare, transform, integrate, automate, analyse, or quality-control data. The candidate shall identify at least one example within the last twenty-four months in which SQL and at least one qualifying analytical programming language were personally used. DAX, Power Query M, VBA, Excel formulas, spreadsheet macros, and comparable reporting or spreadsheet expressions do not satisfy the analytical programming language requirement.
  5. Digital Data Collection and Workflow Modernization: Demonstrated experience within the last five years personally designing or developing at least two structured digital data collection, workflow, low-code/no-code, configured-application, or comparable solutions that reduced reliance on manual, email-driven, or spreadsheet-based information processes. At least one example must have been personally developed or materially enhanced within the last three years. For each example, the candidate shall identify the business process addressed, personal contribution, technology or platform used, previous manual or fragmented process, and resulting operational use. A material enhancement must add new data collection, workflow logic, integration, functionality, or a new user population; cosmetic changes or routine maintenance do not qualify. Multiple components supporting the same workflow and user requirement shall be considered one example.
  6. Business Intelligence and Decision Support: Minimum of three years within the last five years personally developing business intelligence products, analytical products, dashboards, metrics, visualizations, or comparable decision-support products. The candidate shall demonstrate at least one personally developed product used by an identified programme, portfolio, management, or operational user group as part of an active business or decision-making process, rather than solely as a demonstration or proof of concept. The candidate shall identify the information or decision requirement addressed, personal contribution, technology used, user group, and period of operational use. Multiple dashboards, views, or visualizations supporting the same user group and substantially the same information or decision requirement shall be considered one product. Experience limited to supervising, directing, managing, or advising development performed by others does not satisfy this requirement.
  7. Applied Data Modelling, Data Quality, and Governance: Demonstrated hands-on experience within the last five years, including at least one example within the last three years, applying data modelling, data quality, or data-governance practices as part of an operational data or analytical solution. The candidate shall demonstrate practical application in at least two of the following four areas: (1) development of data models or relationships; (2) development of data definitions, metadata, or common data standards; (3) implementation of validation rules or data-quality controls; or (4) implementation of data lineage, stewardship, or authoritative-source controls. The candidate shall provide a brief description of how each claimed area was personally applied. General familiarity with data governance concepts without evidence of practical application does not satisfy this requirement.
  8. Transition, Documentation, and Sustainment: Demonstrated experience within the last five years documenting and transferring at least one data, analytical, or digital solution for continued operation or maintenance by another developer, colleague, support team, platform owner, or operational organization. The candidate shall identify the solution, receiving individual or team, documentation or transition material provided, and method used to manage code or configuration artifacts. The candidate must also demonstrate use within the last three years of at least one of the following: Git or equivalent source control; platform-native solution or environment management supporting versioned deployment; or a documented configuration baseline maintained under change control. Formal transfer between organizations is not required. Internal handover to another appropriately qualified individual or team satisfies this requirement.
  9. Requirements Elicitation and Decision Communication: Minimum of two years within the last five years working directly with operational users, programme personnel, managers, or decision makers to identify information or analytical requirements and communicate findings, assumptions, limitations, risks, or decision implications. The candidate shall identify at least one example including the user or decision-maker group supported, information or analytical requirement addressed, and the candidate's personal role in both elicit

title: DevSecOps Engineer - Clearance Required
description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a highly skilled DevSecOps Engineer to support Army Acquisition, Training, and Readiness (AT&R) in the sustainment and enhancement of the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS). ACWS is built on the Appian Platform. This position will enable secure, repeatable delivery by designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure provisioning, integrating security controls, and supporting scalable cloud and containerized environments.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across development, infrastructure, and cybersecurity disciplines and can translate evolving requirements into clean, scalable, secure technical implementations while supporting an Agile delivery environment.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting ACWS application and infrastructure delivery.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and automation tools such as Ansible.
  • Architect and deploy AWS resources and cloud services that support secure application hosting, integration, monitoring, and operations.
  • Build and deploy secure containerized services using platforms such as OpenShift or Kubernetes.
  • Integrate security scanning, vulnerability detection, automated testing, and security gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build and maintain secure container images and enforce secure configuration standards throughout development and deployment.
  • Administer and monitor containerization platforms, including maintenance, hardening, patching, storage, and service health activities.
  • Support secure deployment and operational integration of Appian-based application services within approved cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline, deployment, infrastructure, integration, and environment issues and drive problems to resolution.
  • Collaborate with application developers, Appian specialists, information assurance personnel, database administrators, and system architects to align delivery with program objectives.
  • Enforce applicable DoD cybersecurity controls, including RMF, NIST SP 800-53, and STIG requirements, throughout build and deployment activities.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including pipeline diagrams, playbooks, system configuration records, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of development, deployment, and operational practices.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 6+ years of experience supporting DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud engineering, systems automation, or related enterprise technology roles.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Experience deploying and operating AWS or comparable cloud solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools and configuration automation.
  • Familiarity with security automation, vulnerability scanning, and integrating security controls into software delivery pipelines.
  • Experience working in Agile software development or enterprise operations environments.
  • Active Secret clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • U.S. citizenship required.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Experience with the Appian Platform, including Appian Cloud or Appian GovCloud environments, preferred.
  • Terraform or Ansible experience or certification.
  • CompTIA Security+, Linux+, or comparable cybersecurity/Linux certification.
  • AWS certification such as Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Security.
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, Tekton, GitLab CI, or comparable CI/CD tooling.
  • Experience with BASH, Python, or Java scripting/programming.
  • Experience applying NIST SP 800-53, RMF, or STIG requirements to cloud and DevSecOps environments.
  • SAFe or Agile DevOps certification and experience supporting PI Planning or similar delivery events.

Target salary range: $100,000 - 166,000

Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

title: Corporate Controller
description:
Corporate Controller

Job Type: Permanent Full Time
Location: Hybrid - Toronto, Ontario
Reporting to: SVP - Finance
Salary: 120k to 150k CAD


Job purpose

The Corporate Controller will lead the global financial close, consolidation, reporting, governance, and control functions. This individual will be responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of financial information across multiple legal entities while streamlining processes, reducing reporting timelines, improving data consistency, and elevating management reporting.

A key mandate of the role will be driving finance transformation initiatives, including the consolidation of financial datasets, systems, and reporting platforms into a streamlined reporting environment. The successful candidate will build a trusted single source of truth, strengthen governance and controls, implement automation, and improve reporting efficiency.

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidations across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
  • Own the preparation and review of consolidated financial results and management reporting packages.
  • Build insightful reporting that highlights KPIs, trends, variances, risks, and opportunities.
  • Reduce month-end reporting timelines while maintaining quality and accuracy.
  • Evaluate and consolidate financial systems, datasets, and reporting processes.
  • Drive automation initiatives and eliminate manual reporting activities.
  • Establish and maintain a single source of truth for financial reporting.
  • Strengthen balance sheet reconciliation processes and ownership accountability.
  • Develop and enforce month-end close schedules, reporting deadlines, and control frameworks.
  • Enhance governance, compliance, and financial controls across the organization.
  • Support annual audits and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Coach and develop finance managers and finance leads globally.
  • Improve commercial acumen, business partnering capabilities, and finance effectiveness.
  • Partner with Finance and Technology teams on ERP, reporting, and transformation initiatives.

What are we looking for?

  • CPA designation required.
  • Big 4 public accounting experience is considered a strong asset.
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge with experience interpreting and applying IFRS and/or US GAAP.
  • Progressive experience in controllership, financial reporting, or finance leadership roles.
  • Significant experience managing multi-entity consolidations and complex reporting environments.
  • Demonstrated success implementing controls, governance frameworks, and process improvements.
  • Strong experience with reporting transformation, finance automation, and systems enhancement initiatives.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex financial analysis, modelling, data manipulation, and reporting automation.
  • Experience with ERP systems, reporting platforms, business intelligence tools, and financial data management solutions.
  • Proven leadership experience developing finance teams.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • Technically strong CPA with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Deep understanding of financial reporting, consolidation methodology, and technical accounting matters.
  • Highly analytical, data-driven, and process-oriented.
  • Builder mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
